translation: April
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: August
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: December
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: February
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: January
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: July
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: June
description: Standalone name of the month of June, used when formatting post timestamps (e.g. in email notifications).

translation: March
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: May
description: Standalone name of the month of May, used when composing translated dates (e.g. in batched email notification subjects).

translation: November
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: October
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: September
description: Month name used standalone when the server formats dates for user-facing text such as email notifications.

translation: A group-synced team cannot have a membership policy applied.
description: API error when applying an attribute-based membership policy to a team whose membership is already managed by group sync.

translation: Render-time access control decisions are not supported for resource type "{{.Type}}".
description: API error when a render-time access control decision is requested for a resource type that has no decision support.

translation: Channel-level permission policies feature is not enabled.
description: API error for admins when channel-level permission policies (attribute-based access control) are not enabled on the server.

translation: Get channels limit is not valid.
description: API validation error for admins listing channels under an access control policy; 'limit' is the pagination page-size parameter.

translation: Get fields limit is not valid.
description: API validation error for admins listing attribute fields for access control; 'limit' is the pagination page-size parameter.

translation: Permission policies feature is not enabled.
description: API error for admins when the permission policies (attribute-based access control) feature is not enabled.

translation: Policy simulation feature is not enabled.
description: API error for admins when the access control policy simulation (rule testing) feature is not enabled.

translation: All users in the simulation must be members of the team or channel in the request.
description: API error in the access control policy simulation tool when some test users are not members of the team or channel being simulated; admin-facing.

translation: Team membership access control feature is not enabled.
description: API error for admins when team-membership access control (policy-managed team membership) is not enabled.

translation: You cannot remove an acknowledgment in an archived channel.
description: API error when removing a message acknowledgment (the 'acknowledge' checkmark on priority posts) in an archived channel.

translation: You cannot delete an acknowledgment after 5min have passed.
description: API error when a user removes their message acknowledgment more than 5 minutes after acknowledging; 'acknowledgment' is the priority-post confirmation feature.

translation: You cannot save an acknowledgment in an archived channel.
description: API error when acknowledging a message in an archived channel; 'acknowledgment' is the priority-post confirmation feature.

translation: Failed to add certificate.
description: API error in the System Console when uploading a certificate file (e.g. for audit log mutual TLS) fails; admin-facing.

translation: No file under 'certificate' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a certificate when the 'certificate' form field contains no file; 'certificate' is a literal form field name.

translation: Too many files under 'certificate' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a certificate (e.g. SAML) when the multipart request has several files in the 'certificate' field; 'certificate' is a literal form field name.

translation: No file under 'certificate' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a certificate when the multipart request lacks a file in the 'certificate' field; 'certificate' is a literal form field name.

translation: Could not open certificate file.
description: API error in the System Console when the uploaded certificate file cannot be opened; used in audit, LDAP, and SAML settings; admin-facing.

translation: Error parsing multiform request
description: Admin API error when the multipart form of a certificate upload cannot be parsed; 'multiform' means multipart form.

translation: Could not save certificate file.
description: API error in the System Console when the uploaded certificate file cannot be saved to disk; used in audit, LDAP, and SAML settings; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to delete brand image, not found.
description: API error in the System Console custom branding settings when deleting the custom brand image fails because none exists; admin-facing.

translation: Error reading log file.
description: Error shown in the System Console when the server log file cannot be read for display.

translation: Image storage is not configured.
description: API error when the custom brand image cannot be served because no file storage is configured; admin-facing.

translation: LDAP is not available.
description: API error when an AD/LDAP operation is attempted but LDAP is not configured or licensed on the server; admin-facing.

translation: Failed to remove certificate.
description: API error in the System Console when deleting a previously uploaded certificate fails; admin-facing.

translation: An error occurred while deleting the certificate.
description: Admin console error shown when deleting an uploaded LDAP or SAML certificate file fails.

translation: Failed to obtain metadata from Identity Provider URL.
description: API error in the System Console SAML setup when fetching metadata from the configured Identity Provider URL fails; admin-facing.

translation: Failure encountered while parsing the metadata information received from the Identity Provider to a certificate.
description: Admin console error when the certificate extracted from the SAML Identity Provider's metadata cannot be parsed; shown while configuring SAML SSO.

translation: Failed to reset AuthData field to Email.
description: Admin console error when resetting SAML users' AuthData database field back to their email fails; 'AuthData' and 'Email' are field names.

translation: Could not save certificate file.
description: Admin console error when the SAML Identity Provider certificate obtained from metadata cannot be written to disk.

translation: Missing Identity Provider SSO Descriptors node in the XML.
description: Admin console error when SAML Identity Provider metadata XML lacks the IDPSSODescriptor element; technical XML node name.

translation: Missing Identity Provider Key Descriptors node in the XML.
description: Admin console error when SAML Identity Provider metadata XML lacks the KeyDescriptor element; technical XML node name.

translation: Missing Identity Provider SSO Services node in the XML.
description: Admin console error when SAML Identity Provider metadata XML lacks the SingleSignOnService element; technical XML node name.

translation: An error occurred while building Service Provider Metadata.
description: Admin console error when generating the Mattermost Service Provider metadata for SAML setup fails; 'Service Provider' is a SAML role term.

translation: SAML 2.0 is not configured or supported on this server.
description: API error when a SAML operation is attempted but SAML 2.0 is not configured or supported on the server; admin-facing.

translation: Invalid certificate text.
description: API error in the System Console SAML setup when the certificate text extracted from IdP metadata is invalid; admin-facing.

translation: Invalid content type.
description: API error in the System Console SAML setup when the request's Content-Type header value is not acceptable; admin-facing.

translation: Missing content type.
description: API error in the System Console SAML setup when the request lacks a Content-Type header; admin-facing.

translation: failed to add user to group-teams and group-channels
description: Lowercase API error when adding a user to the teams and channels linked to their groups fails; 'group-teams' and 'group-channels' are group-synchronized memberships.

translation: An Azure Blob Storage setting is missing or invalid.
description: Admin-facing error from the file storage connection test when an Azure Blob Storage setting is missing or invalid; 'Azure Blob Storage' is a product name.

translation: It appears your Mattermost email is setup correctly!
description: Body text of the test email sent when an admin clicks Test Connection in the System Console SMTP settings.

translation: SMTP Server is required
description: API error in the System Console email connection test when the SMTP server address is not configured; admin-facing.

translation: The SMTP server, port, or username has changed. Please re-enter the SMTP password to test connection.
description: API error in the System Console email connection test asking the admin to re-enter the SMTP password after changing server, port, or username.

translation: Mattermost - Testing Email Settings
description: Subject line of the test email sent when an admin clicks Test Connection in the System Console SMTP settings.

translation: S3 Bucket is required
description: Admin-facing error from the S3 file storage connection test when the bucket name setting is empty; 'S3 Bucket' is an Amazon S3 term.

translation: Empty array under 'image' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a custom brand image when the 'image' form field is empty; 'image' is a literal form field name.

translation: No file under 'image' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a custom brand image when no file is present in the 'image' form field; 'image' is a literal form field name.

translation: Could not parse multipart form.
description: Admin API error when the multipart form of a brand image upload cannot be parsed.

translation: Unable to upload image. Image storage is not configured.
description: API error in the System Console custom branding settings when the brand image cannot be uploaded because file storage is not configured; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to upload file. File is too large.
description: Admin API error when the uploaded custom brand image exceeds the size limit.

translation: Bridge test helper is disabled.
description: API error returned when a testing-only AI bridge endpoint is called on a server without testing mode enabled; audience is developers/QA.

translation: Back to {{.SiteName}}
description: Link label on the mobile login error page that returns the user to the app; {{.SiteName}} is the configured site name (e.g. 'Mattermost').

translation: Bot creation has been disabled.
description: API error when creating a bot account is attempted while bot creation is disabled by configuration; 'Bot' is a bot account.

translation: Please add me to teams and channels you want me to interact in. To do this, use the browser or Mattermost Desktop App.
description: Message a bot sends to a mobile user asking to be added to teams and channels; instructs them to use the browser or the Mattermost Desktop App because mobile cannot do it.

translation: %v added to the channel as guest by %v.
description: System message posted in a channel when a guest is added; first %v is the added guest's username, second %v is the username of the member who added them.

translation: %v added to the channel by %v.
description: System message posted in a channel when a member is added; first %v is the added user's username, second %v is the username of the member who added them.

translation: Error adding channel member(s).
description: API error when adding one or more members to a channel fails; 'member(s)' may be singular or plural.

translation: Channel membership denied to the following users because of group constraints: {{ .UserIDs }}
description: API error when group-synchronized membership rules block adding users to a channel; {{ .UserIDs }} is a list of the denied users' IDs.

translation: Failed to build access control subject for user.
description: Internal error when the attribute-based access control subject (the user's attribute data) cannot be built while adding a user to a channel; technical.

translation: Failed to add user to channel.
description: API error when adding a user to a channel fails for a generic reason.

translation: Failed to add user to channel because they have been removed from the team.
description: API error when a user cannot be added to a channel because they were removed from the containing team.

translation: User does not have required attributes to join the channel.
description: API error when a user cannot join a channel because they do not satisfy the channel's attribute-based access control policy.

translation: Cannot add user to this channel type.
description: API error when adding a user to a channel type that does not accept members this way (e.g. a direct message channel).

translation: Board channels cannot be accessed via /channels endpoints. Use the /boards API instead.
description: API error steering integrators away from using the channels API on board-type channels; '/channels' and '/boards' are literal API endpoint paths.

translation: Board bookmarks are managed by the boards feature and cannot be created, updated, or deleted through the bookmarks API.
description: API error when a client tries to modify a channel bookmark that is auto-managed by the boards feature; 'bookmarks API' refers to the REST endpoints.

translation: Your license does not support channel bookmarks.
description: API error when using channel bookmarks (saved links pinned to a channel) without a license that includes them.

translation: Failed to create the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when creating a channel bookmark is denied because the channel is archived; wording hides the reason.

translation: User is not allowed to create a channel bookmark.
description: API error when a user without the needed rights tries to create a bookmark in a direct or group message channel.

translation: Failed to create the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when a guest user is denied creating a bookmark in a direct/group message channel; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to create the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when creating a channel bookmark is denied for permission reasons; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to delete the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when deleting a channel bookmark is denied because the channel is archived; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to delete the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when deleting a bookmark in a direct/group message channel is denied; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to delete the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when a guest user is denied deleting a bookmark in a direct/group message channel; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to delete the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when deleting a channel bookmark is denied for permission reasons; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when editing a channel bookmark is denied because the channel is archived; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when editing a bookmark in a direct/group message channel is denied; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when a guest user is denied editing a bookmark in a direct/group message channel; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark.
description: Deliberately generic error when editing a channel bookmark is denied for permission reasons; wording hides the reason.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark's sort order.
description: Deliberately generic error when reordering channel bookmarks is denied because the channel is archived; 'sort order' is the bookmark's position in the list.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark's sort order.
description: Deliberately generic error when reordering bookmarks in a direct/group message channel is denied; 'sort order' is the bookmark's position in the list.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark's sort order.
description: Deliberately generic error when a guest is denied reordering bookmarks in a direct/group message channel; 'sort order' is the bookmark's position.

translation: Failed to update the channel bookmark's sort order.
description: Deliberately generic error when reordering channel bookmarks is denied for permission reasons; 'sort order' is the bookmark's position in the list.

translation: This channel has been converted to a Public Channel and can be joined by any team member.
description: System message posted in a channel when it is converted from private to public; explains any team member can now join.

translation: This channel has been converted to a Private Channel.
description: System message posted in a channel when it is converted from public to private.

translation: Your license does not support groups
description: API error when requesting member counts by group without a license that includes user groups; 'groups' are user groups.

translation: You do not have permission to set one of the submitted channel attributes.
description: API error (403) when a user creating a channel supplies a value for a channel attribute (e.g. a classification marking) they are not allowed to set. The message deliberately does not name the attribute.

translation: Channel attributes are not enabled on this server.
description: API error when a channel-creation request includes channel attribute values but the channel attributes / classification markings feature is not enabled or licensed on this server.

translation: Must use createDirectChannel API service for direct message channel creation.
description: Developer-facing API error when the generic channel creation endpoint is used for a direct message channel; 'createDirectChannel' is an API name and must not be translated.

translation: Cannot create a direct channel with a remote user
description: API error when creating a direct message channel with a remote user (from another Mattermost server via shared channels) is not allowed.

translation: A direct channel cannot be created between these users because they do not share a team in common.
description: API error when a direct message channel cannot be created because the two users do not share any team.

translation: One of the submitted channel attributes is not valid for this channel.
description: API error when a channel-creation request includes an attribute value that is malformed, duplicated, unknown, or sent for a direct/group message. The message deliberately does not name the attribute.

translation: Unable to create more than {{.MaxChannelsPerTeam}} channels for current team.
description: API error when channel creation would exceed the per-team channel limit; {{.MaxChannelsPerTeam}} is the maximum number of channels allowed per team.

translation: Missing display_name in request body
description: API validation error when creating a channel; 'display_name' is a literal JSON field name and must not be translated.

translation: This channel is missing required attributes.
description: API error when a user creates a channel without a value for one or more attributes an admin has marked required (e.g. a classification marking).

translation: Missing team_id in request body
description: API validation error when creating a channel; 'team_id' is a literal JSON field name and must not be translated.

translation: Off-Topic
description: Display name of the 'Off-Topic' channel automatically created in every new team.

translation: Town Square
description: Display name of the 'Town Square' default channel automatically created in every new team; every team member belongs to it.

translation: Invalid user ID for direct channel creation.
description: API error when a direct message channel creation request contains an invalid user ID.

translation: Group message channels must contain at least 3 and no more than 8 users.
description: API error when creating a group message with too few or too many participants; group messages need 3 to 8 users.

translation: One of the provided users does not exist.
description: API error when creating a group message with a user ID that does not match any existing user.

translation: Cannot create a group channel with remote users
description: API error when creating a group message that includes remote users (from other Mattermost servers via shared channels) is not allowed.

translation: %v archived the channel.
description: System message posted in a channel when it is archived; %v is the username of the person who archived it.

translation: Unable to delete the default channel {{.Channel}}.
description: API error when someone tries to archive a team's default channel; {{.Channel}} is the default channel's name (e.g. Town Square).

translation: The channel has been archived or deleted.
description: API error when an action targets a channel that has already been archived or deleted.

translation: Unable to delete direct or group message channels
description: API error when a client tries to archive a direct message or group message channel, which is not allowed.

translation: You are already a member of this channel.
description: API error shown when a user requests to join a discoverable private channel they already belong to.

translation: Cannot request to join an archived channel.
description: API error shown when a user requests to join a channel that has been archived.

translation: This channel requires admin approval to join. Please send a request from the Browse Channels modal.
description: Error when directly joining a discoverable channel that needs approval; 'Browse Channels' is the name of a UI modal in the app.

translation: You already have a pending request to join this channel.
description: API error shown when a user submits a join request for a channel where they already have one pending.

translation: Discoverable channels are not enabled on this server.
description: API error when requesting to join a discoverable channel while the discoverable channels feature is turned off.

translation: Guests cannot request to join discoverable private channels.
description: API error shown when a guest account tries to request access to a discoverable private channel; guests are not allowed to.

translation: Invalid update for the channel join request.
description: API error returned when an update to a channel join request (approve/deny) contains invalid data.

translation: This channel is not discoverable.
description: API error shown when requesting to join a private channel that has not been made discoverable (visible in channel browsing).

translation: The join request is no longer pending.
description: API error shown when acting on a join request that has already been approved, denied, or withdrawn.

translation: Only private channels accept join requests.
description: API error shown when submitting a join request for a public channel; join requests only apply to private channels.

translation: You do not satisfy the access rules required to join this channel.
description: API error shown when a user's join request is blocked because they do not meet the channel's attribute-based access rules.

translation: Shared channels do not accept discoverable join requests.
description: API error when a join request targets a shared channel (a channel connected across servers), which does not support discoverable join requests.

translation: Channel ID does not match the channel ID of the flagged post.
description: API error in the content-flagging (post review) flow when the channel ID in the request differs from the flagged post's channel.

translation: Your license does not support channel moderation
description: API error when reading channel moderation settings without a license that includes channel moderation.

translation: User is not allowed to convert group message to private channel
description: API error when a user lacks permission to convert a group message conversation into a private channel.

translation: {{.ConvertedByUsername}} created this channel from a group message with {{.GMMembers}}.
description: System message posted when a group message conversation is converted into a private channel; {{.ConvertedByUsername}} is who converted it and {{.GMMembers}} is the list of the group message participants.

translation: %v joined the channel as guest.
description: System message posted in a channel when a guest joins on their own; %v is the guest's username.

translation: You do not have the appropriate permissions.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to join a channel.

translation: %v joined the channel.
description: System message posted in a channel when a user joins; %v is the user's username.

translation: Unable to leave the default channel {{.Channel}}.
description: Ephemeral error when a user tries to leave the team's default channel via the /leave slash command; {{.Channel}} is the default channel's name (e.g. Town Square).

translation: Unable to leave a direct message channel.
description: API error when a user attempts to leave a direct message channel, which is not possible.

translation: %v left the channel.
description: System message posted in a channel when a user leaves; %v is the user's username.

translation: Unable to move direct or group message channels
description: API error when a client tries to move a direct message or group message channel to another team, which is not allowed.

translation: Error invalidating cache
description: Internal error when clearing cached data fails while updating channel moderation (per-channel permission) settings; technical, admin-facing.

translation: Your license does not support channel moderation
description: API error when changing channel moderation settings without a license that includes channel moderation.

translation: Cannot add a permission that is restricted by the team or system permission scheme.
description: API error in channel moderation settings when trying to grant a permission that the team or system permission scheme has restricted; admin-facing.

translation: Auto translation is not allowed for this channel.
description: API error when enabling automatic message translation on a channel where it is restricted.

translation: Cannot update a managed category for this channel without the correct permissions.
description: API error when updating a channel would modify a managed sidebar category the user cannot change; 'category' is a sidebar category.

translation: Auto translation feature is not available.
description: API error when a channel update tries to use automatic message translation but the feature is unavailable on the server.

translation: Failed to update the channel.
description: Deliberately generic API error when a channel update is denied; wording hides the specific reason from the caller.

translation: You are not allowed to set group_constrained on this channel type.
description: API error updating a channel; 'group_constrained' is a literal JSON field name (group-synchronized membership) and must not be translated.

translation: No changes in the patch.
description: API error when a channel patch request contains no fields that would change anything; 'patch' is a partial update request.

translation: Cannot update a restricted direct message channel.
description: API error when trying to modify a restricted direct message channel, which cannot be updated.

translation: You are not allowed to update the name, display_name, and purpose of direct or group messages.
description: API error updating a direct/group message channel; 'name', 'display_name', and 'purpose' are literal JSON field names and must not be translated.

translation: Failed to post channel privacy update message.
description: Internal error when posting the system message announcing a channel privacy change (public/private) fails.

translation: Failed to post Auto-translation update message.
description: Internal error when posting the system message announcing an auto-translation setting change for a channel fails.

translation: @%s disabled Auto-translation for this channel. All new messages will appear in the original language.
description: System message posted in a channel when auto-translation is turned off; %s is the username of the person who disabled it (rendered as an @mention).

translation: @%s enabled Auto-translation for this channel. All new messages will appear in your preferred language.
description: System post message shown in a channel when a member turns on Auto-translation; %s is the username of that member (rendered as an @mention).

translation: Failed to retrieve user while updating Auto-translation status
description: API error returned when the server cannot look up the acting user before posting the Auto-translation change system message.

translation: Failed to post displayname update message
description: API error returned when the system message announcing a channel display name change could not be posted.

translation: Failed to retrieve user while updating channel DisplayName field
description: API error returned when the server cannot look up the acting user before posting the display name change system message.

translation: %s updated the channel display name from: %s to: %s
description: System post message shown in a channel when its display name changes; the three %s placeholders are the acting user's username, the old display name, and the new display name, in that order.

translation: Failed to post update channel header message
description: API error returned when the system message announcing a channel header change could not be posted.

translation: %s removed the channel header (was: %s)
description: System post message shown in a channel when a member removes the channel header; first %s is the member's username, second %s is the old header text.

translation: Failed to retrieve user while updating channel header
description: API error returned when the server cannot look up the acting user before posting the channel header change system message.

translation: %s updated the channel header from: %s to: %s
description: System post message shown in a channel when its header changes; the three %s placeholders are the acting user's username, the old header text, and the new header text, in that order.

translation: %s updated the channel header to: %s
description: System post message shown in a channel when a header is set for the first time; first %s is the member's username, second %s is the new header text.

translation: Failed to post join/leave message
description: API error returned when a system message announcing a user joining or leaving a channel or team could not be posted.

translation: Unable to remove user from the default channel {{.Channel}}.
description: API error returned when trying to remove a user from the team's default channel; {{.Channel}} is that channel's name (e.g. town-square).

translation: Unable to remove user from a channel.
description: API error when removing a member from a channel type that does not allow it (e.g. a direct message channel).

translation: Unable to remove a user from a group-constrained channel.
description: API error when removing a member from a channel whose membership is synchronized from user groups (group-constrained).

translation: %v removed from the channel.
description: System post message shown in a channel when a member is removed; %v is the removed user's @username. Clients usually render their own message, so this is mainly a fallback.

translation: Channel membership removal denied to the following users because of group constraints: {{ .UserIDs }}
description: API error returned when group-synced membership rules prevent removing users from a channel; {{.UserIDs}} is a list of the affected user IDs.

translation: Cannot remove user from this channel type.
description: API error returned when removing a user from a channel is not possible for that channel type (e.g. a direct or group message).

translation: You cannot rename a direct message channel.
description: API error returned when a user tries to rename a direct message channel, which is not allowed.

translation: You cannot rename a group message channel.
description: API error returned when a user tries to rename a group message channel, which is not allowed.

translation: Unable to unarchive channel. The channel is not archived.
description: API error returned when trying to unarchive a channel that is not archived; 'unarchive' means restoring an archived channel.

translation: {{.Username}} unarchived the channel.
description: System post message shown in a channel after it is unarchived (restored); {{.Username}} is the username of the person or bot who restored it.

translation: Cannot set members on a group-constrained channel.
description: API error when replacing the member list of a channel whose membership is synchronized from user groups.

translation: Cannot set members on a policy-enforced channel.
description: API error when replacing the member list of a channel whose membership is controlled by an access control policy.

translation: Cannot set members on this channel type.
description: API error when replacing the member list on a channel type that does not support it (e.g. direct or group messages).

translation: Space channels cannot be accessed via /channels endpoints. Use the spaces API instead.
description: API error steering integrators away from using the channels API on space-type channels; '/channels' is a literal API endpoint path and 'spaces' is a feature name.

translation: Channel banner can only be configured on Public and Private channels.
description: API error when configuring a channel banner on an unsupported channel type; 'Public' and 'Private' are channel types.

translation: The channel has been archived or deleted.
description: API error when trying to modify a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: Policy enforced channels cannot be updated.
description: API error returned when a user tries to edit a channel whose settings are locked by an access-control policy.

translation: This channel has an attribute-based membership policy applied. Remove the policy before converting between public and private.
description: API error returned when converting a channel between public and private is blocked because an attribute-based access policy is applied to it.

translation: Tried to perform an invalid update of the default channel {{.Channel}}.
description: API error when an update is not allowed on the team's default channel; {{.Channel}} is the default channel's name (e.g. town-square).

translation: Channel type cannot be updated.
description: API error when an update attempts to change a channel's type (public/private) through an endpoint that forbids it.

translation: You are not allowed to update the name, display_name, and purpose of direct or group messages.
description: API error updating a direct/group message channel; 'name', 'display_name', and 'purpose' are literal JSON field names and must not be translated.

translation: Auto-translation is not enabled for this channel.
description: API error when a user turns on automatic message translation for themselves in a channel where the feature is not enabled.

translation: Auto-translation is not available.
description: API error when a user tries to change their per-channel automatic translation setting but the feature is unavailable on the server.

translation: Invalid channel member update: You can't add or remove the guest role manually.
description: API error returned when a role update tries to add or remove the guest role directly; guest status can only change through promotion/demotion.

translation: Invalid channel member update: A guest cannot be made team member or team admin, please promote as a user first.
description: API error returned when trying to give team roles to a guest account; the guest must first be promoted to a regular user.

translation: Invalid channel member update: A user must be a guest or an admin but not both.
description: API error (400) returned from App.UpdateChannelMemberRoles when a request tries to give one channel member both the guest role and the channel admin role. Shown to an admin in the client as the reason the role change was rejected.

translation: Invalid channel member update: A user must be a guest or a user but not both.
description: API error returned when a member role update assigns both the guest and regular user roles at once, which is invalid.

translation: The provided role is managed by a Scheme and therefore cannot be applied directly to a Channel Member.
description: API error returned when trying to assign a scheme-managed role directly to a channel member; 'Scheme' is the Mattermost permissions scheme feature.

translation: Invalid channel member update: A channel member always has a user scheme.
description: API error returned when a role update would leave a channel member without the base user scheme role, which is invalid.

translation: Invalid channel member update: A guest cannot be set for a single channel, a System Admin must promote or demote users to/from guests.
description: API error returned when trying to mark someone as a guest in a single channel; guest status is account-wide and only a System Admin can change it.

translation: The default channel cannot be made private.
description: API error when converting the team's default channel (e.g. Town Square) to private, which is not allowed.

translation: Your license does not support updating a channel's scheme
description: API error when setting a channel's permissions scheme without a supporting license; 'scheme' is a permissions scheme.

translation: Unable to set the scheme to the channel because the supplied scheme is not a channel scheme.
description: API error when the permissions scheme assigned to a channel is not scoped for channels (e.g. it is a team scheme).

translation: Invalid team member update: You can't add or remove the guest role manually.
description: API error when a role update on a team member tries to add or remove the guest role, which can only change via promoting/demoting the account.

translation: The provided role is managed by a Scheme and therefore cannot be applied directly to a Team Member.
description: API error when a role controlled by a permissions scheme is assigned directly to a team member; 'Scheme' is the permissions-scheme feature term.

translation: Internal error during cloud api request.
description: Generic error for requests to the Mattermost Cloud billing/subscription API; admin audience.

translation: Webhook event was not handled. Either it is missing or it is not valid.
description: Error when a webhook sent by the Mattermost customer portal (CWS) has an unknown or missing event type; admin/log audience.

translation: Your license does not support cloud requests.
description: API error when Cloud-only endpoints are called on a server whose license is not a Cloud license; admin audience.

translation: Already notified admin
description: API error returned when a user tries to send the 'notify admin to upgrade the plan' request again after already sending it.

translation: Error processing request to CWS.
description: Error when a request to CWS (the Mattermost customer web server / customer portal) fails; admin audience.

translation: Integrations have been limited to admins only.
description: Error when a non-admin tries to manage integrations (slash commands, webhooks) while the server restricts integration management to admins.

translation: Specified user is not a member of specified channel.
description: API error returned when a slash command's response tries to post as a user who is not in the target channel.

translation: Commands have been disabled by the system admin.
description: API error shown when a user runs a slash command while custom commands are disabled server-wide by the System Admin.

translation: This trigger word is already in use. Please choose another word.
description: API error shown when creating a slash command whose trigger word is already taken; the 'trigger' is the word typed after '/'.

translation: Command '{{.Trigger}}' failed to post response. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: Error shown in the channel when a slash command ran but its response could not be posted; {{.Trigger}} is the command's trigger word.

translation: Cannot run command in deleted channel.
description: Error when a user runs a slash command in a channel that has been archived; 'command' is a slash command.

translation: Command with a trigger of '{{.Trigger}}' failed.
description: Error shown when executing a slash command fails; {{.Trigger}} is the command's trigger word (the word after '/').

translation: Command with a trigger of '{{.Trigger}}' returned an empty response.
description: Error shown when a slash command's integration returned no content; {{.Trigger}} is the command's trigger word.

translation: Command with a trigger of '{{.Trigger}}' returned response {{.Status}}.
description: Error shown when a slash command's integration returned an HTTP error; {{.Trigger}} is the trigger word and {{.Status}} is the HTTP status.

translation: Command trigger word is missing the leading slash character
description: API error returned when a slash command request does not start with the '/' character.

translation: Command with a trigger of '{{.Trigger}}' not found. To send a message beginning with "/", try adding an empty space at the beginning of the message.
description: Error shown when the typed slash command does not exist; {{.Trigger}} is the attempted trigger word. The advice about a leading space tells users how to send a literal message starting with '/'.

translation: Request hostname differs from configured SiteURL. The configured SiteURL will be used for the slash command response URL.
description: Server log warning (seen by admins) when a slash command request's hostname does not match the configured Site URL; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name.

translation: Cannot post in a restricted DM
description: Error when a user runs a slash command in a restricted direct message channel (a DM where posting is blocked, e.g. with a deactivated user).

translation: SiteURL must be configured to use slash commands
description: API error returned when slash commands cannot run because the server's Site URL setting is empty; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name.

translation: No command trigger found.
description: Error when the text a user entered does not match any slash command; 'trigger' is the command's trigger word after the slash.

translation: Send an email invite to your Mattermost team
description: Autocomplete description for the /invite_people slash command, which emails team invitations to the given addresses.

translation: Email invitations are disabled, no invite(s) sent
description: Ephemeral notice when the /invite_people slash command is used but the admin has disabled email invitations.

translation: Email has not been configured, no invite(s) sent
description: Ephemeral notice when the /invite_people slash command is used but the server has no email (SMTP) configured.

translation: Encountered an error sending email invite(s)
description: Ephemeral error when the /invite_people slash command fails to send the invitation emails.

translation: [name@domain.com ...]
description: Autocomplete argument hint for the /invite_people slash command showing an example email address list; keep the bracket notation.

translation: User creation has been disabled on this server, no invite(s) sent
description: Ephemeral notice when the /invite_people slash command is used but account creation is disabled on the server.

translation: invite_people
description: Display name of the /invite_people slash command in the slash command autocomplete list; keep the underscore form.

translation: Please specify one or more valid email addresses
description: Ephemeral error when the /invite_people slash command is run without any valid email address.

translation: Email invite(s) sent
description: Ephemeral confirmation after the /invite_people slash command successfully sends the invitation emails.

translation: No permission to move command
description: API error when a user lacks permission to move a custom slash command to another team.

translation: A single quote near `{{.Near}}` is not closed before ` --`. Close it, or use double quotes if the value contains ` --`.
description: Slash command error when a single quoted argument value reaches a flag before its closing quote. {{.Near}} is the nearest flag (such as --name) or the command action, never the value itself.

translation: Unexpected text near `{{.Near}}`. Wrap a value that contains spaces in quotes, and use double quotes if the value also contains an apostrophe.
description: Slash command error when a word is not the action, a flag or a flag's value, usually because a value with spaces was not quoted. {{.Near}} is the nearest flag (such as --name) or the command action, never the value itself.

translation: A quote near `{{.Near}}` is never closed.
description: Slash command error when a quoted argument value has no closing quote. {{.Near}} is the nearest flag (such as --name) or the command action, never the value itself.

translation: Unable to update commands across teams.
description: API error when an update would move a slash command from one team to another, which is not allowed; 'commands' are slash commands.

translation: Set your status away
description: Description of the built-in /away slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; sets the user's presence to Away.

translation: away
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that sets presence to Away; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: You are now away
description: Confirmation message shown to the user after /away sets their presence status to Away.

translation: Error to retrieve the current channel.
description: Error shown when the /header slash command cannot load the channel it was run in.

translation: Edit the channel header
description: Description of the built-in /header slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; the channel header is the text shown at the top of a channel.

translation: [text]
description: Argument hint for the /header command shown in autocomplete; '[text]' is placeholder syntax indicating the user types the new header text.

translation: Text must be provided with the /header command.
description: Error shown when /header is run without any text argument; '/header' is the literal command and should stay untranslated.

translation: header
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that edits the channel header; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: You don't have the appropriate permissions to edit the channel header.
description: Permission error shown when a user without edit rights runs /header to change the channel header.

translation: Error updating the channel header.
description: Error shown when saving the new channel header from the /header command fails.

translation: The text entered exceeds the character limit. The channel header is limited to {{.MaxLength}} characters.
description: Error shown when the text given to /header is too long; {{.MaxLength}} is the maximum character count for a channel header.

translation: Error retrieving the current channel.
description: Error shown when the /purpose slash command cannot load the channel it was run in.

translation: Edit the channel purpose
description: Description of the built-in /purpose slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; 'purpose' is the channel's description field.

translation: Unable to set purpose for direct message channels. Use /header to set the header instead.
description: Error shown when /purpose is used in a direct or group message, which has no purpose field; '/header' is a literal command name and should stay untranslated.

translation: [text]
description: Argument hint for the /purpose command shown in autocomplete; '[text]' is placeholder syntax indicating the user types the new purpose text.

translation: A message must be provided with the /purpose command.
description: Error shown when /purpose is run without any text argument; '/purpose' is the literal command and should stay untranslated.

translation: purpose
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that edits the channel purpose; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: You don't have the appropriate permissions to edit the channel purpose.
description: Permission error shown when a user without edit rights runs /purpose to change the channel purpose.

translation: Error updating the channel purpose.
description: Error shown when saving the new channel purpose from the /purpose command fails.

translation: The text entered exceeds the character limit. The channel purpose is limited to {{.MaxLength}} characters.
description: Error shown when the text given to /purpose is too long; {{.MaxLength}} is the maximum character count for a channel purpose.

translation: Error retrieving the current channel.
description: Ephemeral error for the /remove or /kick slash command when the server fails to load the current channel.

translation: Error retrieving the current channel.
description: Error shown when the /rename slash command cannot load the channel it was run in.

translation: Rename the channel
description: Description of the built-in /rename slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; renames the current channel.

translation: Unable to rename direct message channels.
description: Error shown when /rename is used in a direct or group message channel, which cannot be renamed.

translation: [text]
description: Argument hint for the /rename command shown in autocomplete; '[text]' is placeholder syntax indicating the user types the new channel name.

translation: A message must be provided with the /rename command.
description: Error shown when /rename is run without a new name; '/rename' is the literal command and should stay untranslated.

translation: rename
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that renames a channel; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: You don't have the appropriate permissions to rename the channel.
description: Permission error shown when a user without edit rights runs /rename to rename the channel.

translation: Channel name must be {{.Length}} or fewer characters.
description: Error shown when the new channel name given to /rename exceeds the maximum length; {{.Length}} is the character limit.

translation: Channel name must be {{.Length}} or more characters.
description: Error shown when the new channel name given to /rename is below the minimum length; {{.Length}} is the minimum character count.

translation: Error updating the current channel.
description: Error shown when saving the renamed channel from the /rename command fails.

translation: Display text as a code block
description: Description of the built-in /code slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; posts the text formatted as a monospace code block.

translation: [text]
description: Argument hint for the /code command shown in autocomplete; '[text]' is placeholder syntax indicating the user types the text to format as code.

translation: A message must be provided with the /code command.
description: Error shown when /code is run without any text argument; '/code' is the literal command and should stay untranslated.

translation: code
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that posts text as a code block; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: Turn on auto-collapsing of image previews
description: Description of the built-in /collapse slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; enables auto-collapsing of inline image previews.

translation: collapse
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that collapses image previews; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: Image links now collapse by default
description: Ephemeral confirmation posted after a user runs the /collapse slash command, which sets image previews to be collapsed by default.

translation: Error setting the status.
description: Error shown when the /status slash command fails to set the user's custom status; 'status' here is the custom status message/emoji, not presence.

translation: Error clearing the status.
description: Error shown when '/status clear' fails to remove the user's custom status.

translation: Your status was cleared.
description: Confirmation message shown after the user's custom status message is cleared via /status clear.

translation: Set or clear your status
description: Description of the built-in /status slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; sets or clears the custom status (emoji + message).

translation: [:emoji_name:] [status_message] or clear
description: Argument hint for the /status command shown in autocomplete; bracketed parts are placeholder syntax for an emoji name and status text, and 'clear' is a literal subcommand.

translation: status
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command for setting a custom status; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: Your status is set to “{{.EmojiName}} {{.StatusMessage}}”. You can change your status from the status popover in the channel sidebar header.
description: Confirmation message after setting a custom status via /status; {{.EmojiName}} is the chosen emoji and {{.StatusMessage}} the status text, and 'status popover' refers to the status menu in the sidebar header.

translation: Do not disturb disables desktop and mobile push notifications.
description: Description of the built-in /dnd slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; 'Do not disturb' is the presence mode that silences notifications.

translation: dnd
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that toggles Do Not Disturb; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: Do Not Disturb is enabled. You will not receive desktop or mobile push notifications until Do Not Disturb is turned off.
description: Confirmation message shown after /dnd enables Do Not Disturb mode, explaining that notifications are silenced.

translation: Delays must be under 10000 seconds.
description: Error shown when the delay argument given to /echo exceeds the allowed maximum in seconds.

translation: Echo back text from your account
description: Description of the built-in /echo slash command shown in the command autocomplete list; reposts the given text as the user after an optional delay.

translation: High volume of echo request, cannot process request.
description: Error shown when too many /echo requests are queued and the command is throttled.

translation: 'message' [delay in seconds]
description: Argument hint for the /echo command shown in autocomplete; 'message' in quotes is the text to echo and the bracketed part is an optional delay in seconds.

translation: A message must be provided with the /echo command.
description: Error shown when /echo is run without any text argument; '/echo' is the literal command and should stay untranslated.

translation: echo
description: Trigger word of the built-in slash command that echoes text back; typed after '/', must be a single lowercase word with no spaces.

translation: Turn off auto-collapsing of image previews
description: Autocomplete description for the /expand slash command, shown in the slash command suggestion list.

translation: expand
description: Display name of the /expand slash command in the slash command autocomplete list; 'expand' refers to expanding image previews.

translation: Image links now expand by default
description: Ephemeral confirmation posted after a user runs the /expand slash command, which sets image previews to expand by default.

translation: An error occurred while expanding previews.
description: Ephemeral error shown when the /expand or /collapse slash command fails to save the preference; the raw error text is appended directly after this sentence.

translation: Generate a link to download an export.
description: Autocomplete description for the /exportlink slash command (system admins only), which generates a download link for a compliance export file; 'export' is a noun.

translation: The file store driver does not support link generation.
description: Ephemeral error for the /exportlink slash command when the configured file storage backend cannot generate download links.

translation: No export file has been found.
description: Ephemeral error for the /exportlink slash command when no export file exists in the export directory.

translation: [job-id|zip filename|{{.LatestMsg}}]
description: Autocomplete argument hint for the /exportlink slash command showing the accepted argument forms; {{.LatestMsg}} is the literal keyword 'latest'. Keep the [x|y|z] notation.

translation: Unable to find the file you requested.
description: Ephemeral error for the /exportlink slash command when the given argument does not match any export file.

translation:
You can download your file here: {{.Link}}.
This link will expire in {{.Expiration}}.
description: Ephemeral message from the /exportlink slash command containing the generated download link; {{.Link}} is the presigned URL and {{.Expiration}} is a duration like '6h0m0s'.

translation: Unable to retrieve the export list.
description: Ephemeral error for the /exportlink slash command when listing files in the export directory fails; 'export' is a noun.

translation: exportlink
description: Display name of the /exportlink slash command in the slash command autocomplete list.

translation: You don't have enough permissions to run this command.
description: Ephemeral error when a user without system admin permission runs the /exportlink slash command.

translation: Unable to generate presign url.
description: Ephemeral error for the /exportlink slash command when generating the presigned download URL fails.

translation: Sends a Group Message to the specified users
description: Autocomplete description for the /groupmsg slash command, which starts a group message conversation with several users.

translation: An error occurred while messaging the users.
description: Ephemeral error when the /groupmsg slash command fails to send the message to the group.

translation: An error occurred while creating the group message.
description: Ephemeral error when the /groupmsg slash command fails to create the group message channel.

translation: @[username1],@[username2] 'message'
description: Autocomplete argument hint for the /groupmsg slash command; keep the @[username] placeholders and quoting notation as-is.
Ephemeral error for the /groupmsg slash command; {{.Users}} is a comma-separated list of the usernames that could not be found; the plural branches distinguish one vs several unknown users.

translation: Group messages are limited to a maximum of {{.MaxUsers}} users.
description: Ephemeral error when a /groupmsg slash command targets too many users; {{.MaxUsers}} is the numeric maximum allowed in a group message.

translation: Group messages are limited to a minimum of {{.MinUsers}} users.
description: Ephemeral error when a /groupmsg slash command targets too few users; {{.MinUsers}} is the numeric minimum required for a group message.

translation: message
description: Display name of the /groupmsg slash command in the slash command autocomplete list; 'message' is a noun here.

translation: You don't have the appropriate permissions to create a new group message.
description: Ephemeral error when the user lacks permission to create a group message via the /groupmsg slash command.

translation: Show Mattermost help message
description: Autocomplete description for the /help slash command, which posts a help message.

translation: help
description: Display name of the /help slash command in the slash command autocomplete list.

translation:
Mattermost is an open source platform for secure communication, collaboration, and orchestration of work across tools and teams.
Mattermost contains two key tools:

**Channels** - Stay connected with your team via 1:1 and group messaging.
**[Playbooks](/playbooks)** - Build and configure repeatable processes to achieve specific and predictable outcomes.

[View documentation and guides]({{.HelpLink}})
description: Ephemeral Markdown message posted by the /help slash command describing Mattermost; {{.HelpLink}} is the documentation URL; keep the Markdown links and bold formatting.

translation: Error retrieving the current channel.
description: Ephemeral error for the /invite slash command when the server fails to load the channel the command was run in.

translation: Could not find the channel {{.Channel}}. Please use the [channel handle](https://docs.mattermost.com/messaging/managing-channels.html#naming-a-channel) to identify channels.
description: Ephemeral Markdown error for the /invite slash command; {{.Channel}} is the channel name the user typed; keep the Markdown documentation link.

translation: This channel is managed by groups. This user is not part of a group that is synced to this channel.
description: Ephemeral error for the /invite slash command when the target channel's membership is managed by (LDAP/AD) groups and the invited user is not in a synced group.

translation: Invite a user to a channel
description: Autocomplete description for the /invite slash command, which adds a user to a channel.

translation: You can't add someone to a direct message channel.
description: Ephemeral error when the /invite slash command is used in a direct message channel, where members cannot be added.

translation: An error occurred while joining the channel.
description: Ephemeral generic error when the /invite slash command fails to add the user to the channel.

translation: @[username]... ~[channel]...
description: Autocomplete argument hint for the /invite slash command; @[username] and ~[channel] are placeholder notations for a mention and channel handle; keep the symbols.

translation: Missing Username and/or Channel.
description: Ephemeral error when the /invite slash command is run without a username or channel argument.

translation: We couldn't find the user {{.User}}. They may have been deactivated by the System Administrator.
description: Ephemeral error for the /invite slash command; {{.User}} is the @username that could not be found.

translation: invite
description: Display name of the /invite slash command in the slash command autocomplete list; 'invite' is a verb.

translation: You don't have enough permissions to add {{.User}} in {{.Channel}}.
description: Ephemeral error for the /invite slash command; {{.User}} is the target @username and {{.Channel}} is the channel name the user lacks permission to add members to.

translation: Could not find the channel {{.Channel}}. Please use the [channel handle](https://docs.mattermost.com/messaging/managing-channels.html#naming-a-channel) to identify channels.
description: Ephemeral Markdown error for the /invite slash command when the named private channel is not found; {{.Channel}} is the channel name typed; keep the Markdown documentation link.

translation: {{.User}} added to {{.Channel}} channel.
description: Ephemeral confirmation for the /invite slash command; {{.User}} is the added @username and {{.Channel}} is the channel name.

translation: {{.FirstUser}} and {{.Others}} added to {{.Channel}} channel.
description: Confirmation message from the /invite slash command when more than 10 users were added at once; {{.FirstUser}} is one @username, {{.Others}} the count of additional users, {{.Channel}} the channel name.
Ephemeral notice for the /invite slash command; {{.User}} is one @username in the 'one' branch and a list of @usernames in the 'other' branch.

translation: {{.FirstUser}} and {{.Others}} others are already in the channel.
description: Ephemeral notice for the /invite slash command when many invited users are already members; {{.FirstUser}} is one @username and {{.Others}} is the count of additional users.

translation: You can add {{.Users}} to this channel once they are members of the **{{.Team}}** team.
description: Ephemeral notice for the /invite slash command; {{.Users}} is a list of @usernames and {{.Team}} is the team name; keep the bold Markdown around the team name.

translation: You can add {{.FirstUser}} and {{.Others}} others to this channel once they are members of the **{{.Team}}** team.
description: Ephemeral notice for the /invite slash command when many invited users are not team members; {{.FirstUser}} is one @username, {{.Others}} is a count, and {{.Team}} is the team name in bold Markdown.

translation: You don't have permission to invite new users to this server.

description: API error when using the data spillage (flagged content review) feature without a license that includes it; 'Data Spillage Handling' is a feature name.

translation: Data Spillage Handling feature is not enabled on this team.
description: API error when data spillage handling (flagged content review) is not enabled for the team where the post lives.

translation: The quarantined post must be in pending or assigned status to be kept or removed.
description: API error returned when a reviewer tries to keep or remove a quarantined (flagged) post that is not in a reviewable state; part of the content flagging / data spillage review feature.

translation: Unknown reason specified for quarantining message.
description: API validation error shown when the reason chosen for flagging/quarantining a message is not one of the admin-configured reasons; 'message' means a chat post.

translation: Please select a reason for quarantining this message.
description: API validation error shown to a user flagging a message for quarantine without selecting a reason; 'message' means a chat post.

translation: The user is not a content reviewer.
description: API error when someone who is not a designated content reviewer tries to act on flagged content; 'content reviewer' is a role in the feature.

translation: Failed to write the post exposure report.
description: API error (500) returned to a content reviewer when the post exposure report CSV could not be serialized for download. Short error detail, not a title.

translation: Failed to open the generated flagged post report file.
description: API error when the generated report file of flagged posts cannot be opened for download; admin/reviewer audience.

translation: Failed to read the flagged post report file information.
description: API error when reading file metadata of the flagged post report fails before download; admin/reviewer audience.

translation: Post delivery audit logging is not enabled on this server.
description: API error when a post delivery audit logging endpoint is called while the feature is disabled on the server.

translation: Your license does not support post delivery audit logging.
description: API error when a post delivery audit logging endpoint is called on a server whose license does not include the feature.

translation: Cannot save draft to deleted channel.
description: API error returned when saving a message draft in a channel that has been archived/deleted; 'draft' is an unsent saved message.

translation: Cannot save draft to restricted direct message channel
description: API error returned when saving a message draft in a direct message conversation the user is restricted from messaging.

translation: Drafts feature is disabled.
description: API error when the synced message drafts feature is turned off on the server and a client calls a drafts endpoint.

translation: Elasticsearch settings has unset values.
description: Admin console error when testing the Elasticsearch connection with incomplete settings; 'Elasticsearch' is a product name.

translation: Email batching job's receiving channel was full. Please increase the EmailBatchingBufferSize.
description: Server error when the email batching job's internal queue is full; 'channel' here is a Go processing queue, not a chat channel, and 'EmailBatchingBufferSize' is a config setting name that should stay untranslated.

translation: Email batching has been disabled by the system administrator.
description: Server error when a notification cannot be batched because the admin disabled the email batching feature.

translation: Open Mattermost
description: Main button label in the batched notification email; opens the Mattermost site.

translation: View this message
description: Per-message button label in the batched notification email; opens that specific message in Mattermost.

translation: See below for a summary of your new messages.
description: Subtitle in the batched notification email, above the list of new messages.
Subject line of the batched notification email; plural branches depend on the number of notifications, and {{.Month}} {{.Day}} {{.Year}} form the date.

translation: {{.Hour}}:{{.Minute}} {{.TimeZone}}
description: Timestamp format shown next to each message in the batched notification email; {{.Hour}}, {{.Minute}} and {{.TimeZone}} are time components — reorder to fit local conventions.

translation: You have new messages
description: Heading of the batched notification email summarizing new unread messages.

translation: Unable to create emoji. Another emoji with the same name already exists.
description: API error shown when creating a custom emoji whose name is already taken by another emoji.

translation: server_error: Encountered internal server error creating the emoji.
description: Bulk import error when saving a custom emoji fails; the 'server_error:' prefix is a technical marker.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error returned when a custom emoji creation request claims a different creator's user ID than the authenticated user.

translation: Unable to create emoji. Could not understand request.
description: API error when a custom emoji creation request cannot be parsed; shown when uploading a custom emoji.

translation: Unable to create emoji. Image must be less than 512 KiB in size.
description: Error shown when uploading a custom emoji image bigger than the limit; '512 KiB' is the fixed size limit.

translation: Custom emoji have been disabled by the system admin.
description: Error shown to end users trying to create or use custom emoji when the system admin has disabled the feature.

translation: Unable to decode image file for emoji.
description: API error returned when the stored image of a custom emoji cannot be decoded when serving it.

translation: Unable to read image file for emoji.
description: API error returned when the stored image file of a custom emoji cannot be read from file storage.

translation: Unable to get that many emojis by name. Only {{.MaxNames}} emojis can be requested at once.
description: API validation error when fetching emojis by name in bulk; {{.MaxNames}} is the maximum number of names allowed per request.

translation: File storage not configured properly. Please configure for either S3 or local server file storage.
description: Admin-facing API error when custom emoji cannot be used because the server's file storage (S3 or local) is misconfigured.

translation: Unable to create emoji. File must be a PNG, JPEG, or GIF.
description: API error shown when a custom emoji upload is not one of the accepted image formats; PNG, JPEG and GIF are format names.

translation: Unable to create emoji. An error occurred when trying to decode the image.
description: API error shown when an oversized custom emoji image cannot be decoded while resizing it.

translation: Unable to create emoji. An error occurred when trying to encode the image.
description: API error shown when an oversized custom emoji image cannot be re-encoded after resizing.

translation: Unable to create emoji. An error occurred when trying to decode the GIF image.
description: API error shown when an oversized animated GIF emoji cannot be decoded while resizing it; 'GIF' is a file format.

translation: Unable to create emoji. An error occurred when trying to encode the GIF image.
description: API error shown when an oversized animated GIF emoji cannot be re-encoded after resizing.

translation: Unable to create emoji. Image must be smaller than {{.MaxWidth}} by {{.MaxHeight}}.
description: API error shown when a custom emoji image exceeds the allowed dimensions; {{.MaxWidth}} and {{.MaxHeight}} are the pixel limits.

translation: Unable to create emoji. The image is too large to process. Try using one with smaller dimensions or fewer frames.
description: API error shown when a custom emoji image cannot be decoded because its pixel dimensions or animation frames exceed server processing limits.

translation: Unable to create the emoji. An error occurred when trying to open the attached image.
description: API error shown when the uploaded custom emoji image file cannot be opened on the server.

translation: Unable to seek to file start.
description: Internal API error when the server cannot rewind the uploaded emoji file to re-read it; technical file-handling failure.

translation: Unable to create emoji. Animated GIF must have at most {{.MaxFrames}} frames.
description: API error shown when an animated GIF emoji has more animation frames than allowed; {{.MaxFrames}} is the frame limit.

translation: Encountered an error encoding JSON for the API response
description: Generic API error when serializing the response body to JSON fails; developer/log audience.

translation: Error trying to retrieve first admin complete setup from the store.
description: Internal API error during initial server onboarding when reading the 'first admin completed setup' flag from the database fails.

translation: Error trying to retrieve the first admin visit marketplace status from the store.
description: API error when reading from the database whether the first admin has already visited the plugin Marketplace.

translation: Error no organization name provided for self hosted onboarding.
description: API error during self-hosted onboarding when the request omits the organization name.

translation: Error trying to save first admin complete setup in the store.
description: Internal API error during initial server onboarding when saving the 'first admin completed setup' flag fails.

translation: Error trying to save the first admin visit marketplace status in the store.
description: API error when saving to the database the flag that the first admin has visited the plugin Marketplace.

translation: Unable to find export file.
description: API error when a requested bulk data export file does not exist on the server; admin/CLI audience.

translation: Unable to append data to the file.
description: API error returned when appending data to a file in file storage fails.

translation: File attachments have been disabled on this server.
description: Error shown to end users trying to attach files when file attachments are disabled server-wide.

translation: Uploading via mmctl to a Cloud instance is not supported. Please check the documentation here: https://docs.mattermost.com/manage/cloud-data-export.html.
description: API error when an mmctl import upload targets a Mattermost Cloud instance, which is unsupported; the URL is a documentation link and 'mmctl' is the CLI tool name.

translation: Unable to check if the file exists.
description: API error returned when checking whether a file exists in file storage fails.

translation: Unable to get last modification time for file.
description: API error returned when reading a file's last-modified time from file storage fails.

translation: Unable to get a file reader.
description: Internal API error when opening a read stream for a stored file fails; technical storage failure.

translation: Unable to get the file size.
description: API error returned when reading a stored file's size fails.

translation: You do not have the required access to download this file.
description: Error shown when an attribute-based access control policy blocks a user from downloading a file.

translation: Mismatched flagged post ID specified.
description: API error in the content-flagging review flow when the flagged post ID in the request does not match the file's post.

translation: Plugin hook timed out
description: API error returned when a plugin intercepting a file download took too long to respond; 'plugin hook' is a plugin extension point.

translation: The public link does not appear to be valid.
description: Error shown when a public file link has a bad or expired signature; 'public link' is a shareable file URL.

translation: File download rejected by plugin
description: Error shown when an installed plugin blocks a file download; 'plugin' is a server extension.

translation: Failed to get file info.
description: API error when loading a file's metadata (name, size, type) fails; 'file info' is the metadata record.

translation: File doesn't have a preview image.
description: API error when a preview image is requested for a file that has none (e.g. a non-image file).

translation: File preview download rejected by plugin
description: Error shown when an installed plugin blocks downloading a file's preview image.

translation: File doesn't have a thumbnail image.
description: API error when a thumbnail is requested for a file that has none (e.g. a non-image file).

translation: File thumbnail download rejected by plugin
description: Error shown when an installed plugin blocks downloading a file's thumbnail image.

translation: Public file download rejected by plugin
