description: Error shown when an installed plugin blocks downloading a file through its public link.

translation: Public links have been disabled.
description: Error when requesting a shareable public link for a file while public links are disabled by the admin.

translation: Unable to get public link for file. File must be attached to a post that can be read by the current user.
description: Error when a public link is requested for a file not attached to any post the requesting user can read.

translation: Unable to list directory.
description: API error when the server cannot list the contents of a directory in the configured file storage; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to move file.
description: API error returned when moving a file within file storage fails.

translation: No file driver selected.
description: API error when file operations are attempted but no file storage driver (local or S3) is configured; admin audience.

translation: Unable to read the file.
description: Generic API error returned when the server fails to read a file from its file storage backend.

translation: Encountered an error reading from local server file storage.
description: API error returned when reading a compliance export file from the server's local file storage fails; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to remove the directory.
description: API error when the server cannot delete a directory from the configured file storage; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to remove the file.
description: API error returned when deleting a file from file storage fails.

translation: Unable to access the file storage.
description: Admin-facing error from the file storage connection test when the storage backend cannot be reached.

translation: Unable to authenticate against the file storage backend. Verify your credentials and authentication settings.
description: Admin-facing error from the file storage connection test when authentication to the storage backend fails; advises checking credentials.

translation: Email settings have unset values.
description: API error in the System Console when testing the email (SMTP) connection with incomplete email settings; admin-facing.

translation: The configured bucket or container does not exist. Verify your file storage configuration and permissions.
description: Admin-facing error from the file storage connection test when the configured storage bucket or container does not exist.

translation: File storage settings have unset values.
description: API error in the System Console when testing the file storage connection with incomplete file storage settings; admin-facing.

translation: Unsupported file storage driver "{{.Driver}}". Supported values are "local", "amazons3", and "azureblob".
description: API error in the System Console file storage connection test when an unknown storage driver is configured; {{.Driver}} is the configured driver value, and 'local', 'amazons3', 'azureblob' are literal config values that must not be translated.

translation: You do not have the required access to upload files to this channel.
description: Error shown when an attribute-based access control policy blocks a user from uploading files to a channel.

translation: Cannot upload file to restricted DM
description: Error when uploading a file into a restricted direct message channel (a DM where posting is blocked, e.g. with a deactivated user).

translation: Unable to upload the file. Incorrect channel ID: {{.channelId}}
description: API error returned when a file upload targets an invalid channel; {{.channelId}} is the rejected channel ID.

translation: Unable to upload file(s). Have {{.NumClientIds}} client_ids for {{.NumFiles}} files.
description: API validation error on multi-file upload; {{.NumClientIds}} is the count of client-supplied IDs and {{.NumFiles}} the count of files, which must match; 'client_ids' is a literal parameter name.

translation: File above maximum dimensions could not be uploaded: {{.Filename}}
description: Error shown when an uploaded image exceeds the maximum allowed pixel dimensions; {{.Filename}} is the rejected file's name.

translation: {{.Filename}} dimensions ({{.Width}} by {{.Height}} pixels) exceed the limits.
description: Error shown when an uploaded image is too large; {{.Filename}} is the file name, {{.Width}} and {{.Height}} are its pixel dimensions.

translation: Unable to upload file(s). Multiple conflicting channel_ids.
description: API validation error when a file upload request specifies more than one target channel; 'channel_ids' is a literal parameter name.

translation: Unable to upload file(s). Error reading the value for {{.Formname}}.
description: API error during file upload; {{.Formname}} is the name of the multipart form field that could not be read.

translation: Unable to upload file(s). Error reading or parsing request data.
description: API error when the body of a file upload request cannot be read or parsed.

translation: Cannot upload file to restricted DM
description: Error when uploading a file into a restricted direct message channel (a DM where posting is blocked, e.g. with a deactivated user).

translation: Unable to upload file. Image storage is not configured.
description: API error shown when file uploads fail because the server has no file storage configured; admin action needed.

translation: Unable to upload file {{.Filename}}. {{.Length}} bytes exceeds the maximum allowed {{.Limit}} bytes.
description: Error shown when an uploaded file exceeds the size limit; {{.Filename}} is the file name, {{.Length}} its size in bytes, {{.Limit}} the maximum allowed bytes.

translation: Unable to write the file.
description: API error returned when writing a file to file storage fails.

translation: Unable to get a zip file reader.
description: Internal API error when opening a zip archive stored in file storage for reading fails.

translation: Unable to filter the configuration.
description: Admin API error when removing restricted fields from the server configuration before returning it fails.

translation: OnlyThreads and OnlyTotals parameters to getThreadsForUser are mutually exclusive
description: API error when a followed-threads request sets both the OnlyThreads and OnlyTotals query parameters, which cannot be combined; parameter names must not be translated.

translation: Before and After parameters to getThreadsForUser are mutually exclusive
description: API error when a followed-threads request sets both the Before and After paging parameters, which cannot be combined; parameter names must not be translated.

translation: Cannot hide both active and inactive users.
description: API error in the admin user reporting endpoint when the filters would exclude both active and deactivated users, leaving nothing to show.

translation: Page size is invalid or too large.
description: API error in the admin user reporting endpoint when the requested page size is out of range.

translation: Invalid team id provided.
description: API error in the admin user reporting endpoint when the team filter contains an invalid team ID.

translation: Could not get the instance site url
description: API error when the server's own Site URL is not configured and cannot be determined; needed for shared channels / secure connection operations.

translation: The health dashboard is not enabled.
description: API error when a health dashboard endpoint is called while the health dashboard feature flag is off.

translation: The health dashboard requires an Enterprise license.
description: API error when a health dashboard endpoint is called on a server without an Enterprise license.

translation: Requested image url cannot be parsed.
description: API error from the image proxy when the requested image URL is malformed and cannot be parsed.

translation: Incoming webhooks have been disabled by the system admin.
description: API error shown when someone tries to use or manage incoming webhooks while the admin has turned the feature off; incoming webhooks let external services post messages into channels.

translation: Invalid username.
description: API error when an incoming webhook payload specifies an override username that is not a valid username format.

translation: Channel listed in the request doesn't belong to the user
description: API error from the sidebar channel categories endpoint when a category update references a channel the user is not a member of.

translation: Invalid custom url scheme has been provided
description: API error when a mobile OAuth redirect uses a custom URL scheme that is not in the server's allowed list.

translation: Invalid redirect url has been provided
description: API error when the redirect URL supplied to an OAuth login flow is not valid or not allowed.

translation: input/output error
description: Generic lowercase API error for a low-level input/output failure; developer/log audience.

translation: The job type of the job you are trying to retrieve does not have permissions defined.
description: Admin API error when a background job's type has no permission metadata defined, so access cannot be checked; developer-leaning register.

translation: Invalid status set
description: Admin API validation error when updating a background job to an unrecognized status value; 'status' is the job status.

translation: The job type of the job you are trying to create is invalid
description: Admin API error when creating a background job with an unknown job type.

translation: Unable to download this job
description: Admin API error when the results of a background job cannot be downloaded; 'job' is a background job.

translation: The job type you are trying to download is not supported at the moment
description: API error shown to admins trying to download the results of a background job whose type has no downloadable output (only compliance export jobs do).

translation: You do not have permission to manage this job type
description: Admin API error when the caller lacks permission for the given background job type; 'manage' means create/cancel.

translation: Invalid test type: {{.TestType}}
description: API error for admins running an AD/LDAP diagnostic test; {{.TestType}} is the unrecognized test type identifier sent in the request.

translation: The AD/LDAP connection settings have changed. Please re-enter the bind password to test the connection.
description: Error shown when testing the AD/LDAP connection after the settings changed, asking the admin to re-enter the bind password because the saved one no longer applies.

translation: ldap group not found
description: Lowercase API error when the requested AD/LDAP group does not exist.

translation: group name already exists
description: Lowercase API error when linking an LDAP group whose chosen mention name is already used by another group.

translation: group name already exists as a reserved name
description: Lowercase API error when an LDAP group's chosen mention name collides with a reserved word (e.g. here, all, channel).

translation: group name already exists as a user name
description: Lowercase API error when an LDAP group's chosen mention name is already taken by a user's username.

translation: your license does not support ldap groups
description: Lowercase API error when the server license does not include AD/LDAP group synchronization.

translation: Empty array under 'license' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a license when the 'license' form field is empty; 'license' is a literal form field name.

translation: Failed to copy license file content to buffer
description: Admin API error when reading the uploaded license file into memory fails; 'buffer' is a memory buffer.

translation: License is either expired or has not yet started.
description: Error shown to system admins uploading an Enterprise license whose validity window has ended or not yet begun.

translation: Invalid license file.
description: Error shown to admins when the uploaded enterprise license file cannot be validated.

translation: Unable to count total unique users.
description: Error shown to admins during license upload when the server fails to count registered users for the seat check.

translation: No file under 'license' in request.
description: Admin API error uploading a license when no file is present in the 'license' form field; 'license' is a literal form field name.

translation: Could not open license file.
description: Admin API error when the uploaded license file cannot be opened.

translation: License did not save properly.
description: Error shown to admins when the uploaded license could not be stored on the server.

translation: Active license ID did not save properly.
description: Error shown to admins when the server fails to record which license is active after upload.

translation: This license only supports {{.Users}} users, when your system has {{.Count}} unique users. Unique users are counted distinctly by email address. You can see total user count under Site Reports -> View Statistics.
description: Error shown to admins when a license's seat count is below the server's user count; {{.Users}} is the licensed seat count, {{.Count}} the current unique user count, and 'Site Reports -> View Statistics' is an admin console menu path.

translation: This is a production license, but this server is running in a test or development environment. Production licenses can only be used on production servers.
description: Error shown to system admins uploading a production Enterprise license to a server running in test/development mode.

translation: This is a test or development license, but this server is running in a production environment. Test or development licenses can only be used on test or development servers.
description: Error shown to system admins uploading a test/development Enterprise license to a server running in production mode.

translation: Failed to compute monthly active users.
description: Admin API error when calculating the monthly active user count for license reporting fails.

translation: Could not parse the license upload form.
description: Admin API error when the multipart form of a license upload cannot be parsed.

translation: Failed to send the disable license email successfully.
description: Server error logged/returned when the email notifying admins that an expired license was disabled could not be sent.

translation: The number of users requested is not correct.
description: Admin API validation error when requesting a trial license with an invalid number of users.

translation: Invalid business email for trial
description: API error when a system admin requests an Enterprise trial license with an email address that is not accepted as a business email.

translation: You must accept the Mattermost Software Evaluation Agreement and Privacy Policy to request a license.
description: API error when a system admin requests a trial license without checking the agreement checkbox; 'Mattermost Software Evaluation Agreement' and 'Privacy Policy' are document titles.

translation: Could not check if a trial can be started
description: Admin API error when the server cannot verify whether a trial license may be started.

translation: Failed to apply new trial license as your workspace has already applied a trial license. If you would like to extend your trial period please [contact our sales team](https://mattermost.com/contact-us/).
description: Admin error when a workspace that already used its trial requests another; contains a markdown link labeled 'contact our sales team' whose URL must stay intact.

translation: Unable to get a trial license. Please try again or contact support@mattermost.com.
description: Error shown to admins when requesting a trial license from Mattermost's servers fails; the support email address should be kept.

translation: We were unable to process the request due to limitations for embargoed countries. [Learn more in our documentation](https://mattermost.com/pl/limitations-for-embargoed-countries), or reach out to legal@mattermost.com for questions around export limitations.
description: Error shown to admins when a trial license request is blocked due to trade-embargo restrictions; contains a markdown link that must keep its [text](url) format.

translation: Feature requires an upgrade to Enterprise Edition.
description: API error when a feature requires Enterprise Edition; 'Enterprise Edition' is a Mattermost product tier name.

translation: api endpoint requires a license
description: Lowercase generic API error returned when an endpoint requires a paid license and none is installed; developer/admin audience.

translation: Mark all as read feature is not enabled.
description: API error when the 'mark all as read' action is invoked while that feature is disabled on the server.

translation: Failed to marshal.
description: Generic API error when serializing a response object to JSON fails; 'marshal' means serialize.

translation: Unable to migrate SAML.
description: API error when the bulk migration of user accounts to SAML authentication fails; admin-facing.

translation: E10 or E20 license required to use this endpoint.
description: API error when an endpoint requires a paid license; 'E10' and 'E20' are legacy Mattermost license tier names.

translation: PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) is required for public OAuth clients using authorization code flow.
description: OAuth authorization error shown to developers/users when a public OAuth client omits PKCE; keep 'PKCE' and the parenthetical expansion technical.

translation: invalid_request: Supplied redirect_uri did not match registered callback_url.
description: OAuth authorization error; the 'invalid_request:' prefix is a standard OAuth error code and 'redirect_uri'/'callback_url' are parameter names — keep them untranslated.

translation: The system admin has turned off OAuth2 Service Provider.
description: Error shown when an OAuth authorization is attempted while the admin has disabled the OAuth 2.0 service provider feature.

translation: Authentication complete
description: Heading on the browser page shown after a mobile app OAuth/SSO login finishes successfully.

translation: OAuth service provider is disabled.
description: API error returned from the OAuth authorization server metadata endpoint when the OAuth service provider feature is disabled.

translation: Invalid URL configuration for authorization server metadata.
description: API error returned when the server's URL configuration prevents building OAuth authorization server metadata; admin-facing.

translation: Site URL must be configured to provide authorization server metadata.
description: API error telling admins the Site URL setting must be set before OAuth authorization server metadata can be served.

translation: The system admin has turned off OAuth2 Service Provider.
description: API error when an OAuth2 authorization is attempted but the admin has disabled the OAuth2 service provider feature.

translation: If you are not redirected automatically, please click the link
description: Fallback line on the post-login browser page; rendered as HTML where 'link' becomes a clickable anchor and {{.Link}} is the redirect URL; keep the <a> tag structure.

translation: You can close this browser tab now.
description: Line on the post-login browser page telling the user the browser tab can be closed once redirection has happened.

translation: invalid_request: Bad client_id.
description: OAuth2 token endpoint error; 'invalid_request' and 'client_id' are OAuth2 protocol terms and should stay in English.

translation: invalid_request: Bad grant_type.
description: OAuth2 token endpoint error; 'invalid_request' and 'grant_type' are OAuth2 protocol terms and should stay in English.

translation: invalid_request: Bad request.
description: OAuth token endpoint error for a malformed request; 'invalid_request' is a literal OAuth 2.0 error code and must not be translated.

translation: invalid_grant: Token grant was not issued to this client.
description: OAuth token endpoint error; 'invalid_grant:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated. Developer-facing.

translation: invalid_client: Invalid client credentials.
description: OAuth token endpoint error; 'invalid_client:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated. Developer-facing.

translation: The system admin has turned off OAuth2 Service Provider.
description: OAuth token endpoint error when the admin has disabled the OAuth 2.0 service provider feature.

translation: invalid_grant: Invalid or expired authorization code.
description: OAuth token endpoint error; 'invalid_grant:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated. Developer-facing.

translation: server_error: Encountered internal server error while accessing database.
description: OAuth token endpoint error; 'server_error:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated. Developer-facing database failure.

translation: server_error: Encountered internal server error while saving access token to database.
description: OAuth token endpoint error when saving the issued access token fails; 'server_error:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated.

translation: server_error: Encountered internal server error while saving session to database.
description: OAuth token endpoint error when saving the new session fails; 'server_error:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated.

translation: server_error: Encountered internal server error while pulling user from database.
description: OAuth token endpoint error when loading the user record fails; 'server_error:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated.

translation: invalid_request: Missing code.
description: OAuth2 token endpoint error when the authorization code is missing; 'invalid_request' and 'code' are OAuth2 protocol terms.

translation: invalid_request: Missing refresh_token.
description: OAuth2 token endpoint error; 'invalid_request' and 'refresh_token' are OAuth2 protocol terms and should stay in English.

translation: invalid_request: Supplied redirect_uri does not match authorization code redirect_uri.
description: OAuth token endpoint error; 'invalid_request:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix and 'redirect_uri' a parameter name — keep both untranslated.

translation: invalid_grant: Invalid refresh token.
description: OAuth token endpoint error; 'invalid_grant:' is a standard OAuth error code prefix — keep it untranslated. Developer-facing.

translation: Resource parameter mismatch between authorization and token requests.
description: OAuth token endpoint error when the 'resource' parameter differs between the authorization and token requests; developer-facing.

translation: Invalid state token.
description: OAuth login error when the anti-forgery state token in the callback is invalid; shown during SSO sign-in.

translation: Redirecting you back to the app.
description: Transient line on the post-login browser page shown while the user is redirected back to the mobile app.

translation: invalid_request: Cannot regenerate secret for public OAuth clients.
description: API error when regenerating a client secret for a public OAuth app, which has no secret; the 'invalid_request:' prefix is an OAuth 2.0 error code and must stay untranslated.

translation: The system admin has turned off OAuth2 Service Provider.
description: Error shown when registering a new OAuth application while the admin has disabled the OAuth 2.0 service provider feature.

translation: Error deleting session from DB.
description: Internal error when deleting the session tied to a revoked OAuth access token fails; 'DB' means database.

translation: Error deleting access token from DB.
description: Internal error when deleting a revoked OAuth access token from the database fails.

translation: Error getting access token from DB before deletion.
description: Internal error when loading an OAuth access token from the database prior to revoking it fails.

translation: User sign-up is disabled.
description: API error when a user tries to create an account through an OAuth provider while account creation is disabled on the server.

translation: The signup link has expired.
description: API error shown when a user opens an OAuth signup link whose token has expired.

translation: The signup link does not appear to be valid.
description: API error shown when a user opens a malformed or tampered OAuth signup link.

translation: Outgoing webhooks have been disabled by the system admin.
description: API error shown when someone tries to use or manage outgoing webhooks while the admin has turned the feature off; outgoing webhooks send channel messages to external services.

translation: An error occurred while parsing the payload.
description: Generic API error returned when a request body sent to the server cannot be parsed; 'payload' is the request body, audience is API clients/developers.

translation: An error occurred while checking the plugin directory configuration.
description: API error shown to a system admin when the server cannot verify the configured plugin directory during plugin installation.

translation: Cannot install plugin: PluginSettings.Directory conflicts with ImportSettings.Directory.
description: API error for system admins when plugin installation is blocked because two config settings point to conflicting directories; 'PluginSettings.Directory' and 'ImportSettings.Directory' are config setting names and must not be translated.

translation: An error occurred while downloading the plugin.
description: API error shown to a system admin when downloading a plugin from a URL or the Marketplace fails.

translation: Exactly one plugin public key file must be uploaded in the public_key field.
description: Error returned by the local-mode API when a plugin-signing public key upload is missing its file; 'public_key' is the literal form field name and must not be translated.

translation: Plugin public key {{.Name}} is not configured.
description: Error returned by the local-mode API when the requested plugin-signing public key is not in PluginSettings.SignaturePublicKeyFiles.

translation: Unable to parse the uploaded plugin public key.
description: Error returned by the local-mode API when the multipart request uploading a plugin-signing public key cannot be parsed or is too large.

translation: File array is empty in multipart/form request.
description: API error when a plugin upload request's multipart form contains an empty file array; technical message aimed at admins/integrators.

translation: Unable to open file in multipart/form request.
description: API error when the server cannot open the plugin bundle file included in the multipart upload request.

translation: Uploaded plugin size exceeds limit. This limit can be changed in the System Console via File Storage > Maximum File Size
description: API error shown to a system admin when an uploaded plugin bundle exceeds the maximum file size; 'File Storage > Maximum File Size' is a System Console navigation path.

translation: Missing file in multipart/form request.
description: API error when a plugin upload request is missing the file part of the multipart form; technical message aimed at admins/integrators.

translation: Unable to verify plugin signature.
description: Admin console error when a plugin's cryptographic signature cannot be verified during installation.

translation: You do not have permission to burn this post. You must be a member of the channel.
description: API error when a user tries to 'burn' (permanently destroy) a burn-on-read message in a channel they are not a member of; 'burn' refers to the burn-on-read feature.

translation: @{{.GroupName}} has no members on this team
description: Ephemeral system message shown to the poster after they @-mention a user group; {{.GroupName}} is the group's mention name (rendered after a literal @).

translation: @{{.Usernames}} and @{{.LastUsername}} did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel. They cannot be added to the channel because they are not a member of the linked groups. To add them to this channel, they must be added to the linked groups.
description: Ephemeral system message to the poster in a group-synced channel; {{.Usernames}} is a comma-separated list of usernames and {{.LastUsername}} the final one, each rendered after @.

translation: @{{.Username}} did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel. They cannot be added to the channel because they are not a member of the linked groups. To add them to this channel, they must be added to the linked groups.
description: Ephemeral system message to the poster in a group-synced channel; {{.Username}} is the mentioned user's username, rendered after a literal @.

translation: @{{.Usernames}} and @{{.LastUsername}} did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel.
description: Ephemeral system message to the poster when several @-mentioned users are not channel members; {{.Usernames}} is a comma-separated list and {{.LastUsername}} the final username.

translation: @{{.Username}} did not get notified by this mention because they are not in the channel.
description: Ephemeral system message to the poster when an @-mentioned user is not a channel member; {{.Username}} is that user's username, rendered after a literal @.

translation: @{{.Usernames}} and @{{.LastUsername}} didn't get notified by this mention because they aren't members of this team.
description: Ephemeral system message to the poster when several @-mentioned users are not on the team; {{.Usernames}} is a comma-separated list and {{.LastUsername}} the final username.

translation: @{{.Username}} didn't get notified by this mention because they aren't a member of this team.
description: Ephemeral system message to the poster when an @-mentioned user is not a team member; {{.Username}} is that user's username, rendered after a literal @.

translation: You do not have permission to send burn-on-read messages in this channel.
description: API error when a user does not have permission to send a burn-on-read message in a channel due to an attribute-based-access-control (ABAC) permission policy.

translation: An error occurred while creating a burn-on-read post.
description: API error when creating a burn-on-read post fails; 'burn-on-read' is the self-destructing message feature name.

translation: Cannot post to restricted direct message channel.
description: API error when posting is blocked in a direct message channel restricted by admin policy (e.g. deactivated user).

translation: Cannot post to deleted channel.
description: API error when a user tries to post a message in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Card posts are not enabled on this server.
description: API error when creating a 'card' type post while that post type is disabled; 'card' is a special post display type.

translation: Invalid ChannelId for RootId parameter.
description: API error when a reply's root post belongs to a different channel than the one being posted to; 'ChannelId'/'RootId' are API parameter names.

translation: Invalid RootId parameter.
description: API error when the thread root referenced by a reply is invalid; 'RootId' is an API parameter name.

translation: Only bot, webhook, OAuth app, and plugin posts can be delivered silently.
description: API error when a regular user tries to create a silent (no-notification) post, which is limited to integrations.

translation: Silent posts cannot use persistent notifications.
description: API error when a post is marked both silent and persistent-notification, which conflict; both are message priority features.

translation: Error creating post.
description: API error when the message a webhook tried to post could not be created; 'post' is a noun (a message).

translation: Failed to cache post after deduplicating a client repeating the same request.
description: Internal error when caching a newly created post for duplicate-request detection fails.

translation: Failed to fetch original post after deduplicating a client repeating the same request.
description: Internal error when retrieving the original post after detecting a duplicate create request fails.

translation: Rejected post since another client is making the same request.
description: API error when a duplicate create-post request is rejected because an identical request is still in progress.

translation: Cannot delete a post in a restricted direct message channel.
description: API error when deleting a post is blocked in a direct message channel restricted by admin policy.

translation: Cannot delete a post in a deleted channel.
description: API error when a user tries to delete a message in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Cannot delete post, ServiceSettings.EnableAPIPostDeletion is not enabled.
description: API error when permanent post deletion is attempted but disabled; 'ServiceSettings.EnableAPIPostDeletion' is a config setting name and must not be translated.

translation: @all notifications are disabled in channels with more than {{.Users}} users. Contact your system administrator for more information.
description: Ephemeral system message to a poster who used @all in a large channel; {{.Users}} is the member-count threshold. Keep '@all' untranslated.

translation: @channel notifications are disabled in channels with more than {{.Users}} users. Contact your system administrator for more information.
description: Ephemeral system message to a poster who used @channel in a large channel; {{.Users}} is the member-count threshold. Keep '@channel' untranslated.

translation: @here notifications are disabled in channels with more than {{.Users}} users. Contact your system administrator for more information.
description: Ephemeral system message to a poster who used @here in a large channel; {{.Users}} is the member-count threshold. Keep '@here' untranslated.

translation: Invalid action id.
description: API error returned when an interactive message button/menu action ID is invalid; developer/integration-facing.

translation: Action integration error.
description: Error when clicking an interactive message button/menu fails because the integration behind it returned an error; 'action integration' is the external integration handling the button.

translation: Invalid action query.
description: API error returned when an interactive message button/menu action request contains an invalid query; developer/integration-facing.

translation: Unable to get the pending post.
description: Internal error when looking up a post by its client-generated pending ID fails during creation.

translation: Burn-on-read posts are not allowed in direct messages with bots or AI agents.
description: API error when sending a burn-on-read (self-destructing) message in a DM with a bot or AI agent, which is not allowed.

translation: An error occurred while validating the channel for burn-on-read post.
description: Internal error when checking whether the target channel allows burn-on-read (self-destructing) posts fails.

translation: Burn-on-read posts are not enabled. Please enable the feature flag and service setting.
description: API error when creating a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post while the feature is not enabled in server configuration; admin-oriented wording.

translation: Burn-on-read posts require an Enterprise Advanced license.
description: API error when creating a burn-on-read post without the required license; 'Enterprise Advanced' is a license tier name.

translation: Burn-on-read posts are not allowed when messaging yourself.
description: API error when sending a burn-on-read (self-destructing) message in one's own self-DM, which is not allowed.

translation: Burn-on-read posts are not allowed in shared channels.
description: API error when sending a burn-on-read (self-destructing) message in a shared channel (channel shared with another server), which is not allowed.

translation: An error occurred while validating the user for burn-on-read post.
description: Internal error when checking whether the posting user may create burn-on-read (self-destructing) posts fails.

translation: The AI-generated user must be either the post creator or a bot.
description: API validation error when a post marked as AI-generated attributes it to a user who is neither the author nor a bot.

translation: Cannot retrieve link metadata for burn-on-read post permalink.
description: API error when generating a link preview for a permalink that points to a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post, which is not allowed.
Text used in notification emails/messages when a post contains only file attachments; plural on {{.Count}} (number of files) and {{.Filenames}} is the list of file names.
Text used in notification emails/messages when a post contains only images; plural on {{.Count}} (number of images) and {{.Filenames}} is the list of file names.

translation: Channel not found
description: API error in an admin reporting endpoint when the channel whose posts were requested does not exist.

translation: Thread moving is disabled
description: API error when a user tries to move a message thread to another channel while the Move Thread feature is disabled.

translation: You do not have permission to move this thread.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to move a message thread to another channel.

translation: Burn-on-read posts cannot be updated.
description: API error when editing a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post, which is not allowed.

translation: Cannot update a post in a deleted channel.
description: API error when a user tries to edit a message in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Cannot update post in restricted direct message channel.
description: API error when editing a post is blocked in a direct message channel restricted by admin policy.

translation: Persistent notification post allows maximum of {{.MaxRecipients}} recipients.
description: API validation error for persistent notification posts; {{.MaxRecipients}} is the configured maximum number of mentioned recipients.

translation: Persistent notification post must have minimum 1 recipient.
description: API validation error when a persistent notification post mentions no recipients; persistent notifications repeatedly alert mentioned users.

translation: Persistent notification validation failed.
description: API error when validating a persistent notification post's recipients fails; internal validation failure.

translation: User is not allowed to create priority post or persistent notification.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to send priority posts or persistent notifications; both are message priority features.

translation: Only root posts are allowed to have priority.
description: API error when message priority is set on a thread reply; priority can only be applied to root (non-reply) posts.

translation: Persistent notification posts must have the Urgent Priority.
description: API error when a persistent notification post lacks the 'Urgent' priority level; 'Urgent' is a priority level name.

translation: The number of Post IDs received has exceeded the maximum size of {{.MaxLength}}
description: API error when a request asks for too many posts at once; {{.MaxLength}} is the maximum number of post IDs allowed per request.

translation: You cannot reveal your own burn-on-read post.
description: API error when the author of a burn-on-read message tries to reveal it themselves; 'reveal' means making the hidden message content visible.

translation: Burn-on-read feature is not enabled or requires an Enterprise Advanced license.
description: API error when a user tries to reveal a burn-on-read message but the feature is off or unlicensed; 'Enterprise Advanced' is a Mattermost license tier name.

translation: Invalid request: missing or invalid X-Requested-With header.
description: API error when a reveal request for a burn-on-read message lacks the required X-Requested-With HTTP header; technical, header name must not be translated.

translation: You do not have permission to reveal this post. You must be a member of the channel.
description: API error when a user tries to reveal a burn-on-read message in a channel they are not a member of.

translation: Unable to parse the request body.
description: API validation error when a file search request body cannot be parsed.

translation: Unable to parse the request body.
description: API error when the JSON body of a post (message) search request cannot be parsed.

translation: notified the channel.
description: Mobile push notification body appended directly after the sender's name (note the leading space) when they use @channel/@all.

translation: replied to a thread you're following.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name (leading space) for a reply in a thread the recipient follows (Collapsed Reply Threads enabled).

translation: replied to a thread.
description: Mobile push notification body for a reply in a followed thread within a direct message; the sender's name is prepended directly, so keep the leading space.

translation: commented on your post.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name (leading space) when someone comments on the recipient's post.

translation: commented on a thread you participated in.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name (leading space) for a comment in a thread the recipient participated in.

translation: mentioned you.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name (leading space) when the recipient is @-mentioned.

translation: posted a message.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name (leading space) for an ordinary channel message.

translation: attached a file.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name (leading space) for a message that contains only a file/image attachment.

translation: sent you a message.
description: Mobile push notification body appended after the sender's name for a direct message; no leading space in source, sender name precedes it.

translation: Burn-on-read posts cannot be edited.
description: API error when editing a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post, which is not allowed.

translation: Cannot update a post in a deleted channel.
description: API error when a user tries to edit a message in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Cannot update post in restricted direct message channel.
description: API error when editing a post is blocked in a direct message channel restricted by admin policy.

translation: Already deleted id={{.PostId}}.
description: Detail text attached to an edit-post permission error; {{.PostId}} is the ID of the post that was already deleted. Mostly developer-facing.

translation: Post edit is only allowed for {{.timeLimit}} seconds. Please ask your System Administrator for details.
description: API error when a user tries to edit a message after the admin-configured edit window has closed; {{.timeLimit}} is the number of seconds edits are allowed.

translation: Unable to update system message.
description: API error when a user tries to edit an automated system message, which is not allowed.

translation: Unable to get post.
description: API error when fetching a single post (chat message) by ID fails.

translation: Unable to delete user preferences.
description: API error when deleting some of a user's preferences (settings records) fails.

translation: Unable to update sidebar to match deleted preferences
description: Internal error when updating the channel sidebar (e.g. favorites categories) after preference deletion fails.

translation: Unable to get user preferences.
description: API error when loading a category of user preferences fails.

translation: Unable to set user preferences.
description: API error when saving updated user preferences fails.

translation: Unable to update sidebar to match updated preferences
description: Internal error when updating the channel sidebar (e.g. favorites categories) after a preference change fails.

translation: Channel attributes require an Enterprise Advanced license.
description: API error when managing channel attribute fields (custom fields defined for channels by admins) on a server without the required license. 'Enterprise Advanced' is a Mattermost license tier name; keep it in English.

translation: Session attributes require an Enterprise Advanced license.
description: API error when the session attributes (user property) feature is used without the required license; 'Enterprise Advanced' is a license tier name.

translation: The specified property group was not found.
description: API error when the requested custom property group does not exist; 'property group' is part of the custom profile attributes / properties system.

translation: You cannot create a property field with permission levels that would prevent you from editing it.
description: API error when a user or admin creates a custom property field (e.g. a user or channel attribute) whose permission settings would leave the creator unable to edit or delete it afterwards.

translation: The provided target type is not valid.
description: API error when creating a custom property field with an unsupported target type (the kind of object the field attaches to).

translation: Only an administrator of the field's channel, team or system can set its permissions when creating it.
description: API error when a user who does not administer the channel, team or system a new custom property field belongs to (e.g. a channel attribute) submits a permissions configuration with it. Such users can still create the field, but it gets the default permissions.

translation: Only a system administrator can set permissions when creating an attribute field.
description: API error when a non-system-administrator submits a permissions configuration while creating a field in the attribute-based access control group (user and channel attributes used by access policies). Such users can still create the field, but it gets the default permissions.

translation: Cannot create a protected property field via API.
description: API error when a client tries to create a system-protected property field through the public API, which is not allowed.

translation: A target_id is required when creating a channel or team scoped property field.
description: API error when creating a channel- or team-scoped property field without the target_id request parameter; 'target_id' is a parameter name and must not be translated.

translation: You do not have permission to delete this property field.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to delete a property field (a custom attribute definition, e.g. a User Attribute).

translation: Invalid property field search options.
description: API error when the query options for listing custom property fields are invalid.

translation: A valid target_type (system, team, or channel) is required.
description: API error when the target_type query parameter is missing or invalid; 'system', 'team', 'channel' and 'target_type' are literal API values and must not be translated.

translation: channel_id/team_id cannot be combined with target_type/target_id.
description: API error when mutually exclusive query parameters are combined when listing property fields; the parameter names (channel_id, team_id, target_type, target_id) are literals and must not be translated.

translation: A scope parameter (channel_id, team_id, or target_type) is required.
description: API error when a property field listing request omits all scope parameters; the parameter names in parentheses are literals and must not be translated.

translation: A target_id is required when querying by channel or team target_type.
description: API error when querying property fields by channel or team target_type without the target_id parameter; parameter names are literals and must not be translated.

translation: A target_type is required when target_id is provided.
description: API error when target_id is given without target_type when querying property fields; parameter names are literals and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid property field patch.
description: API error when the JSON patch body for updating a custom property field is invalid; 'patch' is a partial-update noun.

translation: Cannot look up compliance data for a v1 property field via this API.
description: API error when the System Console asks which channels are missing a value for a channel attribute, but the attribute is a legacy (v1) property field that this compliance lookup does not support.

translation: You do not have permission to view this property field's compliance data.
description: API error when a user without permission asks which channels are missing a value for a channel attribute (the list of non-compliant channels and their admins is admin-only).

translation: A reminder was sent for this attribute recently. Please try again later.
description: API error when an admin clicks Notify to remind channel admins about a missing channel attribute value, but a reminder for the same attribute was already sent within the cooldown period.

translation: Property field object type does not match URL.
description: API error when the property field's object type differs from the type segment in the request URL; developer-leaning register.

translation: No property field options were provided.
description: API error when a request to add, update or delete the selectable options of a custom property field (e.g. a select-type attribute) contains no options.

translation: A property field option cursor must give both cursor_id and cursor_create_at.
description: API error when paging through a property field's options with an incomplete cursor. 'cursor_id' and 'cursor_create_at' are literal query parameter names; keep them in English.

translation: The options of this property field cannot be managed individually.
description: API error when an integration tries to add, update or delete individual options on an older (legacy) property field whose options can only be edited as part of the whole field.

translation: You do not have permission to manage options for this property field.
description: API error (403) when the user lacks permission to add, change or remove the selectable options of a custom property field.

translation: Unable to change that many property field options. Only {{.Max}} options can be changed at once.
description: API error when a single request tries to add, update or delete more property field options than allowed. {{.Max}} is the maximum number of options per request.

translation: You cannot change a property field's permissions in a way that would prevent you from editing it.
description: API error (403) when a user updates the permissions of a custom property field (e.g. a channel attribute) in a way that would leave them unable to edit or delete the field afterwards.

translation: A submitted restrictions object must set all five permission levels: value read, value write, option read, option write and field write.
description: API error (400) when a property field update sends the restrictions part of a permissions object with some of its five permission levels left out. Leaving a level out would otherwise remove that permission, so the whole object must be sent.

translation: The submitted permissions object is invalid.
description: API error (400) when a property field patch carries a permissions object whose restrictions, grants or masking cannot be read, for example grants sent as something other than a list.

translation: Cannot patch a v1 property field via this API.
description: API error when a client tries to update an old (v1) custom property field through the newer v2 API endpoint.

translation: permission_values must be either member or sysadmin.
description: API error when updating a property field with an unsupported permission level for who may set its values. 'permission_values', 'member' and 'sysadmin' are literal API field/value names; keep them in English.

translation: permission_values can only be set on a field linked to a template.
description: API error when trying to change who may set values on a property field that is not linked to a shared template field. 'permission_values' is a literal API field name; keep it in English.

translation: This property group does not support submitting a permissions object.
description: API error (400) when a request to create or patch a property field carries a permissions object for a property group that does not accept one, such as custom profile attributes.

translation: The permissions object must let system administrators edit the field, so its field write level cannot be none.
description: API error (400) when a request to create or update a custom property field (e.g. a channel attribute) submits permissions whose field write level is none, which would leave no system administrator able to edit or delete the field.

translation: This attribute can't be marked as required yet because some active channels don't have a value for it. Notify the channel admins, then try again.
description: API error when an admin tries to mark a channel attribute as Required while some active channels have no value for it; the admin must notify the channel admins and wait for values to be set first.

translation: You do not have permission to edit this property field.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to edit a property field (a custom attribute definition).

translation: You do not have permission to manage options for this property field.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to change the selectable options of a property field; 'options' are the field's choice values.

translation: Invalid property value search options.
description: API error when the query options for listing custom property values are invalid.

translation: The provided object type is not valid.
description: API error when a property value request specifies an unsupported object type (the kind of entity the value is attached to).

translation: The request contains duplicate field IDs.
description: API error when a bulk property value update lists the same field ID more than once.

translation: Request body must contain at least one property value update.
description: API validation error when a bulk property value update request has an empty body; 'property value' is a custom attribute value.

translation: Property field {{.FieldID}} was not found in this group.
description: API error updating property values; {{.FieldID}} is the ID of the property field that does not exist in the group.

translation: One or more field IDs in the request are invalid.
description: API validation error when a bulk property value update references malformed field IDs.

translation: You do not have permission to set values on one or more fields.
description: API error when a user lacks permission to set values on some of the property fields in a bulk update.

translation: Unable to update that many property values. Only {{.Max}} property values can be updated at once.
description: API validation error on bulk property value updates; {{.Max}} is the maximum number of values allowed per request.

translation: System values must use the dedicated system values endpoint.
description: API error when system-scoped property values are sent to the generic endpoint instead of the dedicated system values API route; developer-facing.

translation: Template fields cannot have values.
description: API error when a client tries to set values on a template property field; template fields are definitions only and cannot hold values.

translation: Push Notifications are disabled on this server.
description: API error when a mobile push notification operation is attempted while push notifications are disabled on the server.

translation: You've received a new message.
description: Generic mobile push notification body used when message content is withheld (ID-only push mode); the client fetches the real content separately.

translation: An error occurred fetching the ID-loaded push notification.
description: API error when the server fails to fetch the full content for an ID-only ('ID loaded') push notification; part of the mobile push notification privacy feature.

translation: Reply in {{.channelName}}
description: Title of a mobile push notification for a reply in a followed thread; {{.channelName}} is the channel's display name.

translation: Reply in Direct Message
description: Mobile push notification title used instead of a channel name when a thread reply arrives in a direct message; 'Reply' is a noun.

translation: An error occurred building the push notification message.
description: Internal server error when rendering the push notification text template fails; seen in logs/API responses.

translation: Session Expired: Please log in to continue receiving notifications. Sessions for {{.siteName}} are configured by your System Administrator to expire every {{.hoursCount}} hour(s).
description: Mobile push notification telling the user their session ended and they must log in again; {{.siteName}} is the server's name and {{.hoursCount}} is the session length in hours set by the admin.

translation: An error occurred sending the receipt delivery to the push notification service.
description: API error when forwarding a push notification delivery receipt (ack) to the external push notification service fails.

translation: An error occurred building the push notification ack message.
description: API error when the server cannot build the acknowledgement message for a mobile push notification; 'ack' is the delivery acknowledgement.

translation: You cannot remove a reaction in an archived channel.
description: API error shown to a user who tries to remove an emoji reaction from a post in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Cannot react in restricted DM
description: API error shown when removing an emoji reaction is blocked because the direct message conversation is restricted (e.g. with a deactivated user); 'DM' means direct message.

translation: You cannot react in an archived channel.
description: API error shown to a user who tries to add an emoji reaction to a post in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: You cannot react to a burn-on-read post.
description: API error shown when a user tries to add an emoji reaction to a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post, which is not allowed.

translation: Cannot react in restricted DM
description: API error shown when adding an emoji reaction is blocked because the direct message conversation is restricted; 'DM' means direct message.

translation: Reaction is not valid.
description: API error when an emoji reaction being added to a message fails validation; 'Reaction' is the emoji reaction on a post.

translation: You cannot save reaction for the other user.
description: API error when a user tries to add an emoji reaction on behalf of a different user.

translation: This feature is not enabled.
description: API error when the AI channel recap (summary digest) feature is not enabled on the server.

translation: You do not have permission to access this recap.
description: API error when a user requests an AI-generated recap (channel activity summary) that belongs to another user.

translation: The invitation has expired. Ask the remote site for a new invitation.
description: Error shown to an admin accepting a secure connection (remote Mattermost server) invitation when the remote site reports that the invitation has expired.

translation: The remote site returned an invalid response.
description: Error shown to an admin accepting a secure connection (remote Mattermost server) invitation when the remote site's reply cannot be read, e.g. a proxy returned an HTML page.

translation: The invitation contains an invalid site address: {{.URL}}
description: Error shown to an admin accepting a secure connection (remote Mattermost server) invitation when the remote site address in the invitation is malformed and no request can be made. {{.URL}} is the address, with special characters percent-encoded.

translation: The remote site rejected the invitation.
description: Error shown to an admin accepting a secure connection (remote Mattermost server) invitation when the remote site refuses to confirm it. The remote's reason is logged, not shown.

translation: Could not reach the remote site at {{.URL}}.
description: Error shown to an admin accepting a secure connection (remote Mattermost server) invitation when the remote site cannot be contacted. {{.URL}} is the address that was tried.

translation: Could not accept the remote cluster invitation
description: API error when accepting an invitation to connect with another Mattermost server (remote cluster) fails.

translation: Could not decode the base64 string
description: API error shown to an admin when a pasted secure-connection (remote cluster) invite code cannot be decoded from base64.

translation: Remote cluster has not been deleted
description: API error when a request to delete a remote cluster (secure connection to another Mattermost server) did not remove it.

translation: Could not create remote cluster invite
description: API error shown to an admin when generating an invite for connecting another Mattermost server (remote cluster / Connected Workspaces) fails.

translation: We encountered an error deleting the secure connection.
description: API error shown to an admin when deleting a secure connection (a link to a remote Mattermost server) fails.

translation: Could not encrypt the remote cluster invite using the provided password
description: API error shown to an admin when the remote-cluster invite cannot be encrypted with the password they supplied.

translation: Cannot generate invite code for a confirmed cluster
description: API error when an admin tries to generate a new invite code for a remote cluster connection that is already confirmed/established.

translation: We encountered an error retrieving a secure connection.
description: API error shown to an admin when fetching a secure connection (remote Mattermost server link) fails.

translation: Remote Cluster not found
description: API error shown when the requested remote cluster (connected Mattermost server) does not exist; 'Remote Cluster' is the feature term.

translation: Remote cluster import is not allowed
description: API error when a user without the required permission tries to import a remote cluster (secure connection) definition.

translation: Invalid id.
description: API error when a remote cluster (shared-channels secure connection between Mattermost servers) record has a malformed ID.

translation: Invalid topic.
description: API error when a remote cluster record's topics field is too long; 'topic' is a message-routing category for server-to-server sync, not a conversation subject.

translation: Could not decrypt the remote cluster invite using the provided password
description: API error shown to an admin when a remote-cluster invite cannot be decrypted, usually because the password entered is wrong.

translation: We encountered an error saving the secure connection.
description: API error shown to an admin when creating/saving a secure connection to a remote Mattermost server fails.

translation: Secure connection has already been added.
description: API error shown to an admin when trying to add or accept an invitation for a secure connection (remote server link) that already exists.

translation: The remote cluster service is not enabled.
description: API error shown when a remote-cluster (Connected Workspaces) endpoint is called but the feature is disabled in the server config.

translation: We encountered an error updating the secure connection.
description: API error shown to an admin when updating a secure connection (remote Mattermost server link) fails.

translation: Secure connection with the same url already exists.
description: API error shown to an admin when updating a secure connection to a URL already used by another connection.

translation: Upload from a secure connection cannot resume a partially received file.
description: API error returned to a connected Mattermost server when it sends file data for an upload that has already received some data, which would otherwise corrupt the file.

translation: This action is forbidden to a restricted system admin.
description: API error when a restricted system admin (an admin role with limited settings access) attempts an action outside their allowed scope.

translation: Unable to get that many roles by name. Only {{.MaxNames}} roles can be requested at once.
description: API error when a request asks for more roles by name than allowed at once; {{.MaxNames}} is the maximum number of role names per request.

translation: Your license does not support advanced permissions.
description: API error shown to a system admin when editing role permissions requires the advanced permissions feature, which their license lacks.

translation: One or more of the following permissions that you are trying to add or remove is not allowed
description: API error when a role update tries to grant or revoke a permission that cannot be changed through this endpoint; shown to system admins.

translation: Invalid email_token
description: API error during SAML login when the token carrying the user's email change is invalid; 'email_token' is a parameter name.

translation: scheduled posts feature is disabled
description: API error when a user tries to use scheduled posts (messages scheduled to send later) while the feature is disabled on the server.

translation: Scheduled posts feature requires a license
description: API error when scheduled posts (messages scheduled to send later) are used on a server without the required license.

translation: You do not have permission to access this scheduled recap.
description: API error when a user tries to access or modify a scheduled recap (recurring AI channel summary) belonging to another user.

translation: Your license does not support creating permissions schemes.
description: API error shown to a system admin when creating a permissions scheme is not supported by the server license; 'scheme' is a named set of role permissions.

translation: Your license does not support deleting permissions schemes.
description: API error shown to a system admin when deleting a permissions scheme is not supported by the server license; source English is ungrammatical ('license not support').

translation: Unable to get the channels for scheme because the supplied scheme is not a channel scheme.
description: API error when listing channels for a permissions scheme whose scope is not channel-level; 'scheme' is a named set of role permissions.

translation: Unable to get the teams for scheme because the supplied scheme is not a team scheme.
description: API error when listing teams for a permissions scheme whose scope is not team-level; 'scheme' is a named set of role permissions.

translation: Your license does not support updating permissions schemes.
description: API error shown to a system admin when updating a permissions scheme is not supported by the server license.

translation: Interactions with the Mattermost Customer Portal have been disabled by the system admin.
description: API error when connections to the Mattermost Customer Portal are turned off by the system admin.

translation: Service only available in Mattermost Enterprise edition
description: API error when a customer-portal-related endpoint is called on a server that is not Mattermost Enterprise edition; 'Mattermost Enterprise' is a product name.

translation: Failed to send license up for renewal emails
description: Server error logged/returned when the emails reminding admins that the license is up for renewal fail to send.

translation: Must enable Forward80To443 when using LetsEncrypt
description: Fatal server startup error: the Forward80To443 config setting must be enabled when LetsEncrypt certificates are used; both are setting/product names and should not be translated.

translation: Unable to forward port 80 to port 443 while listening on port %s: disable Forward80To443 if using a proxy server
description: Fatal server startup error about the Forward80To443 config setting; %s is the port number the server is listening on. Audience is system admins reading server logs.

translation: Unable to initialize rate limiting memory store. Check MemoryStoreSize config setting.
description: Fatal error logged/shown at server startup when the in-memory store used for API rate limiting cannot be created; 'MemoryStoreSize' is a config setting name and must not be translated.

translation: Unable to initialize rate limiting.
description: Fatal error logged/shown at server startup when the API rate limiter component fails to initialize.

translation: Error starting server, err:%v
description: Critical log message when the HTTP server fails to start; %v is the underlying error. Seen by system admins in server logs.

translation: FileInfo.CreatorId is required.
description: API validation error for shared-channel file sync when the file's CreatorId field is missing; 'FileInfo.CreatorId' is a struct field name, do not translate it.

translation: File data is required.
description: API validation error for shared-channel file sync when the file's binary content is missing.

translation: FileInfo is required.
description: API validation error for shared-channel file sync when the FileInfo metadata object is missing; 'FileInfo' is a struct name, do not translate it.

translation: FileInfo.Name is required.
description: API validation error for shared-channel file sync when the file name is missing; 'FileInfo.Name' is a struct field name, do not translate it.

translation: Could not fetch shared channel remotes
description: API error when listing the remote servers a shared channel is shared with fails; 'remotes' are connected Mattermost servers.

translation: Could not determine if channel is shared with the remote
description: API error when the server cannot determine whether a channel is already shared with a specific remote (connected Mattermost server).

translation: Could not invite remote to channel.
description: API error when inviting a remote (connected Mattermost server) to participate in a shared channel fails.

translation: Could not uninvite remote from channel.
description: API error when removing a remote (connected Mattermost server) from a shared channel fails; 'uninvite' means revoking the share.

translation: User not found.
description: API error when the user whose online/away status was requested does not exist.

translation: ID Loaded Push Notifications are not configured or supported on this server.
description: API error when ID-only ('ID loaded') push notifications are requested but not configured or supported on the server.

translation: Failed to write logs to buffer
description: API error when preparing the server log file download fails while writing logs into an in-memory buffer; admin-facing.

translation: Invalid log filter
description: API error when the log-viewing request in the System Console contains an invalid filter; admin-facing.

translation: Clearing old product notices failed
description: Internal/log error when purging outdated in-product notices fails; 'product notices' are announcement banners fetched from Mattermost.

translation: Fetching product notices failed
description: Internal/log error when downloading the in-product notices feed fails.

translation: Parsing product notices failed
description: Internal/log error when parsing the downloaded in-product notices JSON fails.

translation: Validating product notice conditions failed
description: Internal/log error when evaluating which in-product notices apply to this server fails.

translation: Updating viewed notices failed
description: Internal/log error when recording that a user has viewed in-product notices fails.

translation: You have been added to the team **{{.TeamName}}** because you now meet its membership requirements.
description: Direct message from the system bot telling a user they were automatically added to a team by attribute-based access rules; {{.TeamName}} is the team's display name and ** ** is Markdown bold.

translation: You have been removed from the team **{{.TeamName}}** because you no longer meet its membership requirements.
description: Direct message from the system bot telling a user they were automatically removed from a team because they no longer satisfy its attribute-based access rules; {{.TeamName}} is the team's display name and ** ** is Markdown bold.

translation: Error adding team member(s).
description: API error when adding one or more members to a team fails.

translation: This team is managed by groups. This user is not part of a group that is synced to this team.
description: API error when a user cannot be added to a team because the team's membership is managed by (LDAP/AD) group sync and the user is not in a synced group.

translation: Unable to parse the request body.
description: API error when the JSON body of an add-team-member request cannot be parsed.

translation: Failed to build access control subject for user.
description: API error when adding a user to a team fails because the server could not assemble the user's attribute data for attribute-based access control evaluation.

translation: User does not have required attributes to join the team.
description: API error shown when attribute-based access control rules block a user from joining a team because their user attributes do not satisfy the team's policy.

translation: %v added to the team by %v.
description: System post message shown when someone is added to a team; first %v is the added user's username, second %v is the username of the person who added them.

translation: Parameter required to add user to team.
description: API error when the request to add a user to a team is missing a required parameter (invite ID or team ID).

translation: Guests are restricted from joining a team via an invite link. Please request a guest email invitation to the team.
description: API error when a guest user tries to join a team using a public invite link, which guests are not allowed to do; suggests requesting an email invitation instead.

translation: Guest accounts are disabled.
description: API error when converting a user to a guest is attempted while the Guest Access feature is disabled.

translation: Your license does not support guest accounts
description: API error when converting a user to a guest is attempted on a server whose license does not include guest accounts.

translation: You don't have the appropriate permissions to list all teams
description: API error when a user without the required permission requests the list of all teams on the server.

translation: Invite is invalid because this is not an open team.
description: API error when invite information is requested for a team that does not allow open joining; 'open team' is a team anyone can join.

translation: Team ID does not match the flagged post's team ID.
description: API error in the content flagging feature when the team ID in the request differs from the team of the flagged (reported) post.

translation: Invalid driver name for file settings. Must be 'local' or 'amazons3'.
description: API error when fetching a team icon fails due to a misconfigured file storage driver; 'local' and 'amazons3' are config values and must not be translated.

translation: Unable to read the team icon file.
description: API error when reading the team icon image from file storage fails; 'team icon' is the team's avatar image.

translation: Error invalidating email invites.
description: API error shown to an admin when invalidating all pending email invitations fails.

translation: The channels of the invite must be part of the team of the invite.
description: API validation error when a guest invitation lists channels that belong to a different team than the invitation's team.

translation: Cannot invite guest users to this channel because it has access restrictions based on user attributes.
description: API error when inviting guests to a channel is blocked because the channel has attribute-based access restrictions; 'guests' are limited-access guest accounts.

translation: Guest accounts are disabled
description: API error when sending guest invitations while the Guest Access feature is disabled on the server.

translation: Guest magic link is not enabled
description: API error when a guest invitation uses the magic link method while that sign-in option is disabled; 'magic link' is a passwordless email sign-in link.

translation: Invalid or missing request body.
description: API error when the JSON body of a guest invitation request is missing or cannot be parsed.

translation: Your license does not support guest accounts
description: API error when guest invitations are attempted on a server whose license does not include guest accounts.

translation: The account associated with {{.Addresses}} has been deactivated. Please contact your System Administrator for details.
description: API error (400) shown to the inviter when an email invitation targets an existing but deactivated account. {{.Addresses}} is the email address (or a comma-separated list of addresses) that was rejected. Used for team invites, guest invites, and the mmctl/local invite path.

translation: Email invitations are disabled.
description: API error when sending team invitation emails while email invitations are disabled on the server.

translation: The following email addresses do not belong to an accepted domain: {{.Addresses}}. Please contact your System Administrator for details.
description: API error when team invitation emails are rejected because their domains are not in the allowed list; {{.Addresses}} is the list of rejected email addresses.

translation: No one to invite.
description: API validation error when a team invitation request contains no email addresses or users to invite.

translation: Pre-setting profile fields on invitations requires locked profile fields to be enabled.
description: API error when an invitation tries to pre-fill profile fields but the locked custom profile attributes feature is disabled; audience is admins.

translation: Pre-setting profile fields on invitations requires graceful mode.
description: API error when a team invitation tries to pre-fill profile fields without using the API's graceful mode (which reports per-invite results); developer-facing.

translation: Pre-setting profile fields on invitations requires an Enterprise license.
description: API error when pre-setting profile fields on invitations requires an Enterprise license; 'Enterprise' is a license tier name.

translation: Error while sending the email
description: API error when sending a team invitation email fails.

translation: SMTP is not configured in System Console
description: API error when invitation emails cannot be sent because SMTP is not configured; 'System Console' is the admin console name.

translation: The username {{.Username}} is already taken.
