description: API error when an invitation pre-sets a username that is already in use; {{.Username}} is the conflicting username.

translation: Invalid request body.
description: API error when the JSON body of an invite-members-to-team-and-channels request cannot be parsed.

translation: Team creation has been disabled. Please ask your System Administrator for details.
description: API error when a user tries to create a team while team creation is disabled by the admin.

translation: The user cannot be added as the domain associated with the account is not permitted. Contact your System Administrator for additional details.
description: API error when a user cannot create/join a team because their email domain is not permitted by server settings.

translation: %v joined the team.
description: System post message shown when a user joins a team on their own; %v is that user's username.

translation: The user cannot be added as the domain associated with the account is not permitted. Contact your System Administrator for additional details.
description: API error shown when a user cannot join a team because their email domain is not in the team's allowed domains list.

translation: %v left the team.
description: System message posted in the channel when a user leaves the team; %v is the username. Appears as '<username> left the team.'

translation: Failed to post channel move message.
description: API error returned when the system message announcing a channel move between teams could not be posted.

translation: This channel has been moved to this team from %v.
description: System post message shown in a channel after it is moved to a different team; %v is the name of the team it came from.

translation: Unable to remove a user from a group-constrained team.
description: API error when removing a member from a team whose membership is managed by (LDAP/AD) group sync; members cannot be removed manually.

translation: An error occurred getting the team.
description: API error when the team cannot be loaded while removing its icon (team avatar image).

translation: The user does not appear to be part of this team.
description: API error returned when trying to remove a user from a team they are not a member of.

translation: %v removed from the team.
description: System message posted in the channel when a user is removed from the team by someone else; %v is the removed user's username.

translation: Pagination not implemented for private-only team search.
description: API error when a paginated team search is requested with a private-teams-only filter, a combination the server does not support; developer-facing.

translation: Pagination not implemented for public-only team search.
description: API error when a paginated team search is requested with a public-teams-only filter, a combination the server does not support; developer-facing.

translation: Empty array under 'image' in request.
description: API error when the team icon upload's multipart form field named 'image' contains an empty array; 'image' is a literal field name.

translation: Image limits check failed. Resolution is too high.
description: API error shown when an uploaded team icon image exceeds the maximum allowed resolution.

translation: Could not decode team icon.
description: API error when the uploaded team icon image file cannot be decoded as an image.

translation: Could not encode team icon.
description: API error when re-encoding the processed team icon image fails.

translation: An error occurred getting the team.
description: API error when the team cannot be loaded while setting its icon (team avatar image).

translation: No file under 'image' in request.
description: API error when a team icon upload request has no file under the multipart form field named 'image'; 'image' is a literal field name.

translation: Could not open image file.
description: API error when the uploaded team icon file cannot be opened for reading.

translation: Could not parse multipart form.
description: API error when the multipart form of a team icon upload cannot be parsed.

translation: Unable to seek to file start.
description: Internal API error when the server cannot rewind the uploaded team icon file to re-read it; technical file-handling failure.

translation: Unable to upload team icon. Image storage is not configured.
description: API error when a team icon upload fails because no file storage is configured on the server; audience is admins.

translation: Unable to upload team icon. File is too large.
description: API error when an uploaded team icon image exceeds the maximum file size.

translation: Could not save team icon.
description: API error when writing the team icon image to file storage fails.

translation: An error occurred updating the team icon.
description: API error when updating the team record with its new icon fails.

translation: Group sync cannot be enabled on a team that has a membership policy applied.
description: API error when enabling LDAP group sync on a team that already has an attribute-based membership policy; the two features are mutually exclusive.

translation: Specified user is not a member of specified team.
description: API error when updating team roles for a user who is not a member of that team.

translation: Restricting team to {{ .Domain }} is not allowed by the system config. Please contact your system administrator.
description: API error when a team's allowed email domains setting conflicts with the server-wide domain restrictions; {{ .Domain }} is the offending domain.

translation: Invalid team member update: A guest cannot be made a team member or team admin. Please promote them to a user first.
description: API error when trying to grant member or admin roles to a guest account; guests must first be promoted to regular users.

translation: Invalid team member update: A user must be a guest or an admin but not both.
description: API error (400) returned from App.UpdateTeamMemberRoles when a request tries to give one team member both the guest role and the team admin role. Shown to an admin as the reason the role change was rejected.

translation: Invalid team member update: A user must be a guest or a user but not both.
description: API validation error when a team member role update marks an account as both guest and regular user simultaneously.

translation: Invalid team member update: A team member always has a user scheme.
description: API validation error when a role update tries to remove the base user role from a team member; 'user scheme' refers to the base scheme-derived role.

translation: Invalid team member update: A guest cannot be set for a single team, a System Admin must promote or demote users to/from guests.
description: API error when trying to change guest status for one team only; guest status is account-wide and only a System Admin can promote/demote.

translation: Your license does not support updating a team's scheme
description: API error shown to a system admin when assigning a permissions scheme to a team is not supported by the server license.

translation: Unable to set the scheme to the team because the supplied scheme is not a team scheme.
description: API error when the permissions scheme being assigned to a team is not a team-scoped scheme.

translation: Unable to find the user.
description: API error when the user referenced in a team operation cannot be found.

translation: Add apps to your workspace
description: Section heading in the Cloud workspace welcome email, introducing app integrations.

translation: Streamline your work with tools like GitHub, Jira and Zoom. Explore all of the integrations we have on our
description: Body sentence in the Cloud welcome email; it is a sentence fragment that continues into a link labelled 'app marketplace.', so it should end mid-sentence.

translation: app marketplace.
description: Link text at the end of the 'add apps' sentence in the Cloud welcome email; continues the preceding fragment, hence the lowercase start and trailing period.

translation: Open Mattermost
description: Call-to-action button label in the Cloud welcome email that opens the user's new Mattermost workspace.

translation: Download the Mattermost App
description: Section heading in the Cloud welcome email prompting the user to download the Mattermost desktop/mobile apps.

translation: Thanks for creating
description: Sentence fragment in the Cloud welcome email; the workspace name is appended directly after it, so keep the trailing space and open-ended phrasing.

translation: Make sure to save or bookmark your link for future use.
description: Body line in the Mattermost Cloud welcome email reminding the new workspace owner to keep their workspace URL.

translation: Invite people to your workspace
description: Section heading in the Cloud welcome email introducing the invite link for adding teammates.

translation: Share this link to invite your members to join {{.WorkSpace}}:
description: Body text in the Cloud welcome email preceding the invite link; {{.WorkSpace}} is the workspace name.

translation: mobile and desktop apps
description: Link text within a Cloud welcome email sentence pointing to the mobile and desktop app downloads; concatenated into a larger sentence, hence lowercase.

translation: Sign into your workspace on our
description: Sentence fragment in the Cloud welcome email that continues into the 'mobile and desktop apps' link text; should end mid-sentence.

translation: for the best experience on Windows, Linux, Mac, iOS and Android.
description: Sentence fragment in the Cloud welcome email that follows a 'download the apps' link; completes a sentence about downloading desktop/mobile apps.

translation: Having questions about getting started? Email us at
description: Footer sentence fragment in the Cloud welcome email; the support email address is appended directly after it.

translation: Congratulations!
description: Subject line of the welcome email sent when a new Mattermost Cloud workspace is created.

translation: Set up your workspace
description: Subtitle line in the Cloud welcome email, above the workspace setup checklist.

translation: Take the following steps to build out your teams and get the most out of your workspace.
description: Introductory paragraph in the Cloud welcome email above the list of suggested onboarding steps for the new workspace owner.

translation: Your workspace is ready to go!
description: Main heading of the Cloud welcome email announcing the new workspace is created.

translation: You deactivated your account on {{ .SiteURL }}.
description: Body text of the email confirming the user deactivated their own account; {{ .SiteURL }} is the Mattermost server URL.

translation: Your account has been deactivated at {{ .ServerURL }}
description: Heading of the account-deactivation confirmation email; {{ .ServerURL }} is the Mattermost server address.

translation: If this change was not initiated by you or you want to reactivate your account, contact your system administrator.
description: Warning paragraph in the account-deactivation email telling the recipient what to do if they did not initiate the change.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Your account at {{ .ServerURL }} has been deactivated
description: Subject line of the account-deactivation email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name and {{ .ServerURL }} the server address.

translation: Your email address for {{.TeamDisplayName}} has been changed to {{.NewEmail}}.
description: Body text of the email confirming an email address change; {{.TeamDisplayName}} is the site/team name and {{.NewEmail}} the new address.

translation: You updated your email
description: Heading of the email confirming the user changed their account email address.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Your email address has changed
description: Subject line of the email-address-change confirmation email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: Verify Email
description: Button label in the email asking the user to verify their new email address after changing it.

translation: To finish updating your email address for {{.TeamDisplayName}}, please click the link below to confirm this is the right address.
description: Body text of the email-change verification email explaining the verify link; {{.TeamDisplayName}} is the site/team name.

translation: You successfully updated your email
description: Heading of the verification email sent after a user updates their email address.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Verify new email address
description: Subject line of the email asking the user to verify their new email address; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: To change your notification preferences, log in to your team site and go to Settings > Notifications.
description: Standard footer line in notification emails telling users where to change notification preferences; 'Settings > Notifications' is a UI menu path.

translation: © 2015 - {{ .CurrentYear }} Mattermost, Inc. 2100 Geng Road, Suite 210, Palo Alto, CA, 94303
description: Legal footer at the bottom of Mattermost emails; {{.CurrentYear}} is the current year in the copyright range, and the company address should remain unchanged.

translation: Any questions at all, mail us any time:
description: Email footer sentence fragment; the support email address link is appended directly after it, so keep the trailing space.

translation: Best wishes,
description: Sign-off line in email footers ('Best wishes,'), followed on the next line by the team name.

translation: The {{.SiteName}} Team
description: Email footer signature line naming the sender; {{.SiteName}} is the site name (e.g. 'The Mattermost Team').

translation: Sent by
description: Email footer fragment; the configured organization name and address are appended directly after it, so keep the trailing space.

translation: Email us any time at
description: Email footer sentence fragment; the support email address is appended directly after it, so keep the trailing space.

translation: If you did not make this change, please contact the system administrator.
description: Security warning line in account-change emails telling the recipient to contact an admin if they did not make the change.

translation: This email was sent to you because someone requested a login link for Mattermost. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.
description: Footer paragraph in the guest magic-login-link email reassuring recipients who did not request the link.

translation: Didn't request this email?
description: Footer heading in the guest magic-login-link email, above the 'you can safely ignore this' note.

translation: Click the button below to sign in to your account. Remember not to share this link with anyone else.
description: Body text of the guest magic-login-link email, above the sign-in button.

translation: Sign in to Mattermost
description: Heading of the email containing a one-time sign-in (magic) link for a guest user.

translation: Sign in to {{ .SiteName }}
description: Subject line of the guest magic-login-link email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: Join now
description: Button label in the team invitation email that accepts the invite and opens Mattermost.

translation: Start collaborating with your team on Mattermost
description: Subtitle line in the team invitation email, under the '{sender} invited you' heading.

translation: {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join the {{ .TeamDisplayName }} team.
description: Heading of the team invitation email; {{ .SenderName }} is the inviter's name and {{ .TeamDisplayName }} the team's display name.

translation: Reminder
description: Prefix prepended (followed by a colon) to the subject/title of a re-sent team invitation email, marking it as a reminder of an earlier invite.

translation: Mattermost is a flexible, open source messaging platform that enables secure team collaboration.
description: Footer paragraph in invitation emails briefly describing what Mattermost is, for recipients unfamiliar with the product.

translation: Learn more
description: Link text in the invitation email footer pointing to more information about Mattermost.

translation: What is Mattermost?
description: Footer heading in invitation emails, above the short description of Mattermost.

translation: You were invited as a guest to collaborate with the team
description: Subtitle line in the guest invitation email explaining the recipient was invited as a guest (limited-access) user.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join the team {{ .TeamDisplayName }} as a guest
description: Subject line of the guest invitation email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name, {{ .SenderName }} the inviter, {{ .TeamDisplayName }} the team.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join {{ .TeamDisplayName }} Team
description: Subject line of the team invitation email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name, {{ .SenderName }} the inviter, {{ .TeamDisplayName }} the team.

translation: {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join the {{ .ChannelName }} Channel on the {{ .TeamDisplayName }} Team
description: Heading of the invitation email when invited to a specific channel; {{ .SenderName }} is the inviter, {{ .ChannelName }} the channel, {{ .TeamDisplayName }} the team.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join the {{ .ChannelName }} Channel on the {{ .TeamDisplayName }} Team
description: Subject line of the invitation email for a specific channel on a team; placeholders are the site name, inviter name, channel name, and team name.

translation: {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join {{ .ChannelsLen }} channels on the {{ .TeamDisplayName }} Team
description: Heading of the invitation email when invited to multiple channels; {{ .ChannelsLen }} is the number of channels.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] {{ .SenderName }} invited you to join {{ .ChannelsLen }} channels on the {{ .TeamDisplayName }} Team
description: Subject line of the invitation email for multiple channels; {{ .ChannelsLen }} is the number of channels.

translation: Review changes
description: Button label in the email notifying admins that workspace IP filtering rules changed; opens the settings to review.

translation: @{{ .InitiatingUsername }} changed the IP filtering settings for your workspace at the URL: {{ .SiteURL }}
description: Body text of the IP-filtering-change notification email; {{ .InitiatingUsername }} is the admin who made the change (prefixed with @) and {{ .SiteURL }} the workspace URL.

translation: Changes to Your Workspace's IP Filters
description: Subject line of the email notifying workspace admins that IP filtering settings were changed.

translation: IP filtering changes for your workspace

translation: Your {{.SkuName}} license has expired

description: Body text of the email alerting the user that a personal access token (API credential) was added to their account; {{ .SiteURL }} and {{.SiteName}} identify the server.

description: Body text of the email alerting the user that a personal access token on their account was regenerated (old secret invalidated); {{ .SiteURL }} is the server URL.

translation: Personal access token regenerated
description: Heading of the security email alerting the user that a personal access token was regenerated.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Personal access token regenerated
description: Subject line of the email about a regenerated personal access token; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Personal access token added to your account
description: Subject line of the email about a new personal access token on the account; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: Your username for {{.TeamDisplayName}} has been changed to {{.NewUsername}}.
description: Body text of the username-change confirmation email; {{.TeamDisplayName}} is the site/team name and {{.NewUsername}} the new username.

translation: You updated your username
description: Heading of the email confirming the user changed their username.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Your username has changed
description: Subject line of the username-change confirmation email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: Verify Email

description: Body line in the email-verification email explaining why the recipient got it.

translation: Click below to verify your email address.
description: Sentence in the verification email prompting the user to click the verify button below.

translation: Verify your email address
description: Heading of the email asking a new user to verify their email address.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Email Verification
description: Subject line of the email-verification email; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name.

translation: Download
description: Button label in the welcome email linking to the app download page; compact button text.

translation: For the best experience, download the apps for PC, Mac, iOS and Android.
description: Body text in the welcome email encouraging the user to install the desktop and mobile apps.

translation: Download the desktop and mobile apps
description: Section heading in the welcome email, above the app download button.

translation: Verify Email
description: Button label in the welcome email that verifies the new user's email address.

translation: This email address was used to create an account with Mattermost.
description: Body line in the welcome email explaining why the recipient got it (their address was used to create an account).

translation: If it was not you, you can safely ignore this email.
description: Reassurance line in the welcome/verification email telling recipients they can ignore it if they didn't create the account.

translation: {{ .ServerURL }}.
description: Fragment in the welcome email showing just the server URL followed by a period; {{ .ServerURL }} is the server address and it completes the preceding 'Thanks for joining' sentence.

translation: Thanks for joining

translation: Click below to verify your email address.
description: Sentence in the welcome email prompting the user to click the verify button below.

translation: Welcome to the team
description: Heading of the welcome email sent to newly registered users.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] You joined {{ .ServerURL }}
description: Subject line of the welcome email for new users; {{ .SiteName }} is the site name and {{ .ServerURL }} the server address.

translation: Error creating zip file.
description: API error when the server fails to create a zip archive (e.g. when packaging logs or support data for download); admin-facing.

translation: Failed to unmarshal.
description: Generic technical error when the server fails to parse JSON data; 'unmarshal' is a deserialization term, developer-facing.

translation: You have already upgraded to Mattermost Enterprise Edition. Please restart the server to finish the upgrade.
description: API error in the in-product upgrade flow when the Enterprise Edition binary was already downloaded and only a server restart is pending; admin-facing.

translation: You cannot upgrade because you are already running Mattermost Enterprise Edition.
description: API error when an admin triggers the in-product upgrade but the server is already running Enterprise Edition.

translation: An upgrade to Mattermost Enterprise Edition is already running.
description: API error when an admin triggers the in-product Enterprise Edition upgrade while another upgrade is already in progress.

translation: Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition.
description: Generic API error when the in-product upgrade to Mattermost Enterprise Edition fails; admin-facing.

translation:
Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition. The Mattermost system user {{.MattermostUsername}} does not have write access to the necessary binary file. A system administrator can update the file permissions by executing the following command on the server where Mattermost is installed:

```
chmod +w "{{.Path}}"
```

After changing the file permissions, try to upgrade Mattermost again. When you have upgraded and restarted, remember to restore the original binary file permissions:

```
chmod -w "{{.Path}}"
```
description: Long admin-facing error for the in-product Enterprise upgrade when the server binary is not writable; {{.MattermostUsername}} is the OS account running Mattermost, {{.Path}} is the binary file path, and the fenced blocks contain literal shell commands that must not be translated.

translation:
Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition. The Mattermost system user {{.MattermostUsername}} does not have write access to the necessary binary file. A system administrator can update the file permissions by executing the following command on the server where Mattermost is installed:

```
chown {{.MattermostUsername}} "{{.Path}}"
chmod +w "{{.Path}}"
```

After changing the file permissions, try to upgrade Mattermost again. When you have upgraded and restarted, remember to restore the original binary file permissions:

```
chown {{.FileUsername}} "{{.Path}}"
chmod -w "{{.Path}}"
```
description: Long admin-facing error for the in-product Enterprise upgrade when both file owner and permissions block writing the binary; {{.MattermostUsername}} and {{.FileUsername}} are OS account names, {{.Path}} is the binary path, and the fenced shell commands must not be translated.

translation:
Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition. The Mattermost system user {{.MattermostUsername}} does not have write access to the necessary binary file. A system administrator can update the file permissions by executing the following command on the server where Mattermost is installed:

```
chown {{.MattermostUsername}} "{{.Path}}"
```

After changing the file permissions, try to upgrade Mattermost again. When you have upgraded and restarted, remember to restore the original binary file permissions:

```
chown {{.FileUsername}} "{{.Path}}"
```
description: Long admin-facing error for the in-product Enterprise upgrade when the binary file is owned by a different OS user; {{.MattermostUsername}} and {{.FileUsername}} are OS account names, {{.Path}} is the binary path, and the fenced shell commands must not be translated.

translation: Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition. This feature will only work on Linux systems with x86-64 architecture.
description: API error when the in-product Enterprise Edition upgrade is attempted on an unsupported platform; only Linux x86-64 is supported.

translation: Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition.
description: API error reported when checking the status of an in-product Enterprise Edition upgrade shows it failed; admin-facing.

translation: Mattermost was unable to upgrade to Enterprise Edition. The digital signature of the downloaded binary file could not be verified.
description: API error when the digital signature of the downloaded Enterprise Edition binary cannot be verified during the in-product upgrade; admin-facing.

translation: An error occurred while checking the import directory configuration.
description: API error when the server cannot verify the configured import directory while creating an import file upload; admin-facing.

translation: Cannot create import upload: ImportSettings.Directory conflicts with PluginSettings.Directory.
description: API error when an import upload is blocked because two config settings point to conflicting directories; 'ImportSettings.Directory' and 'PluginSettings.Directory' are config setting names and must not be translated.

translation: Failed to upload file. Upload channel is not shared with remote.
description: API error when a remote Mattermost instance tries to upload a file into a channel that is not shared with it; 'remote' is the other instance.

translation: Unable to upload file. File is too large.
description: API error when a file upload exceeds the server's maximum allowed file size.

translation: Failed to get upload.
description: API error when a user requests an upload session that belongs to another user; deliberately vague for security.

translation: Failed to upload file. Upload channel is not shared with remote.
description: API error when a file upload from a remote Mattermost instance has an upload type not allowed for shared channels.

translation: Invalid Content-Length.
description: API error when the Content-Length HTTP header of an upload request is invalid; header name must not be translated.

translation: Invalid Content-Type for multipart upload.
description: API error when the Content-Type HTTP header of a multipart upload is invalid; header name must not be translated.

translation: Failed to process the multipart data.
description: API error when reading the multipart form data of a file upload fails.

translation: MFA is not available for this account type.
description: API error when enabling multi-factor authentication is attempted on an account type that does not support it (only email and LDAP accounts do); 'MFA' means multi-factor authentication.

translation: Failed to add direct channel preferences for user user_id={{.UserId}}, team_id={{.TeamId}}, err={{.Error}}
description: Internal API error logged when the server fails to set up direct message channel preferences for a user; {{.UserId}}, {{.TeamId}} and {{.Error}} are diagnostic IDs and the underlying error text.

translation: not an ldap user
description: Lowercase API error when group-based team/channel membership is applied to a user who does not authenticate via LDAP.

translation: Invalid device id.
description: API error returned when a mobile client sends a malformed push-notification device ID during session attach.

translation: Invalid VoIP device id.
description: API error returned when a mobile client sends a malformed VoIP (calls) push-notification device ID; keep 'VoIP' as-is.

translation: Authentication Transfer is not available as email signup is disabled.
description: API error shown when switching a user's sign-in method to email fails because email account creation is disabled; 'Authentication Transfer' is the feature name.

translation: Authentication Transfer is not available as neither email login nor username login is enabled.
description: API error shown when switching a user's sign-in method to email/password fails because both email and username login are disabled.

translation: Bad response from token request.
description: SSO login error when the external OAuth provider returns an unusable response to the token request.

translation: Bad token type.
description: SSO login error when the external OAuth provider returns a token of an unexpected type.

translation: Invalid state
description: SSO login error when the anti-forgery state value returned by the provider doesn't match; shown during OAuth/SAML sign-in.

translation: Missing access token.
description: SSO login error when the external OAuth provider's response contains no access token.

translation: Received invalid response from OAuth service provider.
description: SSO login error when the external OAuth provider's response cannot be parsed.

translation: An error occurred in the OnSamlLogin hook. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: Login error shown when a plugin's OnSamlLogin hook fails during SAML sign-in; 'OnSamlLogin' is a code identifier.

translation: SAML response is too long
description: Login error when the SAML response posted by the identity provider exceeds the maximum allowed size; SAML is a protocol name.

translation: Token request to {{.Service}} failed.
description: SSO login error; {{.Service}} is the OAuth provider name (e.g. GitLab, Google) whose token request failed.

translation: Token request failed.
description: SSO login error when the HTTP request exchanging the authorization code for a token fails.

translation: {{.Service}} SSO through OAuth 2.0 not available on this server.
description: SSO login error; {{.Service}} is the OAuth provider name (e.g. GitLab, Google) that is not enabled on this server.

translation: Team id parameter is required to autocomplete by channel.
description: API error when user autocomplete is scoped to a channel without also providing the team ID parameter.

translation: Your account is locked because of too many failed password attempts. Please reset your password.
description: Login error shown after too many failed password attempts lock the account; advises the user to reset their password.

translation: Your account is locked because of too many failed password attempts. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: Login error shown to an AD/LDAP user whose account is locked after too many failed password attempts; advises contacting the admin since they cannot self-reset.

translation: Invalid MFA token.
description: Login error when the multi-factor authentication code the user entered is invalid; 'MFA token' is the one-time code.

translation: Login failed because of invalid password.
description: Login error shown when the entered password is wrong.

translation: The format of the hashed password is invalid and could not be parsed.
description: Internal login error when the stored password hash has an unrecognized format and cannot be verified; technical.

translation: Blank email.
description: Error when finishing a switch to OAuth sign-in and the provider returned no email address for the account.

translation: Could not parse auth data out of {{.Service}} user object.
description: Error when finishing a switch to OAuth sign-in; {{.Service}} is the OAuth provider name whose user data could not be parsed.

translation: Failed to create token data for email verification
description: API error when generating the token embedded in the email-verification link fails.

translation: There is already an account associated with that email address using a sign in method other than {{.Service}}. Please sign in using {{.Auth}}.
description: API error during SSO signup when the email is already registered with a different login method; {{.Service}} is the SSO provider being attempted (e.g. GitLab) and {{.Auth}} is the existing sign-in method the user should use.

translation: Could not create user out of {{.Service}} user object.
description: API error when the server cannot build a Mattermost account from the SSO provider's user data; {{.Service}} is the provider name (e.g. GitLab, Google).

translation: Unable to create password recovery token
description: API error when generating the password-reset token fails.

translation: Could not create default profile image font.
description: API error when generating a user's default profile picture (colored circle with their initial) fails because the font could not be loaded.

translation: Could not encode default profile image.
description: API error when encoding the generated default profile picture image fails.

translation: Could not add user initial to default profile picture.
description: API error when drawing the user's initial letter onto the generated default profile picture fails.

translation: The email you provided does not belong to an accepted domain. Please contact your administrator or sign up with a different email.
description: Signup error shown when the user's email address is not on the server's list of allowed email domains; suggests contacting an administrator.

translation: The email address in the token does not match the one in the user data.
description: API error during invitation signup when the email in the submitted account data differs from the email the invitation token was issued for.

translation: User creation is disabled.
description: API error when account creation is attempted while user creation is disabled in the server config.

translation: Guest accounts are disabled.
description: API error when creating a guest account while the Guest Access feature is disabled.

translation: Your license does not support guest accounts.
description: API error when creating a guest account on a server whose license does not include guest accounts.

translation: Unable to create the user, invalid invitation.
description: API error during signup when the invitation token is of an unexpected type, so the account cannot be created.

translation: Can't create user. Server exceeds maximum licensed users. Contact your administrator with: ERROR_LICENSED_USERS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
description: API error when creating a user would exceed the licensed seat count; 'ERROR_LICENSED_USERS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' is a support error code and must not be translated.

translation: This server does not allow open signups. Please speak with your Administrator to receive an invitation.
description: API error when someone tries to sign up on a server that requires an invitation (open signups disabled).

translation: User sign-up with email is disabled.
description: API error when email-based signup is attempted while that method is disabled in the server config.

translation: The signup link has expired.
description: API error shown when a user opens an account-creation link whose invitation has expired.

translation: The signup link does not appear to be valid.
description: API error shown when a user opens a malformed or tampered account-creation link.

translation: Can't create user. Server exceeds safe user limit. Contact your administrator with: ERROR_SAFETY_LIMITS_EXCEEDED.
description: API error when creating a user would exceed the unlicensed server's safety user limit; 'ERROR_SAFETY_LIMITS_EXCEEDED' is a support error code and must not be translated.

translation: Permanent channel deletion feature is not enabled. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: Error shown to end users when permanent (non-archive) channel deletion is attempted but disabled by configuration.

translation: Permanent channel deletion feature is not enabled. ServiceSettings.EnableAPIChannelDeletion must be set to true to use this command. See https://mattermost.com/pl/environment-configuration-settings for more information
description: Admin-facing variant of the permanent channel deletion error; 'ServiceSettings.EnableAPIChannelDeletion' is a literal config setting name and the URL is a documentation link.

translation: Permanent team deletion feature is not enabled. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: API error shown to a non-admin when permanent team deletion is attempted but the feature is disabled.

translation: Permanent team deletion feature is not enabled. ServiceSettings.EnableAPITeamDeletion must be set to true to use this command. See https://mattermost.com/pl/environment-configuration-settings for more information.
description: API error shown to a system admin when permanent team deletion is disabled; 'ServiceSettings.EnableAPITeamDeletion' is a config setting name and the URL is a documentation link; neither should be translated.

translation: Permanent user deletion feature is not enabled. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: API error shown to a non-admin when permanent user deletion is attempted but the feature is disabled.

translation: Permanent user deletion feature is not enabled. ServiceSettings.EnableAPIUserDeletion must be set to true to use this command. See https://mattermost.com/pl/environment-configuration-settings for more information.
description: API error shown to a system admin when permanent user deletion is disabled; 'ServiceSettings.EnableAPIUserDeletion' is a config setting name and the URL is a documentation link; neither should be translated.

translation: Unable to convert the user to a guest because they are already a guest.
description: API error when converting a user to a guest fails because the account is already a guest.

translation: Bot accounts cannot be converted to guest accounts.
description: API error shown to an admin who tries to convert a bot account into a guest account, which is not allowed.

translation: AD/LDAP not available on this server.
description: API error shown when trying to switch an account from email to AD/LDAP sign-in on a server without AD/LDAP; 'AD/LDAP' is the directory-service login method.

translation: Authentication Transfer not configured or available on this server.
description: API error when switching an account from email to OAuth sign-in is attempted but the feature ('Authentication Transfer') is unavailable.

translation: Error retrieving endpoint from Discovery Document.
description: SSO login error when the OAuth endpoints cannot be read from the provider's OpenID discovery document; 'Discovery Document' is an OpenID Connect term.

translation: Error while checking if a user has a custom profile image.
description: API error when the server cannot determine whether the user has uploaded a custom profile picture.

translation: Failed to get uploads.
description: API error when a user requests another user's upload sessions; deliberately vague for security.

translation: Unable to get user by email.
description: API error when the caller lacks permission to look up a user account by email address.

translation: Error fetching roles during validation.
description: Internal API error when fetching role data fails while validating a user listing request.

translation: Access control service unavailable. Cannot filter users for ABAC-enabled channel.
description: API error when listing users eligible for a channel governed by attribute-based access control fails because the access control service is down; 'ABAC' means attribute-based access control.

translation: Access control service unavailable. Cannot filter users for ABAC-enabled team.
description: API error when listing users eligible for a team governed by attribute-based access control fails because the access control service is down; 'ABAC' means attribute-based access control.

translation: This invitation link has expired.
description: Error shown to a guest who opens a magic sign-in invitation link after it has expired; 'magic link' is passwordless email sign-in.

translation: Invalid invitation link.
description: Error shown to a guest who opens a malformed or revoked magic sign-in invitation link.

translation: Missing invitation token.
description: API error when a guest sign-in magic link is opened without its invitation token; the token is part of the emailed link.

translation: Could not generate a unique username. Please contact your system administrator.
description: Error during guest magic-link signup when the server cannot generate an unused username for the new guest account.

translation: Unable to get tokens by type when invalidating password recovery tokens
description: Internal API error when listing existing password-recovery tokens (to invalidate them) fails; mostly seen in logs.

translation: Unable to remove token when invalidating password recovery tokens
description: Internal API error when deleting an old password-recovery token fails; mostly seen in logs.

translation: Unable to parse token when invalidating password recovery tokens
description: Internal API error when parsing a stored password-recovery token fails during invalidation; mostly seen in logs.

translation: Unable to get tokens by type when invalidating email verification tokens
description: Internal API error when the server cannot fetch existing email-verification tokens to invalidate them; seen mostly in logs.

translation: Unable to remove token when invalidating email verification tokens
description: Internal API error when the server fails to delete an old email-verification token; seen mostly in logs.

translation: Unable to parse token when invalidating email verification tokens
description: Internal API error when a stored email-verification token cannot be parsed; seen mostly in logs.

translation: AD/LDAP not available on this server.
description: API error shown when trying to switch an account from AD/LDAP to email sign-in on a server without AD/LDAP.

translation: This user account does not use AD/LDAP.
description: API error shown when a user tries to switch from AD/LDAP to email sign-in but their account is not an AD/LDAP account.

translation: Password field must not be blank
description: Login error when the password field is submitted empty.

translation: Bot login is forbidden.
description: Login error when someone tries to log in interactively with a bot account, which is not allowed.

translation: Guest accounts are disabled
description: Login error when a guest account tries to log in while the Guest Access feature is disabled.

translation: Your license does not support guest accounts
description: Login error when a guest account tries to log in on a server whose license does not include guest accounts.

translation: Login with magic link is disabled.
description: Login error when a guest tries to sign in with a magic link while that option is disabled; 'magic link' is a passwordless email sign-in link.

translation: Login failed because your account has been deactivated. Please contact an administrator.
description: Login error shown when the account attempting to sign in has been deactivated.

translation: Enter a valid email and/or password
description: Login error for wrong credentials on servers where users sign in with email; deliberately does not reveal which part was wrong.

translation: Enter a valid email or username and/or password.
description: Error shown on the login form when sign-in fails and both email and username sign-in are enabled; deliberately does not reveal which credential was wrong.

translation: Enter a valid email or username and/or password, or sign in using another method.
description: Login error for wrong credentials on servers offering SSO sign-in options in addition to email/username.

translation: Enter a valid username and/or password.
description: Login error for wrong credentials on servers where users sign in with a username; deliberately does not reveal which part was wrong.

translation: Login failed because email address has not been verified.
description: Login error when the account's email address has not yet been verified.

translation: Login failed because remote users are not allowed to log in.
description: Login error when a remote user (an account synchronized from another Mattermost server via shared channels) tries to log in locally.

translation: Please sign in using {{.AuthService}}.
description: Login error telling the user to sign in with their configured authentication provider instead of a password; {{.AuthService}} is the provider name, e.g. GitLab, SAML, LDAP.

translation: CWS token is not valid
description: Login error when the one-time token from the Customer Web Server (Mattermost cloud portal) is invalid; 'CWS' is that portal's name.

translation: Your account has been deactivated. Please contact your system administrator.
description: Login error shown to a deactivated user signing in via Microsoft Intune.

translation: Bot accounts cannot sign in using Microsoft authentication.
description: Login error when a bot account attempts to sign in through Microsoft Intune authentication.

translation: Microsoft Intune authentication is not available.
description: Login error when Microsoft Intune authentication is attempted but the feature is not enabled/licensed on this server.

translation: Microsoft Intune authentication is not configured.
description: Login error when Microsoft Intune authentication is attempted but the admin has not configured it.

translation: Bot login is forbidden.
description: Login error when a bot account attempts to sign in through an OAuth SSO provider.

translation: {{.Service}} SSO through OAuth 2.0 not available on this server.
description: Login error; {{.Service}} is the OAuth provider name (e.g. GitLab, Google) that is not enabled on this server.

translation: Could not parse auth data out of {{.Service}} user object.
description: Login error; {{.Service}} is the OAuth provider name whose returned user object could not be parsed.

translation: AD/LDAP not available on this server.
description: Login error when AD/LDAP sign-in is attempted but LDAP is not configured or licensed on the server.

translation: This endpoint is deprecated and disabled. Please update your mobile app.
description: API error returned to outdated mobile apps calling a removed SSO code-exchange endpoint; asks the end user to update their mobile app.

translation: User is not an OAuth or SAML user.
description: API error in the desktop app server-side login flow when the desktop token belongs to a user who does not authenticate via OAuth or SAML.

translation: Failed to get {{.Service}} settings
description: Internal error when loading server configuration for an SSO provider; {{.Service}} is the provider name.

translation: Update password failed because context user_id did not match provided user's id.
description: API error when switching from OAuth to email sign-in fails because the requesting user's ID doesn't match the target account; security check message.

translation: Unable to switch to email authentication using an integration session.
description: API error (403) returned when a user tries to switch their account from an OAuth/SSO provider to email-and-password authentication while authenticated with an integration (bot/token) session rather than an interactive login session.

translation: Magic Link is the only sign-in method available for this account.
description: API error when switching to email/password sign-in is blocked because the account only supports Magic Link (email link) sign-in; 'Magic Link' is a feature name.

translation: Authentication Transfer not configured or available on this server.
description: API error when switching an account from OAuth to email sign-in is attempted but the feature ('Authentication Transfer') is unavailable.

translation: Unable to switch to email authentication because user is not using OAuth or SAML authentication.
description: API error when a user tries to switch to email sign-in but their account isn't using OAuth or SAML in the first place.

translation: Field '{{.Field}}' must be set through user's login provider.
description: API error when a profile update tries to change a field controlled by the user's external login provider (LDAP/SAML/OAuth); {{.Field}} is the profile field name, e.g. email or first name.

translation: The {{.Field}} field is managed by your System Admin and cannot be changed.
description: API error when a profile update tries to change a field the admin has locked from editing; {{.Field}} is the profile field name.

translation: Unable to convert the guest to regular user because the guest uses magic link authentication.
description: API error when a guest signed in via magic link (passwordless email link) cannot be promoted to a regular user account.

translation: Unable to convert the guest to a regular user because they are not a guest.
description: API error when promoting a guest to a regular user fails because the account is not a guest.

translation: The reset password token does not appear to be valid.
description: API error shown on the password reset page when the reset token is malformed or of the wrong type.

translation: The reset password link does not appear to be valid.
description: API error shown when a user opens a password reset link that is not valid.

translation: The password reset link has expired.
description: API error shown when a user opens a password reset link after it has expired.

translation: using a reset password link
description: Adverbial phrase inserted into the password-changed notification email describing how the password was changed (e.g. 'Your password has been updated ... using a reset password link'); must read naturally inside that sentence.

translation: Unable to reset password for SSO accounts.
description: API error when a password reset is attempted for an account that signs in via SSO and therefore has no Mattermost password.

translation: Unable to parse the reset password token
description: API error when the data inside a password reset token cannot be parsed.

translation: User auth service must be LDAP or Email.
description: API error when resetting a user's failed login attempt counter is attempted for an account whose authentication is neither LDAP nor email; admin-facing.

translation: You do not have permission to update this resource.
description: API error when the caller lacks permission to reset another user's failed login attempt counter.

translation: Cannot regenerate a disabled access token.
description: API error when regenerating a personal access token that is currently disabled; the token must be enabled first.

translation: SAML 2.0 is not configured or supported on this server.
description: API error when a SAML login endpoint is used but SAML 2.0 is not configured or licensed on the server.

translation: SAML relay state is too long.
description: API error (400) returned during SAML login when the RelayState parameter supplied by the identity provider exceeds the allowed length. Seen by an end user as a login failure.

translation: Failed to send cloud welcome email
description: Error when sending the welcome email to a new Mattermost Cloud workspace user fails; admin/log audience.

translation: Failed to send the deactivate account email successfully
description: Internal error when the confirmation email sent after account deactivation fails to send.

translation: Failed to send email change verification email successfully
description: Server error when the verification email for an address change fails to send; mostly seen in logs.

translation: Unable to reset password for guest magic link accounts.
description: API error when a password reset is requested for a guest account that signs in via magic link and has no password.

translation: Failed to send password reset email successfully.
description: API error when the password reset email fails to send.

translation: Unable to reset password for SSO accounts.
description: API error when a password reset is requested for an account that signs in via SSO and has no Mattermost password.

translation: Failed to send update password email successfully
description: Internal/log error when the notification email about a changed sign-in method fails to send after a SAML account switch.

translation: Failed to send verification email successfully
description: Server error when the account email verification message fails to send; mostly seen in logs.

translation: Session attributes are not enabled.
description: API error when a session-attributes endpoint is called but the feature (per-session attribute-based access control data) is disabled.

translation: You cannot activate a guest account because Guest Access feature is not enabled.
description: API error when reactivating a guest account while the Guest Access feature is disabled.

translation: You cannot modify user status. User is managed by LDAP
description: API error when activating/deactivating a user whose account is managed by AD/LDAP sync; such accounts cannot be changed manually.

translation: You cannot deactivate yourself because this feature is not enabled. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: API error when a user tries to deactivate their own account while self-deactivation is disabled by the admin.

translation: You do not have the appropriate permissions.
description: API error when the caller lacks permission to activate or deactivate a user account.

translation: Could not get user from {{.Service}} user object.
description: API error when parsing the user data returned by the SSO provider during login fails; {{.Service}} is the provider name (e.g. GitLab).

translation: Update password failed because context user_id did not match props user_id.
description: API error when a password change request's session user does not match the user whose password is being changed; technical, mentions request field names.

translation: Update password failed.
description: Generic API error when saving a user's new password fails.

translation: The "Current Password" you entered is incorrect. Please check that Caps Lock is off and try again.
description: API error on the change-password form when the current password entered is wrong; 'Current Password' matches the form field label and 'Caps Lock' is the keyboard key.

translation: Cannot update password for Magic Link accounts.
description: API error when a password change is attempted on a magic-link (passwordless) account; 'Magic Link' is the passwordless sign-in feature.

translation: using the settings menu
description: Phrase inserted into the password-changed notification email describing how the password was changed, e.g. 'your password has been changed using the settings menu'; lowercase mid-sentence fragment.

translation: Update password failed because the user is logged in through an OAuth service.
description: API error when a password change is attempted on an account that authenticates through an OAuth/SSO service.

translation: There was an internal error saving the password.
description: API error when hashing/saving the new password fails internally.

translation: Only system administrators can set already-hashed passwords.
description: API error when a non-admin submits an already-hashed password value; only system admins may set pre-hashed passwords.

translation: Update password failed because we couldn't find a valid account.
description: API error when a password change fails because the target account could not be found or is invalid.

translation: The email you provided does not belong to an accepted domain. Please contact your administrator or sign up with a different email.
description: API error when a user's new email address is outside the server's accepted email domains.

translation: The email you provided does not belong to an accepted domain for guest accounts. Please contact your administrator or sign up with a different email.
description: API error when a guest's new email address is outside the domains allowed for guest accounts.

translation: Field '{{.Field}}' must be set through user's login provider.
description: API error when a user update tries to change a field controlled by the user's external login provider (LDAP/SAML/OAuth); {{.Field}} is the profile field name.

translation: The {{.Field}} field is managed by your System Admin and cannot be changed.
description: API error when a user update tries to change a profile field the admin has locked from editing; {{.Field}} is the profile field name.

translation: Request is missing either AuthData or AuthService parameter.
description: API error when an admin request to change a user's authentication method omits both required parameters; 'AuthData' and 'AuthService' are literal field names.

translation: Custom Permission Schemes not supported by current license
description: API error when assigning custom roles to a user requires the Custom Permission Schemes feature, which the license lacks; admin-facing.

translation: Empty array under 'image' in request.
description: API error when the multipart form field named 'image' in a profile picture upload contains an empty file array; 'image' is a literal field name.

translation: Image limits check failed. Resolution is too high.
description: API error shown when an uploaded profile picture exceeds the maximum image resolution.

translation: Could not decode profile image.
description: API error when an uploaded profile picture cannot be decoded as an image.

translation: Could not encode profile image.
description: API error when re-encoding the processed profile picture fails.

translation: Profile picture must be set through user's login provider.
description: API error when a profile picture change is blocked because the picture is controlled by the user's external login provider (LDAP/SAML).

translation: No file under 'image' in request.
description: API error when a profile picture upload request has no file in the multipart form field named 'image'; 'image' is a literal field name.

translation: Could not open image file.
description: API error when the uploaded profile picture file cannot be opened for reading.

translation: Could not parse multipart form.
description: API error when the multipart form of a profile picture upload request cannot be parsed.

translation: The profile picture is managed by your System Admin and cannot be changed.
description: API error when a profile picture change is blocked because the admin has locked that profile field from editing.

translation: Unable to upload file. Image storage is not configured.
description: API error when a profile picture cannot be uploaded because the server has no file storage configured; directs users to contact an admin.

translation: Unable to upload profile image. File is too large.
description: API error when an uploaded profile picture exceeds the maximum file size.

translation: Couldn't upload profile image.
description: API error when saving the profile picture to file storage fails.

translation: Bad verify email link.
description: API error when the email verification link the user clicked is malformed or invalid.

translation: Bad verify email token type.
description: API error when the email verification token is of the wrong type; 'verify email' refers to confirming the account's email address.

translation: The email verification link has expired.
description: API error shown when a user opens an email verification link after it has expired.

translation: Failed to parse token data from email verification
description: API error when the data inside an email verification token cannot be parsed.

translation: Cannot create a view in a deleted channel.
description: API error when creating a view (a saved filtered perspective of a channel's posts) in a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: View does not belong to the specified channel.
description: API error when the view being deleted does not belong to the channel given in the request; 'view' is a saved filtered perspective of a channel's posts.

translation: Cannot delete a view in a deleted channel.
description: API error when deleting a view (saved channel perspective) in a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: View does not belong to the specified channel.
description: API error when the requested view does not belong to the channel given in the request; 'view' is a saved filtered perspective of a channel's posts.

translation: Cannot get a view from a deleted channel.
description: API error when fetching a view (saved channel perspective) from a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: View does not belong to the specified channel.
description: API error when fetching posts for a view that does not belong to the channel given in the request; 'view' is a saved filtered perspective of a channel's posts.

translation: Cannot get posts for a view from a deleted channel.
description: API error when fetching a view's posts from a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: Cannot list views for a deleted channel.
description: API error when listing views (saved channel perspectives) for a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: View does not belong to the specified channel.
description: API error when the view being updated does not belong to the channel given in the request; 'view' is a saved filtered perspective of a channel's posts.

translation: Cannot update a view in a deleted channel.
description: API error when updating a view (saved channel perspective) in a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: Cannot update view sort order in a deleted channel.
description: API error when reordering views (saved channel perspectives) in a channel that has been archived or deleted.

translation: URL Blocked because of CORS. Url: {{.BlockedOrigin}}
description: WebSocket connection error when the request's origin is rejected by CORS policy; {{.BlockedOrigin}} is the blocked origin URL; developer/admin-facing.

translation: Unknown WebSocket action.
description: WebSocket error sent to a client that requested an unrecognized WebSocket action; developer-facing.

translation: Invalid sequence for WebSocket message.
description: WebSocket error sent to a client whose message sequence number is out of order; developer-facing.

translation: No websocket action.
description: WebSocket error sent to a client whose message did not specify an action; developer-facing.

translation: WebSocket connection is not authenticated. Please log in and try again.
description: WebSocket error sent when a client sends requests before authenticating; asks the user to log in.

translation: Outgoing webhooks from the same channel cannot have the same trigger words/callback URLs.
description: API error when creating an outgoing webhook whose trigger words and callback URLs overlap with an existing webhook in the same channel.

translation: Outgoing webhooks can only be created for public channels.
description: API error when trying to create an outgoing webhook on a private, direct, or group channel; only public channels are allowed.

translation: Invalid permissions to create outgoing webhook.
description: API permission error when the user lacks the rights needed to create an outgoing webhook.

translation: Either trigger_words or channel_id must be set.
description: API validation error for outgoing webhook creation; 'trigger_words' and 'channel_id' are literal API field names and should not be translated.

translation: The webhook user must be a member of the target team or channel.
description: API error when assigning a webhook to a user who does not belong to the team or channel the webhook posts to.

translation: You cannot assign a webhook to a user with higher privileges than your own.
description: API error when a user tries to assign a webhook to run as a user with more privileges than themselves.

translation: Unable to update webhook across teams.
description: API error when a webhook update tries to move the webhook to a channel in a different team, which is not allowed.

translation: Outgoing webhooks from the same channel cannot have the same trigger words/callback URLs.
description: API error when updating an outgoing webhook so that its trigger words and callback URLs would overlap with another webhook in the same channel.

translation: Invalid {{.Name}} parameter.
description: Error sent over the WebSocket connection when a request is missing or has an invalid parameter; {{.Name}} is the parameter name.

translation: Server is busy, non-critical services are temporarily unavailable.
description: Error sent over the WebSocket connection while the server is in high-load ('server busy') mode and rejecting non-critical requests.

translation: Failed to parse request
description: Error returned by a local-mode (mmctl) plugin reattach endpoint when the request body cannot be parsed; developer-facing.

translation: Failed to retrieve the access control subject.
description: Internal error in attribute-based access control when loading the user's attribute data (the policy 'subject') fails.

translation: Failed to retrieve the access control attribute group.
description: Internal error in attribute-based access control when loading the attribute group used to evaluate policies fails.

translation: Unable to get channel role for the user. Please try again.
description: Error in attribute-based access control when the user's channel role cannot be determined; asks the user to retry.

translation: Failed to retrieve the session attributes.
description: API error returned when loading the attributes attached to the user's session for attribute-based access control fails.

translation: You do not have permission to manage this access control policy.
description: API error when the caller lacks permission to manage an attribute-based access control policy; admin-facing.

translation: Access control could not be evaluated for this resource.
description: API error (503) returned to a plugin when the Access Control / Policy Enforcement Point is not available to decide whether the requested resource may be accessed. The underlying reason is carried in the untranslated error detail.

translation: The acting user is invalid or does not exist.
description: API error (400) returned to a plugin when the user ID it supplied as the actor for an access-control check is empty or does not resolve to an existing user.

translation: The action is not a valid access control action.
description: API error (400) returned to a plugin when the action name passed to an access evaluation request is not one of the recognized access control actions. The rejected action name appears in the untranslated error detail.

translation: Invalid identifier supplied to the access control API.
description: API error (400) returned to a plugin when an ID argument (typically the access control policy ID) passed to the plugin access-control API is empty or malformed.

translation: The resource type is not a valid plugin access control resource type.
description: API error (400) returned to a plugin when the resource type it passed to the plugin access-control API is not one of the supported plugin resource types.

translation: Access control policy not found.
description: API error (404) returned to a plugin when the access control policy it asked to fetch, update, or delete does not exist.

translation: The calling plugin does not own this resource type.
description: API error (403) returned when a plugin tries to manage an access control resource type registered by a different plugin. The calling plugin ID appears in the untranslated error detail.

translation: An access control policy of a different type already exists for this ID.
description: API error (400) returned when a plugin saves an access control policy whose ID is already used by a stored policy of another type. The stored type appears in the untranslated error detail.

translation: Subject does not match the authenticated session user.
description: Access control error when a render-time decision names a subject other than the user the session is authenticated as.

translation: Unsupported action for render decisions: {{.Action}}
description: Access control error when a render-time decision requests an action that decisions do not support.

translation: Failed to save the batch of acknowledgement objects
description: Internal error when saving multiple post acknowledgement records at once fails.

translation: Unable to delete acknowledgement.
description: API error when deleting a post acknowledgement record fails; 'acknowledgement' is the priority-post confirmation feature.

translation: Cannot delete acknowledgement for missing post
description: API error when removing an acknowledgement fails because the target post no longer exists.

translation: Unable to get acknowledgement.
description: API error when loading a post acknowledgement record fails.

translation: Unable to get acknowledgement for post.
description: API error when loading the acknowledgements for a specific post fails.

translation: Cannot save acknowledgement for missing post
description: API error when acknowledging fails because the target post no longer exists.

translation: Unable to save acknowledgement for post.
description: API error when saving a user's acknowledgement of a post fails.

translation: Could not decode the XML metadata information received from the Identity Provider.
description: Admin console error when the XML metadata downloaded from the SAML Identity Provider cannot be decoded.

translation: Failure encountered when reading the response payload received from the Identity Provider.
description: Admin console error when reading the HTTP response body from the SAML Identity Provider's metadata URL fails.

translation: Could not read the response received from the Identity Provider.
description: Admin console error when the SAML Identity Provider's metadata endpoint returns an unreadable/invalid response.

translation: Connection unsuccessful: {{.Error}}
description: API error when the System Console SMTP test connection fails; {{.Error}} is the underlying SMTP error detail; admin-facing.

translation: This is not a valid live URL
description: API error in the System Console when the Site URL being tested does not respond as a live Mattermost URL; admin-facing.

translation: Failed to get agents.
description: API error when fetching the list of configured AI agents (bots backed by language models) fails; 'agents' are AI assistants.

translation: Bridge call failed.
description: Internal error when the server's call to the AI agents bridge (Agents plugin integration) fails while listing agents; technical.

translation: Failed to get LLM services.
description: API error when fetching the configured LLM (large language model) services for AI agents fails; admin audience.

translation: Bridge call failed.
description: Internal error when the server's call to the AI agents bridge fails while listing available AI services; technical.

translation: AI agent call failed.
description: API error returned when the request to the AI agents service for a summarization (e.g. channel recap) fails.

translation: Failed to parse AI summarization response.
description: API error returned when the AI service's summarization response cannot be parsed into the expected structure.

translation: Invalid configuration for AI bridge test helper.
description: API error from a testing-only endpoint when the supplied AI bridge test configuration is malformed; audience is developers/QA.

translation: Unable to get the analytics.
description: Internal API error when computing site statistics for the System Console analytics pages fails; admin-facing.

translation: We encountered an error finding the audits.
description: Internal error when fetching audit log records from the database fails; admin-facing.

translation: Limit exceeded for paging.
description: API error when an audit log request asks for more records per page than allowed; admin-facing.

translation: We encountered an error saving the audit.
description: API error returned when the server fails to save an audit log record.

translation: Unable to save the bot.
description: Internal API error when saving a new bot account to the database fails.

translation: This username is reserved for a system-owned bot.
description: API error when an admin or integration tries to create a bot with a username reserved for a built-in, system-owned bot (e.g. the system or feedback bots).

translation:
{{if .disableBotsSetting}}{{if .printAllBots}}{{.UserName}} was deactivated. They managed the following bot accounts which have now been disabled.

{{.BotNames}}{{else}}{{.UserName}} was deactivated. They managed {{.NumBots}} bot accounts which have now been disabled, including the following:

{{.BotNames}}{{end}}You can take ownership of each bot by enabling it at **Integrations > Bot Accounts** and creating new tokens for the bot.

For more information, see our [documentation](https://docs.mattermost.com/developer/bot-accounts.html#what-happens-when-a-user-who-owns-bot-accounts-is-disabled).{{else}}{{if .printAllBots}}{{.UserName}} was deactivated. They managed the following bot accounts which are still enabled.

{{.BotNames}}
{{else}}{{.UserName}} was deactivated. They managed {{.NumBots}} bot accounts which are still enabled, including the following:

{{.BotNames}}{{end}}We strongly recommend you to take ownership of each bot by re-enabling it at **Integrations > Bot Accounts** and creating new tokens for the bot.

For more information, see our [documentation](https://docs.mattermost.com/developer/bot-accounts.html#what-happens-when-a-user-who-owns-bot-accounts-is-disabled).

If you want bot accounts to disable automatically after owner deactivation, set “Disable bot accounts when owner is deactivated” in **System Console > Integrations > Bot Accounts** to true.{{end}}
description: Go-templated direct message sent to system admins when a user who owned bot accounts is deactivated; branches on whether bots were auto-disabled ({{if .disableBotsSetting}}) and whether all bots are listed ({{.printAllBots}}); {{.UserName}} is the deactivated owner, {{.BotNames}} the bot list, {{.NumBots}} a count; uses Markdown (bold paths, links); template syntax must be preserved exactly.

translation: List of admins is empty.
description: Internal error when the server needs a system admin to own the system bot but finds no admin accounts; technical.

translation: Unable to get the bot.
description: Internal API error when fetching a bot account from the database fails.

translation: Unable to get the bots.
description: Internal API error when fetching the list of bot accounts from the database fails.

translation: Unable to update the bot.
description: Internal API error when saving changes to a bot account fails.

translation: This username is reserved for a system-owned bot.
description: API error when an admin or integration tries to rename an existing bot to a username reserved for a built-in, system-owned bot.

translation: Unable to delete the bot permanently.
description: Internal API error when permanently deleting a bot account from the database fails.

translation: Unable to delete the bot.
description: Internal API error when permanently deleting a bot fails due to an invalid bot ID (key contains a legacy spelling of 'permanent').

translation: Unable to update the bot.
description: API error returned when updating a bot account fails (seen during bulk import of bots).

translation: Unable to update the bot.
description: Internal API error when saving changes to a bot account fails.

translation: Cannot disable a system-owned bot.
description: API error (403) shown to a system admin who tries to deactivate a bot account that Mattermost itself owns and manages (for example a built-in system bot), which is not permitted.

translation: This post is not a burn-on-read post and cannot be burned.
description: API error when a user tries to 'burn' (destroy early) a post that isn't a burn-on-read post; 'burn' is the feature's verb for destroying the message.

translation: This burn-on-read post has not been revealed yet. You must reveal it before burning.
description: API error when burning a burn-on-read post before revealing (opening) it; 'reveal' and 'burn' are the feature's action verbs.

translation: An error occurred while retrieving the read receipt.
description: Internal error when loading the read receipt record for a burn-on-read post fails; a read receipt tracks who revealed the post.

translation: An error occurred while updating the read receipt.
description: Internal error when updating the read receipt record while burning a burn-on-read post fails.

translation: Unable to add the user as a member of the channel.
description: API error returned when a user could not be added as a channel member (e.g. the account is deactivated).

translation: Adding channel member rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error returned when a plugin blocks adding a member to a channel; {{.Reason}} is the explanation supplied by the plugin.

translation: Unable to get channel type counts.
description: Internal error when the statistics query counting channels by type (public/private) fails; used by System Console analytics.

translation: Failed to update thread membership for mentioned user
