description: Internal error when automatically making an @-mentioned user follow the message thread fails.

translation: Could not delete bookmark.
description: API error returned when deleting a channel bookmark fails; bookmarks are saved links/files pinned in the channel's bookmarks bar.

translation: Could not get bookmark.
description: API error returned when fetching a channel bookmark fails.

translation: Could not get existing bookmark to update.
description: API error returned when the bookmark being edited cannot be loaded from the database.

translation: Could not save bookmark.
description: API error returned when creating a channel bookmark fails.

translation: Could not update bookmark.
description: API error returned when updating a channel bookmark fails.

translation: Could not sort the bookmark.
description: API error returned when reordering channel bookmarks fails; 'sort' refers to the bookmarks' display order.

translation: Could not sort the bookmark. Invalid input.
description: API error returned when a bookmark reorder request has an invalid target position.

translation: Could not sort the bookmark. Not found.
description: API error returned when the bookmark to be reordered cannot be found.

translation: Failed to retrieve the channel members.
description: Internal error (permissions reset operation, e.g. via mmctl) when querying channel member records fails.

translation: Unable to count messages since given date.
description: Internal error when counting a channel's messages posted after a given timestamp fails.

translation: Unable to count urgent posts since given date.
description: Internal error when counting a channel's urgent-priority posts after a given timestamp fails; 'urgent' is a message priority level.

translation: The Integrated Boards feature is not enabled.
description: API error when creating a board-linked channel while the Integrated Boards (kanban boards) feature is disabled.

translation: Unable to create the board channel.
description: Internal API error when creating the channel associated with a board (kanban project) fails.

translation: Invalid board channel data.
description: API error when the data submitted to create a board-linked channel fails validation.

translation: The maximum number of channels per team has been reached.
description: API error when creating a board channel would exceed the maximum number of channels allowed per team.

translation: Board channels cannot be created via CreateChannel. Use the /boards API instead.
description: API/developer error returned when code tries to create a Boards-type channel through the generic channel creation endpoint; 'CreateChannel' and '/boards' are API names and should not be translated.

translation: Unable to save channel.
description: Generic API error returned when saving a newly created channel to the database fails.

translation: Must specify the team ID to create a channel.
description: API error returned when a channel creation request is missing the team ID.

translation: Space channels cannot be created via this endpoint.
description: API error returned when a request tries to create a Space-type channel (Docs feature) through the regular channel creation endpoint.

translation: The Docs feature is not enabled.
description: API error returned when creating a Space channel while the Docs feature is turned off; 'Docs' is the Mattermost feature name.

translation: Unable to save direct channel.
description: API error returned when saving a new direct message channel to the database fails.

translation: Unable to create initial sidebar categories for user.
description: API error returned when the server fails to create the default sidebar categories (Favorites, Channels, Direct Messages) for a user.

translation: Unable to delete the channel.
description: API error returned when archiving/deleting a channel fails due to a server error.

translation: Channel archive rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error returned when a plugin blocks archiving a channel; {{.Reason}} is the explanation supplied by the plugin.

translation: Could not get channel.
description: Generic API error returned when fetching a channel from the database fails.

translation: Unable to find the existing channel {{.channel_id}}.
description: API error returned when a channel with the given ID does not exist; {{.channel_id}} is the requested channel ID.

translation: We encountered an error finding the channel {{.channel_id}}.
description: API error returned when a database error occurs while looking up a channel; {{.channel_id}} is the requested channel ID.

translation: Unable to get all the channels.
description: Error during a bulk data export when listing all channels for a team fails; seen in CLI/job output.

translation: Unable to get all the channels.
description: API error returned when listing all channels on the server fails (admin-facing operation).

translation: Unable to count all the channels.
description: API error returned when counting all channels on the server fails (admin-facing operation).

translation: Unable to get all the direct channels.
description: Error during a bulk data export when listing all direct message channels fails.

translation: Unable to find the channel by name.
description: Error from a bulk export (mmctl/export job) when looking up a requested channel by its name fails with a database error.

translation: Unable to find the existing channel.
description: API error returned when no channel with the requested name exists.

translation: Channel does not exist.
description: API error when looking up a channel by its URL name finds nothing.

translation: Unable to get the channels for the provided scheme.
description: API error returned when listing the channels that use a given permissions scheme fails; 'scheme' is the permissions-scheme feature term.

translation: Unable to look up channel admins.
description: Server error when looking up the channel admins of channels that are missing a value for a channel attribute fails.

translation: Unable to get the channels.
description: API error returned when fetching a user's channel list fails due to a server error.

translation: No channels were found.
description: API error when a channel list query returns no results.

translation: Unable to get channels by ids.
description: Internal API error when fetching multiple channels by their IDs from the database fails.

translation: Unable to get the channels.
description: API error returned when fetching a set of channels by their IDs fails due to a server error.

translation: No channel found.
description: API error returned when none of the requested channel IDs match an existing channel.

translation: Unable to get channels with unreads and mentions.
description: API error returned when fetching a team's channels together with their unread and mention counts fails; 'unreads' and 'mentions' are unread messages and @-mentions.

translation: Unable to find member count for given channels.
description: API error returned when member counts for the requested channels could not be found.

translation: Unable to find member count.
description: API error returned when a database error occurs while fetching channel member counts.

translation: Unable to check unreads and mentions
description: API error returned when checking a user's unread messages and @-mentions across channels fails.

translation: Error getting common teams for channel.
description: API error returned when fetching the teams that all members of a group message have in common fails (used when converting a group message to a channel).

translation: Channel is not a group message.
description: API error returned when the common-teams lookup is used on a channel that is not a group message; 'group message' is a multi-person direct conversation.

translation: Couldn't fetch common teams.
description: API error returned when the database query for the teams shared by group message members fails.

translation: Unable to find the existing deleted channel.
description: API error returned when a requested archived (deleted) channel could not be found.

translation: No deleted channels exist.
description: API error returned when the user asks for archived channels but there are none.

translation: Unable to get the file count for the channel
description: API error returned when counting the files attached in a channel fails.

translation: Unable to get the channel for the given post.
description: API error shown when the server cannot load the channel that a post (chat message) belongs to.

translation: Unable to get the channel member.
description: Internal API error when fetching a channel membership record from the database fails.

translation: No channel member found for that user ID and channel ID.
description: API error when no channel membership record exists for the given user and channel; shown when an action requires the user to be a channel member.

translation: Unable to get the channel member count.
description: API error returned when fetching the number of members in a channel fails.

translation: Unable to get channel member IDs.
description: Error from a bulk export (mmctl/export job) when reading the list of members of a channel being exported fails.

translation: Unable to get the channel members.
description: API error returned when fetching the list of members of a channel fails.

translation: Unable to get the channel members.
description: API error returned when fetching specific channel members by user ID fails.

translation: Unable to get the channels.
description: API error returned when fetching the list of public channels a user can join ('More Channels' browse view) fails.

translation: Unable to get the channel pinned post count.
description: API error returned when counting the pinned posts in a channel fails; 'pinned post' is a message pinned to the channel.

translation: Unable to get the priority for posts
description: Internal error when loading priority metadata (important/urgent) for a set of posts fails.

translation: Unable to get private channels.
description: API error returned when listing a team's private channels fails (admin-facing operation).

translation: Unable to get public channels.
description: API error returned when listing a team's public channels fails.

translation: Unable to get the channel unread messages.
description: API error returned when fetching a channel's unread message counts fails.

translation: Couldn't delete existing sidebar categories for converted GM.
description: API error returned when, while converting a group message into a private channel, the server fails to remove the old sidebar category entries; 'GM' means group message.

translation: Cannot find user's channel membership
description: API error returned during group message-to-channel conversion when the acting user's channel membership record cannot be found.

translation: The specified team ID in conversion request does not contain all the group message members
description: API error returned during group message-to-channel conversion when the chosen team does not include every member of the group message.

translation: The channel being converted is not a group message. You can only convert group messages
description: API error returned when the conversion endpoint is used on a channel that is not a group message; only group messages can be converted to channels.

translation: Failed to create group message to channel conversion post
description: API error returned when the system message announcing a group message's conversion to a channel could not be posted.

translation: Failed to load channel join request.
description: API error returned when loading a channel join request from the database fails.

translation: Channel join request not found.
description: API error when a pending request to join a channel cannot be found; 'join request' is a user's request to join a discoverable channel.

translation: Failed to save channel join request.
description: API error returned when saving a new channel join request to the database fails.

translation: Failed to update channel join request.
description: API error returned when updating a channel join request (e.g. approving or denying it) fails.

translation: Failed to select the batch of channel members.
description: Error from the advanced-permissions migration job when reading a batch of channel members from the database fails; visible in the jobs table/logs.

translation: Unable to look up channels missing a value for this attribute.
description: Server error when checking whether any active channel is missing a value for a channel attribute fails, e.g. while marking the attribute as Required.

translation: Unable to count channels missing a value for this attribute.
description: Server error when counting the channels that are missing a value for a channel attribute fails.

translation: Unable to count all channels missing a value for this attribute.
description: Server error when counting all channels (local and shared) that are missing a value for a channel attribute fails.

translation: Unable to count local channels missing a value for this attribute.
description: Server error when counting the local (non-shared) channels that are missing a value for a channel attribute fails.

translation: Unable to list channels missing a value for this attribute.
description: Server error when listing the channels that are missing a value for a channel attribute fails, e.g. in the System Console channel list modal.

translation: Unable to look up remote channels missing a value for this attribute.
description: Server error when looking up which of the channels missing a value for a channel attribute are shared (remote) channels fails.

translation: Unable to move a channel unless all its members are already members of the destination team.
description: API error returned when moving a channel to another team is blocked because some channel members are not members of the destination team.

translation: Spaces cannot be moved through this endpoint.
description: API error returned when trying to move a Space channel (Docs feature) between teams via the regular move endpoint; 'Spaces' is a channel type.

translation: Unable to update channel members' notify props.
description: API error returned when a bulk update of channel members' notification preferences fails; 'notify props' are per-channel notification settings.

translation: Unable to update that many channel members. Only {{.Max}} channel members can be updated at once.
description: API error returned when a bulk notification-settings update covers too many channel members; {{.Max}} is the maximum allowed per request.

translation: Unable to delete the channel.
description: API error returned when permanently deleting a channel from the database fails.

translation: Unable to find the pinned posts.
description: API error returned when fetching the pinned posts of a channel fails.

translation: Failed to post channel purpose message
description: API error returned when the system message announcing a channel purpose change could not be posted.

translation: %s removed the channel purpose (was: %s)
description: System post message shown in a channel when a member removes the channel purpose; first %s is the member's username, second %s is the old purpose text.

translation: Failed to retrieve user while updating channel purpose message %v
description: API error returned when the server cannot look up the acting user before posting the channel purpose change system message; %v carries error details.

translation: %s updated the channel purpose from: %s to: %s
description: System post message shown in a channel when its purpose changes; the three %s placeholders are the acting user's username, the old purpose, and the new purpose, in that order.

translation: %s updated the channel purpose to: %s
description: System post message shown in a channel when a purpose is set for the first time; first %s is the member's username, second %s is the new purpose text.

translation: We could not remove the deactivated users from the channel.
description: API error returned when removing all deactivated user accounts from a channel fails.

translation: Unable to remove the channel member.
description: API error returned when removing a member from a channel fails due to a server error.

translation: We could not reset the channel schemes.
description: Internal error (admin permissions reset operation) when clearing all channels' permissions scheme assignments fails.

translation: Unable to restore the channel.
description: API error returned when unarchiving (restoring) an archived channel fails due to a server error.

translation: Channel restore rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error returned when a plugin blocks unarchiving (restoring) a channel; {{.Reason}} is the explanation supplied by the plugin.

translation: Unable to save channel member.
description: Internal error when saving a channel membership record to the database fails.

translation: A channel member with that ID already exists.
description: API error returned when adding someone to a channel they already belong to; the membership record already exists.

translation: We encountered an error searching channels.
description: API error returned when a channel search query fails due to a server error.

translation: Unable to get the group channels for the given user and term.
description: API error returned when searching a user's group message channels by member names fails; 'group channels' are group message conversations.

translation: The set channel members operation was cancelled.
description: API error returned when a bulk 'set channel members' operation is cancelled before completing (e.g. request timeout).

translation: Cannot remove all members from a private channel.
description: API error returned when a bulk membership update would leave a private channel with no members, which is not allowed.

translation: Unable to get current channel members.
description: API error returned when the server cannot load the channel's current member list during a bulk membership update.

translation: Unable to get channel members for role reconciliation.
description: API error returned when the server cannot re-load channel members to reconcile their roles during a bulk membership update.

translation: Failed to insert record to database.
description: API error returned when saving sidebar category data (the user's channel grouping in the left-hand sidebar) to the database fails.

translation: Unable to update the channel.
description: API error returned when a channel update request references an invalid channel ID.

translation: Unable to update channel.
description: Generic API error returned when saving channel changes to the database fails.

translation: Plugin {{.PluginID}} attempted to mutate channel type via ChannelWillBeUpdated; type changes must go through the dedicated type-change path
description: Developer-facing API error when a plugin illegally tries to change a channel's type (public/private) in the ChannelWillBeUpdated hook; {{.PluginID}} is the plugin's identifier and 'ChannelWillBeUpdated' is a hook name.

translation: Channel update rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error returned when a plugin blocks a channel update; {{.Reason}} is the explanation supplied by the plugin.

translation: Spaces cannot have their privacy changed through this endpoint.
description: API error returned when trying to change a Space channel (Docs feature) between public and private through the regular privacy endpoint.

translation: Unable to update the last viewed at time.
description: API error returned when updating the timestamp of when a user last viewed a channel fails (used for read/unread state).

translation: Unable to mark channel as unread.
description: API error returned when marking a channel as unread from a specific post fails.

translation: Unable to update the channel member.
description: API error returned when updating a channel member's record (roles or settings) fails.

translation: Unable to update the channel member, notify props size limit exceeded.
description: API error returned when a channel member's notification settings exceed the maximum stored size; 'notify props' are per-channel notification preferences.

translation: Unable to determine if the user belongs to a list of channels.
description: API error when checking whether a user is a member of any of a given list of channels fails.

translation: Unable to count the channel admins and channels affected by this attribute.
description: Server error when counting the channel admins and channels to notify about a missing channel attribute value fails.

translation: Unable to look up the channel admins to notify about this attribute.
description: Server error when looking up which channel admins to send a direct-message reminder to about a missing channel attribute value fails.

Direct message from the system bot to a channel admin listing their channels that have no value for a required channel attribute; {{.AttributeName}} is the attribute's name and {{.ChannelList}} is a Markdown bullet list of channel links. Keep the Markdown formatting.

translation: - [{{.ChannelDisplayName}}]({{.ChannelLink}})
description: One Markdown bullet line in the channel-admin reminder direct message, linking to a channel that is missing a channel attribute value; keep the leading newline, the dash and the [text](link) syntax.

translation: - _and {{.Count}} more channels_
description: Last Markdown bullet line in the channel-admin reminder direct message when there are too many channels to list; {{.Count}} is the number of channels not shown. Keep the leading newline, the dash and the underscores (italics).

translation: Please set a value for **{{.AttributeName}}** on your channels. A system administrator needs every channel to have this attribute before it can be marked Required.
description: Preview, shown to the system admin before confirming Notify, of the reminder sent to channel admins about a channel attribute missing a value; {{.AttributeName}} is the attribute's name. Keep the Markdown bold markers.

translation: Unable to claim the notification cooldown for this attribute.
description: Server error when reserving the cooldown that prevents reminders about a missing channel attribute value from being sent too often fails.

translation: Channel ID is not a valid channel identifier.
description: API validation error when a channel guard registration passes a malformed channel ID; a 'channel guard' lets a plugin veto channel operations.

translation: Unable to register the channel guard.
description: API error returned when a plugin's request to register a channel guard fails; 'channel guard' is a plugin hook that protects a channel.

translation: Channel ID is required to register a channel guard.
description: API validation error when a channel guard registration is missing the channel ID.

translation: Unable to unregister the channel guard.
description: API error returned when removing a plugin's channel guard fails.

translation: Channel ID is required to unregister a channel guard.
description: API validation error when a channel guard removal request is missing the channel ID.

translation: Failed to record channel member history.
description: Internal error when recording a channel join/leave event in the membership history (used for compliance exports) fails; technical.

translation: Failed to record channel member history. Failed to update existing join record
description: Internal API error when the server fails to close out a user's join record in the channel member history (used for compliance exports).

translation: Preview bucket URL is not configured
description: API error returned when the Cloud preview modal content cannot be loaded because its storage bucket URL is not set; mainly seen by admins/developers.

translation: Failed to fetch preview modal data
description: API error returned when downloading the Cloud preview modal content from remote storage fails.

translation: Failed to parse preview modal data
description: API error returned when the downloaded Cloud preview modal content is not valid JSON.

translation: {{.UsersNum}} members of the {{.WorkspaceName}} workspace have requested starting the Enterprise trial for access to:
description: Start of a bot direct message to system admins; {{.UsersNum}} is the number of requesting members and {{.WorkspaceName}} the workspace name; a list of requested features is appended after the trailing colon/space.

translation: {{.UsersNum}} member of the {{.WorkspaceName}} workspace has requested starting the Enterprise trial for access to:
description: Direct message from the system bot to admins when exactly one workspace member requested starting an Enterprise trial; {{.UsersNum}} is 1, {{.WorkspaceName}} the workspace name, and a feature list is appended after the trailing space.

translation: {{.UsersNum}} members of the {{.WorkspaceName}} workspace have requested a workspace upgrade for:
description: Start of a bot direct message to system admins; {{.UsersNum}} is the number of requesting members and {{.WorkspaceName}} the workspace name; a list of requested features is appended after the trailing colon/space.

translation: {{.UsersNum}} member of the {{.WorkspaceName}} workspace has requested a workspace upgrade for:
description: Direct message from the system bot to admins when exactly one workspace member requested a paid plan upgrade; {{.UsersNum}} is 1, {{.WorkspaceName}} the workspace name, and a feature list is appended after the trailing space.

translation: Unable to save the command.
description: API error returned when saving a new slash command integration fails.

translation: Unable to delete the command.
description: API error returned when deleting a slash command integration fails.

translation: Unable to get the command.
description: API error returned when fetching a slash command integration fails.

translation: Unable to list the commands.
description: API error returned when listing all slash command integrations fails.

translation: Unable to list the autocomplete commands.
description: API error returned when loading the slash commands offered in the message-box autocomplete fails.

translation: Unable to list the team commands.
description: API error returned when listing a team's slash command integrations fails.

translation: Unable to move the command.
description: API error returned when moving a slash command integration to another team fails; 'move' is the transfer action.

translation: Unable to regenerate the command token.
description: API error returned when regenerating a slash command's secret token fails; the token authenticates the integration.

translation: Unable to execute the custom command.
description: API error returned when running a custom (user-created) slash command fails on the server.

translation: Unable to update the command.
description: API error returned when saving changes to a slash command integration fails.

translation: The specified trigger keyword already exists.
description: API error returned when a slash command's trigger word is already used by another command on the team.

translation: You cannot update an existing CommandWebhook.
description: Internal API error when code tries to save a command webhook that already exists; 'CommandWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Unable to save the CommandWebhook.
description: API error when saving a slash-command response webhook fails; 'CommandWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Unable to get the webhook.
description: API error when fetching a slash-command response webhook from the database fails.

translation: Unable to find the webhook.
description: API error when the slash-command response webhook referenced by a request does not exist.

translation: Unable to parse incoming data.
description: API error when the JSON payload sent to a slash-command response webhook cannot be parsed.

translation: Unable to use the webhook.
description: API error when marking a slash-command response webhook as used fails on the server.

translation: Invalid webhook.
description: API error when a slash-command response webhook is expired or has exceeded its usage limit.

translation: Failed to write CSV headers.
description: Error from the user-report export job when writing the header row of the CSV file fails; surfaces in job status/logs.

translation: Failed to write CSV data.
description: Error from the user-report export job when writing data rows into the CSV file fails.

translation: Unsupported report format.
description: Error from the report export job when the requested output format is not one the server can produce (only CSV is supported).

translation: We encountered an error retrieving the compliance reports.
description: Admin-facing API error when loading the list of compliance reports in the System Console fails.

translation: We encountered an error saving the compliance report.
description: Admin-facing API error when saving a compliance report job fails.

translation: Unable to create default team memberships
description: Error from the /test slash command tooling when creating team memberships for auto-generated test users fails; mostly developer-facing.

translation: Unable to create default team membership because it already exists.
description: Error from test-user creation tooling when the default team membership already exists; mostly developer-facing.

translation: Unable to create default team membership because no more members are allowed in that team
description: Error from test-user creation tooling when the target team has reached its member limit; mostly developer-facing.

translation: group name is not unique
description: API error returned when creating or renaming a custom user group with a name that is already taken; lowercase, appears as an error detail.

translation: Unable to convert the property field to a User Attribute field
description: Internal API error converting a generic property field into a User Attribute field; 'User Attribute' is the custom profile attributes feature name.

translation: No Reviewer ID property field found.
description: Internal API error in content flagging when the 'Reviewer ID' property field is missing from the system's property schema.

translation: Failed to update Status property value on setting reviewer.
description: Internal API error when updating a flagged post's review status after assigning a reviewer fails; 'Status' is the review-status property field.

translation: Failed to set flagged post reviewer.
description: API error returned when recording who will review a flagged post fails.

translation: Cannot quarantine this post as it is already quarantined for review.
description: API error shown when a user tries to flag (quarantine) a post that is already under review.

translation: Cannot quarantine this post as it was removed in a previous review.
description: API error shown when a user tries to flag a post that a reviewer already removed in an earlier review.

translation: Cannot quarantine this post as it was retained in a previous review.
description: API error shown when a user tries to flag a post that a reviewer already decided to keep in an earlier review; 'retained' means kept.

translation: Cannot quarantine this post as it is in unknown status.
description: API error shown when a post cannot be flagged because its review status value is unrecognized.

translation: Unable to save property values for the flagged post.
description: Internal API error when saving the metadata (property values) attached to a newly flagged post fails.

translation: Email
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV that content reviewers download for a flagged post. Column holds each listed user's email address. Keep it short — it is a spreadsheet header, not a sentence.

translation: Deactivated
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV. The cells under it are the translated Yes/No values indicating whether the user account is currently deactivated. Keep it short.

translation: Guest
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV. Cells under it are the translated Yes/No values indicating whether the user is a guest account. Keep it short.

translation: Remote user
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV. Cells under it are Yes/No indicating whether the user comes from a remote server via shared channels. Keep it short.

translation: User last activity time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV for the timestamp of the user's most recent session activity. The parenthetical is the literal RFC 3339 timestamp format the cells use and must be left exactly as-is.

translation: Last viewed channel at (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV for when the user last viewed the channel containing the flagged post. The parenthetical is the literal RFC 3339 timestamp format the cells use and must be left exactly as-is.

translation: User ID
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV holding the user's internal Mattermost ID. Keep it short; "ID" is an identifier, not a document.

translation: Username
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV holding the user's Mattermost username. Keep it short.

translation: Was channel member
description: Column header in the post exposure report CSV. Cells under it are Yes/No indicating whether the user was a member of the channel at any point between the post being created and it being flagged. Keep it short.

translation: Cannot generate an exposure report for an edit history revision. Use the current post ID.
description: API error (400) shown to a content reviewer who requests an exposure report using the ID of an old edit revision of a post rather than the ID of the post itself.

translation: Failed to retrieve the channel membership history for the flagged post.
description: API error (500) shown to a content reviewer when the server could not read the channel member history needed to work out who was in the channel while the flagged post was visible.

translation: Failed to retrieve session activity for the flagged post.
description: API error (500) shown to a content reviewer when the server could not load users' session/last-activity data while building the exposure report.

translation: Failed to retrieve channel read state for the flagged post.
description: API error (500) shown to a content reviewer when the server could not load channel members' last-viewed timestamps while building the exposure report.

translation: Channel
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble at the top of the post exposure report CSV. Its value is the channel display name followed by the channel ID in parentheses. Short label, no trailing colon (the code adds one).

translation: Generated at
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble of the post exposure report CSV, followed by the RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which the report was produced. Short label, no trailing colon.

translation: Post ID
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble of the post exposure report CSV, followed by the ID of the flagged post the report covers. Short label, no trailing colon.

translation: Report version
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble of the post exposure report CSV, followed by the report schema version number (e.g. 1.0). Short label, no trailing colon.

translation: Total users
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble of the post exposure report CSV, followed by the number of user rows in the report. Short label, no trailing colon.

translation: Flagged at
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble of the post exposure report CSV marking the end of the exposure window — the RFC 3339 time at which the post was flagged. Short label, no trailing colon.

translation: Post created at
description: Label in the commented metadata preamble of the post exposure report CSV marking the start of the exposure window — the RFC 3339 time at which the post was created. Short label, no trailing colon.

translation: The flagged post has no reporting time recorded, so the exposure window cannot be determined.
description: API error (500) shown to a content reviewer when the flagged post has no recorded flag/report timestamp, so the server cannot compute the end of the exposure window.

translation: Exposure reports are not supported for direct and group messages.
description: API error (400) shown to a content reviewer who requests an exposure report for a post in a direct or group message channel, where the report is not produced.

translation: N/A
description: Cell value in the "last viewed" column of the post exposure report CSV, used when the user is a channel member who never opened the channel. Rendered as the not-applicable abbreviation; keep it very short.

translation: No
description: Cell value for a false boolean in the post exposure report CSV (guest, remote, deactivated, was-channel-member columns). Single word.

translation: No sessions found
description: Cell value in the "last activity" column of the post exposure report CSV, used when no session records exist for that user so no activity time can be reported.

translation: Unknown
description: Cell value in the "last viewed" column of the post exposure report CSV, used when the user is no longer a channel member and therefore has no read state on record. Single word.

translation: Yes
description: Cell value for a true boolean in the post exposure report CSV (guest, remote, deactivated, was-channel-member columns). Single word.

translation: Failed to marshal flagging user's comment
description: Internal API error when serializing the comment entered by the user who flagged a post fails; 'marshal' means JSON-encode.

translation: Failed to marshal flagging user's reason
description: Internal API error when serializing the reason chosen by the user who flagged a post fails.

translation: The message from @{{.username}} has been quarantined for review. You will be notified once it is reviewed by a Reviewer.
description: Ephemeral confirmation message sent to the person who flagged a post, telling them it is quarantined; {{.username}} is the flagged post author's username (shown as an @mention).

translation: Unable to retrieve the content flagging property group.
description: API error when loading the property group backing the content flagging feature fails; 'property group' is an internal data grouping.

translation: Failed to fetch content reviewer settings from the database
description: Admin-facing API error when loading the content-flagging reviewer configuration from the database fails.

translation: Failed to get Status property field.
description: Internal API error when the content flagging 'Status' property field cannot be loaded.

translation: Failed to fetch thread replies for the flagged post.
description: Internal API error when loading the reply thread of a flagged post fails.

translation: Failed to search reviewers in team.
description: API error returned when searching for content reviewers within a team fails.

translation: Failed to marshal reviewer comment
description: Internal API error when serializing the reviewer's comment while keeping a flagged post fails.

translation: Failed to update flagged post status when undeleting flagged post
description: Internal API error when updating a flagged post's review status while restoring (keeping) it fails.

translation: Failed to update post in database when attempting to undelete the flagged post and associated data.
description: Internal API error when restoring (un-deleting) a flagged post that a reviewer decided to keep fails.

translation: Failed to marshal Content Flagging property values to send in WebSocket event.
description: Internal API error when encoding content-flagging data for a real-time WebSocket event fails.

translation: Unable to find Flagged Post ID property field.
description: Internal API error when the 'Flagged Post ID' property field is missing from the content flagging schema.

translation: Failed to find Manage By property field.
description: Internal API error when the 'Manage By' property field is missing from the content flagging schema.

translation: Unable to find reporting user field.
description: Internal API error when the property field that stores who reported (flagged) the post is missing.

translation: Unable to find value for reporting user field.
description: Internal API error when the stored value identifying who reported the flagged post is missing.

translation: Failed to find Status property field.
description: Internal API error when the 'Status' property field is missing from the content flagging schema.

translation: Cannot fetch flagged post as the post is not flagged.
description: API error returned when requesting flagged-post details for a post that was never flagged.

translation: Failed to marshal reviewer comment
description: Internal API error when serializing the reviewer's comment while permanently deleting a flagged post fails.

translation: Failed to update flagged post status when permanently deleting flagged post.
description: Internal API error when updating a flagged post's review status during its permanent deletion fails.

translation: The attachments on this message were omitted from this report because you do not comply with the channel's file download policy.
description: Text of a notice file placed inside the ZIP report a content reviewer downloads for a flagged (quarantined) message, explaining why the message's files are missing from it.

translation: The report you generated did not include the quarantined message's file attachments, because you do not comply with the channel's file download policy.
description: Message posted by the system bot to a content reviewer in the flagged-content review thread after they generated a report on a quarantined message whose attachments were left out.

translation: Cleared
description: Count label in a markdown post-deletion (data spillage) report showing how many message revisions were successfully cleared; appears next to a checkmark icon in a compact stats row.

translation: Failed to close the flagged post report file.
description: Internal API error when the generated flagged-post report file cannot be closed after writing.

translation: Detail
description: Column header of the summary table in the markdown post-deletion (data spillage) report; the column holds per-step detail text.

translation: Status
description: Column header of the summary table in the markdown post-deletion (data spillage) report; the column holds per-step status icons.

translation: Step
description: Column header of the summary table in the markdown post-deletion (data spillage) report; 'Step' is a stage of the deletion process (noun).

translation: Deleted.
description: Outcome text for a step in the flagged-post deletion report (a file generated for reviewers/admins); states the data was deleted. Keep short.

translation: Failed to retrieve edit history.
description: Outcome text in the flagged-post deletion report when the post's edit history could not be loaded.

translation: **File Info IDs:** {{.FileInfoIDs}}
description: Detail line in the flagged-post deletion report listing the deleted file records; uses markdown bold, and {{.FileInfoIDs}} is a comma-separated list of file record IDs.
Detail line in the flagged-post deletion report for removed attachments; plural branches on {{.Count}}, the number of files deleted from storage.

translation: No data found.
description: Outcome text in the flagged-post deletion report when a cleanup step had nothing to delete.

translation: No files found.
description: Detail line in the flagged-post deletion report when the post had no file attachments to delete.

translation: No rows to delete.
description: Detail line in the flagged-post deletion report when there were no database rows to delete for a step; 'rows' are database records.

translation: Post scrubbed and deleted.
description: Outcome text in the flagged-post deletion report for the post record step; 'scrubbed' means its content was blanked before deletion.
Outcome text in the flagged-post deletion report for the edit-history step; plural branches on {{.Count}} (revisions cleared) with {{.Total}} the total number of revisions.

translation: Threads, reactions, and associated data deleted.
description: Outcome text in the flagged-post deletion report summarizing that thread replies, reactions and related data were deleted.

translation: Error Log
description: Bold heading above a quoted block of raw error messages in the markdown post-deletion (data spillage) report.

translation: Generated:
description: Bold label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report header, followed by the report's generation timestamp; ends with a colon because the date is appended after it.

translation: Post deletion incomplete. Review the Error Log and escalate to a System Administrator for manual remediation.
description: Warning callout at the end of a post-deletion (data spillage) report when some deletion steps failed; read by admins/reviewers, 'Error Log' refers to the report section of that name.

translation: Post ID:
description: Bold label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report header, followed by the deleted message's ID; ends with a colon because the ID is appended after it.

translation: Revision
description: Sub-heading label in the post-deletion report for each stored revision (edit history version) of the deleted message; followed by a revision number, e.g. 'Revision 1'.

translation: Revisions found:
description: Bold label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report followed by the number of stored message revisions; ends with a colon because the count is appended after it.

translation: Failed
description: Status label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report for a deletion step that failed; used in stats rows and next to icons, compact.

translation: Not applicable
description: Status label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report for a deletion step that did not apply to this message; compact.

translation: Partial
description: Status label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report for a deletion step that only partly succeeded; compact adjective.

translation: Removed
description: Status label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report for a step whose data was successfully removed; compact past-participle adjective.

translation: Unknown
description: Fallback status label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report when a step's outcome cannot be determined; compact adjective.

translation: Acknowledgements
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for removing post acknowledgements (the 'Acknowledge' receipt feature); a short section label.

translation: Edit history
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for clearing the post's edit history; a short section label.

translation: File attachments
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for deleting the post's attached files from storage; a short section label.

translation: File attachment records
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for deleting the database records describing the post's attachments; a short section label.

translation: Persistent notifications
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for removing the post's persistent (repeating priority) notifications; a short section label.

translation: Post record
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for deleting the post's own database record; a short section label.

translation: Priority metadata
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for removing the post's priority metadata (important/urgent labels); a short section label.

translation: Reminders
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for removing reminders users set on the post; a short section label.

translation: Thread, replies, and reactions
description: Step name in the flagged-post deletion report for deleting the post's thread, replies, and reactions; a short section label.

translation: Summary
description: Heading of the summary table section at the end of the markdown post-deletion (data spillage) report.

translation: Failed to sync the flagged post report file to disk.
description: Internal API error when flushing the flagged-post report file to disk fails.

translation: Failed to create a temporary file for the flagged post report.
description: Internal API error when a temporary file for building the flagged-post report cannot be created.

translation: Post Deletion Report
description: Top-level title of the markdown report generated when a message is purged for data spillage; 'Post' is a chat message (noun).

translation: Total Steps:
description: Bold label in the post-deletion (data spillage) report header, followed by the number of deletion steps; ends with a colon because the count is appended after it.

translation: Failed to write edit history entry to the flagged post report.

translation: Failed to write the exposure report to the flagged post report.

translation: Failed to write metadata to the flagged post report.

translation: Failed to write post details to the flagged post report.
description: Internal API error when writing the post's details into the flagged-post report file fails.

translation: Failed to write content review details to the flagged post report.
description: Internal API error when writing the content review details into the flagged-post report file fails.

translation: Failed to close the flagged post report archive.

translation: Failed to copy attachment contents into the flagged post report archive.
description: Internal API error when copying an attachment's contents into the flagged-post report zip archive fails.

translation: Failed to create an entry in the flagged post report archive.
description: Internal API error when adding a new entry to the flagged-post report zip archive fails.

translation: Failed to save content reviewer settings to the database.
description: Admin-facing API error when saving the content-flagging reviewer configuration fails.

translation: Failed to search the term in Common Reviewers.
description: API error returned when a reviewer name search fails within the common (shared) reviewers list of the content flagging settings.

translation: Failed to search Content Flagging property fields.
description: Internal API error when loading the content flagging property field definitions fails.

translation: Failed to fetch post's content flagging property values from the database.
description: Internal API error when loading a post's content-flagging metadata from the database fails.

translation: Failed to search reviewer posts for the flagged post.
description: Internal API error when finding the review-thread posts associated with a flagged post fails.

translation: Failed to search Property Values for the flagged post.
description: Internal API error when loading a flagged post's stored property values fails.

translation: Failed to search for System Admin Reviewers.
description: API error returned when a reviewer name search fails within the System Admin reviewers list of the content flagging settings.

translation: Failed to search for Team Admin Reviewers.
description: API error returned when a reviewer name search fails within the Team Admin reviewers list of the content flagging settings.

translation: Failed to search for Team Reviewers.
description: API error returned when a reviewer name search fails within a team's reviewers list of the content flagging settings.

translation: Failed to set property values on thread replies for the flagged post.
description: Internal API error when applying flagging metadata to the replies of a flagged post fails.

translation: Failed to delete scheduled post from database.
description: API error shown when deleting a scheduled post (a message queued to be sent later) from the database fails.

translation: You do not have permission to delete this resource.
description: API error when a user tries to delete a scheduled post they do not own.

translation: Scheduled post does not exist.

translation: Unable to fetch existing scheduled post from database.

translation: Direct and group messages cannot be selected for post delivery audit logging.
description: Validation error when a direct or group message channel is selected for post delivery audit logging, which only applies to channels.

translation: Failed to read the post delivery audit logging settings from the database.
description: Error when the post delivery audit logging settings cannot be read from the database.

translation: One or more of the selected channels could not be found.
description: Validation error when one or more channels selected for post delivery audit logging no longer exist.

translation: Failed to save the post delivery audit logging settings to the database.
description: Error when the post delivery audit logging settings cannot be written to the database.

translation: Token does not exist or is expired
description: API error in the desktop app browser-login flow when the one-time login token is missing or has expired.

translation: Token is not valid or is expired
description: API error in the desktop app browser-login flow when the presented login token is invalid or expired.

translation: Cannot find a user for this token
description: API error in the desktop app browser-login flow when the login token is not associated with any user account.

translation: Unable to delete the Draft.
description: API error returned when deleting a saved message draft fails.

translation: Drafts feature is disabled.
description: API error returned when draft syncing is turned off on the server and a draft API call is made.

translation: Unable to get the Draft.
description: API error returned when fetching a saved message draft fails.

translation: Unable to get user's Drafts.
description: API error returned when fetching all of a user's saved message drafts fails.

translation: Unable to get files for Draft.

translation: Unable to save the Draft.
description: API error returned when saving a message draft fails.

translation: Draft rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error returned when a plugin blocks saving a message draft; {{.Reason}} is the explanation supplied by the plugin.

translation: Rate limiter is not set up.
description: Internal API error when the email invitation rate limiter component is not initialized; technical message.

translation: Invite emails rate limit exceeded. Timer will be reset after {{.ResetAfter}} seconds. Please retry after {{.RetryAfter}} seconds.
description: API error when a user sends too many invitation emails in a short period; {{.ResetAfter}} and {{.RetryAfter}} are numbers of seconds.

translation: Error occurred in the rate limiter.
description: Internal API error when initializing the email invitation rate limiter fails.

translation: Unable to save emoji.
description: API error returned when saving a new custom emoji to the database fails.

translation: Unable to delete the emoji.
description: API error returned when deleting a custom emoji fails.

translation: We couldn’t find the emoji to delete.

translation: Unable to get the emoji.
description: API error returned when fetching a custom emoji fails due to a server error.

translation: We couldn’t find the emoji.
description: API error returned when the requested custom emoji does not exist.

translation: Unable to get the emoji.
description: API error returned when looking up a custom emoji by its name fails due to a server error.

translation: We couldn’t find the emoji.
description: API error returned when no custom emoji with the requested name exists.

translation: Unable to get the emoji.
description: API error returned when listing custom emojis fails.

translation: The specified channel was not found in any of the specified teams.

translation: The specified team has been deleted.
description: Bulk export error (mmctl or export job) when a team passed as an export filter has been deleted/archived.

translation: The specified team was not found.
description: Bulk export error (mmctl or export job) when a team name passed as an export filter does not exist.

translation: Failed to copy file during export.
description: Error during a bulk data export when copying a file attachment into the export output fails.

translation: Failed to create file during export.

translation: Failed to create directory during export.

translation: Unable to copy custom emoji images

translation: Unable to create a directory for custom emoji images

translation: Failed to write the team and channel scope into the export. Aborting rather than producing an archive that would import as a full-instance restore.

translation: Failed to add file to zip archive during export.

translation: Failed to remove the requested files from database

translation: Unable to get the file info.

translation: Could not decode gif.
description: Internal API error when decoding an uploaded GIF image fails while generating its preview; 'gif' is a file format.

translation: Unable to get the file infos by ids for post edit history.
description: Internal error when loading file attachment metadata for a post's edit history fails.

translation: Failed to find files for post.
description: API error returned when looking up the file attachments of a post by its ID fails.

translation: Failed to get count of all files.

translation: Unable to get the file info for the post.
description: API error returned when loading the file attachment records of a post fails.

translation: Failed to get storage usage of all files.

translation: Unable to get the file info with options
description: API error returned when a filtered file listing query (admin file search) fails.

translation: Failed to permanently delete file for post.

translation: Failed to remove the file from file store.

translation: Unable to seek to the beginning of the GIF data.

translation: Unable to set the searchable content of the file.

translation: Failed to restore post file attachments.
description: Internal error when restoring previously deleted file attachments of posts fails; log/admin-facing.

translation: Error occurred fetching scheduled posts.
description: API error shown when fetching the user's scheduled posts for a team fails; 'scheduled posts' are messages queued to send later.

translation: Unable to create group syncable memberships.
description: Internal error from the plugin API when creating team/channel memberships driven by LDAP group sync fails; 'syncable' refers to group-synced teams/channels.

translation: Unable to perform operation for that source type.

translation: Unable to delete invalid group syncable memberships.

translation: group syncable was already deleted
description: API error returned when unlinking a group from a team or channel that was already unlinked; 'group syncable' is the group-to-team/channel link.

translation: invalid id property for group.
description: Validation error when a user group record has a malformed ID; developer-facing detail text.

translation: LDAP license required.
description: Error returned from the plugin API when a group operation requires an LDAP-enabled (Enterprise) license.

translation: no matching group found

translation: group member already exists

translation: Unable to get health finding.
description: Server error when a single health dashboard finding could not be loaded from the database.

translation: Health finding not found.

translation: Unable to get health findings.

translation: Unable to mute health finding.
description: Admin API error when muting (silencing) a server health-check finding in the System Console fails with a server error.

translation: Health finding not found.
description: Admin API error (404) when trying to mute a server health-check finding that no longer exists.

translation: Unable to unmute health finding.
description: Admin API error when unmuting a previously silenced server health-check finding in the System Console fails with a server error.

translation: Health finding not found.
description: Admin API error (404) when trying to unmute a server health-check finding that no longer exists.

translation: Error uploading the file: "{{.FilePath}}"
description: Bulk import error when uploading an imported attachment into file storage fails; {{.FilePath}} is the file's path.

translation: --destination-channel-name requires a single-channel export; this export contains multiple channels.
description: Bulk import error shown to the admin running mmctl import, when renaming the imported channel is requested but the export covers several channels. '--destination-channel-name' is a literal command-line flag; keep it in English.

translation: --destination-channel-name requires an export scoped to exactly one team, otherwise the channel name is ambiguous.
description: Bulk import error shown to the admin running mmctl import, when a channel rename is requested but the export does not cover exactly one team. '--destination-channel-name' is a literal command-line flag; keep it in English.

translation: --destination-team-name requires a single-team export; this export contains multiple teams.
description: Bulk import error shown to the admin running mmctl import, when importing into a different team is requested but the export contains several teams. '--destination-team-name' is a literal command-line flag; keep it in English.

translation: Error reading import data file.
description: Error reported by the bulk import tool (CLI/admin) when reading the import data file fails.

translation: This is a scoped export, so --imported-users must be set to either "active" or "inactive"; there is no safe default. Use --imported-users=active when importing into a new instance that these users are moving to, so they can sign in — otherwise every account the import creates is deactivated and nobody, including SSO users, can log in until an administrator reactivates them one by one. Use --imported-users=inactive when importing into an existing instance that already holds other people's content, so accounts created from weak username or email matches stay deactivated until an administrator reviews them. Either way, users who were deactivated on the source server stay deactivated, and accounts that already exist on the destination are matched rather than created and so are not affected by this choice.
description: Bulk import error shown to the admin running mmctl import on a team- or channel-scoped export without choosing how newly created accounts are handled. '--imported-users', '--imported-users=active', '--imported-users=inactive', "active" and "inactive" are literal command-line flags/values; keep them in English. 'SSO' is Single Sign-On.

translation: JSON decode of line failed.

translation: Incorrect or missing version in the data import file. Make sure version is the first object in your import file and try again.
description: Error reported by the bulk import tool when the import file's version declaration is missing or unsupported; 'version' must be the file's first JSON object.

description: Bulk import error when applying a user's custom status (the emoji + text status message) fails.

description: Bulk import error when a custom emoji's image file cannot be read; {{.EmojiName}} is the emoji's name from the import file.

translation: Error generating password.
description: Error shown during bulk data import when the server fails to generate a random password for an imported user; seen by admins running the import.

translation: Some teams not found
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when team names referenced in the import file don't exist.

translation: Some users not found
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when usernames referenced in the import file don't exist.

translation: Failed to look up existing bot

translation: Unable to find owner of the bot
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when the owner user of an imported bot cannot be found; 'bot' is an automated account.

translation: User for bot not found

description: Bulk import error shown to admins when a channel marked as archived in the import file cannot be archived; 'archive' means soft-delete.

translation: Unable to set a channel to use a deleted scheme.

translation: Channel must be assigned to a Channel-scoped scheme.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins; a permissions scheme has a scope (Team or Channel) and channels need a Channel-scoped one.

translation: Error importing channel. Team with name "{{.TeamName}}" could not be found.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins; {{.TeamName}} is the team name referenced by the channel being imported.

translation: Failed to create direct channel
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when creating a direct message channel between two users fails.

translation: Failed to create group channel
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when creating a group message channel (multi-person DM) fails.

translation: Failed to get channel members for direct channel
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when fetching the member list of an imported direct message channel fails.

translation: Failed to get the history of members who have ever belonged to the direct channel

translation: There are no members for the direct channel
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when a direct message channel entry in the import file lists no member users.

translation: Failed to save channel member during direct channel import
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when saving a member of an imported direct message channel fails.

translation: Failed to update direct channel header

translation: Failed to get direct channel

translation: Failed to get group channel
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when looking up the group message channel for an imported post fails.

translation: Import data line has type "channel" but the channel object is null.

translation: Import data line has type "direct_channel" but the direct_channel object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "direct_channel" but contains no data; the quoted word is a literal JSON type value.

translation: Import data line has type "direct_post" but the direct_post object is null.

translation: Import data line has type "emoji" but the emoji object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "emoji" but contains no emoji data; the quoted word is a literal JSON type value.

translation: Import data line has type "post" but the post object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "post" but contains no post data; 'post' here is a chat message record.

translation: Import data line has type "role" but the role object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "role" but contains no role data; the quoted word is a literal JSON type value.

translation: Import data line has type "scheme" but the scheme object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "scheme" but contains no scheme data; 'scheme' is a permissions scheme record.

translation: Import data line has type "team" but the team object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "team" but contains no team data; the quoted word is a literal JSON type value.

translation: Import data line has type "user" but the user object is null.
description: Bulk import error when a line declares type "user" but contains no user data; the quoted word is a literal JSON type value.

translation: Error importing post. Failed to save preferences.

translation: Error importing post. Failed to save priority.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when saving the priority (important, urgent, acknowledgement request) of an imported post fails.

translation: Unable to set a team to use a deleted scheme.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when the import assigns a team to a permissions scheme that has been deleted.

translation: Team must be assigned to a Team-scoped scheme.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins; a permissions scheme has a scope (Team or Channel) and teams need a Team-scoped one.

translation: Error importing user preferences. Failed to save preferences.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when persisting an imported user's preferences fails.

translation: Error importing user channels. Channel not found.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when a channel referenced in a user's channel-membership data cannot be found.

translation: Error importing user channel memberships. Failed to save preferences.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when saving channel-related preferences (e.g. favorites) for an imported user fails.

translation: Unable to import the new team membership because it already exists
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when an imported team membership conflicts with one already in the database.

translation: Unable to import team memberships
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when saving imported team membership records fails.

translation: Unable to import team membership because no more members are allowed in that team
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when a team has reached its maximum user limit so the membership cannot be added.

translation: Unable to save the team theme preferences
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when saving a user's per-team theme preference during import fails.

translation: Error importing user teams. Team not found.
description: Returned during a bulk import when a user's team membership references a team that does not exist on the destination server. Only surfaces on non-scoped imports; scoped imports skip the membership and log it in the unmatched-users report instead.

translation: SSO user import data is missing required fields (username or email).
description: Bulk import error when a single sign-on (SSO) user record in the import file lacks the data needed to create the account ahead of the main import.

translation: The {{.Service}} auth provider is not configured on this server: {{.Detail}}
description: Bulk import pre-check error when the export contains users of a sign-in method that is not set up on this server. {{.Service}} is the internal auth service ID (e.g. ldap, saml, gitlab, google, office365, openid); {{.Detail}} is an untranslated English explanation.

translation: Unable to read the version of the data import file.
description: Bulk import error when the version declaration at the top of the import file cannot be parsed.

translation: Failed to open the profile image file: {{.FileName}}
description: Bulk import error shown to admins; {{.FileName}} is the path of the profile picture file that could not be opened.

translation: Failed to read profile image data.
description: Bulk import error shown to admins when reading the bytes of an imported profile picture fails.

translation: Failed to validate attachment import data. Invalid path: "{{.Path}}"
description: Bulk-import validation error (CLI/mmctl output) when a post attachment references an invalid file path; {{.Path}} is the offending path.

translation: Bot owner is missing
description: Bulk-import validation error when a bot entry in the import file has no owner user specified.

translation: Channel display_name is not within permitted length constraints.
description: Bulk-import validation error for a channel entry; 'display_name' is a literal field name in the import file and should stay untranslated.

translation: Channel header is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry's header text exceeds the length limit; 'header' is the text shown at the top of a channel.

translation: Channel name contains invalid characters.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry's URL name contains disallowed characters.

translation: Channel name is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry's URL name exceeds the length limit.

translation: Missing required channel property: name
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry lacks the 'name' field; 'name' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Channel purpose is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry's purpose text exceeds the length limit; 'purpose' is the channel description field.

translation: Invalid scheme name for channel.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry references an invalid permissions scheme name; 'scheme' is a permissions scheme.

translation: Missing required channel property: team
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry lacks the 'team' field; 'team' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Channel type is invalid.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry's type is not a recognized channel type (open/private).

translation: Missing required channel property: type.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel entry lacks the 'type' field; 'type' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Direct channel header is too long
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message channel entry's header text exceeds the length limit.

translation: Missing required direct channel property: members
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message channel entry lacks the 'members' field; 'members' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Direct channel members list contains too few items
description: Bulk import validation error when a direct channel entry lists fewer members than the minimum (two).

translation: Direct channel members list contains too many items
description: Bulk import validation error when a direct channel entry lists more members than group messages allow.

translation: Direct channel can only be favorited by members. "{{.Username}}" is not a member.
description: Bulk-import validation error when someone listed as favoriting a direct channel is not one of its members; {{.Username}} is that user's username.

translation: Failed to validate direct post attachment data.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an attachment on a direct-message post fails validation; 'post' is a noun (a message).

translation: Missing required direct post property: channel_members
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post lacks the 'channel_members' field; 'channel_members' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Direct post channel members list contains too few items
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post lists fewer channel members than the minimum required.

translation: Direct post channel members list contains too many items
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post lists more channel members than the maximum allowed.

translation: Missing required direct post property: create_at
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post lacks the 'create_at' timestamp field; 'create_at' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: CreateAt must be greater than 0
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post's creation timestamp is zero; 'CreateAt' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Message is too long
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post's text exceeds the maximum message length.

translation: Missing required direct post property: message
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post lacks the 'message' field; 'message' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Failed to validate direct post thread follower data.
description: Bulk-import validation error when the thread-follower data attached to a direct-message post is invalid; 'follower' means a user following the message thread.

translation: Direct post can only be flagged by members of the channel it is in. "{{.Username}}" is not a member.
description: Bulk-import validation error when someone listed as flagging (saving) a direct-message post is not a member of its channel; {{.Username}} is that user's username.

translation: Missing required direct post property: user
description: Bulk-import validation error when a direct-message post lacks the 'user' (author) field; 'user' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Import emoji data empty.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a custom emoji entry in the import file is empty.

translation: Import emoji image field missing or blank.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a custom emoji entry has no image file specified.

translation: Import emoji image field has an invalid path: "{{.Path}}"
description: Bulk-import validation error when a custom emoji entry's image path is invalid; {{.Path}} is the offending path.

translation: Import emoji name field missing or blank.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a custom emoji entry has no name specified.

translation: Failed to validate post attachment data.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an attachment on a channel post fails validation; 'post' is a noun (a message).

translation: Missing required Post property: Channel.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry lacks the channel field; 'Post' and 'Channel' are literal field names and should stay untranslated.

translation: Missing required Post property: create_at.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry lacks the 'create_at' timestamp field; field names should stay untranslated.

translation: Post CreateAt property must not be zero.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry's creation timestamp is zero; 'CreateAt' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Post Message property is longer than the maximum permitted length.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry's message text exceeds the maximum length; 'Message' is a literal field name.

translation: Missing required Post property: Message.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry lacks the message field; 'Post' and 'Message' are literal field names and should stay untranslated.

translation: Post Props are longer than the maximum permitted length.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry's props (metadata) exceed the maximum size; 'Props' is a literal field name.

translation: Missing required Post property: Team.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry lacks the team field; 'Post' and 'Team' are literal field names and should stay untranslated.

translation: Failed to validate post thread follower data.
