description: Bulk-import validation error when the thread-follower data attached to a post is invalid; 'follower' means a user following the message thread.

translation: Missing required Post property: User.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post entry lacks the author field; 'Post' and 'User' are literal field names and should stay untranslated.

translation: Acknowledgement AcknowledgedAt property must be set and not before the post CreateAt.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post acknowledgement has no timestamp or one earlier than the post; 'AcknowledgedAt' and 'CreateAt' are literal field names.

translation: Missing required Acknowledgement property: User.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post acknowledgement lacks the acknowledging username; 'Acknowledgement' and 'User' are literal field names.

translation: Post acknowledgements require a Priority with RequestedAck set to true.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post has acknowledgements but its priority does not request them; 'Priority' and 'RequestedAck' are literal field names.

translation: Post PersistentNotifications require the urgent Priority.
description: Bulk-import validation error when persistent notifications are set on a post whose priority is not urgent; 'PersistentNotifications' and 'Priority' are literal field names.

translation: Missing required Priority property: Priority.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a post priority object has no priority value (use an empty string for standard priority); 'Priority' is a literal field name.

translation: Reaction CreateAt property must be greater than the parent post CreateAt.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an emoji reaction's timestamp is earlier than the post it reacts to; 'CreateAt' is a literal field name.

translation: Missing required Reaction property: create_at.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an emoji reaction entry lacks the 'create_at' timestamp; field names should stay untranslated.

translation: Reaction CreateAt property must not be zero.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an emoji reaction entry's timestamp is zero; 'CreateAt' is a literal field name.

translation: Reaction EmojiName property is invalid. It must be 1 to 64 ASCII letters and numbers, +, -, or _.
Missing required Reaction property: EmojiName.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an emoji reaction entry lacks the emoji name; 'EmojiName' is a literal field name.

translation: Missing required Reaction property: User.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an emoji reaction entry lacks the user field; 'Reaction' and 'User' are literal field names.

translation: Failed to validate reply attachment data.
description: Bulk-import validation error when an attachment on a reply (threaded message) fails validation.

translation: Missing required Reply property: create_at.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a reply entry lacks the 'create_at' timestamp; 'Reply' means a threaded message, field names stay untranslated.

translation: Reply CreateAt property must not be zero.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a reply entry's creation timestamp is zero; 'CreateAt' is a literal field name.

translation: Reply Message property is longer than the maximum permitted length.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a reply's message text exceeds the maximum length; 'Reply' means a threaded message.

translation: Missing required Reply property: Message.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a reply entry lacks the message field; 'Reply' and 'Message' are literal field names.

translation: Missing required Reply property: User.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a reply entry lacks the author field; 'Reply' and 'User' are literal field names.

translation: Invalid role description.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a role entry's description is invalid; 'role' is a permissions role.

translation: Invalid role display name.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a role entry's display name is invalid; 'role' is a permissions role.

translation: Invalid permission on role.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a role entry lists a permission that does not exist.

translation: Invalid role name.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a role entry's internal name is invalid; 'role' is a permissions role.

translation: Invalid scheme description.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a permissions scheme entry's description is invalid; 'scheme' is a permissions scheme.

translation: Invalid scheme display name.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a permissions scheme entry's display name is invalid.

translation: Invalid scheme name.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a permissions scheme entry's internal name is invalid.

translation: Scheme scope is required.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a permissions scheme entry lacks a scope; 'scope' means whether the scheme applies to teams or channels.

translation: Unknown scheme scope.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a permissions scheme entry's scope value is not recognized (team or channel).

translation: The wrong roles were provided for a scheme with this scope.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a permissions scheme lists roles that don't match its scope (e.g. channel roles on a team scheme).

translation: Team description is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry's description exceeds the length limit.

translation: Team display_name is not within permitted length constraints.
description: Bulk-import validation error for a team entry; 'display_name' is a literal field name in the import file and should stay untranslated.

translation: Missing required team property: display_name.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry lacks the 'display_name' field; the field name should stay untranslated.

translation: Team name contains invalid characters.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry's URL name contains disallowed characters.

translation: Team name is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry's URL name exceeds the length limit.

translation: Missing required team property: name.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry lacks the 'name' field; the field name should stay untranslated.

translation: Team name contains reserved words.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry's URL name uses a reserved word not allowed in team names.

translation: Invalid scheme name for team.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry references an invalid permissions scheme name.

translation: Team type is not valid.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry's type is not a recognized team type (open/invite-only).

translation: Missing required team property: type.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a team entry lacks the 'type' field; the field name should stay untranslated.

translation: Import follower data empty.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a thread-follower entry is empty; 'follower' means a user following a message thread.

translation: Missing required follower property: user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a thread-follower entry lacks the 'user' field; the field name should stay untranslated.

translation: Channel name missing from User's Channel Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's channel membership entry has no channel name.

translation: Invalid Desktop NotifyProps for User's Channel Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel membership's desktop notification setting has an invalid value; 'NotifyProps' is a literal field name.

translation: Invalid MarkUnread NotifyProps for User's Channel Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel membership's mark-unread notification setting has an invalid value; 'MarkUnread' and 'NotifyProps' are literal field names.

translation: Invalid Mobile NotifyProps for User's Channel Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a channel membership's mobile notification setting has an invalid value; 'NotifyProps' is a literal field name.

translation: Invalid roles for User's Channel Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's channel membership lists invalid roles.

translation: Invalid email batching interval setting for User
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's email batching interval preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid markdown preview setting for User
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's markdown preview preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid post formatting setting for User
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's post formatting preference has an invalid value; 'post' is a noun (message).

translation: Invalid show unread section setting for User
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's show-unread-section sidebar preference has an invalid value.

translation: User AuthData and Password are mutually exclusive.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry sets both SSO auth data and a password; 'AuthData' and 'Password' are literal field names.

translation: User AuthService and AuthData are mutually inclusive.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry sets only one of the SSO fields; 'AuthService' and 'AuthData' are literal field names and 'mutually inclusive' means both must be set together.

translation: User AuthData is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's SSO auth data exceeds the length limit; 'AuthData' is a literal field name.

translation: User has channel guest roles but is not a system guest.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user has guest roles in channels without having the system-level guest role; 'guest' is the limited-access account type.

translation: User email has an invalid length.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's email address is too long or empty.

translation: Missing required user property: email.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry lacks the 'email' field; the field name should stay untranslated.

translation: User First Name is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's first name exceeds the length limit.

translation: User profile image path is invalid: "{{.Path}}"
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's profile image path is invalid; {{.Path}} is the offending path.

translation: User Last Name is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's last name exceeds the length limit.

translation: User nickname is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's nickname exceeds the length limit.

translation: Invalid Channel Trigger Notify Prop for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's channel-wide mention notification setting has an invalid value; 'Notify Prop' refers to a notification preference field.

translation: Invalid Comments Prop value for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's reply/comment notification preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid Desktop Notify Prop value for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's desktop notification preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid Desktop Sound Notify Prop value for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's desktop notification sound preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid Email Notify Prop value for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's email notification preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid mention_keys Notify Prop for user: exceeds the limit of {{.MaxCount}} keys or {{.MaxLength}} bytes.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's mention keywords exceed the allowed number of keys or total length.

translation: Invalid Mobile Notify Prop value for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's mobile notification preference has an invalid value.

translation: Invalid Mobile Push Status Notify Prop for user.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's mobile push availability-status preference has an invalid value.

translation: User Password has invalid length.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's password is empty or exceeds the maximum length.

translation: User Position is too long.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's job position text exceeds the length limit; 'Position' is the job title profile field.

translation: Invalid profile image.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's profile image file is invalid.

translation: User roles are not valid.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry lists invalid system roles.

translation: User is a system guest but does not have channel guest roles in all channels. Channel guest count: {{.ChannelGuestCount}}, Total channels: {{.TotalChannels}}.
description: Bulk-import validation error for a guest user lacking guest roles in some channels; {{.ChannelGuestCount}} and {{.TotalChannels}} are counts used to explain the mismatch.

translation: User is a system guest but does not have team guest roles in all teams. Team guest count: {{.TeamGuestCount}}, Total teams: {{.TotalTeams}}.
description: Bulk-import validation error for a guest user lacking guest roles in some teams; {{.TeamGuestCount}} and {{.TotalTeams}} are counts used to explain the mismatch.

translation: User has team guest roles but is not a system guest.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user has guest roles in teams without having the system-level guest role.

translation: Username is not valid.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's username fails format validation.

translation: Missing required user property: username.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry lacks the 'username' field; the field name should stay untranslated.

translation: Invalid auth service: {{.AuthService}}
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user entry's SSO provider name is not recognized; {{.AuthService}} is the invalid provider value.

translation: Invalid roles for User's Team Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's team membership lists invalid roles.

translation: Invalid team theme for the User
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's per-team color theme data is invalid.

translation: Team name missing from User's Team Membership.
description: Bulk-import validation error when a user's team membership entry has no team name.

translation: insert error
description: Low-level database error detail meaning an insert query failed; terse developer-facing text used in group-related API errors.

translation: DownloadExportResults in config.json is false. Please set this to true to download the results of this job.
description: Admin error when downloading export job results while disabled; 'DownloadExportResults', 'config.json', 'false', and 'true' are literal config terms and must not be translated.

translation: Error during job execution.
description: Generic error attached to a background job's status when its worker fails; visible in the System Console jobs table.

translation: Unable to get the job.
description: API error shown to admins when a background job record cannot be fetched from the database; 'job' is a scheduled server task.

translation: Unable to get the jobs.
description: API error shown to admins when the list of background jobs cannot be fetched from the database.

translation: Unable to get all jobs by type and status.
description: API error returned when the server cannot query background jobs by type and status; shown to admins.

translation: Unable to get the job count by status and type.
description: Database error when counting background jobs filtered by status and type; admin/log audience.

translation: Unable to get the newest job by status and type.
description: Database error when querying the most recent background job filtered by status and type; admin/log audience.

translation: Unable to save the job.
description: API error returned when the server fails to save a background job record; shown to admins.

translation: Unable to update the job.
description: API error returned when the server fails to update a background job record; shown to admins.

translation: Unable to update job status. Invalid status set
description: API error shown to admins when a background job's status cannot be changed because the requested status transition is invalid.

translation: Error fetching last accessible post
description: Internal error when determining the oldest post visible under cloud message-history limits fails.

translation: Failed to get single-channel guest count.
description: Internal API error when querying the count of guests who belong to only one channel (used for seat-limit calculations) fails.

translation: Failed to get user count
description: Internal API error when querying the total activated user count (used for seat-limit calculations) fails.

translation: Could not update last login timestamp
description: Internal error logged when recording the user's last-login time during sign-in fails.

translation: Encountered an error decoding JSON response from interactive dialog lookup.
description: API error returned when the JSON response from an integration's interactive dialog lookup URL cannot be decoded; 'interactive dialog' is a form opened by integrations.

translation: Encountered an error processing JSON response from interactive dialog lookup.
description: API error returned when processing the JSON response from an interactive dialog's dynamic option lookup fails.

translation: Encountered an error reading response body from interactive dialog lookup.
description: API error returned when reading the HTTP response body from an interactive dialog lookup request fails.

translation: Failed to clear managed category from channel.
description: API error returned when removing a channel from an admin-managed sidebar category fails; 'managed category' is an admin-controlled sidebar section.

translation: Direct and group message channels cannot be assigned to a managed category.
description: API error returned when trying to place a direct or group message conversation into an admin-managed sidebar category, which is not allowed.

translation: Managed category name cannot be empty.
description: API validation error when an admin-managed sidebar category is created or updated without a name.

translation: Failed to retrieve managed category mappings.
description: API error returned when loading the channel-to-managed-category assignments fails.

translation: Failed to search for managed category for channel.
description: API error returned when looking up which managed sidebar category a channel belongs to fails.

translation: Failed to set managed category on channel.
description: API error returned when assigning a channel to an admin-managed sidebar category fails.

translation: error retrieving member count
description: Low-level database error detail when counting a group's members fails; terse developer-facing text.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} sent you a new Direct Message.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a missed direct message; {{.SenderName}} is the sender's display name.

translation: {{.Hour}}:{{.Minute}} {{.TimeZone}}
description: Timestamp line in email notifications; {{.Hour}} and {{.Minute}} are numbers and {{.TimeZone}} is the recipient's time zone abbreviation. Reorder placeholders to fit local time formats.

translation: {{.SenderName}} sent you a new message
description: Title/heading of an email notification for a missed direct message; {{.SenderName}} is the sender's display name.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} sent a message to your group.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a missed group message (multi-person DM); {{.SenderName}} is the sender's display name.

translation: {{.SenderName}} sent you a new message
description: Title/heading of an email notification for a missed group message (multi-person DM); {{.SenderName}} is the sender's display name.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} mentioned you in the {{.ChannelName}} channel.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a missed @-mention; {{.SenderName}} is the sender and {{.ChannelName}} the channel where the mention occurred.

translation: {{.SenderName}} mentioned you in a message
description: Title/heading of an email notification for a missed @-mention; {{.SenderName}} is the sender's display name.

translation: {{.SenderName}} replied to a thread
description: Title/heading of an email notification for a reply in a followed thread; {{.SenderName}} is the replier's display name.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} replied to a thread you're following.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a reply in a followed thread (channel name hidden by privacy settings); {{.SenderName}} is the replier.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} replied to a thread you're following in {{.ChannelName}}.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a reply in a followed thread; {{.SenderName}} is the replier and {{.ChannelName}} the channel containing the thread.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} replied to a thread in your Direct Message.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a thread reply inside a direct message conversation; {{.SenderName}} is the replier.

translation: While you were away, {{.SenderName}} replied to a thread in your group.
description: Subtitle line in an email notification for a thread reply inside a group message (multi-person DM); {{.SenderName}} is the replier.

translation: and go to Settings > Notifications
description: Footer sentence fragment in notification emails; it is appended directly after a 'log in to your team site' link, so it starts mid-sentence, and 'Settings > Notifications' is a UI menu path.

translation: Login to Mattermost
description: Link/label text in the footer of notification emails inviting the recipient to sign in to the Mattermost server.

translation: Want to change your notifications settings?
description: Footer heading in notification emails, preceding the instructions to change notification settings.

translation: [{{.SiteName}}] New Direct Message from {{.SenderDisplayName}} on {{.Month}} {{.Day}}, {{.Year}}
description: Email subject line for a direct message notification; {{.SiteName}} is the server name, {{.SenderDisplayName}} the sender, and {{.Month}}/{{.Day}}/{{.Year}} form the date.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] New Group Message in {{ .ChannelName}} on {{.Month}} {{.Day}}, {{.Year}}
description: Email subject line for a group message notification; {{.SiteName}} is the server name, {{.ChannelName}} the group conversation name, and {{.Month}}/{{.Day}}/{{.Year}} form the date.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] New Group Message on {{.Month}} {{.Day}}, {{.Year}}
description: Email subject line for a group message notification when the channel name is hidden by privacy settings; {{.SiteName}} is the server name and {{.Month}}/{{.Day}}/{{.Year}} form the date.

translation: [{{ .SiteName }}] Notification in {{ .TeamName}} on {{.Month}} {{.Day}}, {{.Year}}
description: Email subject line for a channel mention/notification; {{.SiteName}} is the server name, {{.TeamName}} the team, and {{.Month}}/{{.Day}}/{{.Year}} form the date.

translation: The post cannot be created
description: API error when the 'send a test notification' feature fails to create the test message; 'post' is a noun (chat message).

translation: Cannot get the system bot
description: API error when the 'send a test notification' feature can't find the system bot account that sends the message.

translation: Cannot get the system bot direct message
description: API error when the 'send a test notification' feature can't open the direct message channel with the system bot.

translation: Cannot get the user
description: API error when the 'send a test notification' feature can't load the requesting user.

translation: If you received this test notification, it worked!
description: Body of the test notification message sent to a user (as a DM from the system bot) to verify their notification settings work.

translation: Unable to save notify data.
description: Internal API error when persisting a user's 'notify admin to upgrade' request fails.

translation: Unable to send notification post.
description: Internal API error when posting the upgrade-request notification message to admins fails.

translation: The personal access token "{{.Description}}" for bot account @{{.BotUsername}} will expire in {{.Days}} days or less. Open **Integrations > Bot Accounts** to regenerate it before it stops working.
description: Direct message from the system bot to a bot's owner warning that one of the bot's personal access tokens expires soon. {{.Description}} is the token's description, {{.BotUsername}} the bot's username, {{.Days}} the number of days (7 or 3). 'Integrations > Bot Accounts' is a menu path; match the translated UI labels. Keep the Markdown ** markers.

translation: The personal access token "{{.Description}}" for bot account @{{.BotUsername}} will expire within 24 hours. Open **Integrations > Bot Accounts** to regenerate it before it stops working.
description: Direct message from the system bot to a bot's owner warning that one of the bot's personal access tokens expires within a day. {{.Description}} is the token's description, {{.BotUsername}} the bot's username. 'Integrations > Bot Accounts' is a menu path; match the translated UI labels. Keep the Markdown ** markers.

translation: Your personal access token "{{.Description}}" will expire in {{.Days}} days or less. Open **Profile > Security** to regenerate it before it stops working.
description: Bot direct message warning a user their personal access token is about to expire; {{.Description}} is the token's name and {{.Days}} the days remaining; '**Profile > Security**' is a markdown-bold menu path.

translation: Your personal access token "{{.Description}}" will expire within 24 hours. Open **Profile > Security** to regenerate it before it stops working.
description: Direct message from the system bot warning a user their personal access token expires within 24 hours; {{.Description}} is the token's user-given label, markdown bold marks the settings path.

translation: (no description)
description: Placeholder substituted for the token name in the expiring-token warning DM when the personal access token has no description.

translation: An error occurred while deleting the OAuth2 App.
description: API error shown (e.g. in System Console / integrations UI) when deleting a registered OAuth 2.0 application fails.

translation: We encountered an error finding all the access tokens.
description: Internal error when loading all OAuth access tokens a user has granted to an application fails.

translation: Unable to find the requested app.
description: API error when the requested registered OAuth application does not exist; 'app' means OAuth application.

translation: We encountered an error finding the app.
description: API error when the database lookup for a registered OAuth application fails; 'app' means OAuth application.

translation: Unable to find any existing apps.
description: API error when listing the OAuth applications created by a user finds none/fails; 'apps' means OAuth applications.

translation: An error occurred while finding the OAuth2 Apps.
description: API error when listing all registered OAuth 2.0 applications fails; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to remove the access token.
description: Internal error when deleting an OAuth access token from the database fails.

translation: Unable to remove oauth data.
description: Internal error when deleting OAuth authorization data for a client application fails.

translation: Must call update for existing app.
description: API error when trying to create an OAuth application that already exists (update should be used instead); developer-facing.

translation: Unable to save the app.
description: API error when saving a new registered OAuth application to the database fails; 'app' means OAuth application.

translation: Unable to find the existing app to update.
description: API error when the OAuth application to be updated cannot be found; 'app' means OAuth application.

translation: We encountered an error updating the app.
description: API error when writing changes to a registered OAuth application fails; 'app' means OAuth application.

translation: Membership policies cannot be applied to team default channels.
description: API error when an attribute-based membership policy is applied to a team's default channel (e.g. Town Square), which is not allowed; 'pap' = Policy Administration Point, admin-facing.

translation: Channel is group constrained and cannot have access control policies applied.
description: API error when an access control policy is applied to a channel whose membership is managed by group sync; admin-facing.

translation: Shared channels cannot have access control policy applied.
description: API error when an access control policy is applied to a shared channel (shared with another Mattermost server); admin-facing.

translation: Access control policies can only be applied to public or private channels.
description: API error when an access control policy targets a channel type other than public or private (e.g. a direct message); admin-facing.

translation: You do not have permission to manage access control for this channel.
description: API error when the caller lacks permission to manage attribute-based access control for a specific channel; admin-facing.

translation: You do not have permission to manage this access control policy.
description: API error when the caller lacks permission to manage a specific attribute-based access control policy; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to assign access control policy to channels.
description: API error when linking an attribute-based access control policy to channels fails; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to assign access control policy to teams.
description: API error when linking an attribute-based access control policy to teams fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not check expression.
description: API error returned to system admins when validating an attribute-based access control (ABAC) policy expression fails; 'expression' is the CEL rule text.

translation: Could not create access control policy.
description: API error when saving a new attribute-based access control policy fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not delete access control policy.
description: API error when deleting an attribute-based access control policy fails; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to delete access control policy.
description: API error shown to system admins when deleting an attribute-based access control policy fails.

translation: You cannot delete this policy because it contains attribute values you do not have permission to view.
description: API error when an admin cannot delete an access control policy because it references attribute values hidden (masked) from them by visibility rules.

translation: Could not generate visual AST from expression.
description: API error for admins when an access control policy expression cannot be converted into the visual rule-editor representation; AST means abstract syntax tree.

translation: Could not get access control auto complete.
description: API error when fetching autocomplete suggestions in the access control policy editor fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not get access control policies.
description: API error when listing attribute-based access control policies fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not get attributes for channel.
description: API error when fetching the access control attributes applied to a channel fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not get channel members to remove.
description: API/job error for admins when computing which channel members no longer satisfy an access control policy and must be removed.

translation: Could not generate masked visual AST from expression.
description: Internal error when generating the visual (tree) representation of an access control policy expression with hidden values masked fails; 'AST' = abstract syntax tree, admin-facing.

translation: Could not get policies for the given field IDs.
description: API error for admins when fetching the access control policies that reference given user-attribute fields fails.

translation: Unable to retrieve the access control policy.
description: API error shown to system admins when loading a single attribute-based access control policy fails.

translation: Could not get attributes for policy.
description: API error for admins when fetching the user attributes referenced by an access control policy fails; 'policy' is an access control policy.

translation: Could not get team members to remove.
description: API/job error for admins when computing which team members no longer satisfy an access control policy and must be removed.

translation: Could not determine masked values for policy expression.
description: API error for admins editing access control policies; 'masked values' are attribute values hidden from the current viewer.

translation: Could not load the action set declared by the channel's access control policy.
description: Internal error when loading the set of actions defined by a channel's access control policy fails; technical, admin-facing.

translation: Unable to initialize access control service.
description: Error returned to admins when the attribute-based access control service fails to start.

translation: Access control service is not ready.
description: Error returned to admins calling access control APIs before the access control service has finished initializing.

translation: Could not mask policy expression.
description: API error for admins when the server fails to hide (mask) restricted attribute values inside an access control policy expression.

translation: Multiple user attributes link the same template, so channel-attribute visibility cannot be determined unambiguously.
description: API error (500) surfaced when resolving attribute-based access control masking: more than one user attribute field points at the same linked template, so the server cannot tell which one governs visibility of the channel attribute. Seen by a system admin editing access rules.

translation: Could not read the caller's graph field value.
description: Server error when evaluating attribute-based access control and the requesting user's own value for a hierarchical (graph-type) attribute cannot be read. 'Caller' means the user making the request.

translation: Cannot resolve attribute visibility for an unknown object type.
description: API error (500) surfaced when the attribute-based access control masking logic is asked about an object type it has no visibility rules for. Seen by a system admin working with access rules.

translation: Could not merge policy expression with stored masked values.
description: API error for admins saving an access control policy when the edited expression cannot be recombined with previously masked (hidden) values.

translation: An attribute is missing from the expression.
description: API error for admins when an access control policy expression references a user attribute that does not exist.

translation: Could not normalize policy expression.
description: API error for admins when an access control policy expression cannot be rewritten into its normalized form.

translation: Could not query for expression.
description: API error for admins when searching for users matching an access control policy expression fails.

translation: Could not restore ranked operators in policy expression.
description: API error for admins when restoring rank-comparison operators in an access control policy expression fails; technical failure, not user mistake.

translation: Only a System Admin can change membership rules that use advanced logic. Edit them in the System Console.
description: API error when a team or channel admin tries to save, or replace, a membership rule that can only be edited in the System Console's Advanced (CEL) editor.

translation: Unable to save access control policy.
description: Generic API error shown to system admins when saving an attribute-based access control policy fails.

translation: You do not have permission to make this change to the policy.
description: API error when an admin tries to make a change to an access control policy they are not permitted to make.

translation: The policy expression contains a value that is not permitted.
description: Validation error shown to admins saving an access control policy whose expression uses a disallowed attribute value.

translation: A condition containing masked values was deleted. Please reload the policy and try again.
description: Error shown to admins saving an access control policy after removing a rule condition whose values were masked (hidden) from them; asks them to reload and retry.

translation: The policy expression contains a placeholder value that could not be resolved. Please reload the policy and try again.
description: API error when a saved access control policy expression still contains an unresolved masked-value placeholder; asks the admin to reload the policy and retry.

translation: This membership rule uses an expression that membership sync cannot evaluate. Rewrite the rule using only comparisons, &&, ||, in, and the supported attribute functions.
description: API error (400) shown to an admin saving a team, channel, or parent access policy whose membership rule uses allowed functions in a shape that cannot be converted to the database query used by membership sync (for example has()). Without this error the rule would be stored but never add or remove members.

translation: This membership rule uses {{.Function}}, which membership sync cannot evaluate. Rewrite the rule using only comparisons, &&, ||, in, and the supported attribute functions.
description: API error (400) shown to an admin saving a team, channel, or parent access policy whose membership rule uses an operator or function that only works outside membership sync. {{.Function}} is the operator or function name, for example "the conditional operator (?:)" or "inCIDR".

translation: A policy with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
description: Validation error when an admin saves an access control policy using a name already taken by another policy.

translation: This access rule uses channel attributes, which teams do not have. Remove the teams assigned to this policy before saving.
description: API error (400) shown to a system admin saving a parent access policy that references channel attributes while one or more teams are still assigned to it. Teams have no attributes, so the assignments must be removed first.

translation: Could not initialize attribute resolver for policy save.
description: Internal error when initializing the attribute resolver component fails while saving an access control policy; technical, admin-facing.

translation: Access rules cannot use channel attributes on this server. This capability is not enabled.
description: API error (400) shown to a system admin saving an access rule that references channel (resource) attributes on a server where that capability is turned off.

translation: Permission rule names must be unique within the policy.
description: Validation error when an admin saves an access control policy containing two permission rules with the same name.

translation: You do not satisfy one or more conditions in this policy.
description: API error when saving an access control policy would lock the saving admin out because they do not satisfy the policy's conditions.

translation: This access rule uses channel attributes, which teams do not have. Access rules with channel attributes can only be applied to channels.
description: API error (400) shown to a system admin saving a team-scoped access policy whose expression references channel attributes, directly or via an imported parent policy. Explains that such rules apply only to channels.

translation: Could not search access control policies.
description: API error when searching attribute-based access control policies fails; admin-facing.

translation: Failed to refresh attributes for the simulation.
description: Error in the access control policy simulator (admin tool for testing policies) when reloading user attribute values fails.

translation: A channel is required to simulate a policy that references channel attributes.
description: API error (400) shown to a system admin running the access-policy simulation/preview in the System Console when the policy references channel attributes but no channel was selected to simulate against.

translation: Failed to compile the policy for simulation.
description: Error in the access control policy simulator when the policy expression fails to compile.

translation: The permission policies feature is currently disabled.
description: Error returned when an admin runs the access control policy simulator but the permission policies feature is turned off.

translation: The policy is not valid.
description: Validation error in the access control policy simulator; the submitted policy failed validation.

translation: At least one action is required for simulation.
description: Validation error in the access control policy simulator when the request lists no actions (permissions) to test.

translation: A channel is required to simulate a channel-scoped policy.
description: Validation error in the access control policy simulator when testing a channel-scoped policy without specifying a channel.

translation: A policy is required for simulation.
description: Validation error in the access control policy simulator when no policy was included in the request.

translation: At least one user is required for simulation.
description: Validation error in the access control policy simulator when the request lists no users to test the policy against.

translation: Could not initialize attribute resolver for policy simulation.
description: Internal error when initializing the attribute resolver component fails during access control policy simulation; technical, admin-facing.

translation: Too many users requested. Maximum allowed is {{.Max}}.
description: Validation error in the access control policy simulator; {{.Max}} is the maximum number of users allowed per simulation request.

translation: Policy Administration Point is not initialized.
description: API error when policy simulation is requested but the Policy Administration Point service is not initialized; technical, admin-facing.

translation: Policy type "{{.Type}}" is not supported by the simulator.
description: Error in the access control policy simulator; {{.Type}} is the policy type identifier (e.g. channel, team) that the simulator cannot handle.

translation: Could not unassign access control policy from channels.
description: API error when unlinking an attribute-based access control policy from channels fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not unassign access control policy from teams.
description: API error when unlinking an attribute-based access control policy from teams fails; admin-facing.

translation: Could not update active status of access control policies.
description: API error when enabling or disabling attribute-based access control policies fails; admin-facing.

translation: Failed to evaluate access control policy.
description: Error when the server fails to evaluate an attribute-based access control policy while deciding whether a user may access a resource.

translation: Failed to evaluate permission policy.
description: Error when the server fails to evaluate a permission policy while checking a user's access.

translation: A configuration file named {{.Name}} already exists.
description: Error when adding a plugin-signing public key would overwrite an existing configuration file of the same name.

translation: The file is not a valid OpenPGP public key.
description: Error when the uploaded plugin-signing public key cannot be parsed as an OpenPGP public key, or contains a private key.

translation: Invalid plugin public key name {{.Name}}. Names may contain only letters, numbers, '.', '_' and '-'.
description: Error when adding a plugin-signing public key whose file name contains disallowed characters or is reserved.

translation: This plugin requires the {{.AddOn}} add-on, which your license does not include.
description: Error shown to an admin trying to enable a plugin that requires a separately purchased license add-on. {{.AddOn}} is the add-on's internal name from the license; it is not translated.

translation: The plugin configuration in your config.json file must be updated manually when using ReadOnlyConfig with clustering enabled.
description: Admin console error when enabling/disabling a plugin can't be saved automatically; 'ReadOnlyConfig' and 'config.json' are technical names to keep untranslated.

translation: Error saving plugin state in config.
description: Admin console error when persisting a plugin's enabled/disabled state to the server configuration fails.

translation: Unable to deactivate plugin.
description: Admin console error when deactivating (stopping) a plugin fails.

translation: An error occurred while deleting the public key.
description: Admin console error when deleting a plugin-signing public key from the server fails.

translation: Plugins have been disabled. Please check your logs for details.
description: API error returned when plugin functionality is invoked while plugins are disabled server-wide; directs admins to the server logs.

translation: An error occurred extracting the plugin bundle.
description: Admin console error when unpacking an uploaded plugin bundle archive fails.

translation: Encountered filesystem error.
description: Admin console error when a file-system operation during plugin install/removal fails.

translation: Unable to get plugin statuses from the cluster.
description: Admin console error when collecting plugin status from all servers in a high-availability cluster fails.

translation: Unable to get active plugins.
description: Internal API error when retrieving the list of active plugins fails.

translation: An error occurred while getting the public key from the store.
description: Admin console error when reading a plugin-signing public key from storage fails.

translation: Unable to get plugin statuses.
description: API error when fetching the running/failed status of installed plugins fails; shown to admins.

translation: Operation rejected: claiming plugin {{.PluginID}} hook call failed
description: API error returned when an operation is cancelled because the plugin guarding it failed while being consulted; {{.PluginID}} is the plugin's identifier.

translation: Operation rejected: a required plugin is not active
description: API error returned when an operation is cancelled because a plugin registered to guard it is not running.

translation: Unable to install plugin.
description: Admin console error when installing a plugin fails for a general reason.

translation: Unable to install plugin. A plugin with the same ID is already installed.
description: Admin console error when installing a plugin whose ID matches an already-installed plugin.

translation: Unable to install plugin. A plugin with the same ID is already installed and failed to be removed.
description: Admin console error when a conflicting already-installed plugin could not be removed during installation.

translation: Failed to install marketplace plugin.
description: Admin console error when installing a plugin from the marketplace fails.

translation: Plugin Id must be at least {{.Min}} characters, at most {{.Max}} characters and match {{.Regex}}.
description: Admin console validation error for a plugin ID; {{.Min}}/{{.Max}} are character limits and {{.Regex}} is the required pattern.

translation: Plugin version could not be parsed.
description: Admin console error when a plugin's version string in its manifest cannot be parsed.

translation: Unable to find manifest for extracted plugin.
description: Admin console error when an extracted plugin bundle contains no manifest file; 'manifest' is the plugin.json descriptor.

translation: Failed to create marketplace client.
description: Admin console error when the server cannot create the HTTP client used to talk to the plugin marketplace.

translation: Failed to get plugins from the marketplace server.
description: Admin console error when fetching the plugin listing from the marketplace server fails.

translation: Marketplace has been disabled. Please check your logs for details.
description: API error shown when the plugin Marketplace feature is disabled on the server; directed at system admins.

translation: Failed to decode the marketplace plugin request.
description: API error when the JSON body of a Marketplace plugin install request cannot be parsed.

translation: Could not find the requested marketplace plugin.
description: Admin console error when the requested plugin does not exist in the plugin marketplace.

translation: Could not find the requested marketplace plugin signature.
description: Admin console error when the cryptographic signature for a marketplace plugin cannot be found.

translation: Failed to marshal marketplace plugins.
description: API error when the server fails to serialize the Marketplace plugin list to JSON; 'marshal' is a serialization term.

translation: Can't modify saml files.
description: Error when a plugin file-write targets SAML certificate files, which is forbidden; 'saml' refers to SAML authentication files.

translation: Unable to move plugin from temporary directory to final destination. Another plugin may be using the same directory name.
description: Admin console error when moving an extracted plugin into the plugins directory fails, often due to a directory name collision.

translation: Plugin is not installed.
description: Admin console error when an operation targets a plugin that isn't installed on the server.

translation: Failed to reattach plugin
description: Internal error when reattaching to a running plugin process (local development feature) fails; developer-facing.

translation: Unable to delete plugin.
description: Admin console error when uninstalling/deleting a plugin fails.

translation: Unable to remove plugin bundle from file store.
description: Admin console error when deleting a plugin's bundle file from the file store fails.

translation: Unable to restart plugin on upgrade.
description: Admin console error when restarting a plugin after upgrading it fails.

translation: Unable to reset the read position to the start of the plugin bundle.
description: Internal error when rewinding the plugin bundle file stream before re-reading it fails; admin/log-facing.

translation: Unable to decode base64 signature.
description: Admin console error when a plugin signature is not valid base64; 'base64' is an encoding name to keep untranslated.

translation: Skipping installation of plugin {{.Id}} since existing version is equal or newer.
description: Informational error/log for admins; {{.Id}} is the plugin's ID whose installation was skipped because the installed version is the same or newer.

translation: Unable to store the plugin to the configured file store.
description: Admin console error when uploading the plugin bundle to the configured file store fails.

translation: Unable to store the plugin signature to the configured file store.
description: Admin console error when uploading the plugin's signature file to the configured file store fails.

translation: Failed to parse SiteURL subpath
description: Internal server error when the subpath portion of the configured SiteURL cannot be parsed; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name that should stay untranslated.

translation: Error reading files from the plugins folder in the file store.
description: Admin/log error when listing plugin files stored in the shared file store (used for cluster sync) fails.

translation: Error reading local plugins folder.
description: Admin/log error when reading the server's local plugins directory during plugin sync fails.

translation: Plugins and/or plugin uploads have been disabled.
description: API error shown to a system admin when plugin installation is attempted but plugins or plugin uploads are disabled in the server config.

translation: Unable to generate plugin webapp bundle.
description: Admin console error when preparing a plugin's web app (browser-side) bundle fails.

translation: An error occurred while reading the file.
description: Internal error when reading a file during a plugin file-write operation fails.

translation: An error occurred while saving the file.
description: Internal error when saving a file during a plugin file-write operation fails.

translation: Could not delete plugin key value.
description: API error when deleting a plugin's stored key-value entry fails; 'key value' refers to the plugin key-value data store.

translation: Could not get plugin key value.
description: API error when reading a plugin's stored key-value entry fails.

translation: Unable to list all the plugin keys.
description: API error when listing the keys in a plugin's key-value store fails.

translation: Could not save or update plugin key value.
description: API error when writing a plugin's key-value entry fails.

translation: Unable to get post counts.
description: Internal API error when the statistics query counting posts (messages) fails; surfaces in admin analytics/usage endpoints.

translation: Unable to get post counts by day.
description: Internal error when the statistics query counting posts (messages) per day fails; used by System Console analytics charts.

translation: Unable to get teams usage
description: API error when the usage/analytics query counting teams fails; shown for admin usage statistics.

translation: Unable to get user counts with posts.
description: Internal error when the statistics query counting active posting users per day fails; used by System Console analytics charts.

translation: Cannot fetch the post as it is past the cloud plan's limit.
description: API error on Mattermost Cloud when a post (message) cannot be fetched because it is older than the message history limit of the workspace's Cloud plan.

translation: Cannot create the post in a DM or GM with remote users
description: API error when posting is blocked in a direct/group message that includes users from another (remote) server; 'DM'/'GM' mean direct and group message.

translation: Unable to delete the post.
description: API error when deleting a post (chat message) fails.

translation: An error occurred getting the team.
description: Internal error during notification processing when the team of a deleted post cannot be loaded.

translation: Unable to get the post.
description: Generic API error when the server fails to fetch a post (message) from the database.

translation: Unable to get post author IDs for the channel.
description: Error from a bulk export (mmctl/export job) when reading which users posted in a channel being exported fails.

translation: Unable to get post author IDs for the team.
description: Error from a bulk export (mmctl/export job) when reading which users posted in a team being exported fails.

translation: Unable to get direct posts.
description: Error during a bulk data export when fetching direct message posts fails.

translation: Unable to get the flagged posts.
description: API error when fetching a user's flagged (saved) posts fails; 'flagged' means bookmarked for follow-up.

translation: An error occurred while retrieving the burn-on-read post content.
description: Internal error when loading the stored content of a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post fails.

translation: Unable to get post after time bound.
description: Internal error when fetching the first post after a given timestamp fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: Unable to get post around time bound.
description: Internal error when locating the post nearest a given timestamp fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: Limit exceeded for paging.
description: API error returned when a post-listing request asks for more items per page than allowed; 'paging' refers to paginated results.

translation: Unable to get the posts for the channel.
description: API error when loading the posts surrounding a specific message (for permalink context) fails.

translation: Unable to get the posts for the channel.
description: API/store error shown when fetching a channel's posts by creation time fails; 'posts' are chat messages.

translation: Unable to retrieve posts for reporting.
description: API error returned when a compliance/reporting query for posts fails on the server.

translation: Unable to retrieve posts for reporting. Invalid input.
description: API error returned when a compliance/reporting query for posts has invalid parameters.

translation: Your license does not support reporting on posts.
description: API error shown to an admin when the server's license tier does not include post reporting.

translation: Unable to get the posts for the view.
description: API error when loading the posts to display in a channel view fails.

translation: Unable to get the posts for the channel.
description: API error when loading a channel's posts newer than a given time fails.

translation: Unable to get the posts for the channel.
description: API error when loading a channel's root (non-reply) posts fails.

translation: Failed to marshal post.
description: Internal error when serializing a post to JSON fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: This thread was moved from another channel
description: System message shown in the destination channel atop a thread that was moved there using the move-thread feature.

translation: A thread with {{.NumMessages}} messages has been moved: {{.Link}}
description: System message posted in the original channel after a thread is moved; {{.NumMessages}} is the message count and {{.Link}} a permalink to the new location; ends with a newline.

translation: A message has been moved: {{.Link}}
description: System message posted in the original channel after a single message is moved; {{.Link}} is a permalink to its new location; ends with a newline.

translation: A thread with {{.NumMessages}} messages has been moved to a Direct/Group Message
description: System message posted in the original channel after a thread is moved into a Direct/Group Message; {{.NumMessages}} is the message count; ends with a newline.

translation: A message has been moved to a Direct/Group Message
description: System message posted in the original channel after a single message is moved into a Direct/Group Message; ends with a newline.

translation: Unable to remove thread
description: Error shown when the move-thread operation fails while removing the thread from its original channel.

translation: Unable to overwrite the Post.
description: API error shown when overwriting an existing post ('Post' = chat message) in the database fails.

translation: Unable to delete the posts by channel.
description: API error returned when permanently deleting all posts of a channel fails.

translation: Failed to permanently delete post.
description: Internal/admin error when permanently (hard) deleting a post from the database fails.

translation: The number of attributes that apply to this post exceeds the supported limit.
description: Server error when loading posts whose channel has more post attributes (custom fields attached to messages) than the server can handle, so their values are not returned.

translation: The number of attribute values for these posts exceeds the supported limit.
description: Server error when loading a page of posts that carry more attribute values in total than the server can handle, so the values are not returned.

translation: Failed to get the old post version.
description: API error when loading the earlier version of a post fails while restoring it from edit history.

translation: You do not have the appropriate permissions.
description: Permission error when a user tries to restore a previous version of a post they can't modify.

translation: The provided post history ID does not correspond to any history item for the specified post.
description: API error when the given edit-history ID doesn't belong to the specified post; shown when restoring a previous post version.

translation: The provided post history ID does not correspond to a post history item.
description: API error when the given ID is not an edit-history entry at all; shown when restoring a previous post version.

translation: Failed to call AI agent.
description: Error shown when the AI-assisted message rewrite feature fails to reach the AI agent.

translation: Empty response from AI.
description: Error shown when the AI-assisted message rewrite feature receives an empty response from the AI.

translation: Invalid rewrite action.
description: Error shown when an unsupported rewrite action (e.g. shorten, change tone) is requested from the AI message rewrite feature.

translation: Failed to parse rewrite response from AI.
description: Error shown when the AI message rewrite feature cannot parse the AI's response.

translation: Unable to save the Post.
description: API error shown when saving a new post (chat message) to the database fails.

translation: You cannot update an existing Post.
description: API error shown when a create-post request supplies the ID of a post that already exists; 'Post' is a chat message.

translation: Unable to save thread membership for post.
description: API error shown when recording the user's membership in a message thread fails after posting a reply.

translation: Error searching posts
description: API error returned when a message search query fails on the server.

translation: Unable to update the Post.
description: API error when saving edits to a post ('Post' = chat message) fails.

translation: Unable to delete the persistent notifications by channel.
description: API error returned when deleting the persistent (repeating priority) notifications belonging to a channel fails.

translation: Unable to delete the persistent notifications by team.
description: API error when deleting persistent (priority, repeated) notifications for a team's posts fails, e.g. during team deletion.

translation: Failed to permanently delete post priority data from database for post.
description: Internal error when permanently deleting a post's priority metadata from the database fails.

translation: Failed to delete persistent notification post
description: Internal error when removing a post's persistent-notification tracking record fails; log-facing.

translation: Unable to get postpriority for post
description: Internal error when loading a post's priority metadata fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: Unable to get postpriority for post with context
description: Internal error when loading a post's priority metadata (with request context) fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: Hi there, here's your reminder about this message from @{{.Username}}: {{.SiteURL}}/{{.TeamName}}/pl/{{.PostId}}
description: Bot direct message delivering a message reminder; {{.Username}} is the original poster's username (after a literal @) and the remaining placeholders assemble the permalink URL — keep the URL structure intact.

translation: We encountered an error while deleting preferences.
description: API error shown when deleting user preference records from the database fails.

translation: We encountered an error while finding preferences.
description: API error when loading a single user preference record fails.

translation: We encountered an error while finding preferences.
description: API error when loading all of a user's preference records fails.

translation: We encountered an error while finding preferences.
description: API error returned when loading a category of user preferences (settings) fails.

translation: We encountered an error while updating preferences.
description: API error shown to end users when saving their preferences (settings) to the database fails.

translation: Prepackaged plugin version could not be parsed.
description: Internal/log error when the version of a plugin prepackaged with the server cannot be parsed.

translation: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
description: Permission error for operations on custom properties (e.g. custom profile attributes); shown when the user lacks access.

translation: The access_mode attribute is invalid.
description: Validation error for a custom property definition; 'access_mode' is an attribute name to keep untranslated.

translation: The property change was rejected.
description: API error when a change to a custom property field, option or value is rejected because the request is malformed (e.g. an option refers to another field or to itself).

translation: Your license does not support this property group.
description: API error when accessing a property group (custom attributes feature area) not included in the server's license.

translation: The specified property does not exist.
description: API error when a requested custom property (e.g. custom profile attribute value) does not exist.

translation: This property field is managed by external sync and cannot be modified directly.
description: API error when editing a property field whose values are controlled by an external sync source (e.g. LDAP) and thus read-only.

translation: Unable to count property fields for group.
description: Internal error when counting the property fields defined in a group fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: Unable to count property fields for target.
description: Internal error when counting the property fields for a target object fails; developer/log-facing.

translation: Unable to create property field.
description: API error when creating a custom property field (attribute definition) fails.

translation: The maximum number of property fields for this group has been reached.
description: API error when creating another property field would exceed the per-group cap; 'property field' is a custom attribute definition.

translation: The maximum number of property fields for this object type has been reached.
description: API error when creating another property field would exceed the cap for that object type (e.g. user profiles).

translation: Cannot link to a field in a different group.
description: API error when creating a linked property field whose source belongs to a different property group; 'group' is a property group, 'field' a custom attribute definition.

translation: The linked source field has been deleted.
description: API error when creating a linked property field whose source field was deleted.

translation: Cannot link to a field that is itself linked. Chains are not allowed.
description: API error when trying to link a property field to another field that is itself a link; chaining links is not allowed.

translation: The linked source field was not found.
description: API error when creating a linked property field and the source field it links to does not exist; 'property field' is a custom attribute definition.

translation: Can only link to template fields.
description: API error when trying to link a property field to a non-template field; only template fields can be link sources.

translation: Only the source plugin can create linked fields from a protected template.
description: API error when a caller other than the owning plugin tries to create fields linked to a protected template; 'source plugin' is the plugin that owns the template.

translation: Linked field target type must match the source template's target type.
description: API error when a linked property field's target type differs from its source template's; 'target type' is the kind of object the field attaches to.

translation: Cannot create property "{{.Name}}": a property with this name already exists at the {{.ConflictLevel}} level.
description: API error when creating a property (custom attribute) whose name already exists; {{.Name}} is the attempted property name and {{.ConflictLevel}} is where the conflict is (e.g. system or channel level).

translation: Cannot create a protected property field.
description: API error when trying to create a property field with a protected (reserved) name/flag, which is not allowed.

translation: The maximum number of property fields for this target has been reached.
description: API error when creating a custom property field fails because the object it belongs to (the target, e.g. a team or channel) already has the maximum number of fields.

translation: Template fields cannot have a linked field.
description: API error when creating a template property field that itself specifies a linked field; templates cannot be links.

translation: Unable to delete property field.
description: API error when deleting a custom property field fails.

translation: Unable to get property field for deletion.
description: Internal error when loading the property field to be deleted fails.

translation: Cannot delete a field with active linked dependents. Unlink or delete dependent fields first.
description: API error when deleting a property field that other linked fields still depend on; the user must unlink or delete the dependents first.

translation: Cannot delete this field because a masked template reads each person's holdings from it. Change or remove the template's masking first.
description: API error when deleting a property field that a masked template names as the field holding each person's own values ('holdings'); masking shows a reader only the values that overlap their own.

translation: Property field not found.
description: API error when the property field targeted for deletion does not exist.

translation: Cannot delete a protected property field.
description: API error when trying to delete a protected (system-reserved) property field, which is not allowed.

translation: Unable to get property field.
description: API error returned when fetching a single property field (custom attribute definition, e.g. custom profile attributes) from the store fails.

translation: Unable to get property field by name.
description: API error returned when looking up a property field (custom attribute definition) by its name fails.

translation: Unable to get property fields for group.
description: API error returned when fetching all property fields belonging to a property group (a feature's set of custom attributes) fails.

translation: Unable to get property fields.
description: API error returned when fetching multiple property fields (custom attribute definitions) by ID fails.

translation: Graph property fields are not enabled.
description: API error when creating or changing a property field of the 'graph' type (hierarchical options) while that feature is turned off. 'graph' is the internal field type name.

translation: Invalid property field attributes.
description: Validation error when a custom property field's attributes (type, options, etc.) are invalid.

translation: Invalid input provided.
description: API error returned when a property-field request contains invalid parameters; generic validation failure.

translation: A linked field's option.read tier ({{.FieldTier}}) cannot be more permissive than its template ({{.TemplateID}})'s tier ({{.TemplateTier}}).
description: API error when creating or updating a property field linked to a shared template with an option.read permission level that lets more people read its options than the template allows. FieldTier and TemplateTier are permission levels such as 'member' or 'everyone'; TemplateID is a field ID.

translation: You do not have permission to mark this property field as admin-managed.
description: Permission error when a non-admin tries to flag a custom property field as admin-managed.

translation: The specified property field does not exist.
description: API error when a requested custom property field (attribute definition) does not exist.

translation: An attribute can't be linked to an OpenID Connect claim while OpenID Connect attribute sync is turned off.
description: API error (400) when an admin links a custom attribute to an OpenID Connect claim, or changes the claim, while the OpenIdAttributeSync feature flag is off. 'OpenID Connect' is a product name and should stay as-is.

translation: Unable to add the property field options.
description: Server error when adding new selectable options to a custom property field fails in the database.

translation: Unable to delete the property field options.
description: Server error when deleting selectable options from a custom property field fails in the database.

translation: Unable to get the property field options.
description: Server error when reading the selectable options of a custom property field fails in the database.

translation: The property field options were rejected: {{.Reason}}.
description: API error when a request to change a property field's options is rejected as a whole. {{.Reason}} is an untranslated English explanation (e.g. 'field X has been deleted').

translation: The property field option at index {{.Index}} {{.Reason}}.
description: API error when one option in a request to change a property field's options is rejected. {{.Index}} is the zero-based position of that option in the request; {{.Reason}} is an untranslated English verb phrase (e.g. 'names option "Red", which field X already has').

translation: Unable to update the property field options.
description: Server error when updating existing selectable options of a custom property field fails in the database.

translation: Rank property fields are not enabled.
description: API error returned when a request tries to use rank-type property fields while that feature flag/setting is turned off; 'rank' is a field type.

translation: This attribute cannot be marked required while required-attribute enforcement is disabled.
description: API error when an admin tries to mark a channel attribute as required while the server feature that enforces required attributes is turned off.

translation: Unable to search property fields.
description: API error returned when a search query over property fields (custom attribute definitions) fails.

translation: Unable to search the global attributes.
description: API error returned when the Global Attributes listing in the System Console cannot be loaded.

translation: This field is the holdings source for its masked template, so its value write level cannot be '{{.ValueWrite}}'. The people the template filters could otherwise edit their own holdings and widen what they can see.
description: API error when an admin or integration saves a property field that its masked template reads each person's own values ('holdings') from, with a value write level that lets regular members edit it. ValueWrite is a permission level such as 'member' or 'everyone'.

translation: An attribute synced from OpenID Connect can't also be synced from AD/LDAP or SAML.
description: API error (400) when an admin links one custom attribute to both an OpenID Connect claim and an AD/LDAP or SAML attribute. 'OpenID Connect', 'AD/LDAP' and 'SAML' should stay as-is.

translation: The attribute is no longer synced from this source, so its sync cannot change it.
description: Error returned when the AD/LDAP, SAML or OpenID Connect sync tries to change an attribute an administrator unlinked from that source while the sync was running.

translation: The options of an attribute synced from AD/LDAP or SAML are managed by the sync and cannot be added, renamed or removed.
description: API error (403) when an admin tries to add, rename or remove an option of a custom attribute synced from AD/LDAP or SAML; the sync owns that option list. 'AD/LDAP' and 'SAML' should stay as-is.

translation: Unable to update property fields.
description: API error returned when saving changes to property fields (custom attribute definitions) fails.

translation: Cannot change link target. Unlink first, then create a new linked field.
description: API error when an update tries to point a linked property field at a different source; 'link target' is the field it links to and 'Unlink' is the suggested action.

translation: Cannot set linked_field_id on an existing field. It can only be set at creation time.
description: API error when an update tries to turn an existing property field into a linked field; 'linked_field_id' is a literal API field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Unable to update property field due to a conflict. Please retry.
description: API error when a concurrent modification prevents updating a custom property field; user should retry.

translation: Unable to get property fields for update.
description: API error returned when the server cannot load the existing property fields that an update request is trying to modify.

translation: Cannot convert a property field to or from the graph type. Create a field of the type you need instead.
description: API error when an admin tries to change an existing property field's type to or from 'graph' (hierarchical options). 'graph' is the internal field type name.

translation: Cannot change this field's owners, access mode, protected or sync settings this way because its permissions cannot be expressed in that form. Update its permissions directly instead.
description: API error (400) when a client using the older property field format changes a field's owners, access mode, protected or sync attributes, but the field's permissions hold settings that older format cannot represent, so applying the change would lose them.

translation: Cannot modify options of a linked field. Options are inherited from the source.
description: API error when an update tries to change the selectable options of a linked property field; options come from the source field.

translation: Cannot modify type of a linked field. Type is inherited from the source.
description: API error when an update tries to change the data type of a linked property field; the type comes from the source field.

translation: Cannot change this field's access mode because it contains data the caller may not read.
description: API error (400) when a client using the older property field format changes a field's access mode, but the field's masking settings (which field each person's own values are read from, and who is exempt) are not visible in that format and would be lost by the change.
