translation: Cannot update property to "{{.Name}}": a property with this name already exists at the {{.ConflictLevel}} level.
description: API error when renaming a property (custom attribute) to a name that already exists; {{.Name}} is the attempted name and {{.ConflictLevel}} is where the conflict is.

translation: Cannot update: linked field {{.DependentID}} is at option.read tier {{.DependentTier}}, which would exceed the new tier {{.NewTier}}.
description: API error when an admin or integration lowers a shared property template's option.read permission level below that of a field already linked to it. DependentID is a field ID; DependentTier and NewTier are permission levels such as 'member' or 'everyone'.

translation: This property has more than {{.Max}} options, so its option list was not loaded and cannot be replaced. Edit its options individually instead.
description: API error when a request tries to replace the whole option list of a property field that has too many options to be loaded at once. {{.Max}} is that option count limit.

translation: Cannot change this field's permissions and its permission levels, owners, access mode, protected or sync settings in the same update. Send the change in one form or the other.
description: API error when one update to a property field both changes its permissions object and changes one of the older permission settings (permission levels, owners, access mode, protected, or AD/LDAP, SAML or OpenID Connect sync attributes). The caller must send the change using only one of the two forms.

translation: Cannot update a protected property field.
description: API error returned when a request tries to modify a property field that is marked protected (system-managed) and cannot be edited.

translation: Cannot update: linked field {{.DependentID}} would supply its own holdings under this masking, but its value write level is '{{.ValueWrite}}'. Lower that field's value write level to admin or below first.
description: API error returned when an admin or integration adds masking to a shared property template while a field linked to it can be edited by regular members. DependentID is a field ID; ValueWrite is a permission level such as 'member' or 'everyone'.

translation: Cannot change type of a field with active linked dependents.
description: API error when changing the data type of a property field that linked fields still depend on.

translation: Cannot unlink this field because a masked template reads each person's holdings from it. Change or remove the template's masking first.
description: API error when unlinking a property field from its template while that masked template names it as the field holding each person's own values ('holdings'); masking shows a reader only the values that overlap their own.

translation: The property field and group versions are incompatible.
description: API error when a property field's schema version does not match its property group's version; developer-facing.

translation: Unable to get property group.
description: API error returned when fetching a property group (a namespace grouping related custom attribute fields) fails.

translation: Unable to register property group.
description: API error returned when registering a new property group (namespace for custom attribute fields) fails.

translation: The synced attribute has invalid options.
description: Server error when the option list stored on a synced custom attribute cannot be read during AD/LDAP or SAML attribute sync; admin/log audience.

translation: Invalid property sync source.
description: Internal error when a custom attribute sync is started for an identity source other than AD/LDAP or SAML; admin/log audience.

translation: Invalid user ID for property sync.
description: Internal error when a custom attribute sync is requested with a malformed user ID; admin/log audience.

translation: Unable to determine which options of the synced attribute are in use.
description: Server error when the attribute sync cannot determine which options of a synced attribute users still hold, so unused options cannot be removed; admin/log audience.

translation: This attribute can only be lowered, never raised.
description: API error (403) when a user tries to set a ranked attribute (e.g. a classification level) to a higher value, but the field only allows lowering it.

translation: This attribute cannot be changed after it is set.
description: API error (403) when a user tries to change an attribute value whose field locks it once it has been set.

translation: This attribute can only be raised, never lowered.
description: API error (403) when a user tries to set a ranked attribute (e.g. a classification level) to a lower value, but the field only allows raising it.

translation: Unable to create property value.
description: API error returned when storing a new property value (the value assigned to a custom attribute field) fails.

translation: Unable to create property values.
description: API error returned when storing multiple property values in one operation fails.

translation: Unable to delete property value.
description: API error returned when deleting a single property value (custom attribute value) fails.

translation: Unable to delete property values for field.
description: API error returned when deleting all values of a given property field fails; 'field' is the custom attribute definition.

translation: Unable to delete property values for target.
description: API error returned when deleting all property values attached to a target object (e.g. a user or post) fails.

translation: Attributes on direct and group messages cannot be set directly.
description: API error (403) when someone tries to set a channel attribute on a direct or group message; those values are computed from the participants.

translation: Unable to get property value.
description: API error returned when fetching a single property value (custom attribute value) fails.

translation: Unable to get property values.
description: API error returned when fetching multiple property values fails.

translation: Invalid input provided.
description: API error returned when a property-value request contains invalid parameters; generic validation failure.

translation: This attribute is required and cannot be left empty.
description: API error when a user tries to clear or leave blank the value of an attribute an admin has marked required.

translation: Unrecognized object type "{{.ObjectType}}" for property value broadcast.
description: API error when broadcasting a property value change over websocket and the target's object type is unrecognized; {{.ObjectType}} is the raw type string (e.g. 'user', 'post').

translation: Unable to search property values.
description: API error returned when a search query over property values fails.

translation: Template fields cannot have values.
description: API error when someone tries to store a value against a template property field; templates only define fields and hold no values.

translation: Unable to update property value.
description: API error returned when saving changes to a single property value fails.

translation: Unable to update property values.
description: API error returned when saving changes to multiple property values fails.

translation: Unable to upsert property values.
description: API error returned when an upsert (create-or-update) of property values fails; 'upsert' is a database term, keep or adapt it naturally.

translation: Duplicate field ID in property value batch.
description: API error when a batch upsert of property values contains the same field ID twice; each field may appear only once per batch.

translation: Property field {{.FieldID}} was not found.
description: API error when a property value references a field that does not exist; {{.FieldID}} is the missing field's ID.

translation: Invalid property field ID.
description: API error when a property value in an upsert request carries a malformed field ID.

translation: All property values in a batch must belong to the same property group.
description: API error when a batch upsert mixes property values from different property groups; all values in one request must share a group.

translation: Property field object type does not match the request.
description: API error when the target type of a property field (e.g. user vs post) differs from the object type given in the upsert request.

translation: Unable to upsert property values.
description: API error returned when a bulk upsert (create-or-update) of property values fails.

translation: Property value failed validation.
description: Validation error when a value supplied for a custom property field doesn't satisfy the field's rules.

translation: Unable to get all reactions with this emoji name.
description: API error returned when the server cannot list the reactions using a given emoji while deleting a custom emoji and its reactions.

translation: Unable to get reaction author IDs for the channel.
description: Error from a bulk export (mmctl/export job) when reading which users reacted to posts in a channel being exported fails.

translation: Unable to get reactions for post.
description: API error returned when loading the emoji reactions on a post fails.

translation: Unable to save reaction.
description: API error shown when saving an emoji reaction on a post fails.

translation: Reaction limit has been reached for this post.
description: API error shown when a user tries to add an emoji reaction to a post that already has the maximum allowed number of reactions.

translation: Your organization's policy requires {{.CooldownMinutes}} minutes between recaps. You can create another recap in {{.RetryAfterMinutes}} minutes.
description: API error shown when a user requests an AI channel recap too soon after the previous one; {{.CooldownMinutes}} is the required wait between recaps and {{.RetryAfterMinutes}} is how long until they can try again. 'Recap' is an AI-generated summary of channel activity.

translation: Failed to check cooldown status.
description: API error returned when the server cannot verify whether the user's recap cooldown period has elapsed; 'recap' is an AI-generated channel summary.

translation: Failed to delete recap.
description: API error returned when deleting an AI channel recap fails.

translation: Failed to delete recap channels.
description: API error returned when deleting the channel entries associated with an AI recap fails.

translation: Failed to get recap.
description: API error returned when fetching an AI channel recap fails.

translation: Failed to get channel.
description: API error returned when the recap feature cannot load a channel referenced by a recap; 'channel' is a messaging channel.

translation: Failed to get recap channels.
description: API error returned when fetching the channels included in an AI recap fails.

translation: Failed to check recap limits.
description: API error returned when the server cannot check how many recaps the user has created today against the daily limit.

translation: Failed to get last viewed timestamp.
description: API error returned when the server cannot read when the user last viewed their recaps; timestamp lookup failure.

translation: Failed to get team.
description: API error returned when the recap feature cannot load the team a recap belongs to.

translation: Failed to get recaps.
description: API error returned when listing a user's AI channel recaps fails.

translation: Failed to mark recap as read.
description: API error returned when marking a single AI recap as read fails.

translation: Failed to mark recaps as viewed.
description: API error returned when marking the user's recaps as viewed fails; plural (all recaps).

translation: Your organization's policy limits recaps to {{.Limit}} channels. You requested {{.Requested}} channels.
description: API error shown when a recap request includes more channels than the admin-configured limit; {{.Limit}} is the maximum allowed and {{.Requested}} is the number the user asked for.

translation: Your organization's policy limits you to {{.Limit}} recaps per day. Please try again tomorrow.
description: API error shown when the user has hit the admin-configured daily limit of AI recaps; {{.Limit}} is the maximum recaps per day.

translation: No permission for recap.
description: API error shown when a user tries to access or modify an AI recap they do not own or lack permission for.

translation: Failed to save recap.
description: API error returned when persisting a new AI recap to the database fails.

translation: Failed to save recap channel.
description: API error returned when saving a channel entry belonging to an AI recap fails.

translation: Failed to check recap post usage.
description: API error returned when the server cannot total how many posts the user's recaps processed today for usage-limit checking.

translation: Failed to update recap.
description: API error returned when updating an existing AI recap fails.

translation: Unable to delete token.
description: API error when deleting a one-time token (e.g. password recovery token) from the database fails.

translation: Unable to save the token.
description: Internal error when saving a temporary token (password reset, email verification, etc.) to the database fails.

translation: all time
description: Date-range phrase inserted into the bot message about a user data export (e.g. 'user data for all time'); lowercase mid-sentence fragment.

translation: the last 30 days
description: Date-range phrase inserted into the bot message about a user data export (e.g. 'user data for the last 30 days'); lowercase mid-sentence fragment.

translation: the last 6 months
description: Date-range phrase inserted into the bot message about a user data export (e.g. 'user data for the last 6 months'); lowercase mid-sentence fragment.

translation: the previous month
description: Date-range phrase inserted into the bot message about a user data export (e.g. 'user data for the previous month'); lowercase mid-sentence fragment.

translation: Failed to fetch user count.
description: API error shown in the admin console user report when the database query counting users fails.

translation: Failed to fetch user report.
description: API error shown in the admin console when the database query building the user report fails.

translation: Your export is ready. The CSV file contains user data for {{.DateRange}}. Click on the link below to download the report.
description: Direct message sent by the system bot to the admin when their user-data CSV export completes; {{.DateRange}} is a translated phrase like 'the last 30 days', and the file is attached below the message.

translation: Failed to save file info.
description: Error from the user-export job when the generated CSV file's metadata cannot be saved before delivering it to the admin.

translation: Missing date range
description: Internal error from the user-export job when the job data lacks a date range; mainly seen in job logs.

translation: No user id to send the report to
description: Internal error from the user-export job when the job data lacks the ID of the user who requested the report; mainly seen in job logs.

translation: Job already exists for this user and date range.
description: API error shown to an admin who starts a user-data export while an identical export (same user and date range) is already running.

translation: Batch reporting export only available to Pro and Enterprise.
description: API error shown to an admin when batch user-report export requires a Professional or Enterprise license; 'Pro' and 'Enterprise' are license tier names.

translation: You've started an export of user data for {{.DateRange}}. When the export is complete, a CSV file will be delivered to you in this direct message.
description: Direct message sent by the system bot confirming a user-data export has begun; {{.DateRange}} is a translated phrase like 'the last 30 days'.

translation: You cannot reveal your own burn-on-read post.
description: API error when the author of a burn-on-read (self-destructing) post tries to reveal it; only recipients can reveal.

translation: The burn-on-read post is missing the required expiration time.
description: Internal error when a burn-on-read post lacks its expiration timestamp; 'burn-on-read' is the self-destructing message feature.

translation: This post is not a burn-on-read post and cannot be revealed.
description: API error when a user tries to reveal (open) a post that isn't a burn-on-read post; 'reveal' is the feature's action verb.

translation: This burn-on-read post has expired and can no longer be revealed.
description: API error when a burn-on-read post's time window has passed so it can no longer be revealed (opened).

translation: An error occurred while retrieving the read receipt.
description: Internal error when loading the read receipt record while revealing a burn-on-read post fails.

translation: Unable to get the unread count for the read receipt.
description: Internal error when recalculating unread counts for a burn-on-read read receipt fails.

translation: An error occurred while saving the read receipt.
description: Internal error when saving the read receipt record while revealing a burn-on-read post fails.

translation: Your access to this burn-on-read post has expired.
description: API error when a user reopens a burn-on-read post after their personal viewing window expired.

translation: The provided role does not exist
description: API error returned when a role name given in a request does not match any existing role; 'role' is a permissions role (e.g. system admin).

translation: Unable to delete role.
description: API error returned when deleting a permissions role from the database fails.

translation: Unable to get role.
description: API error returned when fetching a permissions role by ID fails.

translation: Unable to get all the roles.
description: API error returned when loading all permission roles fails; 'roles' are permission role definitions.

translation: Unable to get role.
description: API error returned when fetching a permissions role by name fails.

translation: Unable to get roles.
description: API error returned when fetching multiple permissions roles by name fails.

translation: We could not permanently delete all the roles.
description: Internal error (admin permissions reset operation) when permanently deleting all roles from the database fails.

translation: Unable to save new role.
description: Internal error when inserting a new permissions role into the database fails; admin-facing.

translation: The role was not valid.
description: Validation error when a permissions role being saved fails validation; 'role' is a permissions role, admin-facing.

translation: An error occurred while broadcasting the role update.
description: API error returned when the websocket broadcast informing clients that a role's permissions changed fails.

translation: An error occurred while broadcasting the role update: unknown scheme scope.
description: API error when broadcasting a role update fails because the permissions scheme's scope (team or channel) is unrecognized; 'scheme' is the permissions-scheme feature term.

translation: An error occurred saving the configuration.
description: API error shown (e.g. in the System Console) when saving the server configuration fails.

translation: The logging configuration contains a log or audit file path outside the logging root directory or inside a directory the server manages. Check the server logs for details.
description: Admin-facing error when saving a configuration whose log or audit file path resolves outside the allowed logging root directory, or inside a directory the server manages such as the plugin, data, config or templates directory; the server logs name the offending path.

translation: An error occurred running the plugin hook on configuration save.
description: API error when a plugin's configuration-change hook fails while the server config is being saved; shown to admins.

translation: Failed to write CSV chunk.
description: Error from the report export job when writing an intermediate CSV chunk file to storage fails.

translation: Unsupported report format.
description: Error from the report export job when asked to save report data in a format other than CSV.

translation: Cannot schedule post in an archived channel.
description: API error shown when a user tries to schedule a message in an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Cannot schedule post in a restricted DM
description: API error shown when scheduling a message is blocked because the direct message conversation is restricted (e.g. deactivated user); 'DM' means direct message.

translation: Error occurred saving the scheduled post.
description: API error shown when persisting a new scheduled post to the database fails.

translation: Channel is archived
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; fills {{.ErrorReason}} after 'Reason:'.

translation: Channel not found
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the target channel no longer exists.

translation: Invalid post content
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the message content failed validation.

translation: Not a member of the channel
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the author is no longer a member of the channel.

translation: No permission to post in channel
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the author lacks permission to post in the channel.

translation: Thread has been deleted
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the thread the reply targeted was deleted.

translation: Unable to send the message
description: Generic failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent.

translation: Unknown Error
description: Fallback failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent, when the cause is not recognized.

translation: User account is deleted
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the author's account was deactivated.

translation: User does not exist
description: Failure reason inserted into the bot notification about scheduled posts that could not be sent; the author account no longer exists.

One bullet line in the bot's direct message listing scheduled posts that failed to send; {{.Count}} is how many failed in that channel, {{.ChannelName}} is the channel's display name (or a placeholder like 'Private channel'), and {{.ErrorReason}} is a translated failure reason. Starts with a Markdown list dash.
Header line of the bot's direct message notifying a user their scheduled posts failed to send; {{.Count}} is the number of failed posts, with singular/plural forms.

translation: Private channel
description: Placeholder used instead of the real channel name in the failed-scheduled-post notification when the channel is private, to avoid leaking its name.

translation: Recurring scheduled posts are disabled on this server.
description: API error (400) returned to an end user who tries to create or manage a repeating scheduled post while the recurring scheduled posts feature is turned off on the server.

translation: Scheduled post rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error shown when a server plugin blocks creation of a scheduled post; {{.Reason}} is the rejection message supplied by the plugin.

translation: Unknown Channel
description: Placeholder used instead of the channel name in the failed-scheduled-post notification when the channel cannot be looked up.

translation: Scheduled post update rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error shown when a server plugin blocks an edit to a scheduled post; {{.Reason}} is the rejection message supplied by the plugin.

translation: Unable to compute the next scheduled recap run.
description: API error returned when calculating the next run time of a recurring scheduled recap fails; a 'scheduled recap' is a recurring AI channel summary.

translation: Unable to create scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when creating a scheduled (recurring) AI recap fails.

translation: Unable to delete scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when deleting a scheduled (recurring) AI recap fails.

translation: Unable to get scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when fetching a scheduled (recurring) AI recap fails.

translation: Unable to get unread channels for scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when the scheduled-recap job cannot determine which channels have unread messages to summarize.

translation: Unable to get scheduled recaps.
description: API error returned when listing a user's scheduled (recurring) AI recaps fails.

translation: Your organization's policy limits recaps to {{.Limit}} channels. You requested {{.Requested}} channels.
description: API error shown when a scheduled recap includes more channels than the admin-configured limit; {{.Limit}} is the maximum allowed and {{.Requested}} is the number the user asked for.

translation: Your organization's policy limits you to {{.Limit}} scheduled recaps. Please delete an existing scheduled recap before creating a new one.
description: API error shown when the user already has the maximum number of scheduled recaps; {{.Limit}} is that admin-configured maximum.

translation: Scheduled recap must include at least one channel.
description: API validation error shown when a user tries to create or save a scheduled recap without selecting any channels.

translation: Unable to pause scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when pausing a scheduled (recurring) AI recap fails; 'pause' is a verb.

translation: Unable to resume scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when resuming a paused scheduled AI recap fails; 'resume' is a verb.

translation: Unable to save recap for scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when the scheduled-recap job fails to save the recap it generated.

translation: Unable to update scheduled recap.
description: API error returned when updating a scheduled (recurring) AI recap fails.

translation: Unable to delete this scheme.
description: API error shown to an admin when deleting a permissions scheme fails.

translation: Unable to get the scheme.
description: API error shown to an admin when fetching a permissions scheme fails.

translation: Unable to get page of schemes.
description: API error returned when loading a page of permission schemes fails; 'scheme' is the Mattermost permissions scheme feature.

translation: We could not permanently delete the schemes.
description: Internal error (admin permissions reset operation) when permanently deleting all permissions schemes fails.

translation: Unable to create the scheme.
description: API error shown to an admin when creating a permissions scheme fails.

translation: The provided scheme is invalid.
description: API validation error shown to an admin when the permissions scheme being saved fails validation.

translation: This API endpoint is not accessible as required migrations have not yet completed.
description: API error returned when a permissions-scheme endpoint is used before the required database migrations for advanced permissions have finished; audience is admins/developers.

translation: select error
description: Low-level database error detail meaning a select (read) query failed; terse developer-facing text.

translation: Unable to count the sessions.
description: Internal error when counting user sessions fails; used by System Console analytics and session expiry notifications.

translation: Unable to extend session length
description: Internal error from the plugin API when extending a login session's expiry time fails.

translation: We encountered an error finding the session.
description: API error returned when looking up a login session in the database fails.

translation: Unable to get least recently used sessions.
description: API error returned when fetching a user's oldest (least recently used) login sessions fails, used when enforcing session limits.

translation: We encountered an error while finding user sessions.
description: API error shown when the server fails to load a user's active login sessions from the database.

translation: Unable to remove all the sessions for the user.
description: Internal error when revoking all of a user's login sessions fails during permanent account deletion.

translation: Unable to remove the session.
description: API error returned when revoking/deleting a login session fails.

translation: Unable to remove all the sessions.
description: API error returned when a bulk revocation of login sessions fails.

translation: Device id cannot be empty.
description: API validation error when a mobile request to revoke other sessions omits the device ID; 'device id' identifies the mobile device.

translation: VoIP device id cannot be empty.
description: API validation error when a mobile request omits the VoIP device ID; 'VoIP' is the iOS voice-call push token type.

translation: Unable to save the session.
description: API error returned when persisting a new login session to the database fails.

translation: Unable to update existing session.
description: API error returned when updating an existing login session record fails.

translation: Unable to update the extra session properties.
description: API error returned when saving additional properties (metadata) on a login session fails.

translation: Unable to update the device id.
description: API error returned when saving the mobile device ID on a login session fails.

translation: Session attribute fields cannot be created or deleted, and only their enabled, ttl_seconds and grace_period_seconds may be changed.
description: API error when trying to create/delete session attribute fields or change disallowed properties; 'enabled', 'ttl_seconds' and 'grace_period_seconds' are literal API field names and should stay untranslated.

translation: Encountered an error retrieving the status.
description: API error when fetching a user's availability status (online/away/etc.) fails; 'status' means user presence, not HTTP status.

translation: No entry for that status exists.
description: API error when no availability status record exists for the requested user; 'status' means user presence.

translation: Encountered an error decoding JSON response from interactive dialog submission.
description: API error returned when the JSON response from submitting an interactive dialog (integration form) cannot be decoded.

translation: File {{.FileId}} does not belong to the submitting user.
description: Validation error when a user submits an interactive dialog referencing a file they didn't upload; {{.FileId}} is the file's ID.

translation: Unable to validate submitted file IDs.
description: API error returned when the server cannot look up metadata for file IDs included in an interactive dialog submission.

translation: File {{.FileId}} is invalid or inaccessible.
description: Validation error for an interactive dialog submission; {{.FileId}} is the ID of the file that is invalid or the user cannot access.

translation: Encountered an invalid response from interactive dialog submission.
description: API error returned when an integration returns a malformed response to an interactive dialog submission.

translation: Encountered an error encoding JSON for the interactive dialog.
description: API error returned when encoding the interactive dialog submission payload to JSON fails.

translation: Encountered an error reading response body from interactive dialog submission.
description: API error returned when reading the HTTP response body after submitting an interactive dialog fails.

translation: Too many file IDs submitted. Maximum allowed is {{.Max}}.
description: Validation error for an interactive dialog submission; {{.Max}} is the maximum number of file attachments allowed.

translation: Too many ID-shaped values in the submission. Maximum allowed is {{.Max}}.
description: Validation error for an interactive dialog submission; {{.Max}} is the maximum number of ID-like values permitted in the form data.

translation: Failed to decode the complete onboarding request.
description: API error when the JSON body of the request marking admin onboarding as complete cannot be parsed.

translation: Onboarding can only be completed by a System Administrator.
description: API error when someone other than a System Administrator tries to complete the initial server onboarding flow.

translation: Data Spillage Bot
description: Display name of the built-in bot account that posts content-flagging (data spillage) review messages; shown as the bot's name in chats.

translation: Unable to find the system variable.
description: Internal error when reading a named system variable (internal key-value setting) from the database fails; technical.

translation: Failed to get onboarding completion status.
description: API error when reading the stored onboarding completion status fails.

translation: We could not permanently delete the system table entry.
description: Internal API error when deleting an entry from the server's system settings table fails; developer/admin diagnostic.

translation: We encountered an error saving the system property.
description: Internal API error when saving an entry to the server's system settings table fails; developer/admin diagnostic.

translation: System
description: Display name of the built-in 'System' bot account that sends automated server messages; keep short, appears as the sender name of those messages.

translation: Failed to parse installation date.
description: Internal error when the stored server installation date cannot be parsed as a number; technical.

translation: One or more channels were not found.
description: API error shown to an admin configuring a team access policy when some of the selected channels do not exist.

translation: Channel {{.ChannelId}} does not belong to this team.
description: API error shown to an admin when a channel listed in a team access policy belongs to another team; {{.ChannelId}} is that channel's ID.

translation: At least one channel is required.
description: API validation error when a team access policy is submitted without any channels selected.

translation: Unable to verify policy ownership for this team.
description: API error when the server cannot confirm that the access control policy belongs to the team being edited.

translation: Failed to reconcile team scope on policy.
description: API error when synchronizing the team scope on an access control policy fails; 'scope' means which team the policy applies to.

translation: You cannot create a policy that would exclude yourself.
description: API error shown to an admin whose proposed attribute-based access policy would remove their own access to the team.

translation: Failed to validate policy rules.
description: API error when the rules of an attribute-based team access policy fail validation.

translation: Unable to count the teams.
description: Internal error when counting teams fails; used by System Console analytics.

translation: Failed to retrieve the team members.
description: Internal error (permissions reset operation) when querying team member records fails.

translation: Error clearing team member cache
description: API error when invalidating the cached team member data fails after a team change.

translation: Unable to find the existing team.
description: API error when the requested team does not exist in the database.

translation: We encountered an error finding the team.
description: API error when a database failure occurs while looking up a team.

translation: Unable to count the team members.
description: API error when counting a team's active members fails.

translation: We could not get all teams.
description: API error returned when listing all teams on the server fails.

translation: We could not get all private teams.
description: API error when listing all private teams (for team browsing) fails.

translation: We could not get all teams.
description: API error when listing all joinable teams (for team browsing) fails.

translation: Unable to find the existing team.
description: API error when no team matches the invite ID from an invitation link.

translation: Unable to find the existing team.
description: API error returned when looking up a team by its name fails.

translation: Unable to find the existing team.
description: API error returned when no team with the requested name exists.

translation: Unable to get the teams for the provided scheme.
description: API error returned when listing the teams that use a given permissions scheme fails.

translation: Unable to get the common team IDs.
description: API error when computing which teams a set of users all share fails.

translation: Unable to get the team member.
description: API error returned when fetching a team member record fails due to a server error.

translation: No team member found for that user ID and team ID.
description: API error returned when no team membership exists for the given user and team.

translation: Unable to count the team members.
description: API error when counting a team's members fails.

translation: Unable to get the team members.
description: API error returned when fetching the members of a team fails.

translation: Unable to get the team members.
description: API error when fetching specific team members by user ID fails.

translation: Unable to get the teams unread messages.
description: API error when fetching a user's unread message counts per team fails; 'unread messages' are messages not yet read.

translation: Unable to get the list of teams of a user.
description: API error when fetching the list of team IDs a user belongs to fails.

translation: Unable to join a group-constrained team by invite.
description: API error when a user tries to join via invite link a team whose membership is managed by LDAP group sync ('group-constrained').

translation: Unable to join a group-constrained team by token.
description: API error when a user tries to join via invitation token a team whose membership is managed by LDAP group sync ('group-constrained').

translation: This team has reached the maximum number of allowed accounts. Contact your System Administrator to set a higher limit.
description: API error when joining a team fails because the team reached its configured maximum number of users.

translation: Adding team member rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error when a server plugin blocks a user from joining a team; {{.Reason}} is the rejection message supplied by the plugin.

translation: Unable to create the new team membership
description: API error when creating the database record for a new team membership fails.

translation: Unable to create the new team membership because it already exists
description: API error when adding a user to a team they already belong to.

translation: Unable to create the new team membership because the team has reached the limit of members
description: API error when a user cannot join because the team has reached its maximum member count.

translation: Failed to update the team member.
description: Error from the advanced-permissions migration job when writing a migrated team member to the database fails; visible in the jobs table/logs.

translation: Unable to delete the existing team.
description: API error when permanently deleting a team from the database fails.

translation: Unable to delete team.
description: API error wrapping an internal failure while permanently deleting a team.

translation: Unable to remove the team member.
description: API error when removing a member from a team fails.

translation: Unable to rename the team, the name is already in use.
description: API error when renaming a team fails because another team already uses that name/URL.

translation: We could not reset the team schemes.
description: Internal error (admin permissions reset operation) when clearing all teams' permissions scheme assignments fails.

translation: Unable to save the team.
description: API error when persisting a new team to the database fails.

translation: Must call update for existing team.
description: Internal API error when create is called for a team that already exists; developer-facing wording ('call update') is intentional.

translation: Unable to save the team member.
description: API error shown when adding or saving a user's team membership record fails.

translation: We encountered an error searching teams.
description: API error when a search across all teams fails.

translation: We encountered an error searching open teams.
description: API error when a search across open (public, joinable) teams fails.

translation: We encountered an error searching private teams.
description: API error when a search across private teams fails.

translation: Unable to find the existing team to update.
description: API error shown when the team to be updated cannot be found in the database.

translation: We encountered an error updating the team.
description: API error shown when writing team changes to the database fails.

translation: Unable to determine if the user belongs to a list of teams.
description: API error when checking whether a user is a member of any of a given list of teams fails.

translation: Unable to save terms of service.
description: API error shown to an admin when saving new custom terms of service text fails; 'terms of service' is the legal-agreement feature.

translation: Must not call save for existing terms of service.
description: Internal API error when the create call is used for a terms-of-service record that already exists; developer-facing wording.

translation: Unable to fetch terms of service.
description: API error when loading the custom terms of service text fails.

translation: No terms of service found.
description: API error returned when no custom terms of service have been configured on the server.

translation: Unable to get thread follower IDs for the channel.
description: Error from a bulk export (mmctl/export job) when reading which users follow threads in a channel being exported fails.

translation: Unable to get thread members for export.
description: Error during a bulk data export when fetching thread follower records fails; 'thread members' are users following a reply thread.

translation: Unable to mark all threads as read by channel
description: API error returned when marking all followed threads in the given channels as read fails; 'threads' are reply threads on posts.

translation: Message is required
description: API validation error when a toast (brief in-app popup notification) request omits the message text.

translation: User ID is required
description: API validation error when a toast (brief in-app popup notification) request omits the recipient user's ID.

translation: update error
description: Low-level database error detail meaning an update query failed; terse developer-facing text.

translation: Unable to convert scheduled post to post format.
description: API error when a scheduled post cannot be converted into a regular post structure while updating it; technical failure message.

translation: Scheduled post does not exist.
description: API error when the scheduled post targeted for update cannot be found; a scheduled post is a message queued to send at a later time.

translation: Unable to fetch existing scheduled post from database.
description: API error when loading a scheduled post from the database fails during an update operation.

translation: Failed to save updated scheduled post in database.
description: API error shown when saving edits to an existing scheduled post fails.

translation: You do not have permission to update this resource.
description: API error when a user tries to edit a scheduled post they do not own.

translation: Cannot upload to a deleted channel.
description: API error when a user starts a file upload targeting an archived (deleted) channel.

translation: Cannot upload file to a restricted direct message.
description: API error when a file upload is blocked because the direct message conversation is restricted (e.g. with a deactivated user).

translation: Cannot upload to the specified channel.
description: API error when a file upload targets a channel the user cannot post to or that does not exist.

translation: Failed to save upload.
description: API error when creating the upload session record in the database fails; 'upload' is a noun (the upload session).

translation: Invalid filename.
description: API validation error when the uploaded file's name is invalid (e.g. contains path traversal characters).

translation: Failed to get upload.
description: API error when fetching an upload session record fails; 'upload' is a noun.

translation: Failed to get uploads for user.
description: API error when listing a user's in-progress upload sessions fails; 'uploads' is a noun.

translation: Failed to move file.
description: API error when relocating an uploaded file in storage fails after plugin processing of the upload.

translation: Unable to upload file {{.Filename}}. Rejected by plugin: {{.Reason}}
description: API error shown when a server plugin rejects an uploaded file; {{.Filename}} is the file's name and {{.Reason}} is the rejection message supplied by the plugin.

translation: Unable to upload data from more than one request.
description: API error when two requests try to write data to the same upload session at once; only one is allowed.

translation: Failed to upload data. First part must be at least {{.Size}} Bytes.
description: API error for resumable uploads when the first chunk is below the minimum size; {{.Size}} is that minimum in bytes.

translation: Failed to generate file info from uploaded data.
description: API error when extracting file metadata (dimensions, type, etc.) from the uploaded data fails.

translation: {{.Filename}} dimensions ({{.Width}} by {{.Height}} pixels) exceed the limits.
description: API error when an uploaded image exceeds the maximum resolution; {{.Filename}} is the file's name, {{.Width}} and {{.Height}} are its pixel dimensions.

translation: Failed to move uploaded file.
description: API error when moving the completed uploaded file into its final storage location fails.

translation: Failed to read a file.
description: API error when reading the partially uploaded file from storage fails.

translation: Failed to save file info.
description: API error when saving the finished upload's file metadata to the database fails.

translation: Failed to update the upload session.
description: API error when updating the upload session's progress in the database fails.

translation: Unable to get the active users during the requested period.
description: Internal error when the statistics query for daily/monthly active users fails; used by System Console analytics.

translation: We could not count the inactive users.
description: Internal error when counting deactivated user accounts fails; used by System Console analytics.

translation: Failed to get single-channel guest count for analytics.
description: Internal error when counting guests who belong to only one channel fails; used for analytics.

translation: Failed to migrate the user's password to the newest hashing method.
description: Internal login error when upgrading the user's stored password hash to a newer hashing algorithm fails; technical.

translation: Failed to update the user's password.
description: Internal login error when saving the user's re-hashed password fails; technical.

translation: Failed to retrieve the users.
description: Internal error (permissions reset operation) when querying user records fails.

translation: Unable to convert bot to user.
description: API error shown to an admin when converting a bot account into a regular user account fails.

translation: Failed to update the user.
description: API error when saving the user record fails while demoting a regular user to a guest account.

translation: We encountered an error finding the account.
description: Generic internal error when looking up a user account in the database fails.

translation: We could not get the badge count for the user.
description: Internal error when computing a user's app icon badge count (unread messages/mentions) for push notifications fails.

translation: Unable to find the user by authentication data.
description: Bulk import error when looking up an existing user by their single sign-on (SSO/LDAP) identifier fails with a database error.

translation: Unable to find an existing account matching your authentication type for this team. This team may require an invite from the team owner to join.
description: Login error shown when no account matches the user's SSO/authentication method for the team; suggests the team may be invite-only.

translation: We encountered an error trying to find the account by authentication type.
description: API error when looking up an account by its authentication method (e.g. LDAP, SAML) fails.

translation: Unable to find an existing account matching your username for this team. This team may require an invite from the team owner to join.
description: Login/lookup error shown to end users when no account matches the given username; mentions team invites because it appears during team sign-in flows.

translation: Unable to get known users from the database.
description: API error when fetching the users known to (sharing channels with) the requesting user fails.

translation: We encountered an error while finding the new users.
description: Internal error when fetching the most recently created user accounts fails; used by System Console analytics.

translation: We encountered an error while finding user profiles.
description: Database error when loading the user profiles belonging to group message channels fails.

translation: We encountered an error while finding user profiles.
description: API error returned when fetching user profile records fails due to a server error.

translation: We encountered an error while finding the recently active users.
description: Internal error when fetching recently active users fails; used by System Console analytics.

translation: We could not get thread count for the user.
description: Internal error when counting a user's unread followed threads (for notification badges) fails.

translation: Unable to get user thread membership
description: API error when fetching the user's membership (follow state) for a message thread fails; 'thread' is a reply thread.

translation: User thread membership doesn't exist
description: API error when the user has no membership record for the requested message thread.

translation: Unable to get user threads
description: API error when fetching the user's followed message threads fails.

translation: User thread doesn't exist or is not followed
description: API error when the requested message thread does not exist or the user does not follow it.

translation: We could not count the users.
description: Internal error when counting all user accounts fails.

translation: We could not get the unread message count for the user.
description: Internal error when counting a user's unread messages (for notification badges) fails.

translation: Unable to get the users batch for indexing.
description: Error status for the search indexing job when a batch of users cannot be read from the database; visible to admins in the jobs table.

translation: Unable to find the user.
description: Generic API error returned when the requested user account does not exist.

translation: Unable to delete the existing account.
description: Internal error when permanently deleting a user account from the database fails; admin-facing.

translation: The account has been deactivated and partly deleted. Running the delete again is safe and will finish it.
description: Admin-facing error returned when permanently deleting a user fails partway through, after the account was already deactivated.

translation: This pass deleted the maximum of {{.Max}} posts. The account has been deactivated and partly deleted. Run the delete again to continue.
description: Admin-facing error returned when permanently deleting a user stops after removing the per-run post limit; the admin is told to run the same delete again. {{.Max}} is the number of posts deleted per run.

translation: Unable to finish deleting {{.Count}} users: {{.Usernames}}. Run the command again to continue.
description: Admin-facing error returned by the delete-all-users command when some users could not be fully deleted. {{.Count}} is the number of users and {{.Usernames}} is a comma-separated list of their usernames.

translation: Failed to update the user.
description: API error when saving the user record fails while promoting a guest to a regular user account.

translation: Failed to reset login attempts.
description: API error when clearing the count of failed login attempts on an account fails.

translation: Unable to save the account.
description: Generic internal error when saving a user account to the database fails.

translation: An account with that email already exists.
description: Signup/user-creation error when the email address is already used by another account.

translation: Must call update for existing user.
description: Internal error when code attempts to create a user that already exists instead of updating; developer-facing.

translation: Unable to determine if that username already exists
description: API error during user creation when the check for a username collision with an existing user group fails.

translation: An account with that username already exists.
description: Signup/user-creation error when the username is already taken by another account.

translation: Unable to find any user matching the search parameters.
description: API error when a user search query fails on the server.

translation: Unable to send auto response from user.
description: Internal error when posting a user's automatic reply (out-of-office auto-response) to a direct message fails.

translation: Failed to check if user store is empty.
description: Internal API error shown when the query checking whether any users exist yet (fresh install detection) fails.

translation: Error determining number of System Admin accounts.
description: API error when counting System Admin accounts fails while validating a role change; 'System Admin' is the top admin role name.

translation: Unable to find the existing account to update.
description: API error when updating a user profile and the existing account record cannot be found; 'account' is the user's account.

translation: We encountered an error finding the account.
description: API error when a database lookup fails while updating a user account.

translation: Cannot demote last System Admin.
description: API error when a role change would demote the only remaining System Admin, which is not allowed.

translation: This username is reserved for a system-owned bot.
description: API error when someone tries to rename a bot account to a username reserved for a built-in, system-owned bot.

translation: Can't activate user. Server exceeds maximum licensed users. ERROR_LICENSED_USERS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
description: API error when reactivating a user would exceed the licensed seat count; 'ERROR_LICENSED_USERS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' is a support error code and must not be translated.

translation: Can't activate user. Server exceeds safe user limit. ERROR_SAFETY_LIMITS_EXCEEDED.
description: API error when reactivating a user would exceed the unlicensed server's safety user limit; 'ERROR_SAFETY_LIMITS_EXCEEDED' is a support error code and must not be translated.

translation: Unable to deactivate guests.
description: API error when bulk-deactivating guest accounts fails.

translation: Unable to update the auth data.
description: API error when updating a user's authentication data (the link between the account and its sign-in method, e.g. LDAP/SAML) fails.

translation: Unable to switch account to {{.Service}}. An account using the email {{.Email}} already exists.
description: Error when switching a user's sign-in method; {{.Service}} is the authentication service name (e.g. SAML, AD/LDAP) and {{.Email}} is the conflicting email address.

translation: Unable to update the failed_attempts.
description: Internal error when saving the count of failed login attempts fails; 'failed_attempts' is a database field name.

translation: Unable to update following state for thread
description: API error when saving whether the user follows a message thread fails; 'following' means subscribing to thread notifications.

translation: Unable to update read state for thread
description: API error when updating the read/unread state of a message thread for the user fails.

translation: Invalid post_id
description: API validation error when marking a thread read up to a specific post and the post ID is invalid; 'post_id' is an API parameter name.

translation: Unable to update all user threads as read
description: API error when marking all of the user's message threads as read fails.

translation: Unable to update the date of the last update of the user.
description: API error when refreshing the user's last-updated timestamp in the database fails; awkward English is about the UpdateAt field.

translation: Unable to update verify email field.
description: API error when the server fails to mark a user's email address as verified in the database.

translation: The personal access token "{{.Description}}" for bot account @{{.BotUsername}} has expired and been removed. Open **Integrations > Bot Accounts** to create a new token.
description: Direct message from the system bot to a bot's owner saying one of the bot's personal access tokens has expired and was deleted. {{.Description}} is the token's description, {{.BotUsername}} the bot's username. 'Integrations > Bot Accounts' is a menu path; match the translated UI labels. Keep the Markdown ** markers.

translation: Unable to count the personal access tokens that violate the maximum lifetime policy.
description: API error shown to admins when counting personal access tokens that exceed the configured maximum lifetime fails; 'personal access token' is the API-token feature.

translation: Unable to delete the personal access token.
description: API error returned when deleting a personal access token fails.

translation: Personal access tokens are disabled on this server. Please contact your system administrator for details.
description: API error shown to an end user trying to use or create a personal access token while the feature is disabled server-wide.

translation: The personal access token has expired.
description: API authentication error (and notification text) when a personal access token has passed its expiry date; 'personal access token' is an API credential.

translation: Your personal access token "{{.Description}}" has expired and been removed. Open **Profile → Security** to create a new token.
description: Direct message from the system bot telling a user their personal access token expired and was deleted; {{.Description}} is the token's user-given label, markdown bold marks the settings path.

translation: The provided expires_at is in the past.
description: API validation error when creating a personal access token with an expiry date in the past; 'expires_at' is the API field name.

translation: Personal access tokens must include an expiry date because the server enforces a maximum token lifetime.
description: API validation error when a personal access token is created without an expiry date while the server enforces a maximum token lifetime.

translation: The provided expires_at exceeds the configured maximum personal access token lifetime ({{.Days}} days).
description: API validation error when a personal access token's expiry exceeds the configured maximum lifetime; 'expires_at' is the API field name and {{.Days}} is the maximum lifetime in days.

translation: Unable to get all personal access tokens.
description: API error shown to admins when listing all personal access tokens on the server fails.

translation: Unable to get the personal access tokens by user.
description: API error returned when listing a specific user's personal access tokens fails.

translation: Unable to retrieve expiring personal access tokens.
description: Internal error when querying the database for personal access tokens nearing expiry fails.

translation: Invalid or missing token.
description: API authentication error when a request's personal access token is invalid, disabled, or absent.

translation: No maximum personal access token lifetime is configured, so there are no non-compliant tokens to revoke.
description: API message shown to an admin who runs the revoke-non-compliant-tokens operation while no maximum token lifetime policy is configured, so nothing can be revoked.

translation: The batch limit was reached before all non-compliant tokens could be revoked. Run the operation again to continue.
description: API message shown to an admin when a bulk revocation of policy-violating personal access tokens stopped at the batch size limit and must be rerun to finish.

translation: Unable to regenerate the access token.
description: API error returned when regenerating (rotating) a personal access token fails.

translation: Unable to save the personal access token.
description: API error returned when persisting a new personal access token fails.

translation: We encountered an error searching user access tokens.
description: API error shown to admins when searching personal access tokens fails.

translation: Unable to disable the access token.
description: API error returned when disabling (temporarily deactivating) a personal access token fails.

translation: Unable to enable the access token.
description: API error returned when re-enabling a disabled personal access token fails.

translation: Unable to delete terms of service.
description: API error when deleting the record of a user's acceptance of the terms of service fails.

translation: Unable to fetch terms of service.
description: API error when fetching the record of a user's acceptance of the terms of service fails.

translation: No terms of service found.
description: API error returned when a user's terms-of-service acceptance record cannot be found; 'terms of service' is the legal agreement document.

translation: Unable to save terms of service.
description: API error when the server fails to record a user's acceptance of the terms of service.

translation: Password is not valid
description: Generic fallback error when a password fails the server's password requirements and no specific message applies.

translation: Failed to count views for channel.
description: API error when counting a channel's views fails; 'view' is a noun meaning a saved channel view (e.g. Kanban board), not the act of viewing.

translation: Unable to create the view.
description: API error when saving a new channel view fails; 'view' is a noun (a Kanban-style board view inside a channel).

translation: Failed to count views for channel.
description: API error when checking the existing view count before creating a channel view; 'views' are Kanban-style board views, not page views.

translation: This channel has reached the maximum number of views.
description: API error shown when a user tries to create another channel view past the per-channel maximum; 'views' are Kanban-style board views.

translation: View is required.
description: API validation error when the create request has no view payload; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: Unable to delete the view.
description: API error when deleting a channel view fails; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: View is required.
description: API validation error when the delete request has no view payload; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: View not found.
description: API error when the channel view to delete does not exist; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: Unable to get the view.
description: API error when fetching a channel view fails; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: View not found.
description: API error when the requested channel view does not exist; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: Unable to get views for this channel.
description: API error when listing the views of a channel fails; 'views' are Kanban-style board views.

translation: Invalid input when getting views for channel.
description: API error when the request to list a channel's views has invalid parameters; 'views' are Kanban-style board views.

translation: Unable to update the view.
description: API error when saving changes to a channel view fails; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: View is required.
description: API validation error when the update request has no view payload; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: View not found.
description: API error when the channel view to update does not exist; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: Unable to update the view sort order.
description: API error when reordering a channel's views fails; 'sort order' is the display position of the views in the channel.

translation: Invalid input for view sort order update.
description: API error when the reorder request for channel views has invalid parameters (e.g. bad index).

translation: View not found.
description: API error when the channel view being reordered does not exist; 'view' is a noun (channel board view).

translation: Unable to count the incoming webhooks.
description: Internal error when counting incoming webhooks fails; used by System Console integration statistics.

translation: Unable to count the outgoing webhooks.
description: Internal error when counting outgoing webhooks fails; used by System Console integration statistics.

translation: Unable to delete the webhook.
description: API error when deleting an incoming webhook fails.

translation: Unable to delete the webhook.
description: API error when deleting an outgoing webhook fails.

translation: Unable to get the webhook.
description: API error when fetching an incoming webhook from the database fails.

translation: Unable to get the webhooks.
description: API error returned when listing the incoming webhooks configured for a channel fails; 'webhook' is an integration term, usually left untranslated.

translation: Unable to get the webhook.
description: API error when fetching the incoming webhooks created by a specific user fails.

translation: Unable to get the webhook for teamID={{.TeamID}}, userID={{.UserID}}, err={{.Error}}.
description: API error when counting incoming webhooks fails; {{.TeamID}} and {{.UserID}} are database IDs and {{.Error}} is the underlying error text.

translation: Unable to get the webhook.
description: API error when fetching an outgoing webhook from the database fails.

translation: Unable to get the webhooks.
description: API error returned when listing the outgoing webhooks configured for a channel fails.

translation: Unable to get the webhooks.
description: API error when listing a team's outgoing webhooks fails.

translation: Unable to delete the webhook.
description: API error returned when deleting a channel's incoming webhooks fails (happens while deleting the channel).

translation: Unable to delete the webhook.
description: API error returned when deleting a channel's outgoing webhooks fails (happens while deleting the channel).

translation: Unable to save the IncomingWebhook.
description: API error when saving a new incoming webhook fails; 'IncomingWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: You cannot overwrite an existing IncomingWebhook.
description: API error when creating an incoming webhook with an ID that already exists; 'IncomingWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Unable to save the OutgoingWebhook.
description: API error when saving a new outgoing webhook fails; 'OutgoingWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: You cannot overwrite an existing OutgoingWebhook.
description: API error when creating an outgoing webhook with an ID that already exists; 'OutgoingWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Unable to update the IncomingWebhook.
description: API error when saving changes to an incoming webhook fails; 'IncomingWebhook' is an internal object name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Unable to update the webhook.
description: API error when saving changes to an outgoing webhook fails.

translation: URL is too long
description: API error returned when the request URL exceeds the server's maximum allowed length.

translation: Image limits check failed. Resolution is too high.
description: API error when an uploaded custom brand image exceeds the maximum allowed resolution; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to decode the image data.
description: API error when the uploaded custom brand image cannot be decoded as an image; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to convert the image data to PNG format. Please try again.
description: API error when converting the uploaded custom brand image to PNG fails; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to upload the custom brand image. Make sure the image size is less than 2 MB and try again.
description: API error when the uploaded custom brand image cannot be opened; advises keeping the image under 2 MB; admin-facing.

translation: Unable to write the image file to your file storage. Please check your connection and try again.
description: API error when writing the custom brand image to file storage fails; admin-facing.

translation: Failed to parse the value {{.Value}} to int64.
description: Internal API error when a stored setting cannot be parsed as a number; {{.Value}} is the offending value and 'int64' is a numeric type name.

translation: Failed to extract data from previous job.
description: Background job error (access control membership sync) shown in the admin jobs table when data carried over from a previous job cannot be parsed.

translation: Failed to run access control sync job.
description: Error status for the background job that synchronizes channel/team membership with access control policies; visible to system admins.

translation: Unable to get users.
description: Error output of the CLI/mmctl authentication-migration command when the list of user accounts cannot be fetched.

translation: Unable to get SAML users.
description: Error output of the CLI/mmctl authentication-migration command when SAML-authenticated users cannot be fetched; SAML is the single sign-on protocol name.

translation: attached a file.
description: Mobile push notification body when a message contains only an attachment; appended directly after the sender's name, so the leading space is intentional.

translation: Translation task must include an object ID.
description: Internal validation error when queueing a translation task without the ID of the object (e.g. post) to translate.

translation: Translation task must include an object type.
description: Internal validation error when queueing a translation task without the type of object (e.g. post) to translate.

translation: Translation task cannot be null.
description: Internal validation error when a null translation task is queued; developer-leaning register.

translation: Translation task cannot be added because the worker has been stopped.
description: Error when a translation task is queued after the background translation worker has shut down.

translation: Failed to create translation.
description: Error when the automatic message translation feature fails to produce a translation for a post.

translation: Context is required for language detection.
description: Internal validation error in automatic message translation; 'context' is the programming request context object, not conversational context.

translation: Text exceeds maximum size for language detection.
description: Validation error when text sent for language detection exceeds the size limit of the automatic translation feature.

translation: Failed to detect language using translation provider.
description: Error from the automatic message translation feature when the external translation provider fails to detect a text's language.

translation: Failed to mask content for translation.
description: Error when the automatic translation feature fails to mask (replace with placeholder tokens) mentions, links, and code before sending text to the translation provider.

translation: Post object cannot be null.
description: Internal validation error in automatic message translation when the post object to translate is missing (null).

translation: Auto-translation is not available. Please contact your system administrator about upgrading your enterprise license.
description: Error shown to end users trying to use automatic message translation when the server license does not include it.

translation: Invalid language code provided.
description: Validation error in automatic message translation when a language code parameter is not valid.

translation: Failed to update translation with new mask values.
description: Error when the automatic translation feature cannot update a stored translation with regenerated mask placeholder values.

translation: Content contains no translatable text.
description: Error from the automatic message translation feature when a post has no text that can be translated (e.g. only attachments).

translation: Translation provider is not available.
description: Error when the configured machine-translation provider service cannot be reached; 'provider' is the external translation service.

translation: Translation provider is not initialized.
description: Error when the machine-translation provider has not been set up yet; 'provider' is the external translation service.

translation: Unable to process auto-translation request.
description: Generic database error while processing an automatic message translation request.

translation: Translation contains unrecognized tokens.
description: Error when the translated text returned by the provider contains placeholder tokens the server did not create; 'tokens' are the masking placeholders.

translation: Translation contains invalid tokens.
description: Error when restoring masked placeholders in a translated message fails because a token is corrupted or unmatched.

translation: Unable to parse JSON content.
description: Validation error in automatic message translation when structured content cannot be parsed as JSON.

translation: Unsupported content type for translation.
description: Validation error in automatic message translation when the object type (e.g. post) is not one the feature can translate.

translation: Content cannot be null.
description: Internal validation error in automatic message translation when the content to translate is missing (null); developer-leaning register.

translation: Content exceeds maximum size for translation.
description: Validation error when a message exceeds the maximum size the automatic translation feature accepts.

translation: Required ID cannot be empty.
description: Validation error in automatic message translation when a required object ID parameter is empty.

translation: Invalid ID format.
description: Validation error in automatic message translation when an object ID parameter is malformed.

translation: Cluster configuration has changed for id={{ .id }}. The cluster may become unstable and a restart is required. To ensure the cluster is configured correctly you should perform a rolling restart immediately.
description: Warning logged/surfaced to system admins of a high-availability cluster; {{ .id }} is the ID of the cluster node whose configuration diverged.

translation: Error occurred while marshalling JSON request
description: Log/error message for admins when a high-availability cluster message cannot be serialized to JSON; 'marshalling' means serializing.

translation: System Console is set to read-only when High Availability is enabled unless ReadOnlyConfig is disabled in the configuration file.
description: Error shown to admins trying to change settings from the System Console when the server runs in High Availability mode; 'System Console' is the admin UI and 'ReadOnlyConfig' is a config setting name that should stay untranslated.

translation: Failed to send cluster request
description: Log/error message for admins when a node in a high-availability cluster cannot send a request to another node.

translation: Timed out waiting for cluster response
description: Log/error message for admins when a node in a high-availability cluster does not answer a request in time.

translation: Compliance functionality disabled by current license. Please contact your system administrator about upgrading your enterprise license.
description: Error shown to admins using compliance export features without a license that includes them.

translation: Compliance export failed for job '{{.JobName}}' at '{{.FilePath}}'
description: Failure message for a compliance export job, seen by admins; {{.JobName}} is the job's name and {{.FilePath}} is the export file path.

translation: Your license does not support Data Retention.
description: Error shown to admins using the Data Retention feature (automatic deletion of old messages/files) without a supporting license.

translation: We encountered an error performing the requested operation.
description: Generic server error shown to admins managing data retention policies in the System Console.

translation: Policy is invalid.
description: Validation error shown to admins when a submitted data retention policy fails validation; 'policy' is a data retention policy.

translation: Data retention job failed.
description: Failure status of the background data retention job (automatic deletion of old messages/files); visible to admins in the jobs table.

translation: {{.Backend}} aggregator worker failed to create the indexing job
description: Error status for the search index aggregation job; {{.Backend}} is 'Elasticsearch' or 'OpenSearch'; it failed to spawn a child indexing job.

translation: {{.Backend}} aggregator worker failed to delete the indexes
description: Error status for the search index aggregation job; {{.Backend}} is 'Elasticsearch' or 'OpenSearch'; 'indexes' are search indices being merged.

translation: {{.Backend}} aggregator worker failed to get indexes
description: Error status for the search index aggregation job; {{.Backend}} is 'Elasticsearch' or 'OpenSearch'; it could not list the search indices.

translation: {{.Backend}} aggregator worker failed due to the indexing job failing
