description: Health dashboard finding detail when a non-containerized node's 15-minute host load average is at least twice its CPU core count; {{.load}} is the load average and {{.cores}} is the number of logical CPU cores.

translation: Check CPU utilization, disk I/O, and running processes on the node, then add capacity or reduce the workload.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when a server node has sustained high host load.

translation: Host load is high
description: Health dashboard finding title when a non-containerized server node's 15-minute load average is at least twice its CPU core count.

translation: The host has {{.available}} MB available out of {{.total}} MB. Mattermost and other processes may be killed or become slow if memory continues to fall.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when a non-containerized node has less than 10% of host memory available; {{.available}} and {{.total}} are values in MB.

translation: Find and reduce the processes using the most memory, or add memory to the host. Review Mattermost and plugin memory use before restarting services.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when a non-containerized server host has little memory available.

translation: Host memory is running low
description: Health dashboard finding title when a non-containerized server node has less than 10% of host memory available.

translation: This node did not return its diagnostics for the health check. It may be down, overloaded, or cut off from the other nodes. Until it responds, its other findings keep their last known state.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when a cluster node did not return its diagnostics; 'findings' are the health dashboard's reported problems.

translation: Check that Mattermost is running on this node, review its logs and its CPU and memory use, and confirm it can reach the other nodes on the gossip port (ClusterSettings.GossipPort).
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a cluster node that is not responding; 'ClusterSettings.GossipPort' is a config setting name and should not be translated, and 'gossip' is the protocol cluster nodes use to talk to each other.

translation: A cluster node is not responding
description: Health dashboard finding title when a node of a high availability cluster did not return its diagnostics for the health check.

translation: The OAuth/OIDC provider connectivity probe failed from every reporting Mattermost node, so sign-in through this provider is likely unavailable.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when every reporting Mattermost node fails to reach an enabled OAuth or OpenID Connect provider.

translation: The OAuth/OIDC provider connectivity probe failed on {{.nodes}}, while the other reporting nodes can reach the provider. Sign-in through this provider may fail on those nodes.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when some cluster nodes cannot reach an enabled OAuth or OpenID Connect provider; {{.nodes}} is a comma-separated list of node hostnames.

translation: Check the error details, the provider's discovery or token endpoint, and outbound network, firewall, proxy and DNS settings. Then confirm sign-in through the provider.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when an enabled OAuth or OpenID Connect provider connectivity probe fails.

translation: OAuth/OIDC provider connectivity probe failed
description: Health dashboard finding title when an enabled OAuth or OpenID Connect provider connectivity probe fails.

translation: PluginSettings.EnableHealthCheck is false, so a plugin that crashes is not restarted automatically.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the plugin health check is turned off; 'PluginSettings.EnableHealthCheck' is a config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Set PluginSettings.EnableHealthCheck to true.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a disabled plugin health check; 'PluginSettings.EnableHealthCheck' is a config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Plugin health check disabled
description: Health dashboard finding title when the server does not monitor and restart crashed plugins.

translation: These plugins are enabled but not running: {{.plugins}}.
description: Health dashboard finding detail listing plugins that are enabled but failed to start or stopped; {{.plugins}} is a comma-separated list of plugin IDs.

translation: In System Console > Plugins > Plugin Management, check the status of each listed plugin, and try disabling and enabling it again. The server log records why a plugin failed to start or was stopped by the plugin health check.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for enabled plugins that are not running; 'System Console > Plugins > Plugin Management' names a System Console page.

translation: Enabled plugins are not running
description: Health dashboard finding title when one or more plugins are enabled but failed to start or to stay running.

translation: PluginSettings.Enable is false, so no plugins run. This suits some locked-down deployments, but is often unintentional.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the plugin framework is turned off; 'PluginSettings.Enable' is a config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: If this is unexpected, set PluginSettings.Enable to true.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a disabled plugin framework; 'PluginSettings.Enable' is a config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Plugins disabled
description: Health dashboard finding title when the plugin framework is turned off, so no plugins run.

translation: PushNotificationServer {{.url}} uses http://, so push notifications are sent in cleartext.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the push notification server URL starts with http:// instead of https://; {{.url}} is the configured URL. 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: PushNotificationServer {{.url}} has an invalid scheme. Mobile users will not receive notifications.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the push notification server URL starts with neither https:// nor http://; {{.url}} is the configured URL. 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: Prefix PushNotificationServer with https:// and verify reachability from the app node.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a push notification server URL that does not use https://; 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and 'app node' is the Mattermost application server.

translation: PushNotificationServer does not use https://
description: Health dashboard finding title when the push notification server URL does not start with https://; 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: Every push attempt will fail with 'unsupported protocol scheme'.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when push notifications are enabled but no push server URL is set; 'unsupported protocol scheme' is the literal error the server reports and should not be translated.

translation: Point PushNotificationServer to https://push.mattermost.com or a self-hosted push proxy.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a blank push notification server URL; https://push.mattermost.com is Mattermost's hosted push service. 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: Push notifications enabled but PushNotificationServer is blank
description: Health dashboard finding title when push notifications are turned on but the push notification server URL is empty; 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: PushNotificationContents is set to full, so the message text and sender are included in the push payload, which travels through the push proxy and the Apple and Google push services.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when push notifications carry the full message text; 'PushNotificationContents' is a config setting name and 'full' is its value, neither should be translated.

translation: For maximum push privacy, set EmailSettings.PushNotificationContents to id_loaded. Only a message ID is sent, and the mobile app fetches the message content from the server. Mobile devices must then be able to reach the server when a notification arrives, so on servers only reachable through a VPN or internal network, notifications can't show message content. If full is a deliberate choice, mute this finding.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for push notifications that carry the full message text; 'EmailSettings.PushNotificationContents' is the config setting path and 'id_loaded' is its value, neither should be translated.

translation: Push notifications include the full message text
description: Health dashboard finding title when push notification payloads contain the message text and sender.

translation: The connection test to the push notification server failed: {{.error}}. Mobile users may not receive push notifications.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when no app node could connect to the configured push notification server; {{.error}} is the error the failing nodes reported, with URL credentials masked.

translation: The connection test to the push notification server failed on {{.nodes}}, while the other nodes reach it. Push notifications sent by those nodes may fail. Check the network, firewall, proxy and DNS settings on those nodes. Error: {{.error}}
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the push notification server connection test fails on some cluster nodes but not others; {{.nodes}} is a comma-separated list of node hostnames and {{.error}} is the error the failing nodes reported, with URL credentials masked.

translation: Check PushNotificationServer, TLS certificates and push proxy health. Confirm every Mattermost app node can reach the configured host over HTTPS, then verify its /version endpoint.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a failed push notification server connection test; 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting path, '/version' is a literal endpoint, and neither should be translated.

translation: Push notification server connection test failed
description: Health dashboard finding title when one or more app nodes could not connect to the configured push notification server.

translation: push-test.mattermost.com is the Mattermost test push proxy. It has no SLA, limited throughput, and is not intended for production use. Mobile push delivery will be unreliable for anything beyond small-scale testing.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the push notification server is push-test.mattermost.com, Mattermost's test push proxy that is not meant for production; 'SLA' means service level agreement.

translation: push-test.mattermost.com is the Mattermost test push proxy. It has no SLA, limited throughput, and is not intended for production use. Your license includes the Mattermost Hosted Push Notification Service: set PushNotificationServer to https://global.push.mattermost.com.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the push notification server is push-test.mattermost.com on a server whose license includes the hosted push service; 'SLA' means service level agreement, 'Mattermost Hosted Push Notification Service' is a product name and 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name, do not translate them.

translation: Point PushNotificationServer at a production push proxy: a self-hosted Mattermost Push Proxy serving your own builds of the mobile apps.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a server using the test push proxy; 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and 'Mattermost Push Proxy' is a product name, do not translate them.

translation: PushNotificationServer points at push-test.mattermost.com
description: Health dashboard finding title when the push notification server is Mattermost's test push proxy; 'PushNotificationServer' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: RateLimitSettings.Enable is false with {{.users}} registered users. Rate limiting protects the server against request floods and abusive or misbehaving clients; with this many users plus webhooks and bot integrations, a single misconfigured client can saturate the API. Mattermost documents its built-in rate limiter as intended for smaller deployments (up to a few hundred users), so at larger scale request throttling is often better handled at a load balancer or API gateway.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when API rate limiting is off on a large instance; {{.users}} is the registered user count, and 'RateLimitSettings.Enable' is the config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Make sure request throttling suited to this scale is in place, either Mattermost's built-in rate limiting (System Console > Environment > Rate Limiting) or at your load balancer or gateway.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for disabled rate limiting on a large instance; 'System Console > Environment > Rate Limiting' is the admin UI path.

translation: API rate limiting is disabled on a large instance
description: Health dashboard finding title when API rate limiting is turned off on an instance with more than 500 registered users.

translation: RateLimitSettings.MemoryStoreSize is {{.size}}, but there are {{.users}} registered users. The rate limiter tracks at most this many clients; when it is full it drops the least recently seen one, whose request quota then starts over, so a small store weakens rate limiting.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the rate limiter's memory store is smaller than the registered user count; {{.size}} is the configured size, {{.users}} is the registered user count, and 'RateLimitSettings.MemoryStoreSize' is the config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Raise RateLimitSettings.MemoryStoreSize to at least the number of registered users.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a small rate limiter memory store; 'RateLimitSettings.MemoryStoreSize' is the config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Rate limiting memory store is smaller than the user count
description: Health dashboard finding title when RateLimitSettings.MemoryStoreSize is below the number of registered users.

translation: TimeBetweenBatchesMilliseconds is {{.value}}. The data retention job pauses this long between delete batches to give the database time to serve live traffic. Under 100 ms, large deletions can slow the database for everyone.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the data retention pause between delete batches is under 100 milliseconds; {{.value}} is the configured pause in milliseconds. 'TimeBetweenBatchesMilliseconds' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: Raise DataRetentionSettings.TimeBetweenBatchesMilliseconds to at least 100 (the default) in the configuration.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a data retention batch pause under 100 milliseconds; 'DataRetentionSettings.TimeBetweenBatchesMilliseconds' is a config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: Data retention TimeBetweenBatchesMilliseconds is under 100
description: Health dashboard finding title when the data retention pause between delete batches is under 100 milliseconds; 'TimeBetweenBatchesMilliseconds' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: Assertions travel unencrypted at the SAML layer. TLS still protects the connection, so this is not a baseline security failure, but if your IdP supports assertion encryption, enabling it adds defense in depth.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when SAML assertion encryption is turned off. 'SamlSettings.Encrypt' is a config name and should not be translated.

translation: If your IdP supports assertion encryption, enable SamlSettings.Encrypt and configure the service provider private key and public certificate.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when SAML assertion encryption is turned off. 'SamlSettings.Encrypt' is a config name and should not be translated.

translation: SAML assertion encryption is disabled
description: Health dashboard finding title when SAML assertion encryption is turned off. 'SamlSettings.Encrypt' is a config name and should not be translated.

translation: Mattermost keys SAML accounts by email address, either because IdAttribute is empty or because it names an email attribute. When a user's email changes at the IdP, the link to their existing account breaks.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the SAML ID attribute is empty or an email attribute. 'IdAttribute', 'SamlSettings.IdAttribute' and 'objectGUID' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: Configure the IdP to send a stable identifier (such as objectGUID or an immutable ID), then set SamlSettings.IdAttribute to that attribute's name. Existing accounts move to the new identifier on their own: at each user's next sign-in, Mattermost finds the account by email and stores the new ID.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when the SAML ID attribute is empty or an email attribute. 'IdAttribute', 'SamlSettings.IdAttribute' and 'objectGUID' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: SAML IdAttribute is empty or an email attribute
description: Health dashboard finding title when the SAML ID attribute is empty or an email attribute. 'IdAttribute', 'SamlSettings.IdAttribute' and 'objectGUID' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: IdAttribute is {{.attribute}}. Usernames, uids and user principal names are often recycled across employees, and when that happens the second person inherits the first person's Mattermost account.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the SAML ID attribute is a username, uid or user principal name that the identity provider can reassign. {{.attribute}} is the configured attribute name. 'IdAttribute', 'objectGUID' and 'Microsoft Entra ID' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: Prefer an identifier that is never reassigned, such as objectGUID (AD) or an immutable ID (Microsoft Entra ID), and review the IdP policy on identifier reuse.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when the SAML ID attribute is a username, uid or user principal name that the identity provider can reassign. 'IdAttribute', 'objectGUID' and 'Microsoft Entra ID' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: SAML IdAttribute can be reassigned at the IdP
description: Health dashboard finding title when the SAML ID attribute is a username, uid or user principal name that the identity provider can reassign. 'IdAttribute', 'objectGUID' and 'Microsoft Entra ID' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: The SAML check of the IdP certificate and IdP URL failed, so SAML sign-in is likely broken.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the SAML configuration check run by the server failed: the IdP certificate is missing, invalid or expired, or the IdP URL is missing or invalid. 'IdpCertificateFile' and 'IdpURL' are config names and should not be translated.

translation: The SAML check of the IdP certificate and IdP URL failed on {{.nodes}}, while it passes on the other nodes, so SAML sign-in may fail on those nodes. Make sure those nodes have the same valid IdP certificate as the other nodes.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the SAML check fails on some cluster nodes but not others; {{.nodes}} is a comma-separated list of node hostnames, and 'IdP' means identity provider.

translation: Check the error details, then fix the IdP certificate (IdpCertificateFile) or the IdP URL (IdpURL) in the SAML settings. If the certificate expired, upload the IdP's current signing certificate.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when the SAML configuration check run by the server failed: the IdP certificate is missing, invalid or expired, or the IdP URL is missing or invalid. 'IdpCertificateFile' and 'IdpURL' are config names and should not be translated.

translation: SAML configuration check failed
description: Health dashboard finding title when the SAML configuration check run by the server failed: the IdP certificate is missing, invalid or expired, or the IdP URL is missing or invalid. 'IdpCertificateFile' and 'IdpURL' are config names and should not be translated.

translation: SSO uses the SHA-1 signature algorithm, which is deprecated. SSO works today, but some identity providers are beginning to reject SHA-1, so this is a compatibility and security improvement to schedule, particularly before any IdP change or upgrade.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when SAML uses the SHA-1 signature algorithm. 'SamlSettings.SignatureAlgorithm' and 'RSAwithSHA256' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: When convenient, and in coordination with your IdP, set SamlSettings.SignatureAlgorithm to RSAwithSHA256.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when SAML uses the SHA-1 signature algorithm. 'SamlSettings.SignatureAlgorithm' and 'RSAwithSHA256' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: SAML SignatureAlgorithm is SHA-1
description: Health dashboard finding title when SAML uses the SHA-1 signature algorithm. 'SamlSettings.SignatureAlgorithm' and 'RSAwithSHA256' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: Mattermost accepts SAML responses without verifying your IdP's signature, so it cannot tell a genuine authentication response from a forged one.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when SAML signature verification is turned off. 'SamlSettings.Verify' and 'AssertionConsumerServiceURL' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: Set SamlSettings.Verify to true and make sure AssertionConsumerServiceURL is set. Enable it in coordination with your IdP and test sign-in, since verification requires the IdP certificate to be configured correctly.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when SAML signature verification is turned off. 'SamlSettings.Verify' and 'AssertionConsumerServiceURL' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: SAML signature verification is disabled
description: Health dashboard finding title when SAML signature verification is turned off. 'SamlSettings.Verify' and 'AssertionConsumerServiceURL' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: The workspace has {{.posts}} posts and search runs against the database. Elasticsearch is recommended above 2,500,000 posts and required above 5,000,000.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when database search is used at more than 2,500,000 and at most 5,000,000 posts; {{.posts}} is the post count.

translation: Plan an Elasticsearch deployment before the next major growth period, or before reaching 5,000,000 posts.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a growing workspace without Elasticsearch search.

translation: Post count is approaching the Elasticsearch threshold
description: Health dashboard finding title when a workspace with more than 2,500,000 and at most 5,000,000 posts searches the database instead of Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

translation: The workspace has {{.posts}} posts and search runs against the database. At this scale, expect slow searches, timeouts, and database CPU spikes.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when database search is used at more than 5,000,000 posts; {{.posts}} is the post count.

translation: Deploy Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, run a full initial index, then enable EnableIndexing, EnableSearching, and EnableAutocomplete.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a large workspace without Elasticsearch search; 'EnableIndexing', 'EnableSearching' and 'EnableAutocomplete' are config setting names and should not be translated.

translation: Elasticsearch is required above 5,000,000 posts
description: Health dashboard finding title when a workspace with more than 5,000,000 posts searches the database instead of Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

translation: Database search is disabled and Elasticsearch searching is off. Searches return no results. Enabling searching with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch also restores search.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when neither the database nor Elasticsearch or OpenSearch serves search. 'Elasticsearch' and 'OpenSearch' are product names and should not be translated.

translation: Database search is disabled and the license does not include Elasticsearch, so Elasticsearch settings have no effect. Searches return no results.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when database search is disabled on a server whose license does not include Elasticsearch. 'Elasticsearch' is a product name and should not be translated.

translation: Set SqlSettings.DisableDatabaseSearch to false in config.json (or MM_SQLSETTINGS_DISABLEDATABASESEARCH=false).
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when search is fully disabled; 'SqlSettings.DisableDatabaseSearch', 'config.json' and 'MM_SQLSETTINGS_DISABLEDATABASESEARCH=false' are literal names and should not be translated.

translation: Search is disabled
description: Health dashboard finding title when database search is disabled and Elasticsearch or OpenSearch searching is off.

translation: {{.used}} users count toward the license limit of {{.limit}} users, which is now reached. The server does not create or reactivate users until seats are freed or added.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the license's enforced user limit is reached; {{.used}} is the number of users taking a seat and {{.limit}} is the licensed seats plus any extra users the license allows.

translation: Purchase additional seats, or deactivate users who no longer need access to free seats.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when the license's user limit is reached and the server refuses new users.

translation: Licensed user limit reached
description: Health dashboard finding title when the number of active users reached the hard user limit the license enforces.

translation: {{.used}} users count toward {{.seats}} licensed seats ({{.percent}}%).
description: Health dashboard finding detail when licensed seats are nearly full; {{.used}} is the number of users taking a seat, {{.seats}} the licensed seats and {{.percent}} the ratio as a percentage.

translation: If you expect more users, plan additional seats before the license is full. Deactivating users who no longer need access frees seats.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when 90% or more of the licensed seats are in use.

translation: Licensed seats are nearly full
description: Health dashboard finding title when users take 90% to 100% of the licensed seats.

translation: {{.used}} users count toward {{.seats}} licensed seats ({{.percent}}%).
description: Health dashboard finding detail when more users take a seat than the license covers; {{.used}} is the number of users taking a seat, {{.seats}} the licensed seats and {{.percent}} the ratio as a percentage.

translation: Purchase additional seats, or deactivate users who no longer need access. Deactivated users do not take a seat.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when more users are active than the license has seats for.

translation: More users than licensed seats
description: Health dashboard finding title when more users take a seat than the license covers.

translation: Sessions expire on a fixed schedule regardless of activity, so active users are signed out. Most deployments benefit from keeping active users signed in.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when sessions are not extended while users are active. 'ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity' and 'ServiceSettings.ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: Enable ServiceSettings.ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity unless your security policy forbids it.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when sessions are not extended while users are active. 'ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity' and 'ServiceSettings.ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity is disabled
description: Health dashboard finding title when sessions are not extended while users are active. 'ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity' and 'ServiceSettings.ExtendSessionLengthWithActivity' are config or product names and should not be translated.

translation: SiteURL is required for webhook URLs, OAuth callbacks, mobile push payloads, and email links. Integrations are broken while it is empty.
description: Health dashboard finding detail explaining what breaks while the Site URL setting is empty; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: Set SiteURL to the public HTTPS URL of the server.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for an empty Site URL setting; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: ServiceSettings.SiteURL is empty
description: Health dashboard finding title when the Site URL setting is empty; 'ServiceSettings.SiteURL' is the config setting path and should not be translated.

translation: SiteURL is {{.url}}. Session cookies and auth tokens travel over the network unencrypted.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the Site URL uses http://; {{.url}} is the configured Site URL.

translation: Serve Mattermost over HTTPS and update SiteURL to the https:// address.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a Site URL that uses http://; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: SiteURL uses http:// (not https://)
description: Health dashboard finding title when the Site URL starts with http:// instead of https://; 'SiteURL' is a config setting name and should not be translated.

translation: The connection test to the SMTP server failed: {{.error}}
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server could not connect to its SMTP server; {{.error}} is the error returned by the connection test and should not be translated.

translation: The connection test to the SMTP server failed on {{.nodes}}, while the other nodes reach it. Check the network, firewall, proxy and DNS settings on those nodes. Error: {{.error}}
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the SMTP connection test fails on some cluster nodes but not others; {{.nodes}} is a comma-separated list of node hostnames and {{.error}} is the error the failing nodes reported.

translation: Email notifications, invitations and password reset emails may not be delivered. Check the SMTP server, port, connection security and credentials in the System Console, confirm the Mattermost server can reach the SMTP host, then use Test Connection to verify.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step when the SMTP connection test failed; 'Test Connection' is the name of the button on the SMTP page of the System Console.

translation: SMTP server connection test failed
description: Health dashboard finding title when the server could not connect to its SMTP server while email notifications are enabled.

translation: Latest release unknown: it could not be fetched, or the packet does not record it.
description: Health dashboard reason shown when a version check could not run because the latest Mattermost release could not be fetched from GitHub or is not recorded in the Support Packet being evaluated, so the check's status is unknown.

translation: This version is not in this build's release table. To evaluate a Support Packet from a newer server, use a newer mmctl.
description: Health dashboard reason shown when a version check could not run because the server version is newer than the release lifecycle table compiled into this build, so the check's status is unknown. 'mmctl' is the Mattermost command line tool and should not be translated.

translation: Server version unknown or not recognized.
description: Health dashboard reason shown when a version check could not run because the server version is missing or cannot be parsed, so the check's status is unknown.

translation: Running {{.version}}. Latest is {{.latest}}, two or more releases newer.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server is two or more releases behind the latest release; {{.version}} is the running version and {{.latest}} the latest released version.

translation: Plan an upgrade to the latest release before support for this release line ends, or move to an Extended Support Release for a slower upgrade cadence.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a server two or more releases behind the latest release; 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Several releases behind the latest release
description: Health dashboard finding title when the server is two or more releases behind the latest Mattermost release.

translation: Running {{.version}}. Latest is {{.latest}}.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server is one release behind the latest release; {{.version}} is the running version and {{.latest}} the latest released version.

translation: Plan an upgrade to the latest release.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a server one release behind the latest release.

translation: A newer release is available
description: Health dashboard finding title when the server is one release behind the latest Mattermost release.

translation: Running Mattermost {{.version}}. Support for this release line ended on {{.eol_date}}. No security patches ship for this release line.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server's Extended Support Release is past end-of-life and no newer Extended Support Release is still supported; {{.version}} is the running version and {{.eol_date}} the day support for its release line ended (YYYY-MM-DD). 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Running Mattermost {{.version}}, an older release line that is no longer supported. No security patches ship for this release line.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server runs a release line older than every line in this build's release table, all of which had reached end-of-life; {{.version}} is the running version.

translation: Running Mattermost {{.version}}, an older release line that is no longer supported. No security patches ship for this release line. The newest supported Extended Support Release is {{.target}}.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server runs a release line older than every line in this build's release table; {{.version}} is the running version and {{.target}} the newest Extended Support Release still supported. 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Running Mattermost {{.version}}. Support for this release line ended on {{.eol_date}}. No security patches ship for this release line. Upgrade to the latest release.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server runs a regular (non-Extended Support) release that is past end-of-life; {{.version}} is the running version and {{.eol_date}} the day support for its release line ended (YYYY-MM-DD).

translation: Running Mattermost {{.version}}. Support for this release line ended on {{.eol_date}}. No security patches ship for this release line. The newest supported Extended Support Release is {{.target}}.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server's Extended Support Release is past end-of-life; {{.version}} is the running version, {{.eol_date}} the day support for its release line ended (YYYY-MM-DD), and {{.target}} the newest Extended Support Release still supported. 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Plan a staged upgrade to a supported Extended Support Release or the latest release. Supported versions are listed at https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/mattermost-server-releases.html.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for a server past end-of-life; the URL is the Mattermost server releases page. 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Mattermost version is past end-of-life
description: Health dashboard finding title when the server's release line no longer receives security patches.

translation: Running {{.version}} on Extended Support Release {{.esr}}. Plan an upgrade before {{.eol_date}} to keep receiving security patches.
description: Health dashboard finding detail when the server's Extended Support Release reaches end-of-life within 90 days; {{.version}} is the running version, {{.esr}} the release line, and {{.eol_date}} its end-of-life date (YYYY-MM-DD). 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Schedule an upgrade to the latest release or to the next Extended Support Release.
description: Health dashboard fix-it step for an Extended Support Release nearing end-of-life. 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: Extended Support Release is nearing end-of-life
description: Health dashboard finding title when the server's Extended Support Release reaches end-of-life within 90 days. 'Extended Support Release' is a Mattermost release type.

translation: {{.OtherItems}} and {{.LastItem}}
description: Pattern for joining a list into a sentence; {{.OtherItems}} is all items except the last joined by commas, {{.LastItem}} is the final item (e.g. 'a, b and c').

translation: Unable to process import: file does not exist.
description: Error status for a bulk import job when the uploaded import file does not exist; shown in the System Console jobs table and mmctl output.

translation: Unable to process import: import_file parameter is missing.
description: Error status for a bulk import job started without the required import_file parameter; 'import_file' is a literal parameter name.

translation: Unable to process import: JSONL file is missing.
description: Error status for a bulk import job whose zip archive lacks the required JSONL data file; JSONL is a file format name.

translation: Unable to process import: failed to open file.
description: Error status for a bulk import job when the import file cannot be opened.

translation: Failed to decode base64 for trigger ID for interactive dialog.
description: API error when opening an interactive dialog from a message button; the trigger ID (a signed token identifying the interaction) is not valid base64; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Failed to decode base64 signature of trigger ID for interactive dialog.
description: API error when verifying an interactive message/dialog trigger ID and its cryptographic signature fails base64 decoding; audience is integration developers.

translation: Trigger ID for interactive dialog is expired. Trigger IDs live for a maximum of {{.Duration}}.
description: API error when opening an interactive dialog with a stale trigger ID; {{.Duration}} is the maximum trigger ID lifetime (e.g. '20m0s'); developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Trigger ID missing required data for interactive dialog.
description: API error when opening an interactive dialog; the trigger ID token lacks its expected components; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Failed to decode base64 signature of trigger ID for interactive dialog.
description: API error when opening an interactive dialog; the cryptographic signature portion of the trigger ID is not valid base64; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Signature verification of the trigger ID for the interactive dialog failed.
description: API error when opening an interactive dialog; the trigger ID's cryptographic signature check failed; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Failed to sign generated trigger ID for interactive dialog.
description: Server error when creating an interactive dialog; cryptographically signing the newly generated trigger ID failed; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Could not request cancellation for job that is not in a cancelable state.
description: API error returned when an admin tries to cancel a background job whose current status does not allow cancellation.

translation: Failed to set job status to error
description: Internal error when the server cannot record a background job's failure status; 'error' at the end is the job status name.

translation: Feature is not available for the current license
description: Generic API error when a requested feature is not included in the server's current license.

translation: {{.Feature}} feature is not available for the current license
description: API error shown when using a feature not covered by the server's license; {{.Feature}} is the English feature name (e.g. 'Channel Banner') inserted at runtime.

translation: Unable to parse URL.
description: Error from an internal manual-testing endpoint when the test request URL cannot be parsed; developer-facing only.

translation: Unable to get channels.
description: Error from an internal manual-testing endpoint when it cannot fetch the channel list; developer-facing only, 'channels' are chat channels.

translation: Mattermost Security Bulletin
description: Subject line of the security bulletin email Mattermost sends to system administrators; 'Mattermost' is the product name.

translation: Unable to update MFA active status for the user.
description: API error when enabling multi-factor authentication fails while saving the user's MFA status.

translation: Invalid MFA token.
description: API error shown when the one-time code entered during multi-factor authentication setup is wrong; 'MFA token' is the authenticator app code.

translation: Unable to update MFA active status for the user.
description: API error when disabling multi-factor authentication fails while saving the user's MFA status.

translation: Error generating QR code.
description: API error when generating the QR code used to set up multi-factor authentication in an authenticator app fails.

translation: Multi-factor authentication has been disabled on this server.
description: API error when a multi-factor authentication operation is attempted while MFA is disabled on the server.

translation: Invalid MFA token.
description: Error when the multi-factor authentication code entered by the user fails validation; 'MFA token' is the one-time code.

translation: We encountered an error saving the system property.
description: Error when a migration job fails to save its progress marker to the Systems table; 'system property' is a database record, not hardware.

translation: Migration failed due to invalid progress data.
description: Error status for the advanced-permissions migration job when its saved progress data cannot be parsed.

translation: Unable to run migration job due to unknown migration key.
description: Error status when a migration job is scheduled with a migration key the server does not recognize.

translation: Invalid access token.
description: Validation error for OAuth2 access data; 'access token' is an OAuth2 protocol term.

translation: Invalid client id.
description: Validation error for OAuth2 access data; 'client id' is an OAuth2 protocol term identifying the OAuth app.

translation: Invalid redirect uri.
description: Validation error for OAuth2 access data; 'redirect uri' is an OAuth2 protocol term.

translation: Invalid refresh token.
description: Validation error for OAuth2 access data; 'refresh token' is an OAuth2 protocol term.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: Validation error for OAuth2 access data when the associated user ID is malformed.

translation: Action names cannot be empty.
description: Validation error when an access control decision request contains an action with an empty name.

translation: Too many actions requested.
description: Validation error when an access control decision request asks about more actions than are allowed in one call.

translation: Invalid resource id.
description: Validation error when an access control decision request carries a malformed resource id.

translation: Resource type is required.
description: Validation error when an access control decision request omits the resource type.

translation: Invalid subject id.
description: Validation error when an access control decision request carries a malformed subject id.

translation: The parent is already imported.
description: Admin-facing error when an access control policy tries to import a parent policy it has already imported; 'parent' is the higher-level policy.

translation: Imports must target a membership parent policy.
description: Admin-facing error for access control policies; 'imports' is a noun (imported policies) and 'membership parent policy' is a policy type.

translation: Permission policies cannot inherit from other policies.
description: Admin-facing error stating that permission-type access control policies cannot inherit rules from other policies.

translation: Could not inherit access control policy.
description: Admin-facing error when inheriting rules from a parent access control policy fails (e.g. version mismatch).

translation: Action(s) is not valid.
description: Validation error for an access control policy rule whose action list is invalid; 'action' is what the rule allows (e.g. join, view).

translation: Membership cannot be combined with other actions in the same rule.
description: Validation error for an access control policy rule; 'Membership' is a specific action type that must appear alone in a rule.

translation: Permission action rules are only allowed on channel policies.
description: Validation error for an access control policy; permission-action rules are only valid on channel-scoped policies.

translation: Invalid policy id.
description: Validation error when an access control policy's ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid imports for the policy.
description: Validation error when an access control policy's list of imported parent policies is invalid; 'imports' is a noun.

translation: Invalid name for the policy.
description: Validation error when an access control policy's name is missing or invalid.

translation: Invalid access control policy: type is not a valid plugin resource type.
description: Validation error (400) returned when an access control policy is saved with a type that is not a recognized plugin resource type. Surfaced to an admin or to the plugin that submitted the policy.

translation: Invalid policy revision.
description: Validation error when an access control policy's revision number is invalid; 'revision' is a version counter.

translation: Permission policies must be applied to exactly one role.
description: Validation error for permission-type access control policies, which must target exactly one role; 'role' is a permissions role.

translation: Only a membership rule may omit its expression.
description: API error when saving an attribute-based access policy that has a rule with no condition expression; only the membership rule may be empty.

translation: Automatically adding members can only be set on the policy's membership rule.
description: API error when saving an attribute-based access policy that turns on automatic member adding for a rule other than its membership rule.

translation: "{{.Mode}}" is not a supported way of automatically adding members.
description: API error when saving attribute-based access policies with an unknown automatic member adding mode. {{.Mode}} is the invalid mode value as sent by the client, left as-is.

translation: The way members are automatically added must be given as text.
description: API error when saving an attribute-based access policy whose automatic member adding setting is not sent as a text value.

translation: Rule metadata contains an unrecognized key.
description: API error when saving an attribute-based access policy whose rule contains an unknown extra setting (metadata key).

translation: Permission rules require a non-empty name within the policy max length.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy; a permission rule's name is missing or exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Permission rule names must be unique within the policy.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy when two permission rules share the same name.

translation: Invalid role for the rule.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy; 'rule' is a policy rule and 'role' is the user role the rule applies to.

translation: Rule(s) is not valid.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy when one or more of its rules fail validation; 'Rule(s)' refers to policy rules.

translation: Policy must either import or define rules.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy that has neither its own rules nor imported rules from a parent policy.

translation: Invalid scope value for this access control policy.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy with an unrecognized scope value (e.g. 'team').

translation: Scope ID must be a valid ID when scope is set.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy; the ID of the scoped entity (e.g. a team) is not a valid ID.

translation: Scope ID cannot be set without a scope.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy that specifies a scope ID but no scope type.

translation: Membership rules cannot reference session attributes (user.session). Use a permission policy instead.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an access control policy; 'user.session' is a literal attribute prefix in the rule expression and 'membership'/'permission' are policy rule kinds.

translation: Invalid policy type.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy with an unrecognized policy type (parent, channel, team, permission).

translation: Version is not valid for this access control policy.
description: API validation error shown to system admins saving an attribute-based access control policy whose schema version string is not supported.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API error when a post acknowledgement (recipient confirms having read a priority message) has a malformed channel ID.

translation: Invalid post id.
description: API error when a post acknowledgement references a malformed post ID; 'post' is a chat message.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when a post acknowledgement has a malformed user ID for the acknowledging user.

translation: An internal error occurred.
description: Generic fallback returned to API clients when an unexpected internal error (one without a more specific error) reaches the API; shown as the error message, so keep it short and user-facing.

translation: Invalid authorization code.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the generated authorization code field is malformed; developer/integration-facing.

translation: Invalid client id.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the OAuth client (application) ID is malformed; developer/integration-facing.

translation: Code challenge is required when using PKCE.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 authorization when PKCE is in use but the code_challenge parameter is missing; PKCE and 'code challenge' are OAuth technical terms.

translation: Code challenge must be base64url-encoded (using characters A-Z, a-z, 0-9, -, _).
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 PKCE authorization when the code_challenge parameter contains characters outside the base64url alphabet; keep the character list literal.

translation: Code challenge must be between 43 and 128 characters long.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 PKCE authorization when the code_challenge parameter is not 43-128 characters long.

translation: Code challenge method is required when using PKCE.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 PKCE authorization when the code_challenge_method parameter is missing.

translation: Only 'S256' code challenge method is supported.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 PKCE authorization; 'S256' is a literal method identifier and must not be translated.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error for an OAuth 2.0 authorization request whose creation timestamp field is unset; 'Create at' is the CreateAt field name.

translation: Expires in must be set.
description: API validation error for an OAuth 2.0 authorization request whose 'expires in' (code lifetime) field is unset; 'Expires in' is the ExpiresIn field name.

translation: Invalid redirect uri.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the redirect URI is missing, too long, or not a valid http(s) URL; developer/integration-facing.

translation: Resource parameter cannot contain a fragment component.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 authorization; 'resource' is the RFC 8707 resource request parameter and 'fragment' is the #... part of a URI.

translation: Resource parameter must be a valid URI.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 authorization when the RFC 8707 'resource' request parameter cannot be parsed as a URI.

translation: Resource parameter cannot exceed 512 characters.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 authorization when the RFC 8707 'resource' request parameter is longer than 512 characters.

translation: Resource parameter must be an absolute URI.
description: API validation error during OAuth 2.0 authorization when the RFC 8707 'resource' request parameter is a relative URI instead of an absolute one.

translation: Invalid response type.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the response_type request parameter is missing or malformed.

translation: Invalid scope.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the requested scope string exceeds the allowed length; 'scope' is the OAuth permission scope parameter.

translation: Invalid state.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the state request parameter exceeds the allowed length; 'state' is the OAuth anti-CSRF parameter.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error during the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow when the authorizing user's ID field is malformed.

translation: PKCE code verifier provided but PKCE was not used during authorization.
description: OAuth 2.0 token exchange error when the client sends a PKCE code_verifier but the original authorization request did not include a code challenge; developer/integration-facing.

translation: PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) is required for public clients.
description: OAuth 2.0 authorization error telling integrators that public (non-confidential) OAuth clients must use PKCE; keep the acronym expansion.

translation: PKCE code verifier does not match the code challenge.
description: OAuth 2.0 token exchange error when the PKCE code_verifier hash does not match the stored code_challenge; developer/integration-facing.

translation: PKCE code verifier is required when PKCE is used.
description: OAuth 2.0 token exchange error when the authorization used PKCE but the token request omits the code_verifier parameter.

translation: Invalid create at.
description: API validation error when creating or updating a bot account whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset; shown to developers/admins managing bots.

translation: Invalid creator id.
description: API validation error when creating or updating a bot account; the ID of the user who created the bot is malformed.

translation: Invalid description.
description: API validation error when creating or updating a bot account whose description text exceeds the allowed length.

translation: Invalid update at.
description: API validation error when creating or updating a bot account whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error when creating or updating a bot account whose underlying user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid username.
description: API validation error when creating or updating a bot account whose username does not meet the username format rules.

translation: Name must be 1 or more lowercase alphanumeric character.
description: API validation error when creating or renaming a channel whose URL name is empty or contains non-lowercase-alphanumeric characters; 'Name' is the channel's URL slug, not its display name.

translation: Channel banner color cannot be empty when channel banner is enabled
description: API validation error when saving channel banner settings with the banner enabled but no background color chosen; shown to channel admins.

translation: Channel banner color must be a valid hex color (e.g., #FF0000 or #F00)
description: API validation error when saving channel banner settings; '#FF0000' and '#F00' are literal hex color examples.

translation: Channel banner can only be configured on Public and Private channels
description: API validation error when trying to configure a channel banner on an unsupported channel type; 'Public' and 'Private' refer to channel visibility types.

translation: Channel banner info text cannot be empty when channel banner is enabled
description: API validation error when saving channel banner settings with the banner enabled but no banner text entered.

translation: Channel banner info text is too long. Max allowed length is {{.maxLength}} characters.
description: API validation error when saving channel banner settings; {{.maxLength}} is the maximum number of characters allowed for the banner text.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a channel whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid creator id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel; the ID of the user who created the channel is malformed.

translation: Only private channels can be marked as discoverable.
description: Channel validation error; 'discoverable' means the channel is findable/joinable by request, and only private channels support it.

translation: Invalid display name.
description: API validation error when saving a channel whose display name is empty or too long; the display name is the human-readable channel name, distinct from its URL name.

translation: Only public and private channels can be group constrained.
description: API validation error when enabling group-constrained membership (LDAP/AD group sync) on a channel type that does not support it, such as a direct message.

translation: Invalid header.
description: Validation error when a channel's header text fails validation (e.g. too long); 'header' is the text shown at the top of a channel.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel whose ID field is malformed.

translation: Channel names can't be in a hexadecimal format. Please enter a different channel name.
description: API validation error shown when a new channel's URL name looks like a 26-character hexadecimal string (reserved for IDs); asks the user to pick a different name.

translation: Invalid purpose.
description: Validation error when a channel's purpose (description) text fails validation, e.g. too long.

translation: Invalid type.
description: API validation error when saving a channel whose type code (open, private, direct, group) is not recognized.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a channel whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Board display name must not be empty.
description: API validation error when creating a board-type channel (Boards feature) with an empty display name.

translation: Board channels must belong to a team.
description: API validation error when creating a board-type channel (Boards feature) without a team ID; boards cannot exist outside a team.

translation: Channel type must be BO (open board) or BP (private board).
description: API validation error when creating a board-type channel; 'BO' and 'BP' are literal channel type codes and must not be translated.

translation: Board bookmarks cannot reference a file.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark that points to a board but also has a file attachment, which is not allowed.

translation: Board bookmarks cannot set an image URL.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark that points to a board but also specifies a custom image URL, which is not allowed.

translation: Board bookmark link URL must be a site-relative path starting with /, must not contain ://, and must not exceed the maximum length.
description: API validation error when saving a board-type channel bookmark whose link is not a relative path within the site; '/' and '://' are literal URL fragments.

translation: Board bookmarks require a valid target id.
description: API validation error when saving a board-type channel bookmark whose target board ID is missing or malformed.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose channel ID is malformed.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Display name missing.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark without a display name; the display name is the bookmark label shown in the channel's bookmarks bar.

translation: File id is missing or invalid.
description: API validation error when saving a file-type channel bookmark whose attached file ID is missing or malformed.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose ID field is malformed.

translation: Invalid image url.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose custom image URL is not a valid URL.

translation: Cannot set a link and a file in the same bookmark.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark that specifies both a link URL and an attached file; a bookmark can only be one or the other.

translation: Link url is missing or invalid.
description: API validation error when saving a link-type channel bookmark whose URL is missing or not a valid URL.

translation: Invalid original id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose 'original id' (the ID of the bookmark it was copied from) is malformed.

translation: Invalid owner id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose owner (creating user) ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid parent id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose parent bookmark ID (for nested bookmarks) is malformed.

translation: Target id is only allowed for bookmark types that reference another entity.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark that has a target ID but is not a bookmark type that references another entity (like a board).

translation: Invalid type.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose type (link, file, board) is not a recognized value.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a channel bookmark whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API validation error when saving a request to join a channel; the channel ID is malformed.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a channel join request whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Denial reason is too long.
description: API validation error when a reviewer denies a channel join request with a denial reason text exceeding the maximum length.

translation: Denial reason can only be set on a denied join request.
description: API validation error when a denial reason is provided for a channel join request whose status is not 'denied'.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel join request whose ID field is malformed.

translation: Join request message is too long.
description: API validation error when a user's optional message on their channel join request exceeds the maximum length; 'join request' is a request to join a channel.

translation: Invalid reviewer id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel join request; the ID of the reviewer (the user who approved/denied it) is malformed.

translation: An approved or denied join request must record the reviewer and review time.
description: API validation error when a channel join request is marked approved or denied without recording who reviewed it and when.

translation: Invalid join request status.
description: API validation error when saving a channel join request whose status (pending, approved, denied) is not a recognized value.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a channel join request whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel join request; the requesting user's ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid channel-auto-follow-threads value.
description: API validation error when updating a user's per-channel notification preferences; the auto-follow-threads setting must be 'on' or 'off'.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel membership record whose channel ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid email notification value.
description: API validation error when updating a user's per-channel notification preferences; the email notification setting has an unrecognized value.

translation: Invalid ignore channel mentions status.
description: API validation error when updating a user's per-channel notification preferences; the 'ignore @channel mentions' setting has an unrecognized value.

translation: Invalid notify level.
description: API validation error when updating a user's per-channel notification preferences; the desktop notification level (all/mentions/none) has an unrecognized value.

translation: Notify props size limit exceeded.
description: API validation error when a channel member's notification preferences payload exceeds the maximum stored size; 'Notify props' is the NotifyProps data field.

translation: Invalid push notification level.
description: API validation error when updating a user's per-channel notification preferences; the mobile push notification level has an unrecognized value.

translation: Invalid channel member roles longer than {{.Limit}} characters.
description: API validation error when a channel member's assigned roles string exceeds the length limit; {{.Limit}} is the maximum number of characters.

translation: Invalid mark unread level.
description: API validation error when updating a user's per-channel notification preferences; the 'mark channel unread' level (all/mentions) has an unrecognized value.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error when saving a channel membership record whose user ID is malformed.

translation: CreateAt must be set.
description: Server-side validation error for a cluster discovery record or remote cluster (shared channels) entry whose CreateAt timestamp field is unset; 'CreateAt' is a field name.

translation: Hostname must be set.
description: Server-side validation error for a high-availability cluster discovery record missing its hostname; audience is system admins reading logs/API responses.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: Server-side validation error for a cluster discovery record or remote cluster (shared channels) entry whose ID field is malformed.

translation: LastPingAt must be set.
description: Server-side validation error for a high-availability cluster discovery record whose LastPingAt timestamp field is unset; 'LastPingAt' is a field name.

translation: ClusterName must be set.
description: Server-side validation error for a cluster discovery record or remote cluster entry missing its name; 'ClusterName' is a field name.

translation: SiteURL must be set.
description: API error when a remote cluster record lacks a site URL; 'SiteURL' is the field/setting name for a server's base URL and can stay untranslated.

translation: Type must be set.
description: Server-side validation error for a high-availability cluster discovery record whose Type field is unset; 'Type' is a field name.

translation: Invalid AutocompleteData
description: API validation error when registering a slash command whose autocomplete definition is invalid; 'AutocompleteData' is a struct/field name; developer-facing.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid description.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose description exceeds the allowed length.

translation: Invalid title.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose title (display name) is empty or too long; 'title' refers to the command's display name in the integrations UI.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose ID field is malformed.

translation: Invalid Method.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose HTTP request method is not GET or POST; 'Method' is the HTTP method field.

translation: Invalid plugin id.
description: API validation error when registering a slash command; the ID of the plugin that owns the command is malformed, or both a plugin ID and creator ID were set.

translation: Invalid team ID.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose team ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid token.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose verification token is malformed; the token authenticates outgoing command requests.

translation: Invalid trigger.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose trigger word (the word typed after '/') is empty, too long, or contains invalid characters.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid URL.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose request/callback URL is empty or too long.

translation: Invalid URL. Must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command whose callback URL is not a valid absolute URL; 'http://' and 'https://' are literal scheme prefixes.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error when saving a slash command; the ID of the user who created it is malformed.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: Server-side validation error for a slash command webhook record whose channel ID is malformed; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Invalid command id.
description: Server-side validation error for a slash command webhook record whose command ID is malformed; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: Server-side validation error for a slash command webhook record whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid command hook id.
description: Server-side validation error for a slash command webhook record whose own ID is malformed; 'command hook' is the webhook created for a slash command response.

translation: Invalid root id.
description: Server-side validation error for a slash command webhook record whose root post ID (the thread it replies to) is malformed.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: Server-side validation error for a slash command webhook record whose user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid attachment.
description: Error shown when a slash command integration's HTTP response contains an invalid message attachment; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Invalid goto location.
description: Error shown when a slash command integration's HTTP response contains an invalid 'goto_location' URL (the location to redirect the user to); developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Invalid icon url.
description: Error shown when a slash command integration's HTTP response specifies an invalid icon URL for the posted message; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Invalid response type.
description: Error shown when a slash command integration's HTTP response has an unrecognized response type (in_channel or ephemeral); developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: Validation error when a system admin creates a compliance export job whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid description.
description: Validation error when a system admin creates a compliance export job whose job name/description is empty or too long.

translation: To must be a valid time.
description: Validation error when a system admin creates a compliance export job; 'To' is the label of the export date-range end field.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: Validation error for a compliance export job record whose ID field is malformed; shown to system admins.

translation: From must be a valid time.
description: Validation error when a system admin creates a compliance export job; 'From' is the label of the export date-range start field.

translation: To must be greater than From.
description: Validation error when a system admin creates a compliance export job with an end date before the start date; 'To' and 'From' are the date-range field labels.

translation: Invalid access control attribute refresh interval. Must be greater than or equal to 0.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the access control attribute refresh interval setting is negative. Blocks saving the configuration.

translation: Invalid access control sync job interval. Must be at least 60 seconds.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the access control sync job interval setting is below the 60 second minimum. Blocks saving the configuration.

translation: Invalid AI recap cooldown minutes. Must be greater than or equal to 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the cooldown between recaps, in minutes, must be zero or more.

translation: Invalid AI recap max channels per recap. Must be greater than or equal to 1, or -1 for unlimited.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the limit on channels included in a single recap must be at least 1 or -1 for unlimited.

translation: Invalid AI recap max posts per day. Must be greater than or equal to 1, or -1 for unlimited.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the daily limit on posts processed must be at least 1 or -1 for unlimited.

translation: Invalid AI recap max posts per recap. Must be greater than or equal to 1, or -1 for unlimited.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the limit on posts summarized in one recap must be at least 1 or -1 for unlimited.

translation: Invalid AI recap max recaps per day. Must be greater than or equal to 1, or -1 for unlimited.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the daily limit on recaps per user must be at least 1 or -1 for unlimited.

translation: Invalid AI recap max scheduled recaps. Must be greater than or equal to 1, or -1 for unlimited.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the limit on scheduled recaps must be at least 1 or -1 for unlimited.

translation: Invalid AI recap max tokens per recap. Must be greater than or equal to 1, or -1 for unlimited.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving AI Recap settings; the LLM token budget per recap must be at least 1 or -1 for unlimited.

translation: Allowing cookies for subdomains requires SiteURL to be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'SiteURL' is the config setting name and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid timeout value {{.Value}}. Should be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Amazon S3 file storage request timeout setting; {{.Value}} is the rejected timeout value.

translation: The 'atmos/camo' image proxy type was removed in Mattermost v12.0. Set ImageProxySettings.ImageProxyType to 'local', or set ImageProxySettings.Enable to false to disable the image proxy.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin (and logged at startup) when the config still selects the removed 'atmos/camo' image proxy. The setting names, the value 'local', and 'false' are literal identifiers and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid autotranslation agents configuration: AI service must not be empty.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving automatic translation settings when the Agents provider is selected but no AI service is chosen.

translation: LibreTranslate URL must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins saving automatic translation settings; 'LibreTranslate' is a product name and 'http://'/'https://' are literal scheme prefixes.

translation: Invalid autotranslation provider, must not be empty.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when automatic translation is enabled but no translation provider is configured.

translation: Unsupported autotranslation provider.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the configured automatic translation provider is not one of the supported backends.

translation: Invalid timeout for autotranslation settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the automatic translation request timeout setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Workers must be between 1 and 64.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the automatic translation worker-pool size setting; 'Workers' means concurrent worker processes.

translation: Invalid Azure authentication mode {{.Value}}. Must be 'shared_key' or 'default_credential'.
