description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Azure Blob file storage; {{.Value}} is the rejected setting value and 'shared_key'/'default_credential' are literal option values.

translation: Invalid value {{.Value}} for {{.Setting}}. Must be 'commercial', 'government', or 'custom'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Azure cloud environment setting; {{.Value}} is the rejected value, {{.Setting}} is the setting name, and 'commercial'/'government'/'custom' are literal option values.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be set when the corresponding AzureCloud value is 'custom'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Azure Blob storage; {{.Setting}} is the name of the custom endpoint setting that must be filled in, and 'custom' is a literal option value.

translation: Invalid value {{.Value}} for {{.Setting}}. The Azure storage account name must be 3 to 24 characters long and contain only lowercase letters and numbers.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Azure Blob storage; {{.Value}} is the rejected account name and {{.Setting}} is the setting name.

translation: Invalid timeout value {{.Value}}. Should be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Azure Blob storage request timeout setting; {{.Value}} is the rejected timeout value.

translation: Cache type must be either lru or redis.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'lru' and 'redis' are literal cache type option values and must not be translated.

translation: Unable to enable email batching when clustering is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; email batching (grouping notification emails) cannot be combined with high-availability clustering.

translation: ClusterSettings.GossipPort must be a valid port number.
description: Configuration validation error shown when saving the System Console or starting the server with an invalid cluster gossip port. 'ClusterSettings.GossipPort' is a config setting name; keep it in English.

translation: CollapsedThreads setting must be either disabled, default_on or default_off.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'CollapsedThreads' is the config setting name and 'disabled'/'default_on'/'default_off' are literal option values.

translation: ThreadAutoFollow must be true to enable CollapsedThreads
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'ThreadAutoFollow' and 'CollapsedThreads' are config setting names and must not be translated.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error for a Connected Workspaces (shared channels) sync size setting. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. ConnectedWorkspacesSettings.MaxPostsPerSync; it is not translated.

translation: Common reviewers or additional reviewers must be set when "Same reviewers for all teams" is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring content flagging; 'Same reviewers for all teams' is the display name of a toggle in that settings page.

translation: Reasons for flagging cannot be empty.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring content flagging when the list of selectable flagging reasons is empty.

translation: Team reviewers or additional reviewers must be set when setting "Enabled" for a team.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring per-team content flagging reviewers; 'Enabled' refers to the per-team toggle label.

translation: Data retention job start time must be a 24-hour time stamp in the form HH:MM.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the data retention deletion job's daily start time; 'HH:MM' is a literal 24-hour time format.

translation: File retention days and file retention hours cannot both be 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention; file retention must be specified in either days or hours, not neither.

translation: File retention days cannot be less than 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention when the file retention period in days is negative.

translation: File retention hours cannot be less than 0
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention when the file retention period in hours is negative.

translation: File retention days and file retention hours cannot both be greater than 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention; file retention days and hours are mutually exclusive settings.

translation: Message retention days and message retention hours cannot both be 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention; message retention must be specified in either days or hours, not neither.

translation: Message retention days cannot be less than 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention when the message retention period in days is negative.

translation: Message retention hours cannot be less than 0
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention when the message retention period in hours is negative.

translation: Message retention days and message retention hours cannot both be greater than 0.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring data retention; message retention days and hours are mutually exclusive settings.

translation: DCR redirect URI allowlist contains an invalid pattern. Each pattern must be a valid URI with a scheme and host (for example https://example.com/** or cursor://app/callback) and cannot be empty or whitespace.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'DCR' means OAuth Dynamic Client Registration, and 'http://'/'https://' are literal scheme prefixes.

translation: Invalid Local Storage Directory. Must be a non-empty string.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the local file storage directory setting is empty; 'Local Storage Directory' is the setting's display name.

translation: Path traversal sequences ("..") are not allowed in {{.Setting}}. Found "{{.Value}}".
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when a directory path setting contains '..'; {{.Setting}} is the setting name and {{.Value}} is the rejected path.

translation: Leading or trailing whitespace detected for {{.Setting}}. Found "{{.Value}}".
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when a directory path setting has leading or trailing spaces; {{.Setting}} is the setting name and {{.Value}} is the rejected path.

translation: The custom URL scheme {{.Scheme}} is invalid. Custom URL schemes must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, plus (+), period (.) and hyphen (-).
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the custom URL schemes display setting; {{.Scheme}} is the rejected scheme string.

translation: Search AggregatePostsAfterDays setting must be a number greater than or equal to 1.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch; 'AggregatePostsAfterDays' is the config setting name.

translation: Search Bulk Indexing Batch Size must be at least {{.BatchSize}}.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch bulk indexing batch size setting; {{.BatchSize}} is the minimum allowed value.

translation: Search ConnectionUrl setting must be provided when indexing is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'ConnectionUrl' is the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch config setting name and must not be translated.

translation: IndexPrefix cannot be empty if GlobalSearchPrefix is set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch; 'IndexPrefix' and 'GlobalSearchPrefix' are config setting names.

translation: {{.EnableIndexing}} setting must be set to true when {{.Autocomplete}} is set to true
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch; {{.EnableIndexing}} and {{.Autocomplete}} are the names of the two config settings involved.

translation: {{.Searching}} setting must be set to true when {{.EnableCJKAnalyzers}} is set to true
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch; {{.Searching}} and {{.EnableCJKAnalyzers}} are config setting names; CJK means Chinese/Japanese/Korean text analyzers.

translation: {{.EnableIndexing}} setting must be set to true when {{.Searching}} is set to true
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch; {{.EnableIndexing}} and {{.Searching}} are the names of the two config settings involved.

translation: Ignored indexes for purge should not start with dash.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch 'ignored indexes for purge' setting; index names must not begin with a dash character.

translation: GlobalSearchPrefix {{.GlobalSearchPrefix}} should be a prefix of IndexPrefix {{.IndexPrefix}}.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch; {{.GlobalSearchPrefix}} and {{.IndexPrefix}} are the current values of those two settings.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be greater than or equal to 0.
description: Configuration validation error for an Elasticsearch index replica count. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. ElasticsearchSettings.PostIndexReplicas; it is not translated.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be greater than or equal to 1.
description: Configuration validation error for an Elasticsearch index shard count. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. ElasticsearchSettings.PostIndexShards; it is not translated.

translation: Invalid search backend. Must be either elasticsearch or opensearch.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'elasticsearch' and 'opensearch' are literal backend option values and must not be translated.

translation: Search Live Indexing Batch Size must be at least 1.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch live indexing batch size setting; must be at least 1.

translation: Search PostsAggregatorJobStartTime setting must be a time in the format "hh:mm".
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'PostsAggregatorJobStartTime' is the config setting name and 'hh:mm' is a literal time format.

translation: Search Request Timeout must be at least 1 second.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch request timeout setting; must be at least 1 second.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be a valid email address.
description: Configuration validation error when an email address setting is invalid. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. SupportSettings.SupportEmail or EmailSettings.FeedbackEmail; it is not translated.

translation: Invalid email batching buffer size for email settings. Must be zero or a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the email batching buffer size setting (how many notifications can be queued before sending a batched email).

translation: Invalid email batching interval for email settings. Must be 30 seconds or more.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the email batching interval setting; batched notification emails cannot be sent more often than every 30 seconds.

translation: Invalid email notification contents type for email settings. Must be one of either 'full' or 'generic'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'full' and 'generic' are literal option values for how much content notification emails include.

translation: Invalid push notification buffer size for email settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error shown when saving the System Console or starting the server with a zero or negative value for EmailSettings.PushNotificationBuffer.

translation: Invalid connection security for email settings. Must be '', 'TLS', or 'STARTTLS'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SMTP connection security setting; '', 'TLS', and 'STARTTLS' are literal option values.

translation: RedisAddress must be specified for redis cache type.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'RedisAddress' is the config setting name and 'redis' is a literal cache type value.

translation: When audit file logging is enabled, a file name must be specified.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling experimental audit logging to a file without specifying a file name.

translation: The file name must not be a directory.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the experimental audit log file name setting points to a directory instead of a file.

translation: Value for Directory should not be empty.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the export settings; 'Directory' is the export destination directory setting name.

translation: Invalid value for RetentionDays. Value should be greater than 0
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for export settings; 'RetentionDays' is the setting controlling how long exported files are kept.

translation: Invalid Azure authentication mode {{.Value}} for the dedicated export store. Must be 'shared_key' or 'default_credential'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the dedicated compliance-export Azure storage; {{.Value}} is the rejected value and 'shared_key'/'default_credential' are literal option values.

translation: Invalid timeout value {{.Value}}. Should be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the dedicated compliance-export Azure storage request timeout; {{.Value}} is the rejected timeout value.

translation: Invalid export driver name for file settings. Must be 'local', 'amazons3', or 'azureblob'.
description: Configuration validation error for the storage type used for export files (FileSettings.ExportDriverName). 'local', 'amazons3' and 'azureblob' are literal config values; keep them in English.

translation: Invalid content extraction timeout for file settings. Must be a whole number of seconds greater than or equal to zero.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the document content extraction (file search indexing) timeout setting, in whole seconds.

translation: The AppsEnabled feature flag is no longer supported and must be disabled.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the retired AppsEnabled feature flag is still switched on. "AppsEnabled" is a literal flag name and must stay in English.

translation: The MoveThreadsEnabled feature flag is no longer supported and must be disabled.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the retired MoveThreadsEnabled feature flag is still switched on. "MoveThreadsEnabled" is a literal flag name and must stay in English.

translation: Invalid driver name for file settings. Must be 'local', 'amazons3', or 'azureblob'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'local', 'amazons3', and 'azureblob' are literal file storage driver option values and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid public link salt for file settings. Must be 32 chars or more.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; the public link salt is the random string used to sign public file links and must be at least 32 characters.

translation: Invalid group unread channels for service settings. Must be 'disabled', 'default_on', or 'default_off'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the 'group unread channels' sidebar setting; 'disabled'/'default_on'/'default_off' are literal option values.

translation: You cannot enforce multifactor authentication for guest accounts when magic link authentication is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring guest accounts; MFA enforcement conflicts with magic-link (emailed sign-in link) authentication for guests.

translation: Invalid decoder concurrency {{.Value}}. Should be a positive number or -1.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the image decoder concurrency setting; {{.Value}} is the rejected value and -1 means automatic.

translation: Invalid image proxy type. Must be 'local'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'local' and 'atmos/camo' are literal image proxy type option values and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid value for Directory.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the import settings; 'Directory' is the import working directory setting name.

translation: Invalid value for RetentionDays. Value is too low.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for import settings; 'RetentionDays' is the setting controlling how long imported files are kept.

translation: Intune MAM Auth Service is required when Intune is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune mobile app management (MAM); the linked authentication service setting is required.

translation: Intune MAM Auth Service must be either 'office365' or 'saml'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM; 'office365' and 'saml' are literal auth service option values and must not be translated.

translation: Intune MAM Client ID is required when Intune is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM; the Entra/Azure application client ID setting is required.

translation: Intune MAM Client ID must be a valid UUID.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM when the client ID is not in UUID format.

translation: Intune MAM requires OpenID Connect (Office 365) to be enabled when Auth Service is set to 'office365'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM; 'office365' is a literal option value and 'OpenID Connect (Office 365)' names the required sign-in method.

translation: Intune MAM requires SAML to be enabled when Auth Service is set to 'saml'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM; 'saml' is a literal option value and SAML sign-in must be enabled.

translation: Intune MAM Tenant ID is required when Intune is enabled.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM; the Entra/Azure tenant ID setting is required.

translation: Intune MAM Tenant ID must be a valid UUID.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring Microsoft Intune MAM when the tenant ID is not in UUID format.

translation: Redis cache prefix must not contain ':', '*', '?', '[', ']' or '\'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'Redis cache prefix' is the setting that namespaces this server's keys and cluster messages in a Redis instance shared with other servers.

translation: Redis DB must have a value greater or equal to zero.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'Redis DB' is the numeric Redis database index setting.

translation: AD/LDAP field "BaseDN" is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling AD/LDAP; 'BaseDN' is the LDAP setting's field name and should stay in quotes untranslated.

translation: AD/LDAP field "Email Attribute" is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling AD/LDAP; 'Email Attribute' is the display name of the required LDAP setting.

translation: AD/LDAP field "ID Attribute" is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling AD/LDAP; 'ID Attribute' is the display name of the required LDAP setting.

translation: AD/LDAP field "Login ID Attribute" is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling AD/LDAP; 'Login ID Attribute' is the display name of the required LDAP setting.

translation: Invalid maximum login attempts for ldap settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the AD/LDAP maximum login attempts setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid max page size value.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the AD/LDAP maximum page size setting (results returned per LDAP query page).

translation: Invalid connection security for AD/LDAP settings. Must be '', 'TLS', or 'STARTTLS'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the AD/LDAP connection security setting; '', 'TLS', and 'STARTTLS' are literal option values.

translation: AD/LDAP field "AD/LDAP Server" is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling AD/LDAP; 'AD/LDAP Server' is the display name of the required server address setting.

translation: Invalid sync interval time. Must be at least one minute.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the AD/LDAP synchronization interval setting; must be at least one minute.

translation: AD/LDAP field "Username Attribute" is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling AD/LDAP; 'Username Attribute' is the display name of the required LDAP setting.

translation: Invalid value for link metadata timeout. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the link preview metadata fetch timeout setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid listen address for service settings. Must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the server's network listen address setting is empty.

translation: Unable to locate local socket file directory.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins enabling local mode (mmctl local socket) when the socket file's directory cannot be found.

translation: Available Languages must contain Default Client Language.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'Available Languages' and 'Default Client Language' are the display names of two localization settings.

translation: Invalid lock profile fields setting. Must be 'none', 'name_and_username' or 'all'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'none', 'name_and_username', and 'all' are literal option values for which profile fields users cannot edit.

translation: Failed to parse JSON: {{.Error}}
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the advanced logging configuration is not valid JSON; {{.Error}} is the technical parse error message.

translation: Invalid format: {{.Error}}
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the advanced logging configuration parses as JSON but has an invalid structure; {{.Error}} is the technical error message.

translation: Invalid log level {{.Value}} for {{.Setting}}.
description: Configuration validation error for an unknown log level. {{.Value}} is the value entered; {{.Setting}} is the config setting name (LogSettings.ConsoleLevel or LogSettings.FileLevel); neither is translated.

translation: Invalid maximum login attempts for service settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the maximum failed login attempts setting (before account lockout); must be a positive number.

translation: Maximum burst size must be greater than zero.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the API rate limiting maximum burst size setting.

translation: Invalid maximum channels per team for team settings. Must be 0 (unlimited) or a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the maximum channels per team setting; must be 0, meaning no limit, or a positive number.

translation: Invalid max file size for file settings. Must be a whole number greater than zero.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the maximum file upload size setting; must be a whole number greater than zero.

translation: Invalid maximum notifications per channel for team settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the setting limiting how many users an @channel/@all mention can notify.

translation: Invalid max payload size for service settings. Must be a whole number greater than zero.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the maximum API request payload size setting.

translation: Invalid MaximumPersonalAccessTokenLifetimeDays. Must be between 0 (unlimited) and {{.Max}} days.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'MaximumPersonalAccessTokenLifetimeDays' is the config setting name and {{.Max}} is the upper limit in days.

translation: Invalid max URL length for service settings. Must be a whole number greater than zero.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the maximum request URL length setting.

translation: Invalid maximum users per team for team settings. Must be 0 (unlimited) or a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the maximum users per team setting; must be 0, meaning no limit, or a positive number.

translation: Message export job BatchSize must be a positive integer.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring compliance message export; 'BatchSize' is the config setting name.

translation: Message export job DailyRuntime must be a 24-hour time stamp in the form HH:MM.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring compliance message export; 'DailyRuntime' is the setting for the job's daily start time and 'HH:MM' is a literal 24-hour format.

translation: Message export job EnableExport setting must be either true or false.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring compliance message export; 'EnableExport' is the config setting name and 'true'/'false' are literal values.

translation: Message export job ExportFromTimestamp must be a timestamp (expressed in seconds since unix epoch). Only messages sent after this timestamp will be exported.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring compliance message export; 'ExportFromTimestamp' is the config setting name for the earliest message time to export.

translation: Message export job ExportFormat must be one of 'actiance', 'csv' or 'globalrelay'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'ExportFormat' is the setting name and 'actiance'/'csv'/'globalrelay' are literal export format values.

translation: Message export job ExportFormat is set to 'globalrelay', but GlobalRelaySettings are missing.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'globalrelay' is a literal export format value and 'GlobalRelaySettings' is the missing config section name.

translation: Message export GlobalRelaySettings.CustomHeaderName and CustomHeaderValue must both be set, or both left empty.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin configuring Global Relay message export: only one of the custom header name/value pair was provided. The setting names are literal config keys and must stay in English.

translation: Message export GlobalRelaySettings.CustomHeaderName must be a valid header name with no spaces, colons, separators, or line breaks.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the Global Relay export custom header name contains characters that are illegal in an HTTP header name. The setting name is a literal config key and must stay in English.

translation: Message export GlobalRelaySettings.CustomHeaderName must not reuse a header that the Global Relay export already writes.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the configured Global Relay custom header name collides with a header the export already sets itself. The setting name is a literal config key and must stay in English.

translation: Message export GlobalRelaySettings.CustomHeaderValue must not contain control characters or line breaks.
description: Configuration validation error shown to a system admin when the Global Relay export custom header value contains control characters or newlines. The setting name is a literal config key and must stay in English.

translation: Message export job GlobalRelaySettings.CustomSMTPPort must be a valid port number.
description: Configuration validation error for compliance message export to Global Relay with a custom SMTP server. 'Global Relay' is a vendor name and 'GlobalRelaySettings.CustomSMTPPort' a config setting name; keep both in English.

translation: Message export GlobalRelaySettings.CustomerType must be set to one of either 'A9', 'A10' or 'CUSTOM'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'GlobalRelaySettings.CustomerType' is a config setting path and 'A9'/'A10'/'CUSTOM' are literal option values.

translation: If GlobalRelaySettings.CustomerType is 'CUSTOM', then GlobalRelaySettings.CustomSMTPServerName and GlobalRelaySettings.CustomSMTPPort must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; the quoted names are config setting paths for Global Relay message export and must not be translated.

translation: Message export job GlobalRelaySettings.EmailAddress must be set to a valid email address.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'GlobalRelaySettings.EmailAddress' is the config setting path for the Global Relay delivery address.

translation: Message export GlobalRelaySettings.SenderAddress must be empty or a valid email address.
description: Configuration validation error for compliance message export to Global Relay when the sender address is not a valid email. 'GlobalRelaySettings.SenderAddress' is a config setting name; keep it in English.

translation: Message export job GlobalRelaySettings.SmtpPassword must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'GlobalRelaySettings.SmtpPassword' is a config setting path and must not be translated.

translation: Message export job GlobalRelaySettings.SmtpUsername must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'GlobalRelaySettings.SmtpUsername' is a config setting path and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid client side user id: {{.Id}}
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring client-side performance metrics; {{.Id}} is the malformed user ID entry.

translation: Number of elements in ClientSideUserIds {{.CurrentLength}} is higher than maximum limit of {{.MaxLength}}.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'ClientSideUserIds' is the config setting name, {{.CurrentLength}} is the current list size, and {{.MaxLength}} is the allowed maximum.

translation: Invalid version number. Must be a valid semantic version (e.g. 5.0.0).
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the minimum required desktop app version setting; '5.0.0' is a literal semantic-version example.

translation: Invalid Auto Cache Cleanup value. Must be between {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} days.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring mobile ephemeral mode; {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} are the allowed range bounds for the auto cache cleanup setting, in days.

translation: Invalid Disconnection Timeout value. Must be between {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} seconds.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring mobile ephemeral mode; {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} are the allowed range bounds for the disconnection timeout, in seconds.

translation: Invalid Offline Persistence Timer value. Must be between {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} hours.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring mobile ephemeral mode; {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} are the allowed range bounds for the offline persistence timer, in hours.

translation: Invalid domain for move thread settings
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the 'move thread' feature settings when an entry in the allowed domains list is not a valid domain.

translation: One or more app download links are not valid URLs.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when one of the mobile/desktop app download link settings is not a valid URL.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be a non-negative number.
description: Configuration validation error shown when saving the System Console or starting the server with a negative value. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. LogSettings.MaxFieldSize; it is not translated.

translation: Invalid flagging event specified.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring content flagging notifications when an event name (e.g. post flagged/removed) is not recognized.

translation: Invalid flagging event target specified.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring content flagging notifications when a notification target (e.g. reviewers, author) is not recognized.

translation: Notifications for new flagged post cannot be disabled for reviewers.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring content flagging; reviewers must always be notified of newly flagged posts, so that notification cannot be turned off.

translation: Invalid Outgoing Integrations Request Timeout for service settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the timeout applied to outgoing integration (webhook/slash command) HTTP requests; must be a positive number.

translation: Minimum password length must be a whole number greater than or equal to {{.MinLength}} and less than or equal to {{.MaxLength}}.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the minimum password length setting; {{.MinLength}} and {{.MaxLength}} are the allowed bounds for that setting's value.

translation: Invalid total number of persistent notifications per post. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the setting limiting how many times a persistent (repeating priority) notification is re-sent per post.

translation: Invalid frequency of persistent notifications. Must be at least two minutes.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the interval between repeated persistent notifications; must be at least two minutes.

translation: Invalid maximum number of recipients for persistent notifications. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the setting limiting how many recipients a persistent notification post can have.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be a valid port.
description: Configuration validation error for a port number outside the valid range. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. EmailSettings.SMTPPort or LdapSettings.LdapPort; it is not translated.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error for a setting that must be greater than zero. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name, e.g. ServiceSettings.IdleTimeout; it is not translated.

translation: Invalid memory store size for rate limit settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the rate limiting in-memory store size setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid per sec for rate limit settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the rate limiting queries-per-second setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid value for read timeout.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the web server read timeout setting.

translation: RedisTLSClientCert and RedisTLSClientKey must be set together.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'RedisTLSClientCert' and 'RedisTLSClientKey' are config setting names and should not be translated.

translation: Invalid report a problem link. Must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the 'Report a Problem' link setting (URL users are sent to for support); 'http://'/'https://' are literal scheme prefixes.

translation: Report a problem link is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the 'Report a Problem' type requires a link but the URL setting is empty.

translation: Invalid report a problem mail. Must be a valid email address.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the 'Report a Problem' email address setting; 'mail' here means the support email address.

translation: Report a problem mail is required.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the 'Report a Problem' type requires an email address but the setting is empty.

translation: Invalid direct message restriction. Must be 'any', or 'team'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the setting controlling who users can direct-message; 'any' and 'team' are literal option values.

translation: {{.Setting}} must be at least {{.Min}} bytes.
description: Configuration validation error when the Amazon S3 multipart upload chunk size is too small. {{.Setting}} is the config setting name (e.g. FileSettings.AmazonS3UploadPartSizeBytes), not translated; {{.Min}} is the minimum size in bytes.

translation: Invalid Admin attribute. Must be in the form 'field=value'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; the Admin attribute maps a SAML assertion field to admin status, in literal 'field=value' form.

translation: Service Provider Login URL must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; 'Service Provider Login URL' is the setting's display name and 'http://'/'https://' are literal prefixes.

translation: Invalid Canonical Algorithm.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML when the XML canonicalization algorithm setting has an unrecognized value.

translation: Invalid Email attribute. Must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; the Email attribute setting maps a SAML assertion field to the user's email and is required.

translation: Invalid Guest attribute. Must be in the form 'field=value'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; the Guest attribute maps a SAML assertion field to guest status, in literal 'field=value' form.

translation: Identity Provider Public Certificate missing. Did you forget to upload it?
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML when the Identity Provider public certificate has not been uploaded; phrased as a helpful question.

translation: Identity Provider Issuer URL cannot be an empty string.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; 'Identity Provider Issuer URL' is the setting's display name.

translation: SAML SSO URL must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; 'SAML SSO URL' is the setting's display name and 'http://'/'https://' are literal prefixes.

translation: Service Provider Private Key missing. Did you forget to upload it?
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML when the Service Provider private key has not been uploaded; phrased as a helpful question.

translation: Service Provider Public Certificate missing. Did you forget to upload it?
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML when the Service Provider public certificate has not been uploaded; phrased as a helpful question.

translation: Invalid Signature Algorithm.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML when the signature algorithm setting has an unrecognized value.

translation: Service Provider Identifier is required
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; 'Service Provider Identifier' is the display name of the required entity ID setting.

translation: Invalid Username attribute. Must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring SAML; the Username attribute setting maps a SAML assertion field to the username and is required.

translation: BurnOnReadDurationSeconds must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error for the burn-on-read (self-deleting messages) duration. 'BurnOnReadDurationSeconds' is a config setting name; keep it in English.

translation: BurnOnReadMaximumTimeToLiveSeconds must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error for the maximum lifetime of burn-on-read (self-deleting) messages. 'BurnOnReadMaximumTimeToLiveSeconds' is a config setting name; keep it in English.

translation: BurnOnReadSchedulerFrequencySeconds must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error for how often the server deletes expired burn-on-read messages. 'BurnOnReadSchedulerFrequencySeconds' is a config setting name; keep it in English.

translation: FeatureFlagSyncIntervalSeconds must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error for how often feature flags are refreshed. 'FeatureFlagSyncIntervalSeconds' is a config setting name; keep it in English.

translation: RefreshPostStatsRunTime must be a time in the format "hh:mm".
description: Configuration validation error for the daily time the post statistics job runs. 'RefreshPostStatsRunTime' is a config setting name and "hh:mm" is the literal 24-hour time format; keep both as-is.

translation: Site URL must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: Config validation error for admins; 'Site URL' is a System Console setting name, and 'http://' / 'https://' are literal URL schemes.

translation: Unable to enable email batching when SiteURL isn't set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; email batching requires the SiteURL setting, and 'SiteURL' must not be translated.

translation: Site name must be less than or equal to {{.MaxLength}} characters.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Site Name setting; {{.MaxLength}} is the maximum number of characters allowed.

translation: Invalid analytics query timeout for SQL settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SQL analytics (statistics) query timeout setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid connection maximum idle time for SQL settings. Must be a non-negative number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SQL connection maximum idle time setting, in milliseconds; must be non-negative.

translation: Invalid connection maximum lifetime for SQL settings. Must be a non-negative number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SQL connection maximum lifetime setting, in milliseconds; must be non-negative.

translation: Invalid data source for SQL settings. Must be set.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the SQL database connection string (data source) setting is empty.

translation: Invalid driver name for SQL settings. Must be 'postgres'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'postgres' is the literal SQL driver name and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid maximum idle connection for SQL settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SQL maximum idle connections setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid maximum open connection for SQL settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SQL maximum open connections setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid migrations statement timeout for SQL settings. Must be a non-negative number.
description: Configuration validation error shown when saving the System Console or starting the server with a negative SqlSettings.MigrationsStatementTimeoutSeconds (database migration timeout).

translation: Invalid query timeout for SQL settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the SQL query timeout setting; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid replica monitor interval for SQL settings. Must be a positive number.
description: Configuration validation error shown when saving the System Console or starting the server with a zero or negative SqlSettings.ReplicaMonitorIntervalSeconds (database replica health check interval).

translation: Additional scopes must be OAuth scope names separated by spaces, at most {{.MaxLength}} characters in total.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when the OpenID Connect 'Additional scopes' setting holds characters a scope name can't contain or is too long; {{.MaxLength}} is the character limit.

translation: Invalid storage class {{.Value}}.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the Amazon S3 storage class setting; {{.Value}} is the rejected storage class value.

translation: Invalid teammate display. Must be 'full_name', 'nickname_full_name' or 'username'.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins; 'full_name', 'nickname_full_name', and 'username' are literal option values for how teammate names are displayed.

translation: Time between user typing updates should not be set to less than 1000 milliseconds.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the minimum interval between 'user is typing' websocket updates, in milliseconds.

translation: Invalid value for TLS certificate file - Either use LetsEncrypt or set path to existing certificate file.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring TLS; 'LetsEncrypt' is a product name, and the certificate file path must point to an existing file.

translation: Invalid value for TLS key file - Either use LetsEncrypt or set path to existing key file.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins configuring TLS; 'LetsEncrypt' is a product name, and the key file path must point to an existing file.

translation: Invalid TLS minimum version {{.Value}}. Must be '1.0', '1.1', '1.2', or '1.3'.
description: Configuration validation error for the minimum TLS version (ServiceSettings.TLSMinVer). {{.Value}} is the value entered; '1.0' to '1.3' are literal config values.

translation: Invalid value passed for TLS overwrite cipher - Please refer to the documentation for valid values.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins when a value in the TLS cipher override list is not a supported cipher name; points to documentation.

translation: Invalid value for user status away timeout. Must be a positive number.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the inactivity timeout after which users are shown as Away; must be a positive number.

translation: Invalid webserver mode {{.Value}}. Must be 'gzip', 'uncompressed', or 'disabled'.
description: Configuration validation error for the web server compression mode (ServiceSettings.WebserverMode). {{.Value}} is the value entered; 'gzip', 'uncompressed' and 'disabled' are literal config values; keep them in English.

translation: Invalid value for webserver connection security.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the web server connection security setting (e.g. TLS mode).

translation: Websocket URL must be a valid URL and start with ws:// or wss://.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the WebSocket URL setting; 'ws://' and 'wss://' are literal URL scheme prefixes.

translation: Invalid value for write timeout.
description: Config validation error shown to system admins for the web server write timeout setting.

translation: Invalid CPA field name '{{.Name}}': must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (CEL identifier rule).
description: Validation error for a Custom Profile Attributes field used in access control rules; {{.Name}} is the rejected field name and the regex/CEL reference is literal technical text.

translation: Invalid CPA field name '{{.Name}}': this is a CEL reserved word and cannot be used as a field identifier.
description: Validation error for a Custom Profile Attributes field; {{.Name}} is the rejected field name, which collides with a reserved word of the CEL expression language.

translation: Client name must be 64 characters or less.
description: API error for OAuth Dynamic Client Registration when the submitted client name exceeds 64 characters; audience is app developers.

translation: Invalid client URI format.
description: API error for OAuth Dynamic Client Registration when the client_uri field is not a valid http(s) URL.

translation: Client URI must be less than 256 characters.
description: API error for OAuth Dynamic Client Registration when the client_uri field is too long.

translation: Invalid redirect URI format.
description: API error for OAuth Dynamic Client Registration when one of the submitted redirect URIs is not a valid http(s) URL.

translation: At least one redirect URI is required.
description: API error for OAuth Dynamic Client Registration when the request contains no redirect URIs.

translation: Unsupported token_endpoint_auth_method supplied.
description: API error for OAuth Dynamic Client Registration; 'token_endpoint_auth_method' is a literal OAuth protocol field name and must not be translated.

translation: Select at least one channel to record deliveries in.
description: Validation error when post delivery audit logging is enabled for specific channels but none were selected.

translation: Invalid channel ID provided in the post delivery audit logging settings.
description: Validation error when the post delivery audit logging settings contain a malformed channel id.

translation: The post delivery audit logging settings are incomplete.
description: Validation error when the post delivery audit logging settings are saved without stating whether the feature is on.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft whose channel ID is malformed; a draft is an unsent message saved by the server.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid file ids.
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft whose attached file ID list is invalid.

translation: Draft Message property is longer than the maximum permitted length.
description: API validation error when a synced message draft's text exceeds the maximum post length; 'Message' is the draft's text field.

translation: Invalid priority
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft with invalid message priority metadata (priority/acknowledgement settings).

translation: Invalid props.
description: API validation error when a synced message draft's props (arbitrary metadata payload) is invalid or too large; 'props' is a technical field name.

translation: Invalid root id.
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft whose root post ID (the thread it replies to) is malformed.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error when syncing a message draft whose author user ID is malformed.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a custom emoji whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid emoji id.
description: API validation error when saving a custom emoji whose ID field is malformed.

translation: Name must be 1 to 64 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
description: API validation error shown to users creating a custom emoji whose name violates the 1-64 lowercase alphanumeric character rule.

translation: Name conflicts with existing system emoji name.
description: Validation error shown when creating a custom emoji whose name matches a built-in system emoji name.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving a custom emoji whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid creator id.
description: API validation error when saving a custom emoji; the ID of the user who created the emoji is malformed.

translation: Invalid value for create_at.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'create_at' is the literal field name for the creation timestamp.

translation: Invalid value for id.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'id' is the literal field name.

translation: Invalid value for name.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'name' is the literal field name for the file name.

translation: Invalid value for path.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'path' is the literal field name for the file's storage path.

translation: Invalid value for post_id.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'post_id' is the literal field name for the post the file is attached to.

translation: Invalid value for update_at.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'update_at' is the literal field name for the last-update timestamp.

translation: Invalid value for user_id.
description: API validation error for an uploaded file's metadata record; 'user_id' is the literal field name for the uploader.

translation: invalid create at property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group (LDAP or custom) whose creation timestamp property is unset; lowercase style matches sibling group errors.

translation: invalid description property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group whose description exceeds the allowed length.

translation: invalid display name property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group whose display name is empty or too long.

translation: invalid name property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group whose name (unique @mention handle) is missing or invalid; distinct from the group's display name.

translation: invalid characters in the name property for group
description: API validation error when a user group's mention name contains disallowed characters.

translation: Name must be 1 to 64 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
description: API validation error when a user group's mention name violates the 1-64 lowercase alphanumeric character rule.

translation: group name already exists as a reserved name
description: API validation error when a user group's mention name collides with a reserved system name (e.g. channel, all, here).

translation: invalid remote id property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group; the remote ID links an LDAP-synced group to its directory entry and is required for that source.

translation: invalid source property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group whose source (e.g. ldap, custom) is not a recognized value.

translation: invalid update at property for group.
description: API validation error when saving a user group whose last-update timestamp property is unset.

translation: invalid group id property for group member.
description: API validation error when adding or removing a group member; the group's ID is malformed.

translation: invalid user id property for group member.
description: API validation error when adding or removing a group member; the user's ID is malformed.

translation: invalid group id property for group syncable.
description: API validation error when linking a group to a team or channel (group syncable); the group ID is malformed.

translation: invalid syncable id for group syncable.
description: API validation error when linking a group to a team or channel; 'syncable' is the linked team or channel and its ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid channel.
description: API validation error when inviting guests; one of the channel IDs the guests would be added to is malformed.

translation: Invalid channels.
description: API validation error when inviting guests without selecting any channels to add them to.

translation: Invalid email.
description: API validation error when inviting guests; one of the entered email addresses is empty, too long, or not a valid email.

translation: Invalid emails.
description: API validation error when submitting a guest invitation with no email addresses entered.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose target channel ID is malformed; shown in the integrations UI.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid description.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose description exceeds the allowed length.

translation: Invalid title.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose title (display name) is empty or too long; 'title' is the webhook's name in the integrations UI.

translation: Invalid post icon.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose post icon URL is too long; 'post icon' is the avatar image used for webhook posts.

translation: Invalid Id: {{.Id}}.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook; {{.Id}} is the malformed webhook ID.

translation: Unable to parse incoming data.
description: Error returned to an external service posting to an incoming webhook when the request payload cannot be parsed; developer/integrator-facing.

translation: Invalid team ID.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose team ID is malformed.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose last-update timestamp field (UpdateAt) is unset.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook; the ID of the user who created it is malformed.

translation: Invalid username.
description: API validation error when saving an incoming webhook whose override username (the name webhook posts appear under) is invalid.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: Validation error for a background job record (e.g. data retention, export) whose creation timestamp field (CreateAt) is unset; seen by system admins via the Jobs API.

translation: Invalid job Id.
description: Validation error for a background job record whose job ID is malformed; seen by system admins via the Jobs API.

translation: Invalid job status.
description: Validation error for a background job record whose status (pending, in progress, success, etc.) is not a recognized value.

translation: Invalid job type.
description: Validation error returned when a background job is created or queried with an unrecognized job type.

translation: Invalid value for bytes when uploading a license.
description: Validation error when storing an uploaded Enterprise license whose raw content ('bytes') is empty or too large; shown to system admins.

translation: Invalid value for create_at when uploading a license.
description: Validation error when storing an uploaded Enterprise license record; 'create_at' is the literal creation timestamp field name.

translation: Invalid value for id when uploading a license.
description: Validation error when storing an uploaded Enterprise license record; 'id' is the literal license record ID field name.

translation: Link metadata data cannot be nil.
description: Server-side validation error for a cached link preview metadata record whose data payload is nil; mostly developer/log-facing.

translation: Link metadata data does not match the given type.
description: Server-side validation error for a cached link preview metadata record whose data payload does not match its declared type (image, opengraph, etc.).

translation: Link metadata timestamp must be nonzero and rounded to the nearest hour.
description: Server-side validation error for a cached link preview metadata record; timestamps are bucketed to the hour for caching, hence 'rounded to the nearest hour'.

translation: Invalid link metadata type.
description: API error returned when saving link preview metadata whose Type field is not one of the supported metadata types (image, opengraph, none).

translation: Link metadata URL must be set.
description: API error returned when saving link preview metadata with an empty URL field.

translation: Length of link metadata URL is {{ .Length }} characters long, which exceeds the maximum limit of {{ .MaxLength }} characters.
description: API error returned when a link preview metadata URL is too long; {{.Length}} is the actual character count and {{.MaxLength}} the allowed maximum.

translation: Invalid date_from filter. Expected the format "{{.Layout}}".
description: API error (400) returned to a system admin filtering server logs in the System Console when the start-date filter is unparseable. {{.Layout}} is the expected date format pattern (a Go time layout string) and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid date_to filter. Expected the format "{{.Layout}}".
description: API error (400) returned to a system admin filtering server logs in the System Console when the end-date filter is unparseable. {{.Layout}} is the expected date format pattern (a Go time layout string) and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid search filter. It must be at most {{.MaxLength}} characters.
description: API error (400) returned to a system admin searching server logs in the System Console when the search term is too long. {{.MaxLength}} is the maximum number of characters.

translation: Channel name is not valid
description: API error returned when a member invitation includes a channel ID with an invalid format; 'Channel name' refers to a chat channel identifier.

translation: Email list is empty
description: API error returned when a member invitation request contains no email addresses to invite.

translation: Profile email is not in the invited email list
description: API error returned when an invitation profile's email address does not match any of the emails being invited.

translation: Invitation profiles must have unique emails
description: API error returned when two invitation profiles reference the same email address; profiles carry pre-filled account fields for invited users.

translation: Invalid first name in invitation profile
description: API error returned when the first name in an invitation profile exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid last name in invitation profile
description: API error returned when the last name in an invitation profile exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invitation profile cannot be null
description: API error returned when a member invitation request contains a null entry in its list of invitation profiles.

translation: Invalid username in invitation profile
description: API error returned when the username in an invitation profile fails username format rules.

translation: Invitation profiles must have unique usernames
description: API error returned when two invitation profiles use the same username.

translation: Invalid app id.
description: API error returned when validating an OAuth 2.0 app registration and its ID field is malformed; 'app id' is the OAuth application identifier.

translation: Callback URL must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's callback (redirect) URL is missing or not an http(s) URL; keep 'http://' and 'https://' literal.

translation: Invalid client secret.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's client secret is empty or too long; 'client secret' is an OAuth 2.0 term.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's creation timestamp field is zero/unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid creator id.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's creator user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid description.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's description text exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Homepage must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's homepage URL is missing or not an http(s) URL; keep 'http://' and 'https://' literal.

translation: Icon URL must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's icon URL is set but is not a valid http(s) URL; keep 'http://' and 'https://' literal.

translation: The maximum length of MattermostAppID is 32 characters.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's MattermostAppID field is too long; 'MattermostAppID' is a field name and should not be translated.

translation: Invalid name.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's display name is empty or too long.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API error returned when an OAuth app's last-update timestamp field is zero/unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: Invalid client credentials.
description: API error returned during an OAuth 2.0 token exchange when the client ID/secret do not match; 'client credentials' is an OAuth term, audience is app developers.

translation: PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) is required for public clients.
description: API error returned during an OAuth 2.0 token exchange when a public client omits PKCE; keep the acronym 'PKCE' and its expansion, audience is app developers.

translation: Public clients cannot use refresh token grant type.
description: API error returned when a public (secretless) OAuth client attempts the refresh-token grant; 'refresh token' and 'grant type' are OAuth 2.0 terms.

translation: Public clients must not provide a client secret.
description: API error returned when a public OAuth client incorrectly sends a client secret during token exchange; audience is app developers.

translation: Invalid icon.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's icon URL is invalid; 'icon' refers to the webhook's profile image.

translation: Invalid callback URLs.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook has no callback URLs configured; audience is integration developers.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's channel ID is malformed; 'channel' is a chat channel.

translation: Invalid value for content_type.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's content type is unsupported; 'content_type' is a literal field name and should stay untranslated.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's creation timestamp is unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid description.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's description exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid title.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's display name (title) is empty or too long.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's ID field is malformed.

translation: Invalid team ID.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's team ID is malformed; 'team' is a Mattermost workspace team.

translation: Invalid token.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's secret token has an invalid length.

translation: Invalid trigger words.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's trigger words list contains an empty entry; 'trigger words' are the words that fire the webhook when a message starts with them.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's last-update timestamp is unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: Invalid callback URLs. Each must be a valid URL and start with http:// or https://.
description: API error when one of an outgoing webhook's callback URLs is not a valid http(s) URL; keep 'http://' and 'https://' literal.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's creator user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid trigger words.
description: API error when an outgoing webhook's trigger words field itself is empty; same 'trigger words' concept as the webhook trigger configuration.

translation: Invalid username.
description: API error when the override username configured for an outgoing webhook fails username format rules.

translation: Audience must not be empty.
description: API error shown to admins configuring an outgoing OAuth connection when no audience URL is provided; 'Audience' is an OAuth term for the URLs the token is used with.

translation: Audience URL is invalid: {{ .Url }}
description: API error shown to admins configuring an outgoing OAuth connection; {{.Url}} is the rejected audience URL.

translation: Invalid client id.
description: API error shown to admins when an outgoing OAuth connection's client ID is empty or too long.

translation: Invalid client secret.
description: API error shown to admins when an outgoing OAuth connection's client secret is empty or too long.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's creation timestamp is unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid creator id.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's creator user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid grant type.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's grant type is not one of the supported values; 'grant type' is an OAuth 2.0 term.

translation: Invalid id.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's ID field is malformed.

translation: Invalid name.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's display name is empty or too long.

translation: Invalid oauth token url.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's token endpoint URL is empty or invalid.

translation: Invalid password credentials.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection using the password grant has missing username/password credentials.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API error when an outgoing OAuth connection's last-update timestamp is unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: An error occurred while trying to execute this command.
description: Error shown to end users when a plugin-provided slash command fails while executing.

translation: /{{.Command}} command crashed the {{.PluginId}} plugin. Please contact your system administrator
description: Error shown to end users when a slash command crashes its plugin; {{.Command}} is the command name (after a literal /) and {{.PluginId}} the plugin's ID.

translation: Plugin for /{{.Command}} is not working. Please contact your system administrator
description: Error shown to end users when the plugin backing a slash command is not working; {{.Command}} is the command name, rendered after a literal /.

translation: Invalid key, must be more than {{.Min}} and at most {{.Max}} characters long.
description: API error when a plugin key-value store entry's key has an invalid length; {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} are the character limits. Audience is plugin developers.

translation: Invalid plugin ID, must be more than {{.Min}} and at most {{.Max}} characters long.
description: API error when a plugin key-value store entry's plugin ID has an invalid length; {{.Min}} and {{.Max}} are the character limits. Audience is plugin developers.

translation: Invalid old value, it shouldn't be set when the operation is not atomic.
description: API error for plugin key-value store writes when an old (compare) value is supplied for a non-atomic operation; audience is plugin developers.

translation: Channel notifications are disabled in {{.ChannelName}}. The {{.Mention}} did not trigger any notifications.
description: Ephemeral system message to a poster; {{.ChannelName}} is the channel and {{.Mention}} is the mention used (e.g. @channel) that was suppressed by channel settings.

translation: Invalid cursor format: unable to decode base64.
description: API error when a pagination cursor for listing posts cannot be base64-decoded; 'cursor' is a pagination token, audience is API developers.

translation: Invalid cursor format: exclude_system_posts must be a boolean.
description: API error when a post pagination cursor's exclude_system_posts component is not a boolean; 'exclude_system_posts' is a literal field name.

translation: Invalid cursor format: expected 8 parts.
description: API error when a post pagination cursor does not contain the expected number of components; 'parts' means segments of the encoded cursor string.

translation: Invalid cursor format: include_deleted must be a boolean.
description: API error when a post pagination cursor's include_deleted component is not a boolean; 'include_deleted' is a literal field name.

translation: Invalid cursor format: timestamp must be an integer.
description: API error when the timestamp component of a post pagination cursor is not an integer.

translation: Invalid cursor format: version must be an integer.
description: API error when the version component of a post pagination cursor is not an integer.

translation: Unsupported cursor version.
description: API error when a post pagination cursor was created with a cursor format version the server does not support.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API error when saving a post (chat message) whose channel ID is malformed.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error when saving a post whose creation timestamp is unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid file ids. Note that uploads are limited to 10 files maximum. Please use additional posts for more files.
description: API error shown when a post has too many file attachments; 'posts' here are chat messages and the limit is 10 files per message.

translation: Invalid filenames.
description: API error when a post's legacy filenames attachment field fails validation.

translation: Invalid hashtags.
description: API error when a post's hashtags field exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API error when saving a post whose ID field is malformed.

translation: Post Message property is longer than the maximum permitted length.
description: API error shown when a chat message's text is longer than the server allows; 'Post' is the chat message (noun) and 'Message' its text property.

translation: Invalid original id.
description: API error when a post's original ID (reference to the pre-edit version of an edited message) is malformed.

translation: Invalid props.
description: API error when a post's props (attached metadata key-value payload) is too large or invalid; 'props' is a technical field name.

translation: Invalid root id.
description: API error when a post's root ID (the thread's first message) is malformed.

translation: Invalid type.
description: API error when a post's type field is not an allowed post type (e.g. system message types).

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API error when saving a post whose last-update timestamp is unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when saving a post whose author user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid channel id.
description: API error when the channel ID query parameter of a post listing request is malformed; audience is API developers.

translation: Invalid cursor id.
description: API error when the pagination cursor ID query parameter of a post listing request is not a valid post ID.

translation: Invalid sort direction.
description: API error when the sort direction query parameter of a post listing request is neither ascending nor descending.

translation: Invalid time field.
description: API error when the time field query parameter of a post listing request names an unsupported timestamp column.

translation: Invalid category.
description: API error when saving a user preference whose category identifier is empty or too long; 'category' groups related preference settings.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when saving a user preference whose owning user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid value for limit_visible_dms_gms.
description: API error when the preference controlling how many direct/group message conversations show in the sidebar has an out-of-range value; 'limit_visible_dms_gms' is a literal preference name.

translation: Invalid name.
description: API error when saving a user preference whose name identifier is too long; 'name' is the preference key, not a person's name.

translation: Invalid theme.
description: API error when a user's saved color theme preference contains invalid theme JSON.

translation: Value is too long.
description: API error when a user preference's stored value exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid property field: {{.FieldName}} ({{.Reason}}).
description: API error when a custom property field definition (e.g. custom profile attribute) fails validation; {{.FieldName}} is the invalid struct field and {{.Reason}} a short cause phrase.

translation: Invalid property group: {{.FieldName}} ({{.Reason}}).
description: API error when a property group (namespace for custom property fields) fails validation; {{.FieldName}} is the invalid struct field and {{.Reason}} a short cause phrase.

translation: Invalid property value: {{.FieldName}} ({{.Reason}}).
description: API error when a stored property value fails validation; {{.FieldName}} is the invalid struct field and {{.Reason}} a short cause phrase.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error when saving an emoji reaction whose creation timestamp is unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid emoji name.
description: API error when saving an emoji reaction whose emoji name is empty, too long, or has invalid characters.

translation: Invalid post id.
description: API error when saving an emoji reaction that references a malformed post (message) ID.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
