description: API error when saving an emoji reaction whose last-update timestamp is unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when saving an emoji reaction whose reacting user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid remote id.
description: API error when an invitation to connect two Mattermost servers (shared channels) contains a malformed remote server ID.

translation: Invalid site url.
description: API error when an invitation to connect two Mattermost servers contains an invalid site URL for the inviting server.

translation: Invalid token.
description: API error when an invitation to connect two Mattermost servers contains a malformed authentication token.

translation: Date range provided is invalid.
description: API error for admin reporting endpoints when the requested date range value is not one of the supported options; shown to system admins.

translation: Cannot schedule an empty post. Scheduled post must have at least a message or file attachments.
description: API error when trying to schedule a message for later sending that has neither text nor attachments; 'post' is a chat message (noun), 'schedule' is a verb.

translation: Scheduled post must have an ID.
description: API error when a scheduled post (message queued to send later) record lacks an ID.

translation: Invalid processed at time.
description: API error when a scheduled post's processed-at timestamp (when it was actually sent) is negative.

translation: Burn-on-read messages cannot be sent as recurring scheduled posts.
description: Validation error (400) returned to an end user who tries to save a repeating weekly post of Burn-on-read type; Burn-on-Read posts cannot be weekly recurring posts.

translation: Recurring scheduled posts cannot have file attachments.
description: Validation error (400) returned to an end user who tries to save a repeating scheduled post that has files attached; attachments are only allowed on one-off scheduled posts.

translation: Repeat weekly scheduled posts require a valid timezone.
description: Validation error (400) returned to an end user saving a weekly repeating scheduled post without a timezone set, which is needed to pin the recurrence to a local time.

translation: Invalid timezone for recurring scheduled post.
description: Validation error (400) returned to an end user when the timezone supplied for a recurring scheduled post is not a recognized IANA timezone name.

translation: Invalid repeat type for scheduled post.
description: Validation error (400) returned to an end user when the recurrence setting on a scheduled post is not one of the supported repeat options (for example daily or weekly).

translation: Invalid scheduled at time.
description: API error when a scheduled post's scheduled send time is missing or invalid.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap days of week.
description: API error when computing the next delivery time of a scheduled recap (recurring AI-generated channel summary) and its configured weekdays are invalid.

translation: No valid day found for the scheduled recap.
description: API error when no upcoming weekday matches a scheduled recap's recurrence settings; 'recap' is a recurring AI-generated channel summary.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap time format.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's delivery time-of-day string cannot be parsed.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap timezone.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's timezone identifier cannot be resolved while computing the next delivery time.

translation: Scheduled recap must have an agent ID.
description: API error when a scheduled recap lacks an agent ID; 'agent' is the AI bot that generates the recap.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap channel ID.
description: API error when a scheduled recap references a malformed channel ID.

translation: Scheduled recap must include at least one channel when using specific channels.
description: API error when a scheduled recap is set to summarize specific channels but the channel list is empty.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap channel mode.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's channel selection mode is not one of the supported values (e.g. all channels vs. specific channels).

translation: Scheduled recap custom instructions exceed the maximum length.
description: API error when the free-form custom instructions text given to the AI for a scheduled recap is too long.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap days of week.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's configured weekdays for delivery are invalid.

translation: Scheduled recap must have an ID.
description: API error when a scheduled recap record lacks an ID.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap time of day.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's configured delivery time of day is invalid.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap time period.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's summarized time period setting is not one of the supported values.

translation: Invalid scheduled recap timezone.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's timezone setting is invalid.

translation: Scheduled recap title cannot be empty.
description: API error when a scheduled recap is saved without a title.

translation: Scheduled recap title exceeds the maximum length.
description: API error when a scheduled recap's title is longer than allowed.

translation: Scheduled recap must have a user ID.
description: API error when a scheduled recap lacks the owning user's ID.

translation: Invalid scheme.
description: Validation error when a permission scheme record contains invalid data; 'scheme' is the permissions scheme feature.

translation: All IncludeDeletedChannels params should have the same value.
description: API error for message search when mixed search parameters disagree on including archived channels; 'IncludeDeletedChannels' is a literal parameter name, audience is API developers.

translation: Invalid CreateAt field for session.
description: API error when a login session record has an unset creation timestamp; 'CreateAt' is the field name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Invalid Id field for session.
description: API error when a login session record's ID field is malformed; 'Id' is the field name.

translation: Invalid session roles longer than {{.Limit}} characters.
description: API error when the roles string stored on a login session exceeds the length limit; {{.Limit}} is the maximum character count.

translation: Invalid UserId field for session.
description: API error when a login session record's UserId field is malformed; 'UserId' is the field name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Name must be 2 or more lowercase alphanumeric characters.
description: API error when a team's URL name violates format rules; 'Name' here is the team's URL slug, and the constraint text (lowercase alphanumeric) should be kept precise.

translation: Invalid company name.
description: API error when a team's company name field is too long.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error when a team record's creation timestamp is unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid description.
description: API error when a team's description text is too long.

translation: Invalid allowed domains.
description: API error when a team's allowed email domains list (restricting who can join) is too long; 'domains' are email domains.

translation: Invalid email.
description: API error when a team's contact email address is invalid.

translation: Invalid Id.
description: API error when a team record's ID field is malformed.

translation: Invalid invite id.
description: API error when a team's invite ID (code used in invitation links) is empty.

translation: Invalid name.
description: API error when a team's display name is empty or too long.

translation: This URL is unavailable. Please try another.
description: Error shown to end users creating or renaming a team when the chosen URL slug is a reserved word; asks them to pick a different one.

translation: Invalid type.
description: API error when a team's type field is not one of the allowed values (open vs. invite-only).

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API error when a team record's last-update timestamp is unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: Invalid URL Identifier.
description: API error when a team's URL identifier (the slug used in web addresses) fails format rules.

translation: Invalid team member roles longer than {{.Limit}} characters.
description: API error when the roles string stored on a team membership exceeds the length limit; {{.Limit}} is the maximum character count.

translation: Invalid team ID.
description: API error when a team membership record's team ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when a team membership record's user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid post ID.
description: API error when a thread record's root post ID is malformed; a 'thread' is a reply chain on a message.

translation: Invalid user ID.
description: API error when a thread-following record's user ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid token expiry
description: API error when a one-time server token (e.g. email verification or invite token) has an invalid creation/expiry time.

translation: Invalid token.
description: API error when a one-time server token's value has the wrong length; 'token' is an authentication token, not a UI element.

translation: Invalid language code. Use a standard ISO code such as 'en', 'ja', or 'fr'.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the target language code is not a recognized ISO code; 'en', 'ja', 'fr' are literal examples.

translation: Translation object cannot be null.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the translation record being saved is null/missing.

translation: Invalid object id.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the ID of the object being translated (e.g. a post) is malformed.

translation: Invalid object JSON.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the translated object's JSON payload cannot be parsed.

translation: Invalid object type.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the type of object being translated is not a recognized value.

translation: Invalid translation provider.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the configured translation provider (backend service) is not recognized.

translation: Invalid translation text.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the text to translate is missing or invalid.

translation: Invalid translation type.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature when the translation record's type field is missing or invalid.

translation: Invalid translation type. Must be 'string' or 'object'.
description: API validation error for the automatic message translation feature; 'string' and 'object' are literal type values and must not be translated.

translation: Invalid value for ChannelId.
description: API error when a resumable file upload session has a malformed channel ID; 'ChannelId' is the field name and can stay untranslated.

translation: Invalid value for CreateAt
description: API error when a resumable file upload session's creation timestamp is unset; 'CreateAt' is the field name.

translation: Invalid value for FileOffset
description: API error when a resumable file upload session's byte offset is negative or beyond the file size; 'FileOffset' is the field name.

translation: Invalid value for FileSize
description: API error when a resumable file upload session's declared file size is negative; 'FileSize' is the field name.

translation: Invalid value for Filename
description: API error when a resumable file upload session has an empty file name; 'Filename' is the field name.

translation: Invalid value for Id
description: API error when a resumable file upload session's ID is malformed; 'Id' is the field name.

translation: Invalid value for Path
description: API error when a resumable file upload session has an empty storage path; 'Path' is the field name.

translation: Invalid value for Type
description: API error when a resumable file upload session's type is neither an attachment nor an import upload; 'Type' is the field name.

translation: Invalid Value for UserId
description: API error when a resumable file upload session's user ID is malformed; 'UserId' is the field name.

translation: Invalid auth data.
description: API error when a user account's external authentication data field is too long; 'auth data' is the identifier from an SSO provider.

translation: Invalid user, password and auth data cannot both be set.
description: API error when a user account has both a password and external SSO auth data set, which is not allowed.

translation: Invalid user: Auth data can only be set if the user uses an external auth service, not email/password, for authentication.
description: API error when SSO auth data is set on a user without an auth service; 'auth service' means an external login provider such as SAML or LDAP.

translation: Create at must be a valid time.
description: API error when a user account's creation timestamp is unset; 'Create at' names the CreateAt field.

translation: Invalid email.
description: API error when a user account's email address fails validation; may surface during signup or profile editing.

translation: Invalid first name.
description: API error when a user's first name exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when a user record's ID field is malformed.

translation: Invalid props (custom status)
description: API error when a user account's props field contains an invalid custom status entry; 'props' and 'custom status' are the user-set status message feature.

translation: Invalid last name.
description: API error when a user's last name exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid locale.
description: API error when a user's language/locale setting is not a recognized locale code.

translation: Failed to encode field to JSON
description: Internal API error when a user account field cannot be serialized to JSON during validation; audience is developers/admins.

translation: Invalid mention_keys: exceeds the limit of {{.MaxCount}} keys or {{.MaxLength}} bytes.
description: API error when a user's mention keywords exceed the allowed number of keys or total length; surfaces when saving notification settings.

translation: Invalid nickname.
description: API error when a user's nickname exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Unable to set a password over 72 characters due to the limitations of bcrypt.
description: API error when a password over 72 characters is set; 'bcrypt' is the hashing algorithm name and stays untranslated.

translation: Invalid position: must not be longer than 128 characters.
description: API error when a user's position (job title shown on their profile) is longer than 128 characters; 'position' means job role, not location.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter.
description: Password requirement error shown on signup/password change when lowercase letters are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter and at least one number.
description: Password requirement error when lowercase letters and numbers are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter, at least one number, and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when lowercase letters and symbols are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter and at least one uppercase letter.
description: Password requirement error when lowercase and uppercase letters are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter, at least one uppercase letter, and at least one number.
description: Password requirement error when lowercase letters, uppercase letters, and numbers are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter, at least one uppercase letter, at least one number, and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when all character classes (lowercase, uppercase, number, symbol) are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one lowercase letter, at least one uppercase letter, and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when lowercase letters, uppercase letters, and symbols are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain no more than 72 characters.
description: Password requirement error shown when the entered password exceeds the 72-character maximum.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters.
description: Password requirement error shown when the entered password is too short; {{.Min}} is the minimum character count.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one number.
description: Password requirement error when at least one number is required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one number and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when numbers and symbols are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when at least one symbol is required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one uppercase letter.
description: Password requirement error when uppercase letters are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one uppercase letter and at least one number.
description: Password requirement error when uppercase letters and numbers are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum password length.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one uppercase letter, at least one number, and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when uppercase letters, numbers, and symbols are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Your password must contain at least {{.Min}} characters made up of at least one uppercase letter and at least one symbol (e.g. "~!@#$%^&*()").
description: Password requirement error when uppercase letters and symbols are required; {{.Min}} is the minimum length and the quoted symbols are literal examples.

translation: Invalid user roles longer than {{.Limit}} characters.
description: API error when the roles string stored on a user account exceeds the length limit; {{.Limit}} is the maximum character count.

translation: Update at must be a valid time.
description: API error when a user record's last-update timestamp is unset; 'Update at' names the UpdateAt field.

translation: Username must begin with a letter, and contain between 3 to 22 lowercase characters made up of numbers, letters, and the symbols ".", "-", and "_".
description: Error shown on signup or username change describing the username format rules; the quoted symbols are the literal allowed characters and should stay as-is.

translation: There was an internal error saving the password.
description: Generic error shown to end users when hashing their password fails server-side while saving the account; deliberately vague internal error.

translation: Your password must contain no more than 72 characters.
description: Error shown to end users when the password they entered exceeds 72 characters (a bcrypt limit); appears during registration or password change.

translation: Invalid description, must be 255 or less characters.
description: API error when a personal access token's description exceeds 255 characters; the description is the user-supplied label for the token.

translation: Invalid expires_at, must be zero or a positive Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
description: API error when a personal access token's expiry timestamp is invalid; 'expires_at' is a literal field name, zero means no expiry.

translation: Invalid value for id.
description: API error when a personal access token record's ID is malformed.

translation: Invalid access token.
description: API error when a personal access token's secret value has an invalid length; 'access token' is the credential itself.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: API error when a personal access token's owning user ID is malformed.

translation: Provided guest filter is not valid.
description: API error for the admin user report when the guest role filter parameter is invalid; 'guest' is the limited-access user role.

translation: Provided sort column is not valid.
description: API error for the admin user report when the requested sort column is not supported.

translation: could not decode.
description: Generic low-level error when JSON data cannot be decoded; terse developer-facing message.

translation: Invalid view channel ID.
description: API error when a saved channel view (custom list/kanban layout) references a malformed channel ID; 'view' is a noun (a saved data view).

translation: Invalid view create time.
description: API error when a saved view's creation timestamp is unset; 'view' is a saved data view (noun).

translation: Invalid view creator ID.
description: API error when a saved view's creator user ID is malformed.

translation: View description is too long.
description: API error when a saved view's description text exceeds the maximum length.

translation: Invalid view ID.
description: API error when a saved view record's ID is malformed; 'view' is a saved data view (noun).

translation: Kanban column has an invalid or missing ID.
description: API error when validating a kanban-type view whose column definition lacks a valid ID; 'Kanban' is the board layout style and stays untranslated.

translation: Kanban column name must not be empty.
description: API error when a kanban view's column is defined with an empty name; the name is the column's heading on the board.

translation: Kanban column must have at least one option ID.
description: API error when a kanban view's column maps to no property option IDs; 'option ID' refers to the select-field option each column groups by.

translation: Kanban view must have at least one column.
description: API error when a kanban view is saved with no columns defined.

translation: Kanban view exceeds the maximum number of columns.
description: API error when a kanban view defines more columns than the allowed maximum.

translation: Kanban view must reference a valid property field ID.
description: API error when a kanban view's group-by configuration does not reference a valid property field ID.

translation: Kanban view has invalid props structure.
description: API error when a kanban view's props JSON does not match the expected structure; 'props' is a technical field name.

translation: Kanban view requires props with a group_by configuration.
description: API error when a kanban view is missing the required group-by configuration; 'group_by' is a literal configuration key.

translation: View title is required and must be less than 256 characters.
description: API error when a saved view's title is empty or exceeds the length limit; the title is the view's display name.

translation: Invalid view type.
description: API error when a saved view's type is not one of the supported layouts (e.g. list, kanban).

translation: Invalid view update time.
description: API error when a saved view's last-update timestamp is unset.

translation: Unable to connect to the WebSocket server.
description: Error from the Go WebSocket client library when it cannot establish a connection to the Mattermost WebSocket endpoint; audience is developers/CLI users.

translation: GitLab's Terms of Service have updated. Please go to {{.URL}} to accept them and then try logging into Mattermost again.
description: Login error for GitLab SSO users who must accept GitLab's updated Terms of Service; {{.URL}} is the GitLab ToS page link. Keep 'GitLab' and 'Mattermost' as product names.

translation: Unable to get the followers of the thread.
description: Error returned to plugins when GetThreadFollowers cannot read the thread's followers from the database; developer-facing.

translation: Unable to get the users, invalid sorting criteria.
description: Error returned to plugins when listing channel users is called with an unsupported sort option; developer-facing.

translation: The server does not support listing plugin keys with options.
description: Error a plugin receives when it lists its key-value store keys with filter options on a server version that does not support that API. The plugin library then falls back to listing all keys.

translation: Unable to list plugin keys with options.
description: Error a plugin receives when the call from the plugin process to the server fails while it lists its key-value store keys with filter options.

translation: Invalid thread id.
description: Error returned to plugins when GetThreadFollowers or SetThreadFollowing is called with a thread id that is not a valid Mattermost id; developer-facing.

translation: Invalid user id.
description: Error returned to plugins when SetThreadFollowing is called with a user id that is not a valid Mattermost id; developer-facing.

translation: The post is a reply, not the root post of a thread.
description: Error returned to plugins when SetThreadFollowing is called with the id of a reply instead of a thread's root post; developer-facing.

translation: Invalid mm_blocks_actions in plugin post update.
description: Error returned to plugins when a post update contains invalid 'mm_blocks_actions' data (interactive blocks); developer-facing, keep the property name untranslated.

translation: Invalid file creator.
description: Error returned to plugins when UpdatePostWithOptions is called with a FileCreatorID that is not a valid Mattermost user id; developer-facing.

translation: Unable to set the user status. Unknown user status.
description: Error returned to plugins when setting a user's status to an unrecognized value (valid ones are online/away/dnd/offline); developer-facing.

translation: Bot user cannot create bot user.
description: Error returned when a bot account calls the API to create another bot account, which is not allowed.

translation: Notify props cannot be set on space channels.
description: Error returned to plugins when trying to set notification properties on a 'space' type channel; 'space' is a channel type name.

translation: Public links have been disabled.
description: Error returned when requesting a public file link while the admin has disabled public links.

translation: Unable to get public link for file. File must be attached to a post that can be read.
description: Error returned when requesting a public link for a file that isn't attached to a readable post ('post' = chat message).

translation: Missing HTML Body.
description: Error returned to plugins calling the send-email API without an HTML body; developer-facing.

translation: Missing email subject.
description: Error returned to plugins calling the send-email API without a subject line; developer-facing.

translation: Missing TO address.
description: Error returned to plugins calling the send-email API without a recipient (TO) address; developer-facing.

translation: Missing manifest
description: API error for the plugin reattach developer endpoint when the request lacks a plugin manifest; audience is plugin developers.

translation: Missing plugin reattach config
description: API error for the plugin reattach developer endpoint when the request lacks the reattach configuration; audience is plugin developers.

translation: This channel is no longer shared with {{.WorkspaceName}}.
description: System message posted in a channel when sharing with a remote Mattermost instance ends; {{.WorkspaceName}} is the remote instance's display name.

translation: This channel is no longer shared with another workspace.
description: System message posted in a channel when it stops being shared with another Mattermost server and the remote workspace's name is unknown; 'workspace' is the other server.

translation: This channel is now shared with {{.WorkspaceName}}.
description: System message posted in a channel when it starts being shared with a remote Mattermost instance; {{.WorkspaceName}} is the remote instance's display name.

translation: One or more posts could not be delivered to remote site {{.Remote}} because it is offline. The post(s) will be delivered when the site is online.
description: Ephemeral notice in a shared channel when messages cannot be synced to a remote site; {{.Remote}} is the remote Mattermost instance's name; 'posts' are messages.

translation: This post contains permalinks to other channels which may not be visible to users in other sites.
description: Note appended to a message synced to a shared channel when it contains permalinks (links to posts) that users on other connected sites may not be able to open.

translation: Bot does not exist.
description: API error when the requested bot account does not exist.

translation: Unable to find the existing channel.
description: API error returned when a channel referenced by a group operation does not exist.

translation: You can not modify an archived channel.
description: API error returned when trying to change or post to a channel that has been archived; archived channels are read-only.

translation: Use SaveDirectChannel to create a direct channel.
description: Developer-facing API error when regular channel-save code is used for a direct message channel; 'SaveDirectChannel' is a function name and should not be translated.

translation: Must call update for existing channel.
description: Developer-facing API error when channel-create code is called for a channel that already exists; 'update' refers to the update API.

translation: A channel with that name already exists on the same team.
description: API error when creating or renaming a channel fails because another channel in the same team already uses that name.

translation: You've reached the limit of the number of allowed channels.
description: API error returned when creating a channel would exceed the server's maximum number of channels per team.

translation: Not a direct channel attempted to be created with SaveDirectChannel.
description: Developer-facing API error when the direct-channel save function is used for a non-direct channel; 'SaveDirectChannel' is a function name.

translation: Command does not exist.
description: API error returned when the requested slash command integration does not exist.

translation: Unable to get the command.
description: API error returned when a custom slash command cannot be fetched from the database; 'command' is a slash command.

translation: Command does not exist.
description: API error returned when updating a slash command integration that no longer exists.

translation: Searching files has been disabled on this server. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: API error shown when a user tries to search files while file search is disabled on the server; directs them to their System Administrator.

translation: Searching has been disabled on this server. Please contact your System Administrator.
description: Error shown to end users trying to search messages when the admin has disabled search on the server.

translation: A team member with that ID already exists.
description: API/database error returned when adding someone to a team who is already a member; 'ID' is the member's identifier.

translation: A team with this URL already exists.
description: API error when creating a team fails because a team with the same URL handle already exists.

translation: Unable to find an existing account matching your credentials. This team may require an invite from the team owner to join.
description: Login failure message shown to end users when no account matches the entered credentials; mentions team invites because it appears during team sign-in flows.

translation: System
description: Display name used as the sender for automated system messages (in place of a username) in notifications; keep short.

translation: Couldn't find the command {{.command_id}}.
description: API error when the slash command that a response webhook belongs to cannot be found; {{.command_id}} is the command's database ID.

translation: Failed to handle command webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when handling a slash command's delayed response webhook fails; {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: Unable to parse incoming data for webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when the payload sent to a slash command response webhook cannot be parsed; {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: Get the latest Chrome browser
description: Link/button text on the 'unsupported browser' page prompting the user to download the newest version of Chrome.

translation: Get the latest Firefox browser
description: Link/button text on the 'unsupported browser' page prompting the user to download the newest version of Firefox.

translation: Get the latest Safari browser
description: Link/button text on the 'unsupported browser' page prompting the user to update to the newest version of Safari.

translation: Google Chrome
description: Browser product name shown on a download card of the 'unsupported browser' page; usually left untranslated.

translation: Microsoft Edge
description: Browser product name shown on a download card of the 'unsupported browser' page; usually left untranslated.

translation: Firefox
description: Browser product name shown on a download card of the 'unsupported browser' page; usually left untranslated.

translation: Safari
description: Browser product name shown on a download card of the 'unsupported browser' page; usually left untranslated.

translation: Download the App
description: Button label on the 'unsupported browser' page for downloading the Mattermost desktop app; 'App' refers to the desktop application.

translation: Download the Mattermost app or use a supported browser for a better experience.
description: Subtitle text on the full-page 'unsupported browser' screen suggesting alternatives; end-user facing, shown before login.

translation: Download the App
description: Button label on the 'unsupported browser' page linking to the desktop/mobile app download; compact.

translation: Install Guide
description: Link text on the 'unsupported browser' page pointing to the macOS desktop app installation guide.

translation: Install Guide
description: Link text on the 'unsupported browser' page pointing to the Windows desktop app installation guide.

translation: Learn more about supported browsers.
description: Link text on the 'unsupported browser' page leading to documentation about supported browsers.

translation: Version 156+
description: Compact version requirement label on the Chrome card of the 'unsupported browser' page; the number is the minimum Chrome version.

translation: Version 156+
description: Compact version requirement label on the Edge card of the 'unsupported browser' page; the number is the minimum Edge version.

translation: Version 153+
description: Compact version requirement label on the Firefox card of the 'unsupported browser' page; the number is the minimum Firefox version.

translation: Version 27+
description: Compact version requirement label on the Safari card of the 'unsupported browser' page; the number is the minimum Safari version.

translation: macOS 15+
description: Compact OS requirement label on the desktop app card of the 'unsupported browser' page; states the minimum macOS version.

translation: Windows 11+
description: Compact OS requirement label on the desktop app card of the 'unsupported browser' page; states the minimum Windows version.

translation: This browser is no longer supported by Mattermost
description: Main heading of the full-page error shown when someone opens Mattermost in an outdated/unsupported web browser.

translation: This version of your browser is no longer supported by Mattermost
description: Headline on the full-page error shown when someone opens Mattermost in an outdated browser version.

translation: Open Edge
description: Button label on the 'unsupported browser' page that opens the site in the system's Edge browser; 'Edge' is the browser name.

translation: Make default
description: Short link/button on the 'unsupported browser' page for setting the suggested browser as the system default; compact space.

translation: or
description: The lone conjunction 'or' shown between two alternative actions (open browser / make default) on the 'unsupported browser' page.

translation: Contact your system administrator if you need further assistance.
description: Closing line on the full-page error shown when the user's Mattermost desktop app version is too old.

translation: Download Updated App
description: Button label on the outdated desktop app error page linking to the newest desktop app download.

translation: About
description: Footer link on the outdated desktop app error page leading to the About page.

translation: Help
description: Footer link on the outdated desktop app error page leading to help/documentation.

translation: Privacy Policy
description: Footer link on the outdated desktop app error page leading to the privacy policy.

translation: Terms
description: Footer link on the outdated desktop app error page leading to the terms of service; compact space.

translation: Your {{.SiteName}} Desktop App version ({{.CurrentVersion}}) is below the minimum required version ({{.MinimumVersion}}). Please update your app or open {{.SiteName}} in a web browser to continue.
description: Body text of the outdated desktop app error page; {{.SiteName}} is the server's site name, {{.CurrentVersion}} the user's app version, {{.MinimumVersion}} the required version.

translation: Update Required
description: Heading of the full-page error shown when the Mattermost desktop app version is below the server's minimum; 'update' refers to updating the app.

translation: Unable to update the user access data.
description: OAuth token endpoint error when updating stored access data in the database fails.

translation: Couldn't find the channel.
description: API error returned to an incoming webhook request when the target channel cannot be found.

translation: This webhook is not permitted to post to the requested channel {{.channel_id}}
description: API error returned when an incoming webhook that is locked to one channel receives a request targeting a different channel; {{.channel_id}} is the requested channel's ID.

translation: Failed to decode the payload of media type {{.media_type}} for incoming webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when an incoming webhook payload cannot be decoded; {{.media_type}} is a MIME type like 'application/json' and {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: Incoming webhooks have been disabled by the system admin.
description: API error returned to the external caller of an incoming webhook URL when the admin has disabled incoming webhooks.

translation: Failed to handle the payload of media type {{.media_type}} for incoming webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when processing an incoming webhook request fails; {{.media_type}} is the request's MIME type and {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: Invalid webhook.
description: API error returned when the incoming webhook ID in the request URL does not match any webhook.

translation: Failed to parse media type for incoming webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when the Content-Type of an incoming webhook request cannot be parsed; {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: Unable to parse incoming data.
description: API error returned when the payload posted to an incoming webhook URL cannot be parsed as JSON or form data.

translation: Failed to parse form for webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when the URL-encoded form body of an incoming webhook request cannot be parsed; {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: Failed to parse multipart form for webhook {{.hook_id}}.
description: API error when the multipart form body of an incoming webhook request cannot be parsed; {{.hook_id}} is the webhook's ID.

translation: User {{.user}} does not have appropriate permissions to channel {{.channel}}
description: API error when the webhook's assigned user lacks permission to post in the target channel; {{.user}} is a user ID and {{.channel}} is a channel ID.

translation: Unable to split webhook props into {{.Max}} character parts.
description: API error when a webhook post's attachment props are too large to split into database-sized chunks; {{.Max}} is the maximum character count per chunk.

translation: No text specified.
description: API error returned when an incoming webhook request contains no message text or attachments.

translation: Couldn't find the user {{.user}}
description: API error when the user record tied to an incoming webhook cannot be found; {{.user}} is a user ID.
